output: I entreat Thee by Thy Name through which Thou didst cause the dawn to appear, and the winds to blow, and the seas to surge, and the trees to bring forth their fruits, and the earth to be beautified with its rivers, that Thou wilt aid all them that are dear to Thee with both Thy visible and invisible hosts.

input: ثمّ اغلبهم علی الّذین بغوا فی ارضک و هتکوا حرمتک و کفروا بآیاتک و نقضوا میثاقک و نبذوا احکامک و قاموا بالمحاربة الی ان جعلوا اساری اهلک و حبسوا مظهر ذاتک و مطلع کینونتک فی اخرب البلاد.
output: Render them, moreover, victorious over all those who have so rebelled in Thy land, and dishonored Thy name, and disbelieved in Thy signs, and broken Thy Covenant, and cast behind their backs Thy laws, and have to such an extent risen up against Thee, that they carried into captivity Thy kindred, and flung the Manifestation of Thy Self into prison, and immured Him Who is the Dayspring of Thine Essence in the most desolate of cities.

input: ای ربّ انت القویّ القدیر و ذو الأمر الشّدید.
output: Thou, O my Lord, art He whose strength is immense, Whose decree is terrible.

input: خذ اعدائک بسلطانک ثمّ اجمع احبّائک فی ظلّ سدرة فردانیّتک لیحضرنّ تلقآء عرشک و یستمعنّ نغماتک و ینظرنّ جمالک و یعرفنّ اقتدارک.
output: Lay hold on Thine adversaries by the power of Thy sovereignty, and assemble Thy loved ones beneath the shadow of the tree of Thy oneness, that they may stand before Thy throne, and catch the accents of Thy voice, and gaze on Thy beauty, and discover the power of Thy might.

input: انّک انت المقتدر القدیر.
output: Thou art, verily, the All Powerful, the Almighty.

input: قد اخذتنی نفحات وصلک علی شأن نسیت نفسی و ما عندی.
output: I am so carried away by the breezes blowing from Thy presence that I have forgotten my self and all that I possess.

input: ان هذا الّا من بدایع فضلک و مواهبک.
output: This is but a sign of the wonders of Thy grace and bountiful favors vouchsafed unto me.

input: لک الحمد یا الهی علی ما اصطفیتنی بین بریّتک و جعلتنی مطلع قوّتک و مظهر قدرتک و اظهرت منّی من آیاتک و شؤونات عظمتک و اقتدارک ما عجز عنها من فی ارضک و سمائک.
output: I give praise to Thee, O my God, that Thou hast chosen me out of all Thy creatures, and made me to be the Dayspring of Thy strength and the Manifestation of Thy might, and empowered me to reveal such of Thy signs and such tokens of Thy majesty and power as none, whether in Thy heaven or on Thy earth, can produce.

input: ای ربّ اسألک باسمک الأبهی بأن تعرّف اهل البهآء ما قدّرت لهم.
output: I beseech Thee, O my Lord, by Thy most effulgent Name, to acquaint my people with the things Thou didst destine for them.

input: ثمّ احفظهم فی حصن ولایتک و سرادق عصمتک لئلّا یظهر منهم ما یختلف به عبادک.
output: Do Thou, then, preserve them within the stronghold of Thy guardianship and the tabernacle of Thine unerring protection, lest through them may appear what will divide Thy servants.

input: ای ربّ فاجمعهم علی شاطئ هذا البحر الّذی کلّ قطرة منه تنادی بأنّک انت اللّه لا اله الّا انا العزیز الحکیم.
output: Assemble them, O my Lord, on the shores of this Ocean, every drop of which proclaimeth Thee to be God, besides Whom there is none other God, the All Glorious, the All Wise.

input: ای ربّ عرّفهم عظمة امرک لئلّا یشتبه علیهم سلطنتک و اقتدارک.
output: Uncover before them, O my Lord, the majesty of Thy Cause, lest they be led to doubt Thy sovereignty and the power of Thy might.

input: فوعزّتک یا محبوب العالمین.
output: I swear by Thy glory, O Thou Who art the Beloved of the worlds.

input: لو عرفوا ما تکلّموا بما لا قدّرت لهم فی سمآء مشیّتک.
output: Had they been aware of Thy power they would of a certainty have refused to utter what Thou didst not ordain for them in the heaven of Thy will.

input: ای ربّ فألهمهم عجز انفسهم تلقآء مظهر نفسک و علّمهم فقر ذواتهم لدی ظهورات غنائک و استغنائک لیجمعوا علی امرک و یتشبّثوا بذیل رحمتک و یتمسّکوا بحبل ارادتک.
output: Inspire them, O my Lord, with a sense of their own powerlessness before Him Who is the Manifestation of Thy Self, and teach them to recognize the poverty of their own nature in the face of the manifold tokens of Thy self sufficiency and riches, that they may gather together round Thy Cause, and cling to the hem of Thy mercy, and cleave to the cord of the good pleasure of Thy will.

input: انّک انت مولی العالمین و ارحم الرّاحمین.
output: Thou art the Lord of the worlds, and of all those who show mercy, art the Most Merciful.

input: سبحانک یا مالک القدم و خالق الأمم و مصوّر الرّمم.
output: Glory be to Thee, O King of eternity, and the Maker of nations, and the Fashioner of every moldering bone.

input: اسألک باسمک الّذی به نادیت الکلّ الی افق عظمتک و اجلالک و هدیت العباد الی شطر فضلک و الطافک بأن تجعلنی من الّذین انقطعوا عمّا سواک و اقبلوا الیک و ما منعهم سوء القضآء عن شطر مواهبک.
output: I pray Thee, by Thy Name through which Thou didst call all mankind unto the horizon of Thy majesty and glory, and didst guide Thy servants to the court of Thy grace and favors, to number me with such as have rid themselves from everything except Thyself, and have set themselves towards Thee, and have not been kept back by such misfortunes as were decreed by Thee, from turning in the direction of Thy gifts.

input: ای ربّ قد تمسّکت بعروة جودک و تشبّثت بذیل ردآء مکرمتک.
output: I have laid hold, O my Lord, on the handle of Thy bounty, and clung steadfastly to the hem of the robe of Thy favor.

input: فأنزل علیّ من سحاب کرمک ما یطهّرنی عن ذکر دونک و یجعلنی مقبلةً الی قبلة الآفاق الّذی اجتمع علیه اهل النّفاق الّذین نقضوا المیثاق و کفروا بک و بآیاتک.
output: Send down, then, upon me, out of the clouds of Thy generosity, what will purge out from me the remembrance of any one except Thee, and make me able to turn unto Him Who is the Object of the adoration of all mankind, against Whom have been arrayed the stirrers of sedition, who have broken Thy covenant, and disbelieved in Thee and in Thy signs.

input: ای ربّ لا تحرمنی من نفحات قمیصک فی ایّامک و لا من فوحات وحیک عند ظهور انوار وجهک.
output: Deny me not, O my Lord, the fragrances of Thy raiment in Thy days, and deprive me not of the breathings of Thy Revelation at the appearance of the splendors of the light of Thy face.

input: لا مانع لمشیّتک و لا رادّ لما اردته بقدرتک.
output: Naught can resist Thy will, nor frustrate what Thou hast purposed by Thy power.

input: اشهد انّک انت کنت کنزاً مکنوناً فی غیب ذاتیّتک و رمزاً مخزوناً فی کینونتک.
output: I testify that Thou wast a hidden Treasure wrapped within Thine immemorial Being and an impenetrable Mystery enshrined in Thine own Essence.

input: فلمّا اردت ان تعرف فخلقت العالم الاکبر و الاصغر و اخترت منهما الانسان و جعلته حاکیاً عنهما یا ربّنا الرّحمن.
output: Wishing to reveal Thyself, Thou didst call into being the Greater and the Lesser Worlds, and didst choose Man above all Thy creatures, and didst make Him a sign of both of these worlds, O Thou Who art our Lord, the Most Compassionate.

input: و اقمته مقام نفسک بین ملأ الاکوان.
output: Thou didst raise Him up to occupy Thy throne before all the people of Thy creation.

input: و جعلته مطلع اسرارک و مشرق وحیک و الهامک و مظهر اسمائک و صفاتک.
output: Thou didst enable Him to unravel Thy mysteries, and to shine with the lights of Thine inspiration and Thy Revelation, and to manifest Thy names and Thine attributes.

input: الّذی به زیّنت دیباج کتاب الابداع یا مالک الاختراع.
output: Through Him Thou didst adorn the preamble of the book of Thy creation, O Thou Who art the Ruler of the universe Thou hast fashioned.

input: و اشهد انّه لهو الجار المنجمد و المنجمد الجار.
output: I bear witness that in His person solidity and fluidity have been joined and combined.

input: لانّ بسکونه علی امرک و استقراره علی ما اریته فی ریاض المکاشفة و الشّهود عند تجلّی انوار احدیّتک قد تحرّکت العباد شوقاً الی ملکوتک و سرع من فی البلاد مقبلاً الی جبروتک
output: Through His immovable constancy in Thy Cause, and His unwavering adherence to whatsoever Thou, in the plentitude of the light of Thy glory, didst unveil to His eyes, throughout the domains of Thy Revelation and creation, the souls of Thy servants were stirred up in their longing for Thy Kingdom, and the dwellers of Thy realms rushed forth to enter into Thy heavenly dominion.

input: و بحرکته فی سبیلک استقام المخلصون بارجل حدیدة لاظهار امرک بین خلقک و ابراز سلطنتک فی مملکتک.
output: Through the restlessness He evinced in Thy path, the feet of all them that are devoted to Thee were steeled and confirmed to manifest Thy Cause amidst Thy creatures, and to demonstrate Thy sovereignty throughout Thy realm.

input: ما اعظم یا الهی هذا الصّنع الاکبر و ما اکمل هذا الخلق الّذی منه تحیّرت افئدة اهل العبر و الفکر.
output: How great, O my God, is this Thy most excellent handiwork, and how consummate Thy creation, which hath caused every understanding heart and mind to marvel.

input: فلمّا اتی المیقات و ظهر القضآء بعد القدر بالامضآء انطقته بثنائک و اسرارک بین ملأ الانشآء یا مالک الاسمآء و فاطر الارض و السّمآء.
output: And when the set time was fulfilled, and what had been preordained came to pass, Thou didst unloose His tongue to praise Thee, and to lay bare Thy mysteries before all Thy creation, O Thou Who art the Possessor of all names, and the Fashioner of earth and heaven.

input: و به نطق کلّ شیء بذکرک و ثنائک و توجّه کلّ نفس الی ملکوت امرک و سلطانک.
output: Through Him all created things were made to glorify Thee, and to celebrate Thy praise, and every soul was directed towards the kingdom of Thy revelation and Thy sovereignty.

input: مرّة اظهرته یا الهی و زیّنت هیکله بطراز اسم الکلیم و اظهرت منه ما اردته بمشیّتک و قدّرته بتقدیرک.
output: At one time, Thou didst raise Him up, O my God, and didst attire Him with the ornament of the name of Him Who conversed with Thee Moses, and didst through Him uncover all that Thy will had decreed and Thine irrevocable purpose ordained.

input: و طوراً زیّنته باسم الرّوح و انزلته من سمآء مشیّتک لتربیة بریّتک و به نفخت روح الحیوان فی افئدة المقبلین من خلقک و المخلصین من عبادک.
output: At another time, Thou didst adorn Him with the name of Him Who was Thy Spirit Jesus, and didst send Him down out of the heaven of Thy will, for the edification of Thy people, infusing thereby the spirit of life into the hearts of the sincere among Thy servants and the faithful among Thy creatures.

input: و تارة اظهرته بطراز اسم الحبیب و اشرقته من افق الحجاز اظهاراً لامرک و ابرازاً لقدرتک.
output: Again, Thou didst reveal Him, decked forth by the name of Him Who was Thy Friend Muhammad, and caused Him to shine brightly above the horizon of Hijáz, as a token of Thy power and an evidence of Thy might.

input: و بلّغت به العباد ما یجعلهم مرتقیاً الی معارج توحیدک و مرتقباً بدایع علومک و حکمک.
output: Through Him Thou didst send unto Thy servants what enabled them to scale the heights of Thy unity, and to yearn over the wonders of Thy manifold knowledge and wisdom.

input: اشهد یا اله العالمین و مقصود القاصدین بانّ مثلهم بین خلقک کمثل الشّمس کلّما تطلع و تغرب انّها هی شمس واحدة.
output: I testify, O Thou Who art the Lord of the whole creation, and the Desire of whosoever hath sought Thee, that, amidst Thy creatures, They resemble the sun which no matter how often it riseth and setteth is still the one and the same sun.

input: من یری الفرق انّه ما بلغ الی الغایة القصوی و ما فاز بالذّروة العلیا و منع عن اسرار التّوحید و انوار التّجرید و التّفرید.
output: Whoso maketh any distinction between any of Them hath truly failed to attain the ultimate purpose, and to reach the highest goal, and hath been deprived of the mysteries of unity and of the lights of sanctity and oneness.

input: و اشهد انّک ما قدّرت لهم شبیهاً فی ارضک و لا نظیراً فی خلقک لیثبت تنزیه ذاتک عن المثلیّة و تقدیس نفسک عن الشّبهیّة.
output: I testify, moreover, that Thou hast decreed that none on the face of the earth should equal Them, and none of Thy creatures be able to be compared with any of Them, in order that Thine own singleness and peerlessness might be recognized and established.

input: سبحانک سبحانک یا الهی.
output: Glorified, immeasurably glorified be Thy name, O my God.

input: کیف اذکرک و احمدک فیما اظهرته بقدرتک و اشرقته من افق سمآء مشیّتک و جعلته مشرق آیاتک و مطلع ظهورات اسمائک و صفاتک.
output: How can I ever befittingly mention Thee or sufficiently praise Thee, that Thou hast manifested Him by the power of Thy might, and caused Him to shine above the horizon of Thy will, and made Him the Dayspring of Thy signs, and the Dawning Place of the revelation of Thy names and Thine attributes

input: و ما اعظم حیرتی یا الهی فی عرفانه و عرفان ما اودعته فیه بقدرتک و اقتدارک.
output: How bewilderingly mysterious, moreover, O my God, is His nature and all that Thou hast infused into Him, through Thy strength and by the power of Thy might.

input: مرّة اری انّه مآء حیوان قد نزّل من سمآء فضلک و سحاب رحمتک لحیوة بریّتک و ابقائهم ببقآء ملکوتک.
output: At one time He appeareth as the water which is Life indeed, sent down out of the heaven of Thy grace, and poured forth from the clouds of Thy mercy, that Thy creatures may be endued with new life, and live as long as Thine own Kingdom endureth.

input: من فاز بقطرة منه انّه قام من الاموات و اقبل الی شطر الطافک و مواهبک منقطعاً عن سوائک.
output: Every drop of that water would suffice to quicken the dead, and to set their faces in the direction of Thy favors and Thy gifts, and to rid them of all attachment to aught else except Thee.

input: و مرّة اری کانّه نار اوقدت فی سدرة فردانیّتک و منها ظهر الاحتراق فی اکباد العشّاق اذ طلع نیّر الآفاق من افق العراق.
output: At another time He revealeth Himself as the Fire which Thou didst kindle in the tree of Thy unity, whose heat melted the hearts of Thine ardent lovers when He Who is the Daystar of the world shone forth above the horizon of Iráq.

input: اشهد یا الهی به احترقت احجاب البشر و اقبلوا الی المنظر الاکبر.
output: I testify, O my God, that through Him the veils of human fancy were burnt up, and the hearts of men were set towards the scene of Thy most resplendent glory.

input: اسئلک یا مالک القدر بان لا تجعلنی محروماً عن نفحات ایّامک الّتی فیها فاحت فوحات قمیص رحمانیّتک.
output: I implore Thee, O Thou Who art the Supreme Ordainer, not to suffer me to be deprived of the breezes which are wafted in Thy days, the days whereon the sweet smell of the raiment of Thy mercy hath been shed abroad.

input: و لا تمنعنی عن بحرک الاعظم الّذی کلّ قطرة منه تنادی و تقول طوبی لمن ایقظته نسمة اللّه الّتی مرّت من جهة فضله علی المقبلین من خلقه.
output: Neither do Thou keep me back from Thy most great Ocean, every drop of which crieth out and saith: Great is the blessedness that awaiteth him who hath been awakened from his sleep by the breath of God which, from the source of His mercy, hath blown over all such of His creatures as have set themselves towards Him.

input: ای ربّ تری عبادک اسرآء بایادی انفسهم و اهوائهم .
output: Thou seest, O my Lord, how Thy servants are held captive by their own selves and desires.

input: خلّصهم یا الهی بسلطانک و قدرتک لیقبلوا الیک عند ظهور مظهر اسمائک و صفاتک.
output: Redeem them from their bondage, O my God, by the power of Thy sovereignty and might, that they may turn towards Thee when He Who is the Revealer of Thy names and attributes is manifested unto men.

input: ای ربّ فانظر هذا الفقیر بلحظات اعین غنائک و نوّر قلبه بنور معرفتک لیعرف حقایق اللّاهوت و اسرار الجبروت و ظهورات الملکوت و شئونات النّاسوت تلقآء ظهور مظهر نفسک.
output: Cast upon this poor and desolate creature, O my Lord, the glance of Thy wealth, and flood his heart with the beams of Thy knowledge, that he may apprehend the verities of the unseen world, and discover the mysteries of Thy heavenly realm, and perceive the signs and tokens of Thy kingdom, and behold the manifold revelations of this earthly life all set forth before the face of Him Who is the Revealer of Thine own Self.

input: ثمّ اجعله یا الهی مقبلاً الی افق عنایتک و مستقیماً علی حبّک و ناطقاً بذکرک و متمسّکاً بحبل حبّک و متشبّثاً بذیل کرمک و منادیاً باسمک بین خلقک و مثنیاً بثنائک فی دیارک علی شأن لا تمنعه الاحجاب عن اسمک الوهّاب و لا تحجبه السّبحات عن التّوجّه الیک یا من بیدک جبروت الآیات و ملکوت الاسمآء و الصّفات.
output: Direct, then, his eyes, O my God, towards the horizon of Thy loving kindness, and make steadfast his heart in its attachment to Thee, and unloose his tongue to praise Thee, and make him able to hold fast the cord of Thy love, and to cling to the hem of Thy bounteousness, and to proclaim Thy name amidst Thy creatures, and to recount Thy virtues throughout Thy realm, in such wise that no obstacle will deter him from turning to Thy name, the All Bountiful, and no veil shut him out from Thee, in Whose hand is the dominion of utterance and the kingdom of all names and attributes.

input: خذ یا الهی ید هذا المقبل الّذی اقبل الی وجهک ثمّ انقذه من غمرات الاوهام لیطلع من افق قلبه نور الایقان فی الایّام الّتی فیها اظلمت شمس عرفان خلقک عند اشراق شمس احدیّتک و خسف قمر العلم عند ظهور علمک المکنون و سرّک المصون و رمزک المخزون و سقطت انجم الاعمال عند ظهور نور فردانیّتک و تجلّی عزّ وحدانیّتک.
output: Hold Thou the hand of this seeker who hath set his face towards Thee, O my Lord, and draw him out of the depths of his vain imaginations, that the light of certainty may shine brightly above the horizon of his heart in the days whereon the sun of the knowledge of Thy creatures hath been darkened through the shining of the Daystar of Thy glory. the days whereon the moon of the world's wisdom hath been eclipsed through the appearance of Thy hidden knowledge, and the manifestation of Thy well guarded secret, and the revelation of Thine enshrined mystery. the days whereon the stars of men's doings have fallen through the rising of the orb of Thy unity and the shedding of the radiance of Thy transcendent oneness.

input: اسئلک یا الهی بالکلمة العلیا الّتی جعلتها اکسیراً فی مملکتک و به انقلب نحاس الوجود بالذّهب الابریز یا من بیدک ملکوت الغیب و الشّهود بان تجعل مختاری ما اخترته و مرادی ما اردته لاکون راضیاً برضائک و بما قدّرته لی بجودک و احسانک.
output: I beg of Thee, O my God, by Thy most exalted Word which Thou hast ordained as the Divine Elixir unto all who are in Thy realm, the Elixir through whose potency the crude metal of human life hath been transmuted into purest gold, O Thou in Whose hands are both the visible and invisible kingdoms, to ordain that my choice be conformed to Thy choice and my wish to Thy wish, that I may be entirely content with that which Thou didst desire, and be wholly satisfied with what Thou didst destine for me by Thy bounteousness and favor.

input: و انّک انت العزیز الحکیم.
output: Thou, in very truth, art the All Glorious, the All Wise.

input: طوبی لعارف عرفک و وجد عرفک و اقبل الی ملکوتک و ذاق ما کمل فیه بفضلک و احسانک.
output: Happy is the man who hath recognized Thee, and discovered the sweetness of Thy fragrance, and set himself towards Thy kingdom, and tasted of the things that have been perfected therein by Thy grace and favor.

input: طوبی لمن عرف مجدک الاعظم و ما منعته سبحات الامم عن التّوجّه الیک یا مالک القدم و مصوّر الرّمم.
output: Great is the blessedness of him who hath acknowledged Thy most excellent majesty, and whom the veils that have shut out the nations from Thee have not hindered from directing his eyes towards Thee, O Thou Who art the King of eternity and the Quickener of every moldering bone.

input: طوبی لمن استنشق نفحاتک و انجذب من آیاتک فی ایّامک.
output: Blessed, also, is he that hath inhaled Thy sweet savors, and been carried away by Thine utterances in Thy days.

input: طوبی لمن اقبل الیک و ویل للمعرضین.
output: Blessed, moreover, be the man that hath turned unto Thee, and woe betide him that hath turned his back upon Thee.

input: و الحمد لک یا اله العالمین.
output: Praised be Thou, the Lord of the worlds.

input: یا ایّها العادل علی من فی السّموات و الأرض و یا ایّها الحاکم علی من فی ملکوت الأمر و الخلق.
output: Thou Who dealest equitably with all who are in heaven and on earth, and rulest over the kingdom of Thy creation and of Thy Revelation.

input: اشهد انّ کلّ عادل اعترف بالظّلم عند اشراقات انوار شمس عدلک و کلّ محرّر اقرّ بالعجز عند حرکة قلمک الأعلی.
output: I testify that every man of equity hath recognized his unfairness in the face of the revelation of the splendors of the Daystar of Thy Justice, and the ablest of pens hath confessed its impotence before the movement of Thy most exalted Pen.

input: لعمرک یا مالک الأسمآء.
output: By Thy life, O Thou the Possessor of all names.

input: قد تحیّر اولو النّهی من بحر علمک و سمآء حکمتک و شمس فضلک.
output: The minds of the profoundest thinkers are sore perplexed as they contemplate the ocean of Thy knowledge, and the heaven of Thy wisdom, and the Luminary of Thy grace.

input: انّ الّذی خلق بارادتک کیف یقدر ان یعرف ما عندک و ما انت علیه.
output: How can he who is but a creation of Thy will claim to know what is with Thee, or to conceive Thy nature

input: سبحانک سبحانک.
output: Praise, immeasurable praise be to Thee.

input: انّی بلسان سرّی و ظاهری و باطنی اشهد بأنّک کنت مقدّساً عن شؤونات خلقک و بیانات عبادک و ما نطق به اولیائک و اصفیائک و عن کلّ ما عرفه انبیائک و سفرائک.
output: My inner and outer tongue, openly and secretly, testify that Thou hast been exalted above the reach and ken of Thy creatures, above the utterance of Thy servants, above the testimonies of Thy dear ones and Thy chosen ones, and the apprehension of Thy Prophets and of Thy Messengers.

input: ای رب اسألک باسمک الّذی جعلته مطلع امرک و مشرق الهامک بأن تقدّر لهذا المظلوم و احبّتک ما ینبغی لحضرتک.
output: I beseech Thee, O my Lord, by Thy Name which Thou hast made to be the Dayspring of Thy Revelation and the Dawning Place of Thine inspiration, to ordain for this wronged One and for them that are dear to Thee what becometh Thy loftiness.

input: انّک انت المعطی المقتدر العلیم الحکیم.
output: Thou, in very truth, art the All Bountiful, the All Powerful, the All Knowing, the All Wise.

input: اسألک باسمک الّذی ما عرفه احد حقّ العرفان و ما بلغت الیه نفس حقّ البلوغ اسألک بمصدر وحیک و مطلع آیاتک بأن تجعل قلبی انآء حبّک و ذکرک.
output: I implore Thee, by Thy Name which none hath befittingly recognized, and whose import no soul hath fathomed. I beseech Thee, by Him Who is the Fountainhead of Thy Revelation and the Dayspring of Thy signs, to make my heart to be a receptacle of Thy love and of remembrance of Thee.

input: ثمّ اجعله متّصلاً ببحرک الأعظم لیجری منه فرات حکمتک و انهار ذکرک و ثنائک.
output: Knit it, then, to Thy most great Ocean, that from it may flow out the living waters of Thy wisdom and the crystal streams of Thy glorification and praise.

input: تشهد جوارحی بوحدانیّتک و شعراتی بسلطنتک و اقتدارک.
output: The limbs of my body testify to Thy unity, and the hair of my head declareth the power of Thy sovereignty and might.

input: و قمت لدی باب فضلک بالکینونة المعدومة و الذّاتیّة المفقودة متشبّثاً بذیل کرمک و ناظراً الی افق الطافک.
output: I have stood at the door of Thy grace with utter self effacement and complete abnegation, and clung to the hem of Thy bounty, and fixed mine eyes upon the horizon of Thy gifts.

input: قدّر لی یا الهی ما ینبغی لعظمتک و ایّدنی فی تبلیغ امرک علی شأن یقوم به اهل القبور راکضین الیک و متوکّلین علیک و ناظرین الی افق امرک و مشرق وحیک.
output: Do Thou destine for me, O my God, what becometh the greatness of Thy majesty, and assist me, by Thy strengthening grace, so to teach Thy Cause that the dead may speed out of their sepulchers, and rush forth towards Thee, trusting wholly in Thee, and fixing their gaze upon the orient of Thy Cause, and the dawning place of Thy Revelation.

input: انّک انت المقتدر المتعالی العلیم الحکیم.
output: Thou, verily, art the Most Powerful, the Most High, the All Knowing, the All Wise.

input: یا الهی لا یعرف توحیدک الّا بمعرفة مظهر فردانیّتک و مطلع وحدانیّتک.
output: Thy unity is inscrutable, O my God, to all except them that have recognized Him Who is the Manifestation of Thy singleness and the Dayspring of Thy oneness.

input: من یری له ضدّاً قد اقرّ لک بضد و من اعترف له ندّاً اعترف بندّ لک.
output: Whoso assigneth a rival unto Him hath assigned a rival unto Thee, and whoso hath set up a peer for Him hath set up a peer for Thyself.

input: کلّا ثمّ کلّا بأن یکون لک ضدّ فی الامکان.
output: No, no, none can withstand Thee in the whole of creation.

input: لم تزل کنت مقدّساً عن الأشباه و الأمثال.
output: Thou hast everlastingly been exalted far above all comparison and likeness.

input: قد ثبت توحیدک بتوحید مطلع امرک.
output: Thy oneness hath been demonstrated by the oneness of Him Who is the Dawning Place of Thy Revelation.

input: من انکر هذا قد انکر توحیدک و نازعک فی سلطانک و حاربک فی مملکتک و جاحدک فی اوامرک.
output: Whosoever denieth this, hath denied Thy unity, and disputed with Thee about Thy sovereignty, and contended with Thee in Thy realm, and repudiated Thy commandments.

input: ربّ ایّد عبادک علی توحیدک و ذکر تفریدک لیجتمع الکلّ علی ما اردته فی هذا الیوم الّذی فیه اشرقت شمس کینونتک من افق ارادتک و لاح قمر انّیّتک من مطلع امرک.
output: Assist Thou Thy servants, O my Lord, to recognize Thy unity and to declare Thy oneness, that all may gather together around what Thou didst desire in this Day whereon the sun of Thine essence hath shone forth above the horizon of Thy will, and the moon of Thine own being hath risen from the Dayspring of Thy behest.

input: ای ربّ انت الّذی لا یعزب من علمک من شیء و لا یعجزک من شیء.
output: Thou art He, O my Lord, from Whose knowledge nothing whatsoever escapeth, and Whom no one can frustrate.

input: تفعل ما تشآء بسلطانک المهیمن علی العالمین.
output: Thou doest Thy pleasure, by Thy sovereignty that overshadoweth the worlds.

input: یا الهی و محبوبی انت تعلم ظمأ فراقی لا یسکن الّا بمآء وصالک و اضطراب قلبی لا یطمئنّ الّا بکوثر لقائک.
output: Thou well knowest, O my God, my Best Beloved, that naught can quench the thirst I suffer in my separation from Thee except the waters of Thy presence, and that the tumult of my heart can never be stilled save through the living fountain of my reunion with Thee.

input: ای ربّ فأنزل علیّ من سمآء عطائک ما یقرّبنی الی کأس الطافک و یشربنی الرّحیق المختوم الّذی فکّ ختامه باسمک و تضوّع منه عرف ایّامک.
output: Send down, then, upon me, O my Lord, out of the heaven of Thy bounty what will draw me nearer unto the chalice of Thy gifts, and make me able to quaff the choice sealed Wine, Whose seal hath been loosed in Thy name, and from Which the sweet savors of Thy days have been shed abroad.

input: انّک انت الکریم ذو الفضل العظیم.
output: Thou, in truth, art the All Bountiful, Whose grace is infinite.

input: یشهد بکرمک من فی الامکان.
output: The whole universe testifieth to Thy generosity.

input: فارحمنی بجودک ثمّ اکرمنی بسلطانک ثمّ قرّبنی بألطافک.
output: Have mercy, then, upon me by Thy graciousness, and deal bountifully with me through the power of Thy sovereignty, and suffer me to enjoy near access to Thee by Thy manifold favors.

input: انّک انت المعطی المقتدر الغفور الکریم.
output: Thou, truly, art the Great Giver, the Almighty, the Ever Forgiving, the Most Bountiful.

input: سبحانک یا الهی و اله کلّ شیء و بهائی و بهآء کلّ شیء و رجائی و رجآء کلّ شیء و عزّی و عزّ کلّ شیء و سلطانی و سلطان کلّ شیء و مالکی و مالک کلّ شیء و محبوبی و محبوب کلّ شیء و مقصودی و مقصود کلّ شیء و محرّکی و محرّک کلّ شیء.
output: Lauded be Thy name, O my God and the God of all things, my Glory and the Glory of all things, my Desire and the Desire of all things, my Strength and the Strength of all things, my King and the King of all things, my Possessor and the Possessor of all things, my Aim and the Aim of all things, my Mover and the Mover of all things.

input: اسألک بأن لا تمنعنی عن بحر افضالک و لا تبعدنی عن شاطئ قربک.
output: Suffer me not, I implore Thee, to be kept back from the ocean of Thy tender mercies, nor to be far removed from the shores of nearness to Thee.

input: ای ربّ دونک لا ینفعنی و قرب غیرک لا یغنینی.
output: Aught else except Thee, O my Lord, profiteth me not, and near access to anyone save Thyself availeth me nothing.

input: اسألک بغنائک الّذی به استغنیت عمّا سواک بأن تجعلنی من النّاظرین الیک و القائمین علی خدمتک.
output: I entreat Thee by the plenteousness of Thy riches, whereby Thou didst dispense with all else except Thyself, to number me with such as have set their faces towards Thee, and arisen to serve Thee.

input: ای ربّ فاغفر عبادک و امائک.
output: Forgive, then, O my Lord, Thy servants and Thy handmaidens.

input: اللّهمّ انّک انت مظهر المظاهر و مصدر المصادر و مطلع المطالع و مشرق المشارق اشهد باسمک تزیّنت سمآء العرفان و تموّج بحر البیان و شرعت الشّرائع لأهل الأدیان.
output: God, Who art the Author of all Manifestations, the Source of all Sources, the Fountainhead of all Revelations, and the Wellspring of all Lights. I testify that by Thy Name the heaven of understanding hath been adorned, and the ocean of utterance hath surged, and the dispensations of Thy providence have been promulgated unto the followers of all religions.

input: اسألک ان تجعلنی غنیّاً عن دونک و مستغنیاً عمّا سواک.
output: I beseech Thee so to enrich me as to dispense with all save Thee, and be made independent of any one except Thyself.

input: ثمّ انزل علیّ من سحاب جودک ما ینفعنی فی کلّ عالم من عوالمک.
output: Rain down, then, upon me out of the clouds of Thy bounty that which shall profit me in every world of Thy worlds.

input: ثمّ وفّقنی علی خدمة امرک بین عبادک علی شأن یظهر منّی ما یثبت به ذکری بدوام ملکوتک و جبروتک.
output: Assist me, then, through Thy strengthening grace, so to serve Thy Cause amidst Thy servants that I may show forth what will cause me to be remembered as long as Thine own kingdom endureth and Thy dominion will last.

input: ای ربّ هذا عبدک الّذی قد توجّه بکلّه الی افق جودک و بحر فضلک و سمآء الطافک.
output: This is Thy servant, O my Lord, who with his whole being hath turned unto the horizon of Thy bounty, and the ocean of Thy grace, and the heaven of Thy gifts.

input: فافعل بی ما ینبغی لعظمتک و اجلالک و موهبتک و افضالک.
output: Do with me then as becometh Thy majesty, and Thy glory, and Thy bounteousness, and Thy grace.

input: انّک انت المقتدر القدیر و بالاجابة جدیر.
output: Thou, in truth, art the God of strength and power, Who art meet to answer them that pray Thee.

input: لا اله الّا انت العلیم الخبیر.
output: There is no God save Thee, the All Knowing, the All Wise.

input: سبحانک یا الهی یا الهی و النّابض فی قلبی.
output: Lauded be Thy name, O Thou Who art my God and throbbest within my heart.

input: تعلم و تری انّ خجلة احبّتک ترجع الی مظهر نفسک و مطلع امرک.
output: Thou art well aware and dost witness that whatsoever shameth them that are dear to Thee must shame also Him Who is the Manifestation of Thyself and the Dayspring of Thy Revelation.

input: بل انّه یری نفسه اخجل منهم عند اعترافهم بما فات عنهم فی ایّامک.
output: Nay, He is put to greater shame than they when they are led to confess the good things which have escaped them in Thy days.

input: ای ربّ هؤلآء عبادک الّذین هاجروا فی حبّک و حملوا القضایا فی سبیلک.
output: These are Thy servants, O my Lord, who for love of Thee have abandoned their homes, and sustained the tribulations decreed by Thee in Thy path.

input: یا الهی کلّما یقرّ احد منهم بجریراته بین یدیک یغطّی الحیآء وجه البهآء لأنّهم عبادک الّذین ذاقوا کأس البلآء فی امرک و شربوا اکواب البأسآء عند ظهور انوار وجهک و اخذتهم الشّدائد علی شأن ما استراحوا فی جوارک.
output: Every time any one of them testifieth before Thee to his evil doings, shame covereth my face, for they are Thy servants who have tasted of the cup of woe in Thy Cause, who have quaffed from the chalice of adversity when the light of Thy countenance was lifted upon them, and who were so vexed by trials that peace was utterly denied them within the precincts of Thy court.

input: قد ذاب البهآء حبّاً لأحبّتک و تبلبل بما اعترتهم الأحزان عند ظهور امرک و تموّج ابحر فضلک و الطافک.
output: My heart hath melted by reason of my love for them that are dear to Thee, and my soul is laden with anguish for the sorrows which have afflicted them at the revelation of Thy Cause and the appearance of the billowing oceans of Thy grace and favors.

input: ای ربّ من زفرات قلوبهم ارتفعت زفرتی و من احتراق قلوبهم احترق قلبی.
output: The sighs they uttered, O my Lord, have caused my sighs to ascend towards Thee, and the burning of their hearts hath consumed mine own heart within me.

input: اسألک یا مالک الوجود و مربّی الغیب و الشّهود بأن تجعل کلّ واحد منهم علم هدایتک بین عبادک و اشراق انوار شمس عنایتک بین بریّتک.
output: I beseech Thee, O Thou Who art the Lord of all being and the Enlightener of all things visible and invisible, to grant that every one of them may become an ensign of Thy guidance among Thy servants, and a revelation of the splendors of the Daystar of Thy loving kindness amidst Thy creatures.

input: قد اختصصتهم یا الهی لمحبّتک و الحضور لدی عرش عظمتک.
output: Thou hast, O my God, chosen them to love Thee, and to stand before the throne of Thy majesty.

input: هذا مقام ما سبقهم احد فی ذلک.
output: No other station hath excelled the station to which Thou hast called them.

input: کم من لیال یا الهی ما ناموا لذکرک و کم من ایّام ناحوا بما ورد علیک من اعدائک.
output: How many the nights, O my God, when sleep failed to overtake them because of their remembrance of Thee, and how numerous the days which they spent in lamentation over the things that have befallen Thee at the hands of Thine enemies.

input: اسألک یا مالک الملوک و رافع المملوک بأن تؤیّدهم علی نصرة امرک و اعلآء کلمتک علی شأن ینتشر بهم ذکرک بین خلقک و ثنائک فی مملکتک.
output: I entreat Thee, O Thou Who art the Ruler of rulers, and the Uplifter of the downtrodden, to aid them so to assist Thy Cause and exalt Thy word that through them Thy praise may be shed abroad amidst Thy creatures, and Thy virtues recounted throughout Thy realm.

input: انّک انت المقتدر المتعالی الغفور الکریم.
output: Thou art, verily, the Almighty, the Most Exalted, the Ever Forgiving, the Most Generous.

input: هذا عبدک الّذی سمّیته باسمک فی ملکوت اسمائک و ربّیته تحت جناح فضلک و الطافک.
output: This is Thy servant whom Thou hast in the kingdom of Thy names called by Thine own name, and whom Thou hast reared under the wings of Thy grace and favors.

input: اذاً تراه مسرعاً الی شطر مواهبک و راکضاً الیک طلباً لعطائک.
output: Thou seest him, therefore, hastening in the direction of Thy gifts, and rushing forth towards Thee seeking after Thy bounty.

input: زیّنه یا الهی بردآء مکرمتک و ثوب جودک و کرمک لیجدنّ منه الأشیآء تضوّعات قمیص حبّک.
output: Attire him, O my God, with the mantle of Thy favor and the robe of Thy munificence and generosity, that all created things may perceive from him the sweet smell of the raiment of Thy love.

input: ثمّ زیّن رأسه باکلیل ذکرک علی شأن یکون معروفاً بین العباد بحبّک و الاستقامة فی امرک.
output: Adorn, then, his head with the crown of Thy remembrance, in such wise that his fame may be noised abroad among Thy servants as one who loveth Thee and cleaveth steadfastly to Thy Cause.

input: ثمّ ایّده فی کلّ الأحوال علی نصرتک و ذکرک و ثنائک بین خلقک.
output: Assist him, moreover, at all times and under all conditions to help Thee and to remember Thee, and to extol Thy virtues amidst Thy creatures.

input: وعزّتک یا الهی.
output: I swear by Thy glory, O my God.

input: کلّما اتفکّر فی عظمتک و سلطانک اجد نفسی اعصی العصاة فی مملکتک و کلّما انظر مقاماتک الّتی جعلتها مخصوصة لنفسک اری وجودی اذنب من فی ارضک.
output: Every time I muse on Thy glory and Thy sovereignty I find myself as the most guilty among them that have transgressed against Thee in Thy realm, and every time I contemplate the heights in which none except Thee can abide, I discover that I am the most sinful of all the creatures that dwell in Thy land.

input: لو لا ستر اسمک السّتّار و عفو اسمک الغفّار و عرف اسمک الرّحمن لتری الأصفیآء فی مواقف الذّنوب و العصیان.
output: Had it not been for Thy name, the Concealer, and for Thy name, the Ever Forgiving, and for the sweet savors of Thy name, the Most Merciful, all Thy chosen ones had been reckoned amongst the perverse and the wicked.

input: لک الحمد بما سبقتهم رحمتک و احاطهم فضلک و الطافک.
output: I render Thee thanks that Thy mercy hath overtaken them and Thy grace and bountiful favors compassed them on every side.

input: و بعد اعترافی بما اجریته من قلمی اسألک باسمک الّذی جعلته قیّوماً علی الأسمآء و مهیمناً علی من فی الأرض و السّمآء بأن لا تطرد الّذی توجّه الیک و لا تمنعه عن بدائع فضلک و خفیّات رحمتک.
output: And now, having confessed the things Thou didst cause to flow down from my Pen, I implore Thee, by Thy name which Thou hast raised up above every other name, and hast caused to overshadow all that are in heaven and all that are on earth, to cast not away him that hath turned towards Thee, and to deny him not the wonders of Thy grace and the hidden evidences of Thy mercy.

input: اوقد بأیادی قدرتک فی قلبه سراجاً لیکون مشتعلاً فی ایّامک و منادیاً باسمک علی شأن لا یمنعه الحیآء عن الطّیران فی هوآء حبّک و الصّعود الی افق جذبک و اشتیاقک و لا یشغله شؤونات الخلق عن اعلآء کلمتک لتراه مقدّساً کما ترید و ینبغی لعظمتک و جلالک.
output: Let the hands of Thine omnipotence kindle in his heart a lamp that will enable him to shine brightly in Thy days, and to cry out with such vehemence in Thy name that no timidity will deter him from soaring in the atmosphere of Thy love, and from ascending to the horizon of rapture and longing for Thee, and that the pursuits of Thy creatures will not withhold him from magnifying Thy word, that Thou mayest behold him sanctified as Thou wishest and as beseemeth Thy majesty and glory.

input: ولو انّ یا الهی هذا شأن کبیر و مقام عظیم لأنّ غیرک کیف یقدر ان یأتی بما یکون لائقاً لحضرتک و مستحقّاً لجلالک ولکن انت الکریم و انت الرّحیم.
output: Exalted though this station may be, O my God, and however excellent this position—for who else except Thyself hath the power to show forth what may be deemed worthy of Thine exaltation and befit Thy greatness—yet Thou art He Who is the All Bountiful, the Most Compassionate.

input: یشهد کلّ الذّرّات بأنّک انت الغفور العطوف المعطی العزیز الحکیم.
output: All the atoms of the earth testify that Thou art the Ever Forgiving, the Benevolent, the Great Giver, the All Glorious, the All Wise.

input: یا الهی فانظر الیه بطرف عنایتک و لحاظ مکرمتک.
output: Look, then, upon him, O my God, with the eyes of Thy loving kindness, and cast upon him the glance of Thy generosity.

input: ثمّ اجذبه بنغمات مصدر وحیک علی مقام یکون بکلّه فانیاً فی رضائک و آملاً بما قدّرته فی الواحک.
output: Enrapture him, moreover, with the sweet melodies of Him Who is the Fountainhead of Thy Revelation, in such wise that he may wholly surrender his will to Thy pleasure, and fix his hopes upon the things Thou didst ordain in Thy Tablets.

input: ثمّ اجعل قلبه قویّاً باسمک القویّ الأمین لیخرج ید القوّة و ینصر بها امرک عند ظهور نور جمالک و طلوع شمس اجلالک.
output: Strengthen, then, his heart by Thy name, the Almighty, the Faithful, that he may draw forth the hand of power, and with it help Thy Cause when the light of Thy beauty is manifested and the Daystar of Thy majesty is risen.

input: ای ربّ لمّا سمّیته باسمک اجعله مخصوصاً بین العباد لخدمتک.
output: Since Thou hast called him by Thy name, O my Lord, single him out among Thy servants for Thy service.

input: ای ربّ انت تعلم انّی ما اردت فی امر نفسی بل امرک و ما توجّهت الی احد الّا لأمرک و اظهار عنایتک.
output: Thou well knowest, O my Lord, that in revealing myself I have sought only to reveal Thy Cause, and have turned to no one except for the sake of Thy Revelation and for the purpose of manifesting Thy loving kindness.

input: اسألک باسمک المخزون الّذی ینطق الحین بأن تنزل علیه و علی احبّتک ما هو المخزون فی سمآء عطائک و مواهبک لیأخذهم الشّوق و الانجذاب فی عهدک یا ربّ الأرباب.
output: I beseech Thee, by Thy treasured Name Who, at this very moment, is speaking, to send down upon him and upon them that love Thee that which is enshrined in the heaven of Thy favor and bounties, that they may be filled with vehement longing towards Thee, and exult in Thy Covenant, O Thou Who art the Lord of Lords.

input: ثمّ اقض له و لهم ما یقتضی لاسمک الوهّاب.
output: Ordain, then, for him and for them that which becometh Thy name, the All Bountiful.

input: انّک انت المقتدر المتعالی القویّ العزیز العظیم.
output: Thou art, in truth, the Almighty, the Most Exalted, the Most Powerful, the All Glorious, the Most Great.

input: یا الهی و ناری و نوری.
output: My God, my Fire and my Light.

input: قد دخلت الأیّام الّتی سمّیتها بأیّام الهآء فی کتابک یا مالک الأسمآء و تقرّبت ایّام صیامک الّذی فرضته من قلمک الأعلی لمن فی ملکوت الانشآء.
output: The days which Thou hast named the Ayyám i Há the Days of Há, Intercalary Days in Thy Book have begun, O Thou Who art the King of names, and the Fast which Thy most exalted Pen hath enjoined unto all who are in the kingdom of Thy creation to observe is approaching.

input: ای ربّ اسألک بتلک الأیّام و الّذین تمسّکوا فیها بحبل اوامرک و عروة احکامک بأن تجعل لکلّ نفس مقرّاً فی جوارک و مقاماً لدی ظهور نور وجهک.
output: I entreat Thee, O my Lord, by these days and by all such as have during that period clung to the cord of Thy commandments, and laid hold on the handle of Thy precepts, to grant that unto every soul may be assigned a place within the precincts of Thy court, and a seat at the revelation of the splendors of the light of Thy countenance.

input: ای ربّ اولئک عباد ما منعهم الهوی عمّا انزلته فی کتابک.
output: These, O my Lord, are Thy servants whom no corrupt inclination hath kept back from what Thou didst send down in Thy Book.

input: قد خضعت اعناقهم لأمرک و اخذوا کتابک بقوّتک و عملوا ما امروا به من عندک و اختاروا ما نزّل لهم من لدنک.
output: They have bowed themselves before Thy Cause, and received Thy Book with such resolve as is born of Thee, and observed what Thou hadst prescribed unto them, and chosen to follow that which had been sent down by Thee.

input: ای ربّ تری انّهم اقرّوا و اعترفوا بکلّ ما انزلته فی الواحک.
output: Thou seest, O my Lord, how they have recognized and confessed whatsoever Thou hast revealed in Thy Scriptures.

input: ای ربّ فأشربهم من ید عطائک کوثر بقائک.
output: Give them to drink, O my Lord, from the hands of Thy graciousness the waters of Thine eternity.

input: ثمّ اکتب لهم اجر من تغمّس فی بحر لقائک و فاز برحیق وصالک.
output: Write down, then, for them the recompense ordained for him that hath immersed himself in the ocean of Thy presence, and attained unto the choice wine of Thy meeting.

input: اسألک یا مالک الملوک و راحم المملوک بأن تقدّر لهم خیر الدّنیا و الآخرة.
output: I implore Thee, O Thou the King of kings and the Pitier of the downtrodden, to ordain for them the good of this world and of the world to come.

input: ثمّ اکتب لهم ما لا عرفه احد من خلقک ثمّ اجعلهم من الّذین طافوا فی حولک و یطوفون حول عرشک فی کلّ عالم من عوالمک.
output: Write down for them, moreover, what none of Thy creatures hath discovered, and number them with those who have circled round Thee, and who move about Thy throne in every world of Thy worlds.

input: انّک انت المقتدر العلیم الخبیر.
output: Thou, truly, art the Almighty, the All Knowing, the All Informed.

input: لک الحمد یا الهی بما جعلت النّیروز عیداً لمن صاموا فی حبّک و کفّوا انفسهم عمّا یکرهه رضائک.
output: Praised be Thou, O my God, that Thou hast ordained Naw Rúz as a festival unto those who have observed the Fast for love of Thee and abstained from all that is abhorrent unto Thee.

input: ای ربّ فاجعلهم من نار حبّک و حرارة صومک مشتعلین فی امرک و مشتغلین بذکرک و ثنائک.
output: Grant, O my Lord, that the fire of Thy love and the heat produced by the Fast enjoined by Thee may inflame them in Thy Cause, and make them to be occupied with Thy praise and with remembrance of Thee.

input: ای ربّ لمّا زیّنتهم بطراز الصّوم زیّنهم بطراز القبول بفضلک و احسانک.
output: Since Thou hast adorned them, O my Lord, with the ornament of the Fast prescribed by Thee, do Thou adorn them also with the ornament of Thine acceptance, through Thy grace and bountiful favor.

input: لأنّ الأعمال کلّها معلّق بقبولک و منوط بأمرک.
output: For the doings of men are all dependent upon Thy good pleasure, and are conditioned by Thy behest.

input: لو تحکم لمن افطر حکم الصّوم انّه ممّن صام فی ازل الآزال.
output: Shouldst Thou regard him who hath broken the Fast as one who hath observed it, such a man would be reckoned among them who from eternity had been keeping the Fast.

input: و لو تحکم لمن صام حکم الافطار انّه ممّن اغبرّ به ثوب الأمر و بعد عن زلال هذا السّلسال.
output: And shouldst Thou decree that he who hath observed the Fast hath broken it, that person would be numbered with such as have caused the Robe of Thy Revelation to be stained with dust, and been far removed from the crystal waters of this living Fountain.

input: انت الّذی بک نصبت رایة انت المحمود فی فعلک و ارتفعت اعلام انت المطاع فی امرک.
output: Thou art He through Whom the ensign Praiseworthy art Thou in Thy works hath been lifted up, and the standard Obeyed art Thou in Thy behest hath been unfurled.

input: عرّف یا الهی عبادک هذا المقام لیعلموا شرف کلّ امر بأمرک و کلمتک و فضل کلّ عمل باذنک و ارادتک و لیروا زمام الأعمال فی قبضة قبولک و امرک.
output: Make known this Thy station, O my God, unto Thy servants, that they may be made aware that the excellence of all things is dependent upon Thy bidding and Thy word, and the virtue of every act is conditioned by Thy leave and the good pleasure of Thy will, and may recognize that the reins of men's doings are within the grasp of Thine acceptance and Thy commandment. Make this known unto them,

input: لئلّا یمنعهم شیء عن جمالک فی هذه الأیّام الّتی فیها ینطق المسیح الملک لک یا موجد الرّوح و یتکلّم الحبیب لک الحمد یا محبوب بما اظهرت جمالک و کتبت لأصفیائک الورود فی مقرّ ظهور اسمک الأعظم الّذی به ناح الأمم الّا من انقطع عمّا سواک مقبلاً الی مطلع ذاتک و مظهر صفاتک.
output: that nothing whatsoever may shut them out from Thy Beauty, in these days whereon the Christ exclaimeth: All dominion is Thine, O Thou the Begetter of the Spirit Jesus. and Thy Friend Muhammad crieth out: Glory be to Thee, O Thou the Best Beloved, for that Thou hast uncovered Thy Beauty, and written down for Thy chosen ones what will cause them to attain unto the seat of the revelation of Thy Most Great Name, through which all the peoples have lamented except such as have detached themselves from all else except Thee, and set themselves towards Him Who is the Revealer of Thyself and the Manifestation of Thine attributes.

input: ای ربّ قد افطر الیوم غصنک و من فی حولک بعد الّذی صاموا فی جوارک طلباً لرضائک.
output: He Who is Thy Branch and all Thy company, O my Lord, have broken this day their fast, after having observed it within the precincts of Thy court, and in their eagerness to please Thee.

input: قدّر له و لهم و للّذین وردوا علیک فی تلک الأیّام کلّ خیر قدّرته فی کتابک.
output: Do Thou ordain for Him, and for them, and for all such as have entered Thy presence in those days all the good Thou didst destine in Thy Book.

input: ثمّ ارزقهم ما هو خیر لهم فی الدّنیا و الآخرة.
output: Supply them, then, with that which will profit them, in both this life and in the life beyond.

input: انّک انت العلیم الحکیم.
output: Thou, in truth, art the All Knowing, the All Wise.

input: یا اله الغیب و الشّهود و مربّی الوجود.
output: Thou the Lord of the visible and the invisible, and the Enlightener of all creation.

input: اسألک بسلطنتک المکنونة عن الأنظار بأن تظهر من کلّ الجهات آیات عنایاتک و ظهورات الطافک لأقوم بالرّوح و الرّیحان علی بدائع ذکرک یا رحمن و احرّک الأشیآء باسمک و اوقد نار البیان بین خلقک علی شأن تملأ الآفاق انوار بهائک و یشتعل الوجود بنار امرک.
output: I beseech Thee, by Thy sovereignty which is hid from the eyes of men, to reveal in all directions the signs of Thy manifold blessings and the tokens of Thy loving kindness, that I may arise with exultation and rapture and extol Thy wondrous virtues, O Thou the Most Merciful, and stir up by Thy name all created things, and so kindle the fire of Thy glorification amidst Thy creatures, that all the world may be filled with the brightness of the light of Thy glory, and all existence be inflamed with the fire of Thy Cause.

input: ای ربّ لا تطو البساط الّذی انبسط باسمک و لا تطفئ السّراج الّذی اوقد بنارک.
output: Roll not up, O my Lord, what hath been spread out in Thy name, and extinguish not the lamp which Thine own fire hath lit.

input: ای ربّ لا تمنع مآء الحیوان عن الجریان الّذی یسمع من خریره بدائع الألحان فی ذکرک و ثنائک.
output: Withhold not, O my Lord, the water that is life indeed from running down—the water from whose murmuring the wondrous melodies which extol and glorify Thee can be heard.

input: و لا تمنع العباد عن نفحات هذا العرف الّذی فاح بحبّک.
output: Deny not, moreover, Thy servants the sweet fragrance of the breath which hath been wafted through Thy love.

input: تری یا محبوب الأبهی تموّجات بحر القلب فی عشقک و هواک.
output: Thou seest, O Thou Who art my All Glorious Beloved, the restless waves that surge within the ocean of my heart, in my love and yearning towards Thee.

input: اسألک بآیات عظمتک و ظهورات سلطنتک بأن تسخّر العباد بهذا الاسم الّذی جعلته مالک الأسمآء فی ملکوت الانشآء.
output: I implore Thee, by the signs of Thy majesty and the evidences of Thy sovereignty, to subdue Thy servants by this Name Which Thou hast made to be the King of all names in the kingdom of Thy creation.

input: انّک انت الحاکم علی ما تشآء.
output: Potent art Thou to rule as Thou pleasest.

input: لا اله الّا انت العزیز الکریم.
output: No God is there but Thee, the All Glorious, the All Bountiful.

input: ثمّ قدّر لمن اقبل الیک ما یجعله مستقیماً علی امرک علی شأن لا تحجبه اوهام المشرکین من خلقک و لا کلمات المعرضین من عبادک.
output: Do Thou ordain, moreover, for every one who hath turned towards Thee what will make him steadfast in Thy Cause, in such wise that neither the vain imaginations of the infidels among Thy creatures, nor the idle talk of the froward amidst Thy servants will have the power to shut him out from Thee.

input: انّک انت المهیمن المقتدر القدیر.
output: Thou, verily, art the Help in Peril, the Almighty, the Most Powerful.

input: اسألک باسمک الأعظم الّذی سجن فی العکّا و تراه یا الهی بین ایدی الأعدآء و تحت سیوف الأشقیآء بأن تجعلنی مستقیماً علی امره و ناظراً الی شطره فی کلّ الأحوال بحیث لا یمنعنی شیء عن التّوجّه الیه.
output: I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Name Who hath been shut up in the prison town of 'Akká, and Who—as Thou beholdest, O my God—hath fallen into the hands of His enemies, and is threatened by the swords of the wicked doers, to make me steadfast in His Cause, and to direct mine eyes continually towards His court, in such wise that nothing whatsoever will have the power to turn me back from Him.

input: ای ربّ اشهد بأنّه فدی نفسه فی سبیلک و ما اراد لنفسه الّا البلایا فی حبّک.
output: I testify, O my Lord, that He hath surrendered His life in Thy path, and hath wished for Himself nothing but tribulation in the love He beareth to Thee.

input: قد حمل الشّداید کلّها لاظهار سلطنتک بین عبادک و اعلآء کلمتک بین بریّتک.
output: He hath endured all manner of vexations that He may manifest Thy sovereignty unto Thy servants, and exalt Thy word amidst Thy creatures.

input: کلّما ازدادت البلایا و احاطته القضایا من کلّ الأشطار انّه زاد فی ذکرک علی شأن ما خوّفه جنود الّذین کفروا بک و بآیاتک.
output: As the adversities deepened, and the troubles sent down by Thee compassed Him on every side, He became so impassioned by His thought of Thee, that the hosts of all them that had disbelieved in Thee and repudiated Thy signs ceased to affright Him.

input: ای ربّ اسألک به و بما عنده بأن تجعلنی فی حبّه کما کان فی حبّک.
output: I implore Thee, O my Lord, by Him and by whatsoever pertaineth unto Him, to set my affections upon Him even as He hath set His own affections upon Thyself.

input: و اشهد بأنّ حبّه حبّک و نفسه نفسک و جماله جمالک و امره امرک.
output: I testify that His love is Thy love, and His self Thy self, and His beauty Thy beauty, and His Cause Thy Cause.

input: ای ربّ لا تجعلنی محروماً عمّا عندک و غافلاً عمّا اردته فی ایّامک.
output: Deny me not, O my Lord, what is with Thee, and suffer me not to be forgetful of what Thou didst desire in Thy days.

input: انّک انت المقتدر المتعالی العزیز الحکیم.
output: Thou art, verily, the Almighty, the Most Exalted, the All Glorious, the All Wise.

input: اسألک باسمک الّذی به ظهرت السّاعة و قامت القیامة و فزع من فی السّموات و الأرض بأن تنزل من سمآء رحمتک و سحاب رأفتک ما تفرح به قلوب عبادک الّذین اقبلوا الیک و نصروا امرک.
output: I entreat Thee by Thy Name through which the Hour hath struck, and the Resurrection came to pass, and fear and trembling seized all that are in heaven and all that are on earth, to rain down, out of the heaven of Thy mercy and the clouds of Thy tender compassion, what will gladden the hearts of Thy servants, who have turned towards Thee and helped Thy Cause.

input: ای ربّ ان احفظ عبادک و امائک عن رمی الظّنون و الأوهام ثمّ اشربهم سلسبیل عرفانک بأیادی فضلک.
output: Keep safe Thy servants and Thy handmaidens, O my Lord, from the darts of idle fancy and vain imaginings, and give them from the hands of Thy grace a draught of the soft flowing waters of Thy knowledge.

input: تسمع حنین العاشقین فی فراقک و ضجیج العارفین فی بعدهم عن لقائک.
output: Thou hearest Thine ardent lovers lamenting in their separation from Thee, and such as have recognized Thee wailing because of their remoteness from Thy presence.

input: ای ربّ فافتح ابواب فضلک علی وجوههم ظاهراً لیدخلوا فیها باذنک و ارادتک و یحضروا تلقآء عرش عظمتک و یسمعوا نغماتک و یستشرقوا من انوار وجهک.
output: Open Thou outwardly to their faces, O my Lord, the gates of Thy grace, that they may enter them by Thy leave and in conformity with Thy will, and may stand before the throne of Thy majesty, and catch the accents of Thy voice, and be illumined with the splendors of the light of Thy face.

input: ای ربّ انت المقتدر علی ما تشآء.
output: Potent art Thou to do what pleaseth Thee.

input: لن یقدر احد ان یمنعک عن سلطانک.
output: None can withstand the power of Thy sovereign might.

input: لم تزل کنت و لم یکن معک من شیء و لا تزال تکون بلا ذکر شیء معک.
output: From everlasting Thou wert alone, with none to equal Thee, and wilt unto everlasting remain far above all thought and every description of Thee.

input: فارحم عبادک بجودک و فضلک و لا تمنعهم عن شاطئ قربک.
output: Have mercy, then, upon Thy servants by Thy grace and bounty, and suffer them not to be kept back from the shores of the ocean of Thy nearness.

input: ان ترکتهم من یدعهم و ان بعّدتهم من یقرّبهم
output: If Thou abandonest them, who is there to befriend them. and if Thou puttest them far from Thee, who is he that can favor them

input: لیس لهم ربّ سواک و لا معبود دونک.
output: They have none other Lord beside Thee, none to adore except Thyself.

input: جد علیهم بفضلک و احسانک.
output: Deal Thou generously with them by Thy bountiful grace.

input: تری یا الهی بأنّ البهآء یذکرک بعد الّذی ورد علیه من البلایا ما لا یقدر ان یحصیه احد الّا نفسک.
output: Thou dost witness, O my God, how He Who is Thy splendor calleth Thee to remembrance, notwithstanding the manifold troubles that have touched Him, troubles which none except Thee can number.

input: و یثنیک فی السّجن بما الهمته من بدایع وصفک
output: Thou beholdest how, in His prison house, He recounteth Thy wondrous praises with which Thou didst inspire Him.

input: علی شأن ما منعته الأعدآء عن ذکرک یا مالک الأسمآء.
output: Such is His fervor that His enemies are powerless to deter Him from mentioning Thee, O Thou Who art the Possessor of all names.

input: لک الحمد بما جعلته قویّاً بقوّتک و مقتدراً بسلطانک بحیث یری ما سواک کقبضة من التّراب.
output: Praised be Thou that Thou hast so strengthened Him with Thy strength, and endowed Him by Thine almighty power with such potency, that aught save Thee is in His estimation but a handful of dust.

input: و احاطته انوار القدم علی شأن لا یری ما دونک الّا کالعدم.
output: The lights of unfading splendor have so enveloped Him that all else but Thee is in His eyes but a shadow.

input: فلمّا جآء امرک المبرم قمت بحولک و دعوت من فی سمائک و ارضک الی شطر مواهبک و افق الطافک.
output: And when Thine irresistible summons reached me, I arose, fortified by Thy strength, and called all that are in Thy heaven and all that are on Thy earth to turn in the direction of Thy favors and the horizon of Thy bounties.

input: و منهم من اعترض علیّ و قام علی ضرّی و قتلی.
output: Some caviled at me, and determined to hurt me and slay me.

input: و منهم من شرب خمر افضالک و سرع الی جهة عرشک.
output: Others drank to the full of the wine of Thy grace, and hastened towards the habitation of Thy throne.

input: اسألک یا خالق الأرض و السّمآء و موجد الأشیآء بأن تجذب العباد بنفحات قمیص وحیک و الهامک و تبلّغهم الی سرادق امرک و اقتدارک.
output: I beseech Thee, O Thou Who art the Creator of earth and heaven and the Source of all things, to attract Thy servants through the fragrances of the Robe of Thine Inspiration and Thy Revelation, and to help them attain the Tabernacle of Thy behest and power.

input: لم تزل کنت مقتدراً بقیّومیّتک و لا تزال تکون متعالیاً بسلطانک و الوهیّتک.
output: From eternity Thou wert by Thy transcendent might supreme over all things, and Thou wilt be exalted unto eternity in Thy Godhead and surpassing sovereignty.

input: فارحم عبادک و بریّتک.
output: Let Thy mercy, then, be upon Thy servants and Thy creatures.

input: انّک انت المقتدر المتعالی العزیز المختار.
output: Thou art, in truth, the Almighty, the Inaccessible, the All Glorious, the Unconditioned.

input: اسألک بروائح قمیص فضلک الّتی تضوّعت فی الامکان بأمرک و ارادتک و بشمس مشیّتک الّتی اضآءت من افق الفضل بقدرتک و سلطانک بأن تجعل قلبی مقدّساً من الظّنون و الأوهام لأقبل بکلّی الیک یا ربّ الأنام.
output: I entreat Thee by the fragrances of the Raiment of Thy grace which at Thy bidding and in conformity with Thy desire were diffused throughout the entire creation, and by the Daystar of Thy will that hath shone brightly, through the power of Thy might and of Thy sovereignty, above the horizon of Thy mercy, to blot out from my heart all idle fancies and vain imaginings, that with all my affections I may turn unto Thee, O Thou Lord of all mankind.

input: یا الهی انّی عبدک و ابن عبدک.
output: I am Thy servant and the son of Thy servant, O my God.

input: قد تمسّکت بعروة فضلک و حبل عنایتک.
output: I have laid hold on the handle of Thy grace, and clung to the cord of Thy tender mercy.

input: قدّر لی ما هو خیر عندک ثمّ ارزقنی مائدة الّتی نزّلتها من سحاب جودک و سمآء کرمک.
output: Ordain for me the good things that are with Thee, and nourish me from the Table Thou didst send down out of the clouds of Thy bounty and the heaven of Thy favor.

input: انّک انت مولی العالمین و اله من فی السّموات و الأرضین.
output: Thou, in very truth, art the Lord of the worlds, and the God of all that are in heaven and all that are on earth.

input: لم ادر یا الهی ایّ نار جعلتها مشتعلة فی ارضک.
output: I know not, O my God, what the Fire is which Thou didst kindle in Thy land.

input: بحیث لا یسترها التّراب و لا یخمدها المیاه.
output: Earth can never cloud its splendor, nor water quench its flame.

input: و لا یمنعها من علی الأرض کلّها.
output: All the peoples of the world are powerless to resist its force.

input: طوبی لمن استقرب بها و سمع زفیرها.
output: Great is the blessedness of him that hath drawn nigh unto it, and heard its roaring.

input: و من النّاس من وفّقته یا الهی بالتّقرّب الیها و منهم من جعلته محروماً عنها بما اکتسبت یداه فی ایّامک.
output: Some, O my God, Thou didst, through Thy strengthening grace, enable to approach it, while others Thou didst keep back by reason of what their hands have wrought in Thy days.

input: و الّذی سرع الیها و فاز بها فدی نفسه فی سبیلک شوقاً لجمالک و صعد الیک خالصاً عمّا سواک.
output: Whoso hath hasted towards it and attained unto it hath, in his eagerness to gaze on Thy beauty, yielded his life in Thy path, and ascended unto Thee, wholly detached from aught else except Thyself.

input: ای رب اسألک بهذه النّار المشتعلة الملتهبة فی الآفاق بأن تخرق حجبات الّتی منعتنی عن الحضور تلقآء عرش عظمتک و الوقوف لدی بابک.
output: I beseech Thee, O my Lord, by this Fire which blazeth and rageth in the world of creation, to rend asunder the veils that have hindered me from appearing before the throne of Thy majesty, and from standing at the door of Thy gate.

input: ای ربّ قدّر لی کلّ خیر نزّلته فی کتابک و لا تبعدنی عن جوار رحمتک.
output: Do Thou ordain for me, O my Lord, every good thing Thou didst send down in Thy Book, and suffer me not to be far removed from the shelter of Thy mercy.

input: و انّک انت العزیز الکریم.
output: Thou art, verily, the All Powerful, the Most Generous.

input: وفّق عبادک و امائک علی ذکرک و الاستقامة علی حبّک.
output: Aid Thou by Thy strengthening grace Thy servants and Thy handmaidens to recount Thy virtues and to be steadfast in their love towards Thee.

input: کم من اوراق سقطت من اریاح الافتتان و کم منها تمسّکت بسدرة الأمر علی شأن ما حرّکها الامتحان یا ربّنا الرّحمن.
output: How many the leaves which the tempests of trials have caused to fall, and how many, too, are those which, clinging tenaciously to the tree of Thy Cause, have remained unshaken by the tests that have assailed them, O Thou Who art our Lord, the Most Merciful.

input: لک الحمد بما اریتنی عباداً کسّروا اصنام الهوی بقدرتک و سلطانک و ما منعهم عن شطر فضلک ما عند بریّتک.
output: I render Thee thanks that Thou hast made known unto me such servants as have utterly abolished, by the power of Thy might and of Thy sovereignty, the idols of their corrupt desires, and were not kept back by the things which are possessed by Thy creatures from turning in the direction of Thy grace.

input: قد خرقوا الأحجاب علی شأن ناحت سکّان مدائن الهوی و فزعت اصحاب الغلّ و الفحشآء الّذین زیّنوا رؤوسهم و ابدانهم بأسباب العلم و بها استکبروا علی نفسک و اعرضوا عن جمالک.
output: These have so vehemently rent the veils asunder that the dwellers of the cities of self have wept, and fear and trembling seized the people of envy and wickedness who, adorning their heads and their bodies with the emblems of knowledge, have proudly rejected Thee and turned away from Thy beauty.

input: ای ربّ اسألک بمجدک العظیم و اسمک القدیم بأن تؤیّد احبّائک علی نصرتک.
output: I implore Thee, O my Lord, by Thy surpassing majesty and Thine Ancient Name, to enable Thy loved ones to assist Thee.

input: ثمّ اجعلهم فی کلّ الأحوال ناظراً الی وجهک ثمّ اکتب لهم ما تفرح به القلوب و تقرّ به العیون.
output: Direct, then, continually their faces towards Thy face, and write down for them what will cause all hearts to exult and all eyes to be gladdened.

input: انّک انت اللّه المهیمن القیّوم.
output: Thou, truly, art the Help in peril, the Self Subsisting.

input: یا من بلائک دوآء صدور المخلصین و ذکرک شفآء افئدة المقرّبین و قربک حیوة العاشقین و وصلک رجآء المشتاقین و هجرک عذاب الموحّدین و فراقک موت العارفین.
output: God. The trials Thou sendest are a salve to the sores of all them who are devoted to Thy will. the remembrance of Thee is a healing medicine to the hearts of such as have drawn nigh unto Thy court. nearness to Thee is the true life of them who are Thy lovers. Thy presence is the ardent desire of such as yearn to behold Thy face. remoteness from Thee is a torment to those that have acknowledged Thy oneness, and separation from Thee is death unto them that have recognized Thy truth.

input: اسألک بضجیج المشتاقین فی هجرک و صریخ العاشقین فی بعدهم عن لقائک بأن ترزقنی خمر عرفانک و کوثر حبّک و رضائک ای ربّ هذه امة الّتی نسیت ما سواک و آنست بحبّک و ناحت فیما ورد علیک من اشرار خلقک.
output: I beseech Thee by the sighs which they whose souls pant after Thee have uttered in their remoteness from Thy court, and by the cries of such of Thy lovers as bemoan their separation from Thee, to nourish me with the wine of Thy knowledge and the living waters of Thy love and pleasure. Behold Thy handmaiden, O my Lord, who hath forgotten all else except Thee, and who hath delighted herself with Thy love, and lamented over the things that have befallen Thee at the hands of the wicked doers among Thy creatures.

input: قدّر لها ما قدّرته لامائک اللّائی یطفن حول عرش عظمتک و یزرن جمالک فی العشیّ و الاشراق.
output: Do Thou ordain for her that which Thou didst ordain for such of Thy handmaidens as circle round the throne of Thy majesty, and gaze, at eventide and at dawn, on Thy beauty.

input: و انّک انت الحاکم فی یوم التّلاق.
output: Thou art, verily, the Lord of the Judgment Day.

input: هذه ایّام فیها فرضت الصّیام لکلّ الأنام لیزکّی بها انفسهم و ینقطعنّ عمّا سواک و یصعد من قلوبهم ما یکون لایقاً لمکامن عزّ احدیّتک و قابلاً لمقرّ ظهور فردانیّتک.
output: These are the days whereon Thou hast bidden all men to observe the Fast, that through it they may purify their souls and rid themselves of all attachment to any one but Thee, and that out of their hearts may ascend that which will be worthy of the court of Thy majesty and may well beseem the seat of the revelation of Thy oneness.

input: ای ربّ فاجعل هذا الصّیام کوثر الحیوان و قدّر فیه اثره.
output: Grant, O my Lord, that this fast may become a river of life giving waters and may yield the virtue wherewith Thou hast endowed it.

input: و طهّر به افئدة عبادک الّذین ما منعهم مکاره الدّنیا عن التّوجّه الی شطر اسمک الأبهی و ما اضطربوا من ضوضآء الّذین هم کفروا بآیاتک الکبری بعد الّذی ارسلت مظهر نفسک بسلطنتک و اقتدارک و عظمتک و اجلالک.
output: Cleanse Thou by its means the hearts of Thy servants whom the evils of the world have failed to hinder from turning towards Thine all glorious Name, and who have remained unmoved by the noise and tumult of such as have repudiated Thy most resplendent signs which have accompanied the advent of Thy Manifestation Whom Thou hast invested with Thy sovereignty, Thy power, Thy majesty and glory.

input: اولئک اذا سمعوا ندائک سرعوا الی شطر رحمتک و ما امسکتهم الشّؤونات العرضیّة و الحدودات البشریّة.
output: These are the servants who, as soon as Thy call reached them, hastened in the direction of Thy mercy and were not kept back from Thee by the changes and chances of this world or by any human limitations.

input: و انا الّذی یا الهی اکون مقرّاً بوحدانیّتک و معترفاً بفردانیّتک و خاضعاً لدی ظهورات عظمتک و خاشعاً عند بوارق انوار عزّ احدیّتک.
output: I am he, O my God, who testifieth to Thy unity, who acknowledgeth Thy oneness, who boweth humbly before the revelations of Thy majesty, and who recognizeth with downcast countenance the splendors of the light of Thy transcendent glory.

input: آمنت بک بعد الّذی عرّفتنی نفسک و اظهرته بسلطانک و قدرتک.
output: I have believed in Thee after Thou didst enable me to know Thy Self, Whom Thou hast revealed to men's eyes through the power of Thy sovereignty and might.

input: و توجّهت الیه منقطعاً عن کلّ الجهات و متمسّکاً بحبل الطافک و مواهبک و آمنت به و بما نزّل علیه من بدایع احکامک و اوامرک.
output: Unto Him I have turned, wholly detached from all things, and cleaving steadfastly unto the cord of Thy gifts and favors. I have embraced His truth, and the truth of all the wondrous laws and precepts that have been sent down unto Him.

input: و صمت بحبّک و اتّباعاً لأمرک و افطرت بذکرک و رضائک.
output: I have fasted for love of Thee and in pursuance of Thine injunction, and have broken my fast with Thy praise on my tongue and in conformity with Thy pleasure.

input: ای ربّ لا تجعلنی من الّذین هم صاموا فی الأیّام و سجدوا لوجهک فی اللّیالی و کفروا بنفسک و انکروا آیاتک و جاحدوا برهانک و حرّفوا کلماتک.
output: Suffer me not, O my Lord, to be reckoned among them who have fasted in the daytime, who in the night season have prostrated themselves before Thy face, and who have repudiated Thy truth, disbelieved in Thy signs, gainsaid Thy testimony, and perverted Thine utterances.

input: ای ربّ فافتح عینی و عین من ارادک لنعرفک بعینک.
output: Open Thou, O my Lord, mine eyes and the eyes of all them that have sought Thee, that we may recognize Thee with Thine own eyes.

input: و هذا ما امرتنا به فی الکتاب الّذی انزلته علی من اصطیفته بأمرک و اختصصته بین بریّتک و ارتضیته لسلطنتک و اجتبیته و ارسلته علی بریّتک.
output: This is Thy bidding given us in the Book sent down by Thee unto Him Whom Thou hast chosen by Thy behest, Whom Thou hast singled out for Thy favor above all Thy creatures, Whom Thou hast been pleased to invest with Thy sovereignty, and Whom Thou hast specially favored and entrusted with Thy Message unto Thy people.

input: فلک الحمد یا الهی بما وفّقتنا علی الاقرار به و التّصدیق بما نزّل علیه و شرّفتنا بلقآء من وعدتنا به فی کتبک و الواحک.
output: Praised be Thou, therefore, O my God, inasmuch as Thou hast graciously enabled us to recognize Him and to acknowledge whatsoever hath been sent down unto Him, and conferred upon us the honor of attaining the presence of the One Whom Thou didst promise in Thy Book and in Thy Tablets.

input: و اذاً یا الهی قد توجّهت الیک و تمسّکت بعروة عطفک و جودک و تشبّثت بذیل الطافک و مواهبک.
output: Thou seest me then, O my God, with my face turned towards Thee, cleaving steadfastly to the cord of Thy gracious providence and generosity, and clinging to the hem of Thy tender mercies and bountiful favors.

input: اسألک بأن لا تخیّبنی عمّا قدّرته لعبادک الّذین هم اقبلوا الی حرم وصلک و کعبة لقائک و صاموا فی حبّک.
output: Destroy not, I implore Thee, my hopes of attaining unto that which Thou didst ordain for Thy servants who have turned towards the precincts of Thy court and the sanctuary of Thy presence, and have observed the Fast for love of Thee.

input: ولو انّی یا الهی اعترف بأنّ کلّ ما یظهر منّی لم یکن قابلاً لسلطانک و لا یلیق لحضرتک.
output: I confess, O my God, that whatever proceedeth from me is wholly unworthy of Thy sovereignty and falleth short of Thy majesty.

input: ولکن اسألک باسمک الّذی به تجلّیت علی کلّ الأشیآء باسمائک الحسنی فی هذا الظّهور الّذی اظهرت جمالک باسمک الأبهی بأن تشربنی خمر رحمتک و رحیق مکرمتک الّذی جری عن یمین مشیّتک لأتوجّه بکلّی الیک و انقطع عمّا سواک علی شأن لا اری الدّنیا و ما خلق فیها الّا کیوم ما خلقتها.
output: And yet I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which Thou hast revealed Thy Self, in the glory of Thy most excellent titles, unto all created things, in this Revelation whereby Thou hast, through Thy most resplendent Name, manifested Thy beauty, to give me to drink of the wine of Thy mercy and of the pure beverage of Thy favor, which have streamed forth from the right hand of Thy will, that I may so fix my gaze upon Thee and be so detached from all else but Thee, that the world and all that hath been created therein may appear before me as a fleeting day which Thou hast not deigned to create.

input: ثمّ اسألک یا الهی بأن تنزّل من سمآء ارادتک و سحاب رحمتک ما یذهب عنّا روایح العصیان یا من سمّیت نفسک بالرّحمن و انّک انت المقتدر العزیز المنّان.
output: I moreover entreat Thee, O my God, to rain down, from the heaven of Thy will and the clouds of Thy mercy, that which will cleanse us from the noisome savors of our transgressions, O Thou Who hast called Thyself the God of Mercy. Thou art, verily, the Most Powerful, the All Glorious, the Beneficent.

input: ای ربّ لا تطرد من اقبل الیک و لا تبعّد من تقرّب بک.
output: Cast not away, O my Lord, him that hath turned towards Thee, nor suffer him who hath drawn nigh unto Thee to be removed far from Thy court.

input: و لا تخیّب من رفع ایادی الرّجآء الی شطر فضلک و مواهبک و لا تحرم عبادک المخلصین عن بدایع فضلک و افضالک.
output: Dash not the hopes of the suppliant who hath longingly stretched out his hands to seek Thy grace and favors, and deprive not Thy sincere servants of the wonders of Thy tender mercies and loving kindness.

input: ای ربّ انت الغفور و انت الکریم.
output: Forgiving and Most Bountiful art Thou, O my Lord.

input: و انت المقتدر علی ما تشآء.
output: Power hast Thou to do what Thou pleasest.

input: و ما سواک عجزآء لدی ظهورات قدرتک و فقدآء لدی آثار غنائک و عدمآء عند ظهورات عزّ سلطنتک و ضعفآء عند شؤونات قدرتک.
output: All else but Thee are impotent before the revelations of Thy might, are as lost in the face of the evidences of Thy wealth, are as nothing when compared with the manifestations of Thy transcendent sovereignty, and are destitute of all strength when face to face with the signs and tokens of Thy power.

input: ای ربّ هل دونک من مهرب لنهرب الیه او سواک من ملجأ لأسرع الیه.
output: What refuge is there beside Thee, O my Lord, to which I can flee, and where is there a haven to which I can hasten

input: لا وعزّتک.
output: Nay, the power of Thy might beareth me witness.

input: لا عاصم الّا انت و لا مفرّ الّا انت و لا مهرب الّا الیک.
output: No protector is there but Thee, no place to flee to except Thee, no refuge to seek save Thee.

input: ای ربّ اذقنی حلاوة ذکرک و ثنائک.
output: Cause me to taste, O my Lord, the divine sweetness of Thy remembrance and praise.

input: فوعزّتک من ذاق حلاوته انقطع عن الدّنیا و ما خلق فیها و توجّه الیک مطهّراً عن ذکر دونک.
output: I swear by Thy might. Whosoever tasteth of its sweetness will rid himself of all attachment to the world and all that is therein, and will set his face towards Thee, cleansed from the remembrance of any one except Thee.

input: فیا الهی فألهمنی من بدایع ذکرک لأذکرک بها.
output: Inspire then my soul, O my God, with Thy wondrous remembrance, that I may glorify Thy name.

input: و لا تجعلنی من الّذین یقرؤون آیاتک و لا یجدون ما قدّر فیها من نعمتک المکنونة الّتی تحیی بها افئدة بریّتک و قلوب عبادک.
output: Number me not with them who read Thy words and fail to find Thy hidden gift which, as decreed by Thee, is contained therein, and which quickeneth the souls of Thy creatures and the hearts of Thy servants.

input: ای ربّ فاجعلنی من الّذین اخذتهم نفحات ایّامک علی شأن انفقوا ارواحهم فی سبیلک و سرعوا الی مشهد الفنآء شوقاً لجمالک و طلباً لوصالک.
output: Cause me, O my Lord, to be reckoned among them who have been so stirred up by the sweet savors that have been wafted in Thy days that they have laid down their lives for Thee and hastened to the scene of their death in their longing to gaze on Thy beauty and in their yearning to attain Thy presence.

input: و اذا قیل لهم فی الطّریق الی ایّ مقرّ تذهبون.
output: And were any one to say unto them on their way, Whither go ye

input: قالوا الی اللّه الملک المهیمن القیّوم.
output: they would say, Unto God, the All Possessing, the Help in Peril, the Self Subsisting.

input: و ما منعهم ظلم الّذین اعرضوا عنک و بغوا علیک عن حبّهم ایّاک و توجّههم الیک و اقبالهم الی شطر رحمتک.
output: The transgressions committed by such as have turned away from Thee and have borne themselves haughtily towards Thee have not availed to hinder them from loving Thee, and from setting their faces towards Thee, and from turning in the direction of Thy mercy.

input: اولئک عباد یصلّینّ علیهم الملأ الأعلی و یکبّرنّ اهل مداین البقآء ثمّ الّذین رقم علی جبینهم من قلمک الأعلی هؤلآء.
output: These are they who are blessed by the Concourse on high, who are glorified by the denizens of the everlasting Cities, and beyond them by those on whose foreheads Thy most exalted pen hath written: These.

input: اهل البهآء.
output: The people of Bahá.

input: و بهم ظهرت انوار الهدی.
output: Through them have been shed the splendors of the light of guidance.

input: و کذلک قدّر فی لوح القضآء بأمرک و ارادتک.
output: Thus hath it been ordained, at Thy behest and by Thy will, in the Tablet of Thine irrevocable decree.

input: فیا الهی کبّر علیهم و علی الّذین طافوا فی حولهم فی حیوتهم و مماتهم.
output: Proclaim, therefore, O my God, their greatness and the greatness of those who while living or after death have circled round them.

input: ثمّ ارزقهم ما قدّرته لخیرة خلقک.
output: Supply them with that which Thou hast ordained for the righteous among Thy creatures.

input: لا اله الّا انت المقتدر المهیمن العزیز الوهّاب.
output: There is no God but Thee, the All Powerful, the Help in Peril, the Almighty, the Most Bountiful.

input: ای ربّ لا تجعل هذا الصّوم آخر صومنا و آخر عهدنا.
output: Do not bring our fasts to an end with this fast, O my Lord, nor the covenants Thou hast made with this covenant.

input: ثمّ اقبل ما عملناه فی حبّک و رضائک و ما ترک عنّا بما غلبت علینا شؤونات النّفس و الهوی.
output: Do Thou accept all that we have done for love of Thee, and for the sake of Thy pleasure, and all that we have left undone as a result of our subjection to our evil and corrupt desires.

input: ثمّ استقمنا علی حبّک و رضائک ثمّ احفظنا من شرّ الّذین هم کفروا بک و بآیاتک الکبری.
output: Enable us, then, to cleave steadfastly to Thy love and Thy good pleasure, and preserve us from the mischief of such as have denied Thee and repudiated Thy most resplendent signs.

input: و انّک انت ربّ الآخرة و الأولی.
output: Thou art, in truth, the Lord of this world and of the next.

input: لا اله الّا انت العلیّ الأعلی.
output: No God is there beside Thee, the Exalted, the Most High.

input: و کبّر اللّهمّ یا الهی علی النّقطة الأوّلیّة و سرّ الأحدیّة و غیب الهویّة و مطلع الألوهیّة و مظهر الرّبوبیّة الّذی به فصّلت علم ما کان و ما یکون و ظهرت لآلئ علمک المکنون و سرّ اسمک المخزون و جعلته مبشّراً للّذی باسمه الّف الکاف برکنها النّون و به ظهرت سلطنتک و عظمتک و اقتدارک و نزّلت آیاتک و فصّلت احکامک و نشرت آثارک و حقّقت کلمتک و بعثت قلوب اصفیائک و حشر من فی سمائک و ارضک الّذی سمّیته بعلیّ قبل نبیل فی ملکوت اسمائک و بروح الرّوح فی الواح قضائک و اقمته مقام نفسک و رجعت کلّ الأسمآء الی اسمه بأمرک و قدرتک و به انتهت اسمائک و صفاتک.
output: Magnify Thou, O Lord my God, Him Who is the Primal Point, the Divine Mystery, the Unseen Essence, the Dayspring of Divinity, and the Manifestation of Thy Lordship, through Whom all the knowledge of the past and all the knowledge of the future were made plain, through Whom the pearls of Thy hidden wisdom were uncovered, and the mystery of Thy treasured name disclosed, Whom Thou hast appointed as the Announcer of the One through Whose name the letter B and the letter E have been joined and united, through Whom Thy majesty, Thy sovereignty and Thy might were made known, through Whom Thy words have been sent down, and Thy laws set forth with clearness, and Thy signs spread abroad, and Thy Word established, through Whom the hearts of Thy chosen ones were laid bare, and all that were in the heavens and all that were on the earth were gathered together, Whom Thou hast called 'Alí Muhammad in the kingdom of Thy names, and the Spirit of Spirits in the Tablets of Thine irrevocable decree, Whom Thou hast invested with Thine own title, unto Whose name all other names have, at Thy bidding and through the power of Thy might, been made to return, and in Whom Thou hast caused all Thine attributes and titles to attain their final consummation.

input: و له اسمآء فی سرادق عفّتک و فی عوالم غیبک و مداین تقدیسک.
output: To Him also belong such names as lay hid within Thy stainless tabernacles, in Thine invisible world and Thy sanctified cities.

input: و علی الّذین هم آمنوا به و بآیاته و توجّهوا الیه منقطعین عمّا سواک من الّذین اعترفوا بوحدانیّتک فی ظهوره کرّةً اخری الّذی کان مذکوراً فی الواحه و کتبه و صحفه و فی کلّ ما نزّل علیه من بدایع آیاتک و جواهر کلماتک.
output: Magnify Thou, moreover, such as have believed in Him and in His signs and have turned towards Him, from among those that have acknowledged Thy unity in His Latter Manifestation—a Manifestation whereof He hath made mention in His Tablets, and in His Books, and in His Scriptures, and in all the wondrous verses and gem like utterances that have descended upon Him.

input: و امرته بأن یأخذ عهد نفسه قبل عهد نفسه.
output: It is this same Manifestation Whose covenant Thou hast bidden Him establish ere He had established His own covenant.

input: و نزّل البیان فی ذکره و شأنه.
output: He it is Whose praise the Bayán hath celebrated.

input: و اثبات حقّه و اظهار سلطنته و اتقان امره.
output: In it His excellence hath been extolled, and His truth established, and His sovereignty proclaimed, and His Cause perfected.

input: طوبی لمن اقبل الیه و عمل ما امر به من عنده یا اله العالمین و مقصود العارفین.
output: Blessed is the man that hath turned unto Him, and fulfilled the things He hath commanded, O Thou Who art the Lord of the worlds and the Desire of all them that have known Thee.

input: فلک الحمد یا الهی بما وفّقتنا علی عرفانه و حبّه.
