output: Purify me of all that is not of Thee, and strengthen me to love Thee and to fulfill Thy pleasure, that I may delight myself in the contemplation of Thy beauty, and be rid of all attachment to any of Thy creatures, and may, at every moment, proclaim: Magnified be God, the Lord of the worlds.

input: ای ربّ فاجعل رزقی جمالک و شرابی وصالک و املی رضائک و عملی ثنائک و انیسی ذکرک و معینی سلطانک و مستقرّی مقرّک و وطنی المقام الّذی جعلته مقدّساً من حدودات المحتجبین.
output: Let my food, O my Lord, be Thy beauty, and my drink the light of Thy presence, and my hope Thy pleasure, and my work Thy praise, and my companion Thy remembrance, and my aid Thy sovereignty, and my dwelling place Thy habitation, and my home the seat which Thou hast exalted above the limitations of them that are shut out as by a veil from Thee.

input: و انّک انت المقتدر العزیز القدیر.
output: Thou art, in truth, the God of power, of strength and glory.

input: کلّما یخطر بقلبی ذکرک و ثنائک یأخذنی الجذب و الانجذاب علی شأن یمنعنی عن الذّکر و البیان.
output: Every time I am reminded of Thee and muse on Thy virtues, I am seized with such ecstasies and am so enravished by Thee that I find myself unable to make mention of Thy name and to extol Thee.

input: و یرجعنی الی مقام اشاهد هیکلی نفس ذکرک فی مملکتک و کینونة ثنائک بین عبادک.
output: I am carried back to such heights that I recognize my self to be the same as the remembrance of Thee in Thy realm, and the essence of Thy praise among Thy servants.

input: متی یکون یکون ثنائک منتشراً بین خلقک و ذکرک مذکوراً بین بریّتک.
output: As long as that self endureth, so long will Thy praise continue to be shed abroad among Thy creatures and Thy remembrance glorified by Thy people.

input: و کلّ ذی بصر من عبادک یوقن بأنّ هیکلی باقی لا یفنی لأنّ ذکرک باقی بدوام نفسک و ثنائک دائم بدوام سلطنتک.
output: Every man endued with insight among Thy servants is persuaded that my self liveth eternally and can never perish, inasmuch as remembrance of Thee is eternal and will endure so long as Thine own Self endureth, and Thy praise is everlasting and will last as long as Thine own sovereignty will last.

input: و به یذکرک الذّاکرون من اصفیائک و المخلصون من عبادک.
output: By its means Thou art glorified by such of Thy chosen ones as call upon Thee and by the sincere among Thy servants.

input: بل کلّ من یذکرک فی الامکان بدئ ذکره من هذا المقام و یرجع الیه کما انّ الشّمس اذا اشرقت تتجلّی علی کلّ من قابلها.
output: Nay, the praise wherewith any one, in the entire creation, praiseth Thee proceedeth from this exalted self and returneth unto it, even as the sun which, while it shineth, sheddeth its splendor upon whatsoever may be exposed to its rays.

input: و التّجلّی الّذی ظهر فی کلّ شیء هو منها و یرجع الیها.
output: From this sun is generated, and unto it must return, the light which is shed over all things.

input: سبحانک سبحانک من ان یقاس امرک بأمر او یرجع الیه الأمثال او یعرف بالمقال.
output: Exalted, immeasurably exalted art Thou above any attempt to measure the greatness of Thy Cause, above any comparison that one may seek to make, above the efforts of the human tongue to utter its import.

input: لم تزل کنت و ما کان معک من شیء و لا تزال تکون بمثل ما کنت فی علوّ ذاتک و سموّ جلالک.
output: From everlasting Thou hast existed, alone with no one else beside Thee, and wilt, to everlasting, continue to remain the same, in the sublimity of Thine essence and the inaccessible heights of Thy glory.

input: فلمّا اردت عرفان نفسک اظهرت مظهراً من مظاهر امرک و جعلته آیة ظهورک بین بریّتک و مظهر غیبک بین خلقک الی ان انتهت الظّهورات بالّذی جعلته سلطاناً علی من فی جبروت الأمر و الخلق و مهیمناً مقتدراً علی من فی ملکوت السّموات و الأرض.
output: And when Thou didst purpose to make Thyself known unto men, Thou didst successively reveal the Manifestations of Thy Cause, and ordained each to be a sign of Thy Revelation among Thy people, and the Dayspring of Thine invisible Self amidst Thy creatures, until the time when, as decreed by Thee, all Thy previous Revelations culminated in Him Whom Thou hast appointed as the Lord of all who are in the heaven of revelation and the kingdom of creation, Him Whom Thou hast established as the Sovereign Lord of all who are in the heavens and all who are on the earth.

input: و جعلته مبشّراً لظهورک الأعظم و طلوعک الأقدم.
output: He it was Whom Thou hast determined to be the Herald of Thy Most Great Revelation and the Announcer of Thy Most Ancient Splendor.

input: و ما کان مقصودک فی ذلک الّا بأن تمتحن مظاهر اسمائک الحسنی بین الأرض و السّمآء.
output: In this Thou hadst no other purpose except to try them who have manifested Thy most excellent titles unto all who are in heaven and on earth.

input: و امرته بأن یأخذ عهد نفسه عن کلّ الأشیآء.
output: He it was Whom Thou hast commanded to establish His covenant with all created things.

input: فلمّا جآء الوعد و تمّ المیقات ظهر مالک الأسمآء و الصّفات.
output: And when Thy promise came to pass and the set time was fulfilled, He Who is the Possessor of all Names and Attributes was made manifest unto men.

input: اذاً فزع کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرض الّا الّذین عصمتهم بعصمتک و حفظتهم فی کنف قدرتک و عنایتک.
output: Thereupon all that were in the heavens and all that were on the earth were terror stricken save those whom Thou didst keep under Thy protection and preserve within the shelter of Thy power and gracious providence.

input: و ورد علیهم من طغاة خلقک ما عجزت عن ذکره السن عبادک.
output: There befell Him, at the hands of such of Thy creatures as have transgressed against Thee, that which the tongue of no one of Thy servants can recount.

input: اذاً یا الهی فانظر الیه بلحظات رأفتک ثمّ انزل علیه و علی محبّیه کلّ خیر قدّرته فی سمآء مشیّتک و لوح قضائک.
output: Look down, then, upon Him, O my God, with the eye of Thy tender mercy, and send down upon Him and upon those that love Him all the good Thou didst ordain in the heaven of Thy will and the Tablet of Thy decree.

input: ثمّ انصرهم بنصرک و انّک انت المقتدر المتعالی العزیز الجبّار.
output: Aid them, then, with Thy succor, for Thou art, verily, the Almighty, the Most Exalted, the All Glorious, the All Compelling.

input: اشهد لنفسک کما شهدت لنفسک بنفسک قبل خلق الاختراع و ذکر الابداع بأنّک انت اللّه لا اله الّا انت.
output: I bear witness for Thee to that whereto Thou Thyself didst bear witness for Thine own Self, ere the day Thou hadst created the creation or made mention thereof, that Thou art God, and that there is none other God beside Thee.

input: لم تزل کنت فی علوّ وحدانیّتک مقدّساً عن توحید عبادک و لا تزال تکون فی سموّ فردانیّتک متعالیاً عن ذکر خلقک.
output: From eternity Thou hast, in Thy transcendent oneness, been immeasurably exalted above Thy servants' conception of Thy unity, and wilt to eternity remain, in Thine unapproachable singleness, far above the praise of Thy creatures.

input: لا ینبغی لذاتک ذکر غیرک و لا یلیق لنفسک وصف ما سواک.
output: No words that any one beside Thee may utter can ever beseem Thee, and no man's description except Thine own description can befit Thy nature.

input: کلّ موحّد تحیّر فی توحید ذاتک و اعترف بالقصور عن الصّعود الی عرفان کنهک و البلوغ الی ذروة عرفانک.
output: All who adore Thy unity have been sore perplexed to fathom the mystery of Thy oneness, and all have confessed their powerlessness to attain unto the comprehension of Thine essence and to scale the pinnacle of Thy knowledge.

input: کلّ ذی قوّة اقرّ بالعجز و کلّ ذی علم اعترف بالجهل.
output: The mighty have all acknowledged their weakness, and the learned recognized their ignorance.

input: و کلّ ذی وجود معدوم عند ظهورات عزّ سلطنتک و کلّ ذی ظهور مفقود لدی شؤونات عزّ عظمتک.
output: They that are possessed of influence are as nothing when compared with the revelations of Thy stupendous sovereignty, and they who are exalted sink into oblivion when brought before the manifestations of Thy great glory.

input: و کلّ ذی نور مظلم عند بوارق انوار وجهک و کلّ ذی بیان کلیل عند تنزّل آیات قدس احدیّتک و کلّ قائم مضطرب عند ظهور عزّ قیّومیّتک.
output: The radiance of the brightest luminaries is eclipsed by the effulgent splendors of Thy face, and the tongues of the most eloquent of speakers falter under the unrestrained effusions of Thy holy utterance, and the foundations of the mightiest structures tremble before the onrushing force of Thy compelling power.

input: هل لغیرک یا الهی من وجود لیذکر تلقآء ذکرک و هل لدونک من ظهور لیکون دلیلاً لنفسک او مذکوراً فی ساحة عزّ توحیدک.
output: Who is there, O my God, that can be deemed worthy to be remembered when Thou art remembered, and where is he to be found who can be regarded as capable of hinting at Thy nature or worthy of mention in the court of Thy transcendent oneness

input: لم تزل کنت و لم یکن معک من شیء و لا تزال تکون بمثل ما کنت.
output: From everlasting Thou hast been alone with no one else beside Thee, and to everlasting Thou wilt continue to be one and the same.

input: لا اله الّا انت المقتدر العزیز العلیم.
output: No God is there beside Thee, the God of power, of glory and wisdom.

input: اسألک بذکرک العلیّ الأعلی الّذی اظهرته باسمک الأبهی بین اهل الانشآء و جعلت مشیّته ذات مشیّتک و نفسه مظهر نفسک و کینونته مطلع علمک و قلبه مخزن الهامک و فؤاده مهبط وحیک و صدره مشرق اسمائک الحسنی و صفاتک العلیا و لسانه منبع کوثر ثنائک و سلسبیل حکمتک بأن تنزّل علینا ما یجعلنا اغنیآء عن دونک و مقدّسین عمّا سواک و قاصدین الی حرم رضائک و آملین ما قدّرت لنا بتقدیرک.
output: I beseech Thee by Him Who is Thine exalted and supreme Remembrance, Whom Thou hast sent down unto all Thy creatures and invested with Thy name, the All Glorious, Whose will Thou hast ordained to be Thine own will, Whose self Thou hast decreed to be the revealer of Thine own Self, and His essence the Dayspring of Thy wisdom, and His heart the treasury of Thine inspiration, and His breast the dawning place of Thy most excellent attributes and most exalted titles, and His tongue the fountainhead of the waters of Thy praise and the wellspring of the soft flowing streams of Thy wisdom, to send down upon us that which will enable us to dispense with all else except Thee, and will cause us to direct our steps towards the sanctuary of Thy pleasure and to aspire after the things Thou didst ordain for us according to Thine irrevocable decree.

input: ثمّ اجعلنا یا الهی منقطعین عن انفسنا و متوسّلین بمظهر نفسک العلیّ الأعلی.
output: Empower us, then, O my God, to forsake ourselves and cleave steadfastly to Him Who is the Manifestation of Thy Self, the Most Exalted, the Most High.

input: ثمّ ارزقنا ما هو خیر لنا ثمّ اکتبنا من عبادک الّذین کفروا بالطّاغوت و آمنوا بنفسک و استقرّوا علی سرر الایقان علی شأن ما منعتهم اشارات الشّیطان عن التّوجّه الی شطر اسمک الرّحمن.
output: Supply us also with that which is best for us, and write us down with such of Thy servants as have repudiated the Idol Mírzá Yahyá, and firmly believed in Thee, and been so established on the throne of certitude that the whisperings of the Evil One have been powerless to hinder them from turning their faces towards Thy name, the All Merciful.

input: و انّک انت المقتدر علی ما تشآء و الحاکم علی ما ترید.
output: Powerful art Thou to do what Thou pleasest and to ordain what Thou willest.

input: لا اله الّا انت الملک المتعالی المقتدر المعطی العلیم الحکیم.
output: No God is there but Thee, the All Possessing, the All Highest, the Almighty, the All Bountiful, the All Knowing, the All Wise.

input: یا من ذکرک انیس قلوب المشتاقین و اسمک حبیب افئدة المخلصین و ثنائک محبوب المقرّبین و وجهک مقصد العارفین و دائک شفآء صدور المقبلین و بلائک غایة مراد المنقطعین.
output: Thou Whose remembrance is the delight of the souls of all them that yearn after Thee, Whose name is the exultation of the hearts of all who are wholly devoted to Thy will, Whose praise is cherished by such as have drawn nigh unto Thy court, Whose face is the ardent desire of all them that have recognized Thy truth, Whose trial is the healer of the sicknesses of them who have embraced Thy Cause, Whose calamity is the highest aspiration of such as are rid of all attachment to any one but Thyself.

input: سبحانک سبحانک یا من بیدک ملکوت ملک السّموات و الأرضین یا من بکلمة من عندک انصعقت الممکنات و تفرّقت ارکانها و بکلمة اخری اجتمعت و رکّب کلّ جزء بالجزء الآخر.
output: Glorified, immeasurably glorified art Thou, in Whose hands is the empire of whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is on earth, Thou, Who through but one word of Thy mouth, caused all things to expire and dissolve asunder, and Who, by yet another word, caused whatever had been separated to be combined and reunited.

input: سبحانک یا من کنت قادراً علی من فی السّموات و الأرض و مقتدراً علی من فی جبروت الأمر و الخلق.
output: Magnified be Thy name, O Thou Who hast power over all that are in the heavens and all that are on earth, Whose dominion embraceth whatsoever is in the heaven of Thy Revelation and the kingdom of Thy creation.

input: لیس لک شبه فی الابداع و لا مثل فی الاختراع.
output: None can equal Thee in Thy created realms. none can compare with Thee in the universe Thou hast fashioned.

input: ما عرفک نفس و ما بلغ الیک احد.
output: The mind of no one hath comprehended Thee, and the aspiration of no soul hath reached Thee.

input: لو یطیر احد بأجنحة الغیب و الشّهود فی هوآء عرفانک بدوام نفسک لن یقدر ان یتجاوز من الحدودات الکونیّة .
output: Were any one to soar, on whatever wings, as long as Thine own Being endureth, throughout the immensity of Thy knowledge, he would still be powerless to transgress the bounds which the contingent world hath set for him.

input: من کان شأنه هذا کیف یقدر ان یطیر فی هوآء عزّ احدیّتک.
output: How can, then, such a man aspire to wing his flight into the atmosphere of Thy most exalted presence

input: انّ العارف من اقرّ بالعجز و اعترف بالذّنب لأنّ الوجود لو یذکر تلقآء مدین ظهورات عزّ امرک انّه لذنب لا یعادله ذنب فی ممالک ابداعک و اختراعک.
output: He, indeed, is endued with understanding who acknowledgeth his powerlessness and confesseth his sinfulness, for should any created thing lay claim to any existence, when confronted with the infinite wonders of Thy Revelation, so blasphemous a pretension would be more heinous than any other crime in all the domains of Thine invention and creation.

input: ای ربّ اذا اظهرت طلایع آیات عزّ سلطنتک و اقتدارک من یقدر ان یدّعی الوجود لنفسه.
output: Who is there, O my Lord, that, when Thou revealest the first glimmerings of the signs of Thy transcendent sovereignty and might, hath the power to claim for himself any existence

input: کلّ الوجود مفقود لدی ظهورات عزّ احدیّتک.
output: whatever Existence itself is as nothing when brought face to face with the mighty and manifold wonders of Thine incomparable Self.

input: سبحانک سبحانک یا مالک الملوک.
output: Far, immeasurably far, art Thou exalted above all things, O Thou Who art the King of Kings.

input: اسألک بنفسک و بمظاهر امرک و مطالع قدرتک بأن تکتب لنا ما کتبته لأصفیائک.
output: I entreat Thee by Thy Self and by Them Who are the Manifestations of Thy Cause and the Daysprings of Thine authority to write down for us that which Thou hast written down for Thy chosen ones.

input: و لا تجعلنا محرومین عمّا قدّرته لأولیائک الّذین اذا سمعوا ندائک سرعوا الیک و اذا اشرقت علیهم انوار الوجه سجدوا له.
output: Withhold not from us that which Thou didst ordain for Thy loved ones, who, as soon as Thy call reached them, hastened unto Thee, and when the splendors of the light of Thy countenance were shed upon them, instantly prostrated themselves in adoration before Thy face.

input: ای ربّ نحن عبادک و فی قبضة قدرتک.
output: We are Thy servants, O my Lord, and in the grasp of Thy power.

input: لو تعذّبنا بعذاب الأوّلین و الآخرین لتکون عادلاً فی امرک و محموداً فی فعلک.
output: If Thou chastisest us with the chastisement inflicted upon the former and the latter generations, Thy verdict would be assuredly just and Thine act praiseworthy.

input: لا اله الّا انت المقتدر العزیز المهیمن القیّوم.
output: None other God is there beside Thee, the Almighty, the All Glorious, the Help in Peril, the Self Subsisting.

input: سبحانک یا من تسمع ضجیج المنقطعین و صریخ المخلصین.
output: Unto Thee be praise, O Thou Who inclinest Thine ear to the sighing of them that have rid themselves of all attachment to any one but Thee, and Who hearest the voice of the lamentation of those who are wholly devoted to Thy Self.

input: و تری ما ورد علیهم من طغاة خلقک و عصاة بریّتک.
output: Thou beholdest all that hath befallen them at the hands of such of Thy creatures as have transgressed and rebelled against Thee.

input: فوعزّتک یا سلطان ممالک العدل و ملیک مداین الفضل.
output: Thy might beareth me witness, O Thou Who art the King of the realms of justice and the Ruler of the cities of mercy.

input: انّ البلایا قد ورد علیهم علی شأن لا یحصیها قلم الانشآء.
output: The tribulations they have been made to suffer are such as no pen, in the entire creation, can reckon.

input: و لو یرید ان یذکر لا یدری ما یذکر.
output: Should any one attempt to make mention of them, he would find himself powerless to describe them.

input: ولکن لمّا ورد فی سبیلک و حبّک لیشکرونک فی کلّ الأحوال و یقولون یا محبوب قلوبنا و المذکور فی صدورنا.
output: As these tribulations, however, were sustained in Thy path and for love of Thee, they who were afflicted by them render thanks, under all conditions, unto Thee, and say: O Thou Who art the Delight of our hearts and the Object of our adoration.

input: لو یمطر علینا من سحاب القضآء سهام البلآء ما نجزع فی حبّک.
output: Were the clouds of Thy decree to rain down upon us the darts of affliction, we would, in our love for Thee, refuse to be impatient.

input: و نشکرک فی ذلک لأنّا عرفنا و ایقنّا بأنّک ما قدّرت لنا الّا ما هو خیر لنا.
output: We would yield Thee praise and thanksgiving, for we have recognized and are persuaded that Thou hast ordained only that which will be best for us.

input: ولو تجزع بها فی بعض الأحیان اجسامنا تستبشر بها ارواحنا.
output: If our bodies be, at times, weighed down by our troubles, yet our souls rejoice with exceeding gladness.

input: فوعزّتک یا منیة قلوبنا و فرح صدورنا.
output: We swear by Thy might, O Thou Who art the Desire of our hearts and the Exultation of our souls.

input: کلّ نقمة فی حبّک رحمة و کلّ نار نور و کلّ عذاب عذب و کلّ تعب راحة و کلّ حزن فرح.
output: Every trouble that toucheth us in our love for Thee is an evidence of Thy tender mercy, every fiery ordeal a sign of the brightness of Thy light, every woeful tribulation a cooling draught, every toil a blissful repose, every anguish a fountain of gladness.

input: ای ربّ من یجزع من البلایا فی سبیلک انّه ما شرب کأس حبّک و ما ذاق حلاوة ذکرک.
output: Whosoever, O my Lord, is impatient in the tribulations befalling him in Thy path, hath not drunk of the cup of Thy love nor tasted of the sweetness of Thy remembrance.

input: اسألک بسلطان الأسمآء و ملیکها و مظهر الصّفات و موجدها و بالّذین طاروا فی هوآء قربک و لقائک و ذاقوا حدّ الحدید فی سبیلک بأن تؤیّد بریّتک کلّهم علی عرفان مظهر نفسک الّذی سجن فی الغربة بما دعا الخلق الیک.
output: I implore Thee, by Him Who is the King of all names and their Sovereign, Who is the Revealer of all attributes and their Creator, and by them who have soared aloft and drawn nigh unto Thee and winged their flight into the atmosphere of Thy presence, and have endured the galling of chains for Thy sake, to grant that all Thy people may be graciously aided to recognize Him Who is the Manifestation of Thine own Self, Who, because He summoned mankind unto Thee, hath been exiled and cast into prison.

input: ای ربّ سبقت رحمتک غضبک و لطفک قهرک و فضلک عدلک.
output: The tenderness of Thy mercy, O my Lord, surpasseth the fury of Thy wrath, and Thy loving kindness exceedeth Thy hot displeasure, and Thy grace excelleth Thy justice.

input: خذ ایادی خلقک ببدایع عنایاتک و مواهبک و لا تقطع عنهم الأسباب الّتی جعلتها وسیلة لعرفان نفسک.
output: Hold Thou, through Thy wondrous favors and mercies, the hands of Thy creatures, and suffer them not to be separated from the grace which Thou hast ordained as the means whereby they can recognize Thee.

input: عند قطعها یضطرب کلّ نفس و یتحیّر کلّ عاقل و یتوقّف کلّ عارف الّا من اخذته ایادی امرک و ظهورات فضلک و شؤونات الطافک.
output: Were such a thing to happen, every soul would be sore shaken, every man endued with understanding would be bewildered, and every possessor of knowledge would be dumbfounded, except those who have been succored through the hands of Thy Cause, and have been made the recipients of the revelations of Thy grace and of the tokens of Thy favors.

input: لو تنظر الی عبادک بما اکتسبوا فی ایّامک لا یستحقّون الّا نقمتک و عذابک.
output: Wert Thou to regard Thy servants according to their deserts in Thy days, they would assuredly merit naught except Thy chastisement and torment.

input: ولکن انت الکریم ذو الفضل العظیم.
output: Thou art, however, the One Who is of great bounteousness, Whose grace is immense.

input: لا تنظر یا الهی الیهم بلحظات عدلک بل بلحظات اعین فضلک و عنایتک.
output: Look not down upon them, O my God, with the glance of Thy justice, but rather with the eyes of Thy tender compassions and mercies.

input: ثمّ اعمل بهم ما ینبغی بجودک و کرمک.
output: Do, then, with them according to what beseemeth Thy generosity and bountiful favor.

input: و انّک انت المقتدر علی ما تشآء وحدک.
output: Potent art Thou to do whatsoever may please Thee. Incomparable art Thou.

input: لا اله الّا انت ربّ العرش و الثّری و مالک الآخرة و الأولی.
output: No God is there beside Thee, the Lord of the throne on high and of earth below, the Ruler of this world and of the world to come.

input: و انّک انت العطوف الغفور الجواد الوهّاب.
output: Thou art the God of Bounty, the Ever Forgiving, the Great Giver, the Most Generous.

input: صلّ اللّهمّ یا الهی علی الّذی به ظهرت اسرار ربوبیّتک ثمّ استعلت ظهورات الوهیّتک و برزت لآلئ علمک و حکمتک و نشرت آثارک و فصّلت کلمتک و لاح وجهک و حقّق سلطانک.
output: Do Thou bless, O Lord my God, the One through Whom the mysteries of Thine omnipotence have been disclosed, through Whom the revelations of Thy divinity have been glorified, through Whom the goodly pearls of Thy knowledge and wisdom have been uncovered, through Whom Thy signs and tokens have been noised abroad, through Whom Thy word hath been set forth with clearness, through Whom the light of Thy countenance hath shone forth and the power of Thy sovereignty been established.

input: و علی الّذین اقبلوا الیه خالصین لوجهک.
output: Bless Thou all those also who, wholly for Thy sake, have turned towards Thee.

input: ثمّ انزل یا الهی علیه و علیهم من بدایع رحمتک ما یلیق لحضرتک.
output: Send down, moreover, upon Him and them such of Thy wondrous mercies as may well beseem Thy highness.

input: و انّک انت المقتدر المهیمن العزیز القیّوم.
output: Thou art, verily, the Almighty, the Help in Peril, the All Glorious, the Self Subsisting.

input: انت الّذی خلقت الممکنات بکلمة امرک و ذرأت الموجودات بسلطنتک و اقتدارک.
output: Thou art He Who hath created all things through a word uttered by Thy behest, and fashioned the entire creation through the power of Thy sovereignty and might.

input: کلّ عزیز ذلّ عند ظهورات عزّک و کلّ قویّ ضعیف عند شؤونات قدرتک.
output: The mightiest of men are abased before the revelations of Thy glory, and they who are endued with strength tremble when faced with the evidences of Thy might.

input: و کلّ بصیر عمیّ عند بوارق انوار وجهک و کلّ غنیّ فقیر عند بروزات غنائک.
output: Every man of insight is bereft of vision when confronted with the effulgence of the glory of Thy face, and he who is possessed of riches is poor and desolate when beholding the plenteousness of Thy wealth.

input: اسألک باسمک الأبهی الّذی به زیّنت من فی ملکوت امرک و جبروت مشیّتک بأن تجذبنی من نغمات ورقآء احدیّتک الّتی تغنّ علی افنان سدرة قضائک بأنّک انت اللّه لا اله الّا انت.
output: I implore Thee by Thine All Glorious Name, wherewith Thou didst adorn all the denizens of the kingdom of Thy revelation and the inmates of the heaven of Thy will, to grant that my soul may be attracted by the sweetness of the melody of the Bird of Heaven that chanteth amidst the branches of the tree of Thy decree that Thou art God, that there is none other God beside Thee.

input: ای ربّ طهّرنی بمیاه رحمتک ثمّ اجعلنی خالصة لوجهک و مستقربة الی حرم امرک و کعبة قربک.
output: Cleanse me with the waters of Thy mercy, O my Lord, and make me wholly Thine, and cause me to approach the Tabernacle of Thy Cause and the adored Sanctuary of Thy Presence.

input: ثمّ قدّر لی یا الهی ما قدّرته لخیرة امائک ثمّ انزل علیّ ما یستضیء به وجهی و یستنیر به صدری.
output: Ordain, then, for me all the things Thou didst ordain for the chosen ones among Thy handmaidens, and rain down upon me that which will illuminate my face and enlighten my heart.

input: تری فقری و افتقاری و ضرّی و اضطراری و عجزی و انکساری و ندبتی و بکائی و حزنی و ابتلائی.
output: Thou seest my poverty and my misery, my troubles and my needs, my utter helplessness and my extreme lowliness, my lamentations and my bitter wailing, the anguish of my soul and the afflictions which beset me.

input: قد بلغت فی الذّلّة الی مقام یستهزئ علیّ عبادک الغافلون.
output: Such is the depth of mine abasement that Thy servants who have strayed far from Thy path deride me.

input: و انت تعلم بأنّی اکون معروفاً باسمک بین خلقک.
output: Thou knowest that I am recognized as the bearer of Thy name among Thy creatures.

input: و لا یری فی شأنی الّا شأنک و لا فی وصفی الّا وصفک و لا فی کینونتی الّا ظهورات آیات احدیّتک و لا فی ذاتیّتی الّا بروزات توحیدک.
output: Thou knowest that my station is but an image of Thy station, that my virtues recount Thy virtues, that within mine inmost being naught can be found except the revelations of Thy signs, and that my very essence is but a reflection of the evidences of Thy unity.

input: و انّک اشتهرت کلّ ذلک بین بریّتک بحیث لا یعرفنی احد الّا باسمک.
output: All these things Thou hast noised abroad among Thy creatures, in such wise that none can recognize me, except as one who beareth Thy name.

input: و انّی فوعزّتک.
output: I swear by Thy glory.

input: لا اجزع بما ورد علیّ فی سبیلک ولکن اشاهد بأنّ بذلّتی ضعفت قلوب احبّائک و استفرحت افئدة اعدائک بحیث یشمتون علی الّذین انقطعوا عمّا سواک و سرعوا الی شریعة ذکرک و ثنائک.
output: My lamentations are not for the things which have befallen me in Thy path, but are due to my recognition that by reason of mine abasement the hearts of them that love Thee have been sore shaken, and the souls of Thine adversaries have been so filled with joy that they rejoice over those who have detached themselves from all except Thee and have hastened towards the river of Thy remembrance and praise.

input: و قد بلغوا فی الغفلة الی مقام اذا یمرّون علی احبّتک یحرّکون رؤوسهم استهزآء لأمرک و یقولون این ربّکم الّذی تذکرونه باللّیالی و الأیّام.
output: So great is their waywardness that when meeting Thy loved ones, they shake their heads in derision of Thy Cause and say: Where is your Lord Whom ye mention in the daytime and in the night season

input: و این سلطانکم الّذی تدعون به الأنام.
output: Where is He to be found Whom ye call your Sovereign, to Whom ye summon all men to turn

input: و قد بلغوا فی الغرور و الاستکبار الی مقام انکروا قدرتک و سلطنتک و اقتدارک.
output: Their pride and haughtiness waxed greater and greater until they denied the power of Thy might and rejected Thy sovereignty and dominion.

input: انّی فوعزّتک.
output: Thy glory beareth me witness.

input: احبّ ضرّی و ضرّ احبّائی فی سبیلک.
output: I delight in mine own afflictions and in the afflictions which they who love me suffer in Thy path.

input: ولکن صعب علیّ و علیهم بأن یسمعوا منهم من الاعتراض و الانکار ما یرجع الی نفسک المختار.
output: Neither I nor they, however, are able to bear such affronts and reproaches as are uttered by Thine enemies against Thy Self, the Unrestrained.

input: الی م یا الهی استویت علی عرش الصّبر و الاصطبار.
output: How long shalt Thou remain seated, O my God, on the throne of Thy forbearance and patience

input: تکلّم بکلمة من القهر یا من لا تدرک بالأبصار.
output: Speak Thou Thy word of wrath, O Thou Whom no eyes can see.

input: انّ الرّحمة محبوب للمخلصین من عبادک و النّقمة للمشرکین من اعدائک.
output: Well beloved is Thy mercy unto the sincere among Thy servants, and well beseeming Thy chastisement of the infidels among Thine enemies.

input: ای ربّ فأنزل علیهم ما یوقننّ به علی قهرک و قهّاریّتک و یعرفنّ قدرتک و اقتدارک.
output: Send down upon them, therefore, O my Lord, that which will unmistakably reveal unto them the fury of Thy wrath and the ascendancy of Thy power, and will enable them to recognize the weight of Thy might and the greatness of Thy strength.

input: و لو لا تنصر یا الهی احبّتک فانصر نفسک و ذکرک.
output: If Thou refusest, O my God, to aid them that love Thee, assist Thou, then, Thine own Self and Him Who is Thy Remembrance.

input: اسألک باسمک الّذی به تموّج بحر غضبک بأن تعذّب الّذین کفروا بک و بآیاتک.
output: I entreat Thee by Thy name, that hath caused the ocean of Thy wrath to surge, to chastise them who have repudiated Thy truth and disowned Thine utterances.

input: ثمّ اخذلهم بقدرتک و اقتدارک و عزّز الّذین هم توجّهوا الیک خالصین لوجهک لترتفع بهم اعلام ذکرک فی البلاد و تنتشر بهم آثارک بین العباد لیشهدنّ کلّ بأنّک انت اللّه لا اله الّا انت المقتدر العزیز المتعال.
output: Abase them, then, by Thy might and power, and exalt such as have, wholly for Thy sake, set their faces towards Thee, that through them the ensigns of Thy glorification may be unfurled among all nations, and Thy tokens be spread abroad among all peoples, and that all may testify that Thou art God, that there is none other God beside Thee, the God of power, of majesty and glory.

input: اسألک باسمک الّذی جعلته قیّوماً علی الأسمآء و به انشقّ حجاب السّمآء و اشرق عن افقها شمس جمالک باسمک العلیّ الأعلی بأن تنصرنی ببدایع نصرک ثمّ احفظنی فی کنف حفظک و حمایتک.
output: I ask Thee by Thy Name which Thou hast set up above all other names, through which the veil of heaven hath been split asunder and the Daystar of Thy beauty hath risen above the horizon, shining with the brightness of Thy Name, the Exalted, the Most High, to succor me with Thy wondrous help and to preserve me in the shelter of Thy care and protection.

input: و توجّهت الیک و توکّلت علیک.
output: Unto Thee have I turned, and in Thee have I placed my trust.

input: ان اثبتنی علی حبّک و رضائک علی شأن لا یمنعنی اعراض المشرکین من بریّتک و ضوضآء المنافقین من خلقک.
output: Grant that I may be so confirmed in my love for Thee, and in fulfilling that which is well pleasing unto Thee, that neither the defection of the infidels among Thy people, nor the clamor of the hypocrites among Thy creatures, may avail to keep me back from Thee.

input: ای ربّ طهّر اذنی لاستماع آیاتک و نوّر قلبی بنور عرفانک ثمّ انطق لسانی بذکرک و ثنائک.
output: Purge Thou mine ear, O my Lord, that I may hearken unto the verses sent down unto Thee, and illuminate my heart with the light of Thy knowledge, and loose my tongue that it may make mention of Thee and sing Thy praise.

input: لا احبّ سواک ولا ارید دونک.
output: My soul is wedded to none beside Thee, and my heart seeketh none except Thine own Self.

input: لا اله الّا انت العزیز المعطی الغفور الرّحیم.
output: No God is there beside Thee, the All Glorious, the Great Giver, the Forgiving, the Compassionate.

input: یا الهی هذه ایّام فیها فرضت الصّیام علی عبادک.
output: These are, O my God, the days whereon Thou didst enjoin Thy servants to observe the Fast.

input: و به طرّزت دیباج کتاب اوامرک بین بریّتک و زیّنت صحائف احکامک لمن فی ارضک و سمائک و اختصصت کلّ ساعة منها بفضیلة لم یحط بها الّا علمک الّذی احاط الأشیآء کلّها.
output: With it Thou didst adorn the preamble of the Book of Thy Laws revealed unto Thy creatures, and didst deck forth the Repositories of Thy commandments in the sight of all who are in Thy heaven and all who are on Thy earth. Thou hast endowed every hour of these days with a special virtue, inscrutable to all except Thee, Whose knowledge embraceth all created things.

input: و قدّرت لکلّ نفس منها نصیباً فی لوح قضائک و زبر تقدیرک.
output: Thou hast, also, assigned unto every soul a portion of this virtue in accordance with the Tablet of Thy decree and the Scriptures of Thine irrevocable judgment.

input: و اختصصت کلّ ورقة منها بحزب من الأحزاب.
output: Every leaf of these Books and Scriptures Thou hast, moreover, allotted to each one of the peoples and kindreds of the earth.

input: و قدّرت للعشّاق کأس ذکرک فی الأسحار یا ربّ الأرباب.
output: For Thine ardent lovers Thou hast, according to Thy decree, reserved, at each daybreak, the cup of Thy remembrance, O Thou Who art the Ruler of rulers.

input: اولئک عباد اخذهم سکر خمر معارفک علی شأن یهربون من المضاجع شوقاً لذکرک و ثنائک و یفرّون من النّوم طلباً لقربک و عنایتک.
output: These are they who have been so inebriated with the wine of Thy manifold wisdom that they forsake their couches in their longing to celebrate Thy praise and extol Thy virtues, and flee from sleep in their eagerness to approach Thy presence and partake of Thy bounty.

input: لم یزل طرفهم الی مشرق الطافک و وجههم الی مطلع الهامک.
output: Their eyes have, at all times, been bent upon the Dayspring of Thy loving kindness, and their faces set towards the Fountainhead of Thine inspiration.

input: فأنزل علینا و علیهم من سحاب رحمتک ما ینبغی لسمآء فضلک و کرمک.
output: Rain down, then, upon us and upon them from the clouds of Thy mercy what beseemeth the heaven of Thy bounteousness and grace.

input: هذه ساعة فیها فتحت ابواب جودک علی وجه بریّتک و مصاریع عنایتک لمن فی ارضک.
output: This is the hour when Thou hast unlocked the doors of Thy bounty before the faces of Thy creatures, and opened wide the portals of Thy tender mercy unto all the dwellers of Thine earth.

input: اسألک بالّذین سفک دمائهم فی سبیلک و انقطعوا عن کلّ الجهات شوقاً للقائک و اخذتهم نفحات وحیک علی شأن یسمع من کلّ جزء من اجزآء ابدانهم ذکرک و ثنائک ان لا تجعلنا محروماً عمّا قدّرته فی هذا الظّهور الّذی به ینطق کلّ شجر بما نطق به سدرة سینا لموسی کلیمک و یسبّح کلّ حجر بما سبّح به الحصاة فی قبضة محمّد حبیبک.
output: I beseech Thee, by all them whose blood was shed in Thy path, who, in their yearning over Thee, rid themselves from all attachment to any of Thy creatures, and who were so carried away by the sweet savors of Thine inspiration that every single member of their bodies intoned Thy praise and vibrated to Thy remembrance, not to withhold from us the things Thou hast irrevocably ordained in this Revelation—a Revelation the potency of which hath caused every tree to cry out what the Burning Bush had aforetime proclaimed unto Moses, Who conversed with Thee, a Revelation that hath enabled every least pebble to resound again with Thy praise, as the stones glorified Thee in the days of Muhammad, Thy Friend.

input: فیا الهی هؤلآء عبادک الّذین جعلتهم معاشر نفسک و مؤانس مطلع ذاتک.
output: These are the ones, O my God, whom Thou hast graciously enabled to have fellowship with Thee and to commune with Him Who is the Revealer of Thyself.

input: و فرّقتهم اریاح مشیّتک الی ان ادخلتهم فی ظلّک و جوارک.
output: The winds of Thy will have scattered them abroad until Thou didst gather them together beneath Thy shadow, and didst cause them to enter into the precincts of Thy court.

input: ای ربّ لمّا اسکنتهم فی ظلّ قباب رحمتک وفّقهم علی ما ینبغی لهذا المقام الأسنی.
output: Now that Thou hast made them to abide under the shade of the canopy of Thy mercy, do Thou assist them to attain what must befit so august a station.

input: ای ربّ لا تجعلهم من الّذین فی القرب منعوا عن زیارة طلعتک و فی الوصال جعلوا محروماً عن لقائک.
output: Suffer them not, O my Lord, to be numbered with them who, though enjoying near access to Thee, have been kept back from recognizing Thy face, and who, though meeting with Thee, are deprived of Thy presence.

input: ای ربّ هؤلآء عباد دخلوا معک فی هذا السّجن الأعظم و صاموا فیه بما امرتهم فی الواح امرک و صحائف حکمک.
output: These are Thy servants, O my Lord, who have entered with Thee in this, the Most Great Prison, who have kept the Fast within its walls according to what Thou hadst commanded them in the Tablets of Thy decree and the Books of Thy behest.

input: فأنزل علیهم ما یقدّسهم عمّا یکرهه رضائک لیکونوا خالصاً لوجهک و منقطعاً عن دونک.
output: Send down, therefore, upon them what will thoroughly purge them of all that Thou abhorrest, that they may be wholly devoted to Thee, and may detach themselves entirely from all except Thyself.

input: فأنزل علینا یا الهی ما ینبغی لفضلک و یلیق لجودک.
output: Rain down, then, upon us, O my God, that which beseemeth Thy grace and befitteth Thy bounty.

input: ثمّ اجعل یا الهی حیاتنا بذکرک و مماتنا بحبّک ثمّ ارزقنا لقائک فی عوالمک الّتی ما اطّلع بها احد الّا نفسک.
output: Enable us, then, O my God, to live in remembrance of Thee and to die in love of Thee, and supply us with the gift of Thy presence in Thy worlds hereafter—worlds which are inscrutable to all except Thee.

input: انّک انت ربّنا و ربّ العالمین و اله من فی السّموات و الأرضین.
output: Thou art our Lord and the Lord of all worlds, and the God of all that are in heaven and all that are on earth.

input: فیا الهی تری ما ورد علی احبّائک فی ایّامک.
output: Thou beholdest, O my God, what hath befallen Thy dear ones in Thy days.

input: فوعزّتک ما من ارض الّا و فیها ارتفع ضجیج اصفیائک.
output: Thy glory beareth me witness. The voice of the lamentation of Thy chosen ones hath been lifted up throughout Thy realm.

input: و منهم الّذین جعلهم المشرکون اساری فی مملکتک و منعوهم عن التّقرّب الیک و الورود فی ساحة عزّک.
output: Others were able to approach Thee, but were kept back from beholding Thy face.

input: و منهم یا الهی تقرّبوا الیک و منعوا عن لقائک و منهم دخلوا فی جوارک طلباً للقائک و حال بینهم و بینک سبحات خلقک و ظلم طغاة بریّتک.
output: Still others were permitted, in their eagerness to look upon Thee, to enter the precincts of Thy court, but they allowed the veils of the imaginations of Thy creatures and the wrongs inflicted by the oppressors among Thy people to come in between them and Thee.

input: ای ربّ هذه ساعة جعلتها خیر السّاعات و نسبتها الی افضل خلقک.
output: This is the hour, O my Lord, which Thou hast caused to excel every other hour, and hast related to the choicest among Thy creatures.

input: اسألک یا الهی بک و بهم ان تقدّر فی هذه السّنة عزّاً لأحبّائک.
output: I beseech Thee, O my God, by Thy Self and by them, to ordain in the course of this year what shall exalt Thy loved ones.

input: ثمّ قدّر فیها ما یستشرق به شمس قدرتک عن افق عظمتک و یستضیء بها العالم بسلطانک.
output: Do Thou, moreover, decree within this year what will enable the Daystar of Thy power to shine brightly above the horizon of Thy glory, and to illuminate, by Thy sovereign might, the whole world.

input: ای ربّ فانصر امرک و اخذل اعدائک.
output: Render Thy Cause victorious, O my Lord, and abase Thou Thine enemies.

input: ثمّ اکتب لنا خیر الآخرة و الأولی.
output: Write down, then, for us the good of this life and of the life to come.

input: و انّک انت الحقّ علّام الغیوب.
output: Thou art the Truth, Who knoweth the secret things.

input: لک الحمد بما جعلتنی مرجع القضایا و مطلع البلایا لحیوة عبادک و خلقک.
output: I yield Thee thanks for that Thou hast made me the target of divers tribulations and the mark of manifold trials, in order that Thy servants may be endued with new life and all Thy creatures may be quickened.

input: فوعزّتک یا محبوب العالمین و مقصود العارفین.
output: I swear by Thy glory, O Thou the Best Beloved of the worlds and the Desire of all such as have recognized Thee.

input: لا ارید الحیوة الّا لاظهار امرک و ما اردت البقآء الّا لمسّ البلایا فی سبیلک.
output: The one reason I wish to live is that I may reveal Thy Cause, and I seek the continuance of life only that I may be touched by adversity in Thy path.

input: اسألک یا من بندائک طارت افئدة المقرّبین بأن تنزل علی احبّتک ما یجعلهم غنیّاً عمّا سواک.
output: I implore Thee, O Thou by Whose summons the hearts of all them who were nigh unto Thee have soared into the atmosphere of Thy presence, to send down upon Thy loved ones what will enable them to dispense with all else except Thee.

input: ثمّ استقمهم علی شأن یقومنّ علی امرک و ینادینّک بین سمائک و ارضک بحیث لا یمنعهم ظلم الفراعنة من عبادک.
output: Endue them, then, with such constancy that they will arise to proclaim Thy Cause, and will call on Thy name, before all that are in Thy heaven and on Thy earth, in such wise that the Pharaonic cruelties inflicted by the oppressors among Thy servants will not succeed in keeping them back from Thee.

input: هذا طرفی قد کان منتظراً بدائع رحمتک و هذه اذنی قد ارادت اصغآء نغماتک و هذا قلبی یطلب کوثر عرفانک.
output: Behold Thou mine eye expectant to gaze on the wonders of Thy mercy, and mine ear longing to hearken unto Thy sweet melodies, and my heart yearning for the living waters of Thy knowledge.

input: اذاً یا الهی قد قامت امتک تلقآء مدین رحمتک و تدعوک باسمک الّذی جعلته اعظم اسمائک و مهیمناً علی من فی ارضک و سمائک.
output: Thou seest Thy handmaiden, O my God, standing before the habitation of Thy mercy, and calling upon Thee by Thy name which Thou hast chosen above all other names and set up over all that are in heaven and on earth.

input: لترسل علیها نفحات رحمتک لتجذبها بکلّها عن نفسها و تقلّبها الی المقرّ الّذی فیه استضآء وجهک و ظهر سلطانک و استقرّ عرشک.
output: Send down upon her the breaths of Thy mercy, that she may be carried away wholly from herself, and be drawn entirely towards the seat which, resplendent with the glory of Thy face, sheddeth afar the radiance of Thy sovereignty, and is established as Thy throne.

input: ای ربّ اسألک بأن لا تطرد من ارادک و لا تمنع من قصدک و لا تحرم من احبّک.
output: Cast not out, I entreat Thee, O my Lord, them that have sought Thee, and turn not away such as have directed their steps towards Thee, and deprive not of Thy grace all that love Thee.

input: ای ربّ انت الّذی سمّیت نفسک بالرّحمن ثمّ بالرّحیم.
output: Thou art He, O my Lord, Who hath called Himself the God of Mercy, the Most Compassionate.

input: فارحم امتک الّتی لاذت بک و توجّهت الیک.
output: Have mercy, then, upon Thy handmaiden who hath sought Thy shelter, and set her face towards Thee.

input: اشهد بأنّ کلّ ذکر بدیع منع عن الارتقآء الی سمآء عرفانک. و کلّ ثنآء جمیل منع عن الصّعود الی هوآء علمک
output: I testify that no thought of Thee, howsoever wondrous, can ever ascend into the heaven of Thy knowledge, and no praise of Thee, no matter how transcendent, can soar up to the atmosphere of Thy wisdom.

input: لم تزل کنت مقدّساً عن ذکر عبادک و منزّهاً عن وصف ارقّائک.
output: From eternity Thou hast been removed far above the reach and the ken of the comprehension of Thy servants, and immeasurably exalted above the strivings of Thy bondslaves to express Thy mystery.

input: ما شأن العدم لیذکر تلقآء القدم.
output: What power can the shadowy creature claim to possess when face to face with Him Who is the Uncreated

input: اشهد بأنّ توحید الموحّدین و منتهی ذکر العارفین یرجع الی المقرّ الّذی خلق من قلم امرک و ذوّت بارادتک.
output: I bear witness that the highest thoughts of all such as adore Thy unity, and the profoundest contemplations of all them that have recognized Thee, are but the product of what hath been generated through the movement of the Pen of Thy behest, and hath been begotten by Thy will.

input: فوعزّتک یا محبوب البهآء و خالق البهآء.
output: I swear by Thy glory, O Thou Who art the Beloved of my soul and the Fountain of my life.

input: لا یری البهآء لنفسه الّا العجز عن ذکرک و ثنائک علی ما ینبغی لعظمتک و اجلالک.
output: I am persuaded of my powerlessness to describe and extol Thee in a manner that becometh the greatness of Thy glory and the excellence of Thy majesty.

input: لمّا کان الأمر کذلک اسألک برحمتک الّتی سبقت الکائنات و فضلک الّذی احاط الممکنات ان تقبل من عبادک ما یظهر منهم فی سبیلک.
output: Aware as I am of this, I beseech Thee, by Thy mercy that hath surpassed all created things, and Thy grace that hath embraced the entire creation, to accept from Thy servants what they are capable of showing forth in Thy path.

input: ثمّ ایّدهم علی اعلآء کلمتک و انتشار ذکرک.
output: Aid them, then, by Thy strengthening grace, to exalt Thy word and to blazon Thy praise.

input: لم ادر یا الهی بأیّ نار اوقدت سراج امرک و بأیّ زجاجة حفظته من اعادی نفسک .
output: I know not, O my God, what the Fire is with which Thou didst light the Lamp of Thy Cause, or what the Glass wherewith Thou didst preserve it from Thine enemies.

input: فوعزّتک صرت متحیّراً فی بدایع امرک و ظهورات عظمتک.
output: By Thy might. I marvel at the wonders of Thy Revelation, and at the tokens of Thy glory.

input: اری یا مقصودی بأنّ النّار لو یمسّها المآء تخمد فی الحین و هذه النّار لا تخمدها بحور العالمین.
output: I recognize, O Thou Who art my heart's Desire, that were fire to be touched by water it would instantly be extinguished, whereas the Fire which Thou didst kindle can never go out, though all the seas of the earth be poured upon it.

input: و اذا یصبّ علیها المآء تنقلبه ایدی قدرتک و تجعله دهناً لها بما قدّر فی الواحک.
output: Should water at any time touch it, the hands of Thy power would, as decreed in Thy Tablets, transmute that water into a fuel that would feed its flame.

input: و اری یا الهی بأنّ المصباح اذا احاطته الأریاح یطفأ فی نفسه.
output: I, likewise, recognize, O my God, that every lamp, when exposed to the fury of the winds, must cease from burning.

input: لم ادر یا محبوب العالمین بأیّ قدرة حفظته فی سنین معدودات من اریاح الّتی تمرّ فی کلّ الأحیان من شطر مظاهر الطّغیان.
output: As to Thy Lamp, however, O Beloved of the worlds, I cannot think what power except Thy power could have kept it safe for so many years from the tempests that have continually been directed upon it by the rebellious among Thy creatures.

input: انّ سراجک فی هیکل الانسان ینادیک و یقول ای محبوبی.
output: Thy Lamp which Thou didst light within the tabernacle of man crieth out to Thee and saith: O Thou the one alone Beloved.

input: الی متی ترکتنی.
output: How long wilt Thou forsake me

input: فارفعنی الیک.
output: Lift me up to Thee, I pray Thee.

input: ولو انّ ما اتکلّم به لم یکن الّا من لسان بریّتک ولکن انت تعلم بأنّی ارید ان افدی نفسی فی سبیلک.
output: Though this wish of mine be the wish of a human creature, yet Thou knowest that my true wish is to sacrifice myself in Thy path.

input: و انّک جعلت ارادتی نفس ارادتک و مشیّتی ذات مشیّتک.
output: Thou art He Who hath made my desire to be the same as Thy desire, and my will the same as Thy will.

input: اسألک ان تحفظ احبّائک فی ظلّ رحمتک الکبری لئلّا یمنعهم البلایا عن شطر اسمک العزیز الوهّاب.
output: Do Thou preserve Thy loved ones, I beseech Thee, in the shelter of Thy shadowing mercy which transcendeth all things, that haply the sufferings they bear may not deter them from turning in the direction of Thy name, the All Glorious, the Most Bountiful.

input: انت تعلم بأنّی ما اردت لنفسی راحةً فی حبّک و لا سکوناً فی امرک و لا اصطباراً فی اجرآء ما امرت به فی الواحک لذا ورد علیّ ما لم یرد علی احد من اهل مملکتک.
output: Thou knowest that in my love for Thee I have not sought any rest, that in proclaiming Thy Cause I have denied myself every manner of tranquility, and that in the observance of whatever Thou hast prescribed in Thy Tablets I have not delayed to do Thy bidding. I have, for this reason, suffered what no man among all the inhabitants of Thy realm hath suffered.

input: لم اکن ممنوعاً عن ذکرک ولو احاطتنی البلایا من کلّ الأشطار.
output: Nothing whatsoever can withhold me from remembering Thee, though all the tribulations of the earth were to assault me from every direction.

input: کلّ اعضائی و جوارحی یرید ان یقطع فی سبیلک و رضائک و یلقی علی التّراب امام عینیک.
output: All the limbs and members of my body proclaim their readiness to be torn asunder in Thy path and for the sake of Thy pleasure, and they yearn to be scattered in the dust before Thee.

input: یا لیت عبادک ذاقوا ما ذقت من حلاوة حبّک.
output: O would that they who serve Thee could taste what I have tasted of the sweetness of Thy love.

input: اسألک بأن تزرق من توجّه الیک کوثر عطائک لینقطعه عمّا دونک.
output: I implore Thee to supply whosoever hath sought Thee with the living waters of Thy bounty, that they may rid him of all attachment to any one but Thee.

input: ما اعظم قدرتک و سلطانک و ما اکبر قوّتک و اقتدارک.
output: How great is Thy might and Thy sovereignty. how vast Thy strength and Thy dominion.

input: اظهرت من ینطق باسمک بین سمائک و ارضک و امرته بالنّدآء بین خلقک.
output: Thou hast called into being Him Who speaketh in Thy name before all who are in Thy heaven and on Thy earth, and hast bidden Him cry out amongst Thy creatures.

input: فلمّا نطق بکلمة اعرض عنه العلمآء من بریّتک و اعترض علیه الأدبآء من عبادک.
output: No sooner had a word gone forth from His lips, however, than the divines among Thy people turned back from Him, and the learned among Thy servants caviled at His signs.

input: و بذلک اشتعلت نار الظّلم فی مملکتک الی ان قام الملوک علی اطفآء نورک یا مالک الملوک.
output: Thereby the fire of oppression was kindled in Thy land, until the kings themselves rose up to put out Thy light, O Thou Who art the King of kings.

input: و بلغ الأمر الی مقام جعلوا اهلی و احبّتی اساری فی ارضک و منعوا احبّائک عن التّوجّه الی وجهک و الاقبال الی شطر رحمتک.
output: Hostility waxed so intense that my kindred and my loved ones were made captives in Thy land, and they that are dear to Thee were hindered from gazing on Thy beauty and from turning in the direction of Thy mercy.

input: و بما فعلوا ما سکنت نار انفسهم الی ان جعلوا مظهر جمالک و منزل آیاتک اسیراً
output: This hostility failed to cause the fire that burned within them to subside. The enemy finally carried away as captive Him Who is the Manifestation of Thy beauty and the Revealer of Thy signs,

input: و ادخلوه فی حصن العکّا و منعوه عن ذکرک و ثنائک.
output: and confined Him in the fortress town of 'Akká, and sought to hinder Him from remembering Thee and from magnifying Thy name.

input: ولکنّ الغلام ما منع عمّا امر به من عندک.
output: Thy servant, however, could not be restrained from carrying out what Thou hadst bidden Him fulfill.

input: و من افق البلآء ینطق و ینادی من فی الأرض و السّمآء و یدعوهم الی سمآء رحمتک و شطر عنایتک.
output: Above the horizon of tribulation He hath lifted up His voice and He crieth out, summoning all the inmates of heaven and all the inhabitants of the earth to the immensity of Thy mercy and the court of Thy grace.

input: و ینزل فی اللّیالی و الأیّام آیات قدرتک و بیّنات عظمتک لیجتذب بها افئدة بریّتک لیقبلنّ منقطعاً عن انفسهم الیک و یهربنّ من افتقارهم الی سرادق غنائک و یسرعنّ من ذلّهم الی فنآء عزّک و اعتزازک.
output: Day and night He sendeth down the signs of Thine omnipotent power and revealeth the clear tokens of Thy majesty, so that the souls of Thy creatures may be drawn towards Thee, that they may forsake themselves and turn unto Thee, and may flee from their misery and seek the tabernacle of Thy riches, and may haste away from their wretchedness into the court of Thy majesty and glory.

input: هذا سراج اشتعل من نور ذاتک لا یطفیه اریاح النّفاق من الآفاق.
output: This is the Lamp which the light of Thine own Essence hath lit, and whose radiance the winds of discord can never extinguish.

input: و هذا بحر ظهر بسلطانک لا تمنعه سطوة الّذین کفروا بیوم الطّلاق.
output: This is the Ocean that moveth by the power of Thy sovereign might, and whose waves the influence of the infidels that have disbelieved in the Judgment Day can never still.

input: و هذا شمس اشرقت عن افق سمآء مشیّتک لا تمنعها سبحات الفجّار و لا شبهات الأشرار.
output: This is the Sun that shineth in the heaven of Thy will and the splendor of which the veils of the workers of iniquity and the doubts of the evil doers can never cloud.

input: لک الحمد یا الهی علی ما فدیتنی فی سبیلک و جعلتنی هدفاً لسهام البلایا حبّاً لعبادک و مرجع القضایا لاحیآء بریّتک.
output: I yield Thee thanks, O my God, for that Thou hast offered me up as a sacrifice in Thy path, and made me a target for the arrows of afflictions as a token of Thy love for Thy servants, and singled me out for all manner of tribulation for the regeneration of Thy people.

input: و ما الذّ بلائک فی مذاقی و ما اعزّ قضائک فی نفسی.
output: How sweet to my taste is the savor of woes sent by Thee, and how dear to my heart the dispositions of Thy providence.

input: عدمت کینونة تفرّ من سطوة الملوک حفظاً لنفسها فی ایّامک.
output: Perish the soul that fleeth from the threats of kings in its attempt to save itself in Thy days.

input: من شرب کوثر عطایاک لا تجزعه البلایا فی سبیلک و لا تمنعه الرّزایا عن ذکرک و ثنائک.
output: Whoso hath quaffed the living waters of Thy favors can fear no trouble in Thy path, neither can he be deterred by any tribulation from remembering Thee or from celebrating Thy praise.

input: اسئلک یا مالک البهآء و ملیک الأسمآء بأن تحفظ الأفنان الّذین نسبتهم الی نفسک و اختصصتهم فی هذا الظّهور بین عبادک و دعوتهم الی التّقرّب الیک و الاقبال الی افق وحیک.
output: I beseech Thee, O Thou Who art my Governor and the Possessor of all names, to protect them that have branched out from me Afnán, whom Thou hast caused to be related to Thyself, and to whom Thou hast, in this Revelation, shown Thy special favor, and whom Thou hast summoned to draw nigh unto Thee and to turn towards the horizon of Thy Revelation.

input: ای ربّ لا تمنع عنهم سحاب رحمتک و اشراق شمس فضلک.
output: Withhold not from them, O my Lord, the outpourings of Thy mercy or the effulgence of the Daystar of Thy grace.

input: فاجعلهم ممتازاً بین بریّتک لاعلآء کلمتک و نصرة امرک.
output: Enable them to distinguish themselves amongst Thy people, that they may exalt Thy word and promote Thy Cause.

input: وفّقهم یا الهی علی ما انت تحبّ و ترضی.
output: Aid them, O my God, to do Thy will and pleasure.

input: لا اله الّا انت المقتدر العلیّ الأعلی.
output: No God is there but Thee, the All Powerful, the Most Exalted, the Most High.

input: لو لا البلایا فی سبیلک من این تظهر مقامات عاشقیک و لو لا الرّزایا فی حبّک بأیّ شیء تبیّن شؤون مشتاقیک. وعزّتک انیس محبّیک دموع عیونهم و مؤنس مریدیک زفرات قلوبهم و غذآء قاصدیک قطعات اکبادهم. و ما الذّ سمّ الرّدی فی سبیلک و ما اعزّ سهام الأعدآء لاعلآء کلمتک.
output: But for the tribulations which are sustained in Thy path, how could Thy true lovers be recognized. and were it not for the trials which are borne for love of Thee, how could the station of such as yearn for Thee be revealed? Thy might beareth me witness! The companions of all who adore Thee are the tears they shed, and the comforters of such as seek Thee are the groans they utter, and the food of them who haste to meet Thee is the fragments of their broken hearts. How sweet to my taste is the bitterness of death suffered in Thy path, and how precious in my estimation are the shafts of Thine enemies when encountered for the sake of the exaltation of Thy word!

input: یا الهی فأشربنی فی امرک ما اردته و انزل علیّ فی حبّک ما قدّرته .
output: Let me quaff in Thy Cause, O my God, whatsoever Thou didst desire, and send down upon me in Thy love all Thou didst ordain.

input: وعزّتک لا ارید الّا ما ترید و لا احبّ الّا ما انت تحبّ توکّلت علیک فی کلّ الأحوال.
output: By Thy glory. I wish only what Thou wishest, and cherish what Thou cherishest. In Thee have I, at all times, placed my whole trust and confidence.

input: اسألک یا الهی بأن تظهر لنصرة هذا الأمر من کان قابلاً لاسمک و سلطانک لیذکرنی بین خلقک و یرفع اعلام نصرک فی مملکتک.
output: Raise up, I implore Thee, O my God, as helpers to this Revelation such as shall be counted worthy of Thy name and of Thy sovereignty, that they may remember me among Thy creatures, and hoist the ensigns of Thy victory in Thy land.

input: انّک انت المقتدر علی ما تشآء لا اله الّا انت المهیمن القیّوم.
output: Potent art Thou to do what pleaseth Thee. No God is there but Thee, the Help in Peril, the Self Subsisting.

input: قد استظلّت فی ظلّ سدرة وحدانیّتک امة من امائک الّتی آمنت بک و بآیاتک.
output: One of Thy handmaidens, who hath believed in Thee and in Thy signs, hath entered beneath the shadow of the tree of Thy oneness.

input: یا الهی فأشربها رحیقک المختوم باسمک الظّاهر المکنون لیأخذها عن نفسها و یجعلها خالصة لذکرک و منقطعة عمّا سواک.
output: Give her to quaff, O my God, by Thy Name, the Manifest and the Hidden, of Thy choice sealed Wine that it may take her away from her own self, and make her to be entirely devoted to Thy remembrance, and wholly detached from any one beside Thee.

input: ای ربّ لمّا عرّفتها عُرفک لا تمنعها بجودک و لمّا دعوتها الی نفسک لا تطردها بکرمک.
output: Now that Thou hast revealed unto her the knowledge of Thee, O my Lord, deny her not, by Thy bounty, Thy grace. and now that Thou hast called her unto Thyself, drive her not away from Thee, through Thy favor.

input: فارزقها ما لا یعادله ما فی ارضک انّک انت الکریم ذو الفضل العظیم.
output: Supply her, then, with that which excelleth all that can be found on Thine earth. Thou art, verily, the Most Bountiful, Whose grace is immense.

input: لو تهب مثل السّموات و الأرض لأحد من خلقک لا ینقص من ملکوتک مقدار ذرّة.
output: Wert Thou to bestow on one of Thy creatures what would equal the kingdoms of earth and heaven, it would still not diminish by even as much as an atom the immensity of Thy dominion.

input: انت الأعظم من ان تدعی بالعظیم لأنّه اسم من اسمائک قد خلق بارادة من عندک.
output: Far greater art Thou than the Great One men are wont to call Thee, for such a title is but one of Thy names all of which were created by a mere indication of Thy will.

input: لا اله الّا انت المقتدر المتعالی العلیم الکریم.
output: There is no God but Thee, the God of power, the God of glory, the God of knowledge and wisdom.

input: یا الهی یحترق قلب المشتاق من نار الاشتیاق و تبکی عیون العشّاق من سطوة الفراق و ارتفع ضجیج الآملین من کلّ الآفاق.
output: The hearts that yearn after Thee, O my God, are burnt up with the fire of their longing for Thee, and the eyes of them that love Thee weep sore by reason of their crushing separation from Thy court, and the voice of the lamentation of such as have set their hopes on Thee hath gone forth throughout Thy dominions.

input: انّک یا الهی حفظتهم بسلطان قدرتک بین الضّدّین.
output: Thou hast Thyself, O my God, protected them, by Thy sovereign might, from both extremities.

input: لو لا احتراق اکبادهم و زفرات قلوبهم لیغرقون فی دموعهم و لو لا دموعهم لتحرقهم نار قلوبهم و حرارة نفوسهم.
output: But for the burning of their souls and the sighing of their hearts, they would be drowned in the midst of their tears, and but for the flood of their tears they would be burnt up by the fire of their hearts and the heat of their souls.

input: کأنّهم ملائکة الّتی خلقتهم من النّار و الثّلج
output: Methinks, they are like the angels which Thou hast created of snow and of fire.

input: أ تری یا الهی بأن تمنعهم بعد هذا الاشتیاق عن لقائک او تطردهم بعد هذا الاشتعال عن باب رحمتک.
output: Wilt Thou, despite such vehement longing, O my God, debar them from Thy presence, or drive them away, notwithstanding such fervor, from the door of Thy mercy

input: یا الهی یکاد ان ینقطع الرّجآء عن قلوب الأصفیآء.
output: All hope is ready to be extinguished in the hearts of Thy chosen ones, O my God.

input: این نسایم فضلک.
output: Where are the breezes of Thy grace

input: قد احاطتهم الأعدآء من کلّ الأطراف این رایات نصرک الّتی وعدتها فی الواحک.
output: They are hemmed in on all sides by their enemies. where are the ensigns of Thy triumph which Thou didst promise in Thy Tablets where are the ensigns of Thy triumph which Thou didst promise in Thy Tablets

input: لا یصبحون احبّائک الّا و یرون کأس البلآء فی مقابلة وجوههم بما آمنوا بک و بآیاتک.
output: At each daybreak they who love Thee wake to find the cup of woe set before their faces, because they have believed in Thee and acknowledged Thy signs.

input: ولو انّی اعلم بأنّک ارحم بهم من انفسهم و ما ابتلیتهم الّا لاظهار امرک و ارتقائهم الی جبروت البقآء فی جوارک ولکن انت تعلم بأنّ بینهم ضعفآء یجزعون من البلایا.
output: Though I firmly believe that Thou hast a greater compassion on them than they have on their own selves, though I recognize that Thou hast afflicted them for no other purpose except to proclaim Thy Cause, and to enable them to ascend into the heaven of Thine eternity and the precincts of Thy court, yet Thou knowest full well the frailty of some of them, and art aware of their impatience in their sufferings.

input: اسألک یا الهی بأن توفّقهم علی الاصطبار فی حبّک ثمّ اشهدهم ما قدّرت لهم خلف سرادق عصمتک لیسرعنّ الی القضآء فی سبیلک و یستبقنّ البلآء فی حبّک.
output: Help them through Thy strengthening grace, I beseech Thee, O my God, to suffer patiently in their love for Thee, and unveil to their eyes what Thou hast decreed for them behind the Tabernacle of Thine unfailing protection, so that they may rush forward to meet what is preordained for them in Thy path, and may vie in hasting after tribulation in their love towards Thee.

input: او فأظهر رایات نصرتک ثمّ اجعلهم مقتدراً علی اعدائک لیظهر سلطانک علی من فی مملکتک و اقتدارک بین خلقک.
output: And if not, do Thou, then, reveal the standards of Thine ascendancy, and make them to be victorious over Thine adversaries, that Thy sovereignty may be manifested unto all the dwellers of Thy realm, and the power of Thy might demonstrated amidst Thy creatures.

input: ان اثبت یا الهی عبدک الّذی آمن بک علی نصرة امرک ثمّ احفظه فی کنف حفظک و حمایتک فی الآخرة و الأولی.
output: Make steadfast Thou, O my God, Thy servant who hath believed in Thee to help Thy Cause, and keep him safe from all dangers in the stronghold of Thy care and Thy protection, both in this life and in the life which is to come.

input: فأمطر من سحاب فیض فضلک ما تطهّر به افئدة عبادک عمّا یحجبهم عن النّظر الی وجهک و یمنعهم عن التّوجّه الی نفسک لیعرفنّ کلّ موجدهم و خالقهم ثمّ اصعدهم یا الهی بسلطان قدرتک الی مقام یمیّزون النّکهة الدّفرآء من رائحة قمیص اسمک العلیّ الأعلی و یقبلون الیک بقلوبهم و یؤانسون معک فی خفیّات سرّهم بحیث لو یؤتون ما فی السّموات و الأرض لا یعتنون به و لا یشغلهم عن ذکرک و وصفک.
output: Rain down, I beseech Thee, from the clouds of Thine overflowing grace, that which shall cleanse the hearts of Thy servants from whatever may prevent their beholding Thy face, or may prevent them from turning unto Thee, that they may all recognize Him Who is their Fashioner and Creator. Help them, then, O God, to reach forth, through the power of Thy sovereign might, towards such a station that they can readily distinguish every foul smell from the fragrance of the raiment of Him Who is the Bearer of Thy most lofty and exalted name, that they may turn with all their affections toward Thee, and may enjoy such intimate communion with Thee that if all that is in heaven and on earth were given them they would regard it as unworthy of their notice, and would refuse to cease from remembering Thee and from extolling Thy virtues.

input: ثمّ اسألک یا محبوبی و رجائی بأن تحفظ عبدک الّذی توجّه الیک من سهام اشارات المنکرین و رماح دلالات المعرضین.
output: Shield, I pray Thee, O my Beloved, my heart's Desire, Thy servant who hath sought Thy face, from the darts of them that have denied Thee and from the shafts of such as have repudiated Thy Truth.

input: ثمّ اجعله خالصاً لنفسک و ناطقاً بذکرک و متوجّهاً الی کعبة امرک.
output: Cause him, then, to be wholly devoted to Thee, to declare Thy name, and to fix his gaze upon the sanctuary of Thy Revelation.

input: و انّک انت الّذی ما خیّبت الآملین عن باب رحمتک و ما منعت القاصدین عن ساحة فضلک لا اله الّا انت المقتدر المتعالی المهیمن العزیز المتکبّر المختار.
output: Thou art, in truth, He Who, at no time, hath turned away those who have set their hopes in Thee from the door of Thy mercy, nor prevented such as have sought Thee from attaining the court of Thy grace. No God is there but Thee, the Most Powerful, the All Highest, the Help in Peril, the All Glorious, the All Compelling, the Unconditioned.

input: سبحانک اللّهمّ یا الهی اسألک باسمک الّذی به اخضرّت سدرات رضوان امرک و اثمرّت بفواکه القدس فی هذا الرّبیع الّذی فیه هبّت روایح مواهبک و الطافک و اوتی کلّ شیء ما قدّر له فی ملکوت قضائک و جبروت تقدیرک.
output: Magnified, O Lord my God, be Thy Name, whereby the trees of the garden of Thy Revelation have been clad with verdure, and been made to yield the fruits of holiness during this Springtime when the sweet savors of Thy favors and blessings have been wafted over all things, and caused them to bring forth whatsoever had been preordained for them in the Kingdom of Thine irrevocable decree and the Heaven of Thine immutable purpose.

input: بأن لا تجعلنی بعیداً عن ساحة قدسک و لا محروماً عن حرم عزّ توحیدک و کعبة تفریدک.
output: I beseech Thee by this very Name not to suffer me to be far from the court of Thy holiness, nor debarred from the exalted sanctuary of Thy unity and oneness.

input: ثمّ ابتعث یا الهی فی صدری نار حبّک لیحترق بها ذکر ما سواک و ینعدم وصف النّفس و الهوی و یبقی ذکر نفسک العلیّ الأبهی.
output: Ignite, then, O my God, within my breast the fire of Thy love, that its flame may burn up all else except my remembrance of Thee, that every trace of corrupt desire may be entirely mortified within me, and that naught may remain except the glorification of Thy transcendent and all glorious Being.

input: و هذا غایة املی و بغیتی یا من بیدک جبروت الابداع و ملکوت الاختراع.
output: This is my highest aspiration, mine ardent desire, O Thou Who rulest all things, and in Whose hand is the kingdom of the entire creation.

input: و انّک فعّال لما تشآء لا اله الّا انت المقتدر العزیز الغفّار.
output: Thou, verily, doest what Thou choosest. No God is there beside Thee, the Almighty, the All Glorious, the Ever Forgiving.

input: اسألک باسمک الّذی منه تموّج فی کلّ قطرة بحور رحمتک و الطافک و ظهر فی کلّ ذرّة انوار شمس مکرمتک و مواهبک بأن تزیّن کلّ نفس بطراز حبّک لئلّا یبقی احد فی ارضک الّا و یکون مقبلاً الیک و منقطعاً عمّن سواک.
output: I implore Thee by Thy Name that hath caused to surge within every drop the oceans of Thy loving kindness and mercy, and to shine within every atom the luminaries of Thy bountiful blessings and favors,—I implore Thee to adorn every soul with the ornament of Thy love, that none may remain on Thine earth who hath not turned towards Thee, or hath failed to detach himself from all except Thy Self.

input: و انّک انت یا الهی قبلت کلّ الضّرّآء لمظهر نفسک لیصلنّ عبادک الی ذروة فضلک و ما قدّرت لهم فی الواح القضآء بجودک و الطافک .
output: Thou hast, verily, O my God, suffered Him Who is the Manifestation of Thine own Self to be afflicted with all manner of adversity in order that Thy servants may ascend unto the pinnacle of Thy gracious favor, and attain unto that which Thou hast, through Thy providence and tender mercies, ordained for them in the Tablets of Thine irrevocable decree.

input: فوعزّتک لو یفدون فی کلّ حین انفسهم فی سبیلک لیکون قلیلاً عند عطایاک.
output: The glory of Thy might beareth me witness. Were they, every moment of their lives, to offer up themselves as a sacrifice in Thy path, they would still have done but little in comparison with the manifold bestowals vouchsafed unto them by Thee.

input: اذاً اسألک بأن تجعلهم راغبین الیک
output: Grant, therefore, I beseech Thee, that their hearts may be inclined towards Thee,

input: و مقبلین الی شطر رضاک.
output: and that their faces may be turned in the direction of Thy good pleasure.

input: لا اله الّا انت المتعالی العزیز الغفّار.
output: No God is there but Thee, the Inaccessible, the All Glorious, the Ever Forgiving.

input: ثمّ اقبل یا الهی من عبدک ما ظهر منه حبّاً لنفسک.
output: Deign, then, to accept, O my God, from Thy servant the things which he hath shown forth in his love for Thee.

input: ثمّ استقمه علی کلمتک العلیا ثمّ انطقه بثنآء نفسک و احشره مع المقرّبین من بریّتک.
output: Fortify him, then, that he may cling to Thy most exalted Word, and to unloose his tongue to celebrate Thy praise, and cause him to be gathered unto such of Thy people as are nigh unto Thee.

input: و انّک انت الّذی فی قبضتک ملکوت کلّ شیء.
output: Thou art He within Whose grasp is the empire of all things.

input: لا اله الّا انت المقتدر المهیمن العزیز المختار.
output: There is no God but Thee, the Almighty, the Help in Peril, the All Glorious, the Unconstrained.

input: سبحانک یا من فی قبضتک زمام افئدة العارفین و فی یمینک من فی السّموات و الأرضین.
output: Magnified be Thy name, O Thou in Whose grasp are the reins of the souls of all them that have recognized Thee, and in Whose right hand are the destinies of all that are in heaven and all that are on earth.

input: تفعل ما تشآء بقدرتک و تحکم ما ترید بارادتک.
output: Thou doest, through the power of Thy might, what Thou willest, and ordainest, by an act of Thy volition, what Thou pleasest.

input: کلّ ذی مشیّة معدوم عند ظهورات مشیّتک و کلّ ذی ارادة مفقود لدی شؤونات ارادتک.
output: The will of the most resolute of men is as nothing when compared with the compelling evidences of Thy will, and the determination of the most inflexible among Thy creatures is dissipated before the manifold revelations of Thy purpose.

input: انت الّذی بکلمتک استجذبت قلوب الأصفیآء علی شأن انقطعوا فی حبّک عمّا سواک و انفقوا انفسهم و ارواحهم فی سبیلک و حملوا فی حبّک ما لا حمله احد من بریّتک.
output: Thou art He Who, through a word of Thy mouth, hath so enravished the hearts of Thy chosen ones that they have, in their love for Thee, detached themselves from all except Thyself, and laid down their lives and sacrificed their souls in Thy path, and borne, for Thy sake, what none of Thy creatures hath borne.

input: توجّهت الی مدین رحمتک و اردت بدایع الطافک لأنّ کلّ جوارحی یشهد بأنّک انت الکریم ذو الفضل العظیم.
output: I have turned my face towards the habitation of Thy mercy, and have sought the wonders of Thy manifold favors, inasmuch as all the members of my body proclaim Thee to be the All Bounteous, He Whose grace is immense.

input: یا من وجهک کعبتی و جمالک حرمی و شطرک مطلبی و ذکرک رجائی و حبّک مؤنسی و عشقک موجدی و ذکرک انیسی و قربک املی و وصلک غایة رضائی و منتهی مطلبی.
output: Thou Whose face is the object of my adoration, Whose beauty is my sanctuary, Whose court is my goal, Whose remembrance is my wish, Whose affection is my solace, Whose love is my begetter, Whose praise is my companion, Whose nearness is my hope, Whose presence is my greatest longing and supreme aspiration.

input: اسألک ان لا تخیّبنی عمّا قدّرته لخیرة امائک ثمّ ارزقنی خیر الدّنیا و الآخرة.
output: Disappoint me not, I entreat Thee, by withholding from me the things Thou didst ordain for the chosen ones among Thy handmaidens, and supply me with the good of this world and of the world to come.

input: و انّک انت سلطان البریّة.
output: Thou art, verily, the Lord of creation.

input: اسألک بمطلع آیاتک و مظهر اسمائک و مخزن الهامک و مکمن علمک بأن ترسل علی احبّائک ما یجعلهم ثابتین علی امرک و مذعنین بوحدانیّتک و معترفین بفردانیّتک و مقرّین بألوهیّتک.
output: I pray Thee, by Him Who is the Dayspring of Thy signs and the Manifestation of Thy names, and the Treasury of Thine inspiration, and the Repository of Thy wisdom, to send upon Thy loved ones that which will enable them to cleave steadfastly to Thy Cause, and to recognize Thy unity, and to acknowledge Thy oneness, and to bear witness to Thy divinity.

input: ثمّ اصعدهم یا الهی الی مقام ینظرون فی کلّ الأشیآء آیات قدرة مظهر نفسک العلیّ الأبهی.
output: Raise them up, O my God, to such heights that they will recognize in all things the tokens of the power of Him Who is the Manifestation of Thy most august and all glorious Self.

input: ای ربّ انت الّذی تفعل ما تشآء و تحکم ما ترید.
output: Thou art He, O my Lord, Who doeth what He willeth, and ordaineth what He pleaseth.

input: کلّ ذی قدرة ضعیف عند ظهورات قوّتک و کلّ ذی عزّ ذلیل لدی شؤونات عزّک.
output: Every possessor of power is forlorn before the revelations of Thy might, and every fountain of honor becomes abject when confronted by the manifold evidences of Thy great glory.

input: اسألک بنفسک و بما انت علیه بأن تجعلنی ناصراً لأمرک و ناطقاً بثنائک و مقبلاً الی حرم عزّک و منقطعاً عمّا سواک.
output: I beseech Thee, by Thyself and by whatsoever is of Thee, to grant that I may help Thy Cause and speak of Thy praise, and set my heart on the sanctuary of Thy glory, and detach myself from all that pertaineth not unto Thee.

input: لا اله الّا انت المقتدر العزیز الحکیم.
output: No God is there beside Thee, the God of power, the God of glory and wisdom.

input: تری اضطرابی و همّی و غمّی و ابتلائی .
output: Thou beholdest my perplexity, and the depth of mine anguish, and the agony of my soul, and the afflictions which beset me.

input: فوعزّتک قلب البهآء ینوح بما ورد علی احبّائه فی سبیلک و عینه یتذرّف بما صعد الیک فی تلک الأیّام من الّذین نبذوا الدّنیا عن ورائهم و توجّهوا الی شاطئ عزّ رحمتک.
output: By Thy glory. My heart crieth to Thee by reason of the things that have befallen my loved ones in Thy path, and mine eyes run down with tears for them who, in these days, have ascended unto Thee, who have cast the world behind their backs, and set their faces towards the shores of Thy transcendent mercy.

input: فألبسهم یا الهی ردآء مکرمتک و اثواب رحمتک الّتی جعلتها مخصوصة لنفسک و نسجتها ایادی الطافک و مواهبک.
output: Clothe them, O my God, with the robe of Thy favor and the raiment of Thy loving providence, which Thou hast reserved for Thine own Self and woven with the hands of Thy manifold bounties and gifts.

input: ثمّ اشربهم من کؤوس رحمتک الکبری من ایادی عطوفتک.
output: Give them, then, to drink, from the hands of Thy loving kindness, of the cups of Thy measureless mercy.

input: ثمّ اسکنهم یا محبوبی فی جوارک حول سرادق الأبهی و انّک انت فعّال لما تشآء.
output: Cause them, moreover, O my Best Beloved, to abide within the precincts of Thy court and around Thy most effulgent Tabernacle. Powerful art Thou to do what pleaseth Thee.

input: ثمّ اسألک بقدم ذاتک بأن تصبّر البهآء فی هذه المصیبات الّتی فیها ناحت اهل الملإ الأعلی و بکت اهل الجنّة المأوی و اخذت کلّ الوجود غبار الصّفرآء فی هذا الحزن الّذی احاط العباد الّذین توجّهوا الی شطر اسمک العلیّ الأعلی.
output: And now I implore Thee, by the eternity of Thy Self, to enable me to be patient in these tribulations which have caused the Concourse on high to wail and the denizens of the everlasting Paradise to weep, and through which all faces have been covered with the tawny dust provoked by the anguish that hath seized such of Thy servants as have turned towards Thy Name, the Most Exalted, the Most High.

input: لا اله الّا انت المقتدر المتعالی الغفور الرّحیم.
output: No God is there but Thee, the Almighty, the Inaccessible, the Ever Forgiving, the Most Compassionate.

input: فیا الهی کلّ العباد مشغول بأنفسهم من شدّة البلایا الّتی احاطتهم من قضائک.
output: All Thy servants, O my God, are occupied with their own selves, so great have been the troubles which, as decreed by Thee, have encompassed them on every side.

input: و لسان البهآء مشغول بذکر اصفیائک و قلب البهآء ذاکر احبّائک و ارقّائک.
output: My tongue, however, is busied in extolling Thy chosen ones, and my heart in remembering them that are dear to Thee and are wholly subject to Thy will.

input: فیا الهی لا تنظر الیّ و علی ما غفلت فی ادآء خدمتک فانظر الی بحور رحمتک و الطافک و الی ما یلیق لجلالک و عفوک و ینبغی لألطافک و مواهبک.
output: Look not on my state, O my God, nor my failure to serve Thee, nay rather regard the oceans of Thy mercy and favors, and the things that beseem Thy glory and Thy forgiveness and befit Thy loving kindness and bounties.

input: تری ما عجزت السن ما سوىک عن ذکره و تشهد ما تکلکل عن بیانه غیرک.
output: Thou beholdest what the tongue of no one except Thee can utter, and bearest witness unto things which no mouth can recount.

input: بحیث تموّجت بحور الابتلآء و تهیّجت اریاح القضآء و تمطر من السّحاب سهام الافتتان و من سمآء القدر رماح الامتحان.
output: The floods of afflictions are let loose, and the winds of Thy judgment have blown, and from the clouds rain down the darts of tests, and the heavens of Thy decree pour forth the arrows of trial.

input: ای ربّ تری عبادک الّذین آمنوا بک و بآیاتک کیف وقعوا بین مخالیب اعدائک و سدّوا علی وجوههم ابواب الرّخآء و ترکوهم فی هذا الحصن الّذی منع عنه الرّاحة و الرّجآء.
output: Thou seest, O my Lord, how Thy servants, who have believed on Thee and acknowledged Thy signs, have fallen into the clutches of Thine enemies, how the doors of ease and comfort have been shut against them, how they languish in the Fortress wherein neither pleasantness nor hope can be found.

input: و ورد علیهم فی سبیلک ما لا ورد علی احد من قبل.
output: They have suffered in Thy path what no man before them hath suffered.

input: و یشهد بذلک سکّان العرش و الثّری و اهل ملأ الاعلی.
output: To this bear witness they who abide around Thy throne, and the dwellers of the earth, and the Concourse on high.

input: فیا الهی هؤلآء عباد الّذین انقطعوا عن دیارهم حبّاً لجمالک و اهتزّهم اریاح شوقک الی مقام انقطعوا عن کلّ نسبة فی سبیلک.
output: These, O my God, are Thy servants who, for love of Thy beauty, have forsaken their homes, and been so stirred up by the gentle winds of their desire for Thee that they have sundered every tie in Thy path.

input: و حاربهم طغاة عبادک من اهل مملکتک و اخرجوهم عن کلّ الدّیار و جعلوهم اساری بایادی الفجرة من عبادک و الکفرة من اشقیآء اهل ارضک.
output: Such of Thy servants as dwell in Thy land and have transgressed against Thee have assailed them, and banished them from Thy cities, and made them captives, and delivered them into the hands of workers of iniquity among Thy people and the perverse amidst the wicked doers in Thy realm.

input: الی ان ادخلوهم فی هذا المقام الّذی لن یوجد اردأ منه فی مملکتک.
output: And finally, they were made to abide in this place with which no other place, however loathsome, in all Thy dominion, can compare.

input: و اخذتهم البلایا علی شأن یبکی السّحاب علیهم و ینوح الرّعد لقضایا الّتی مسّتهم فی حبّک و رضاک.
output: They were seized with such trials that the clouds weep over them and the thunder groaneth by reason of the manifold tribulations that have afflicted them in their love for Thee and for the sake of Thy pleasure.

input: و انت تعلم یا الهی لم یکن فی ارضک من ینسب الیک الّا هؤلآء الّذین استشهد منهم عدّة و بقی عدّة اخری.
output: Thou knowest full well, O my God, that there is no one on Thine earth who can claim to be related to Thee except these, some of whom have suffered martyrdom for Thy sake, while the rest have been permitted to survive.

input: ولو انّ یا الهی لمثلنا لا یلیق ان تنسب انفسنا الی نفسک لانّ الخطایا و الغفلة عن امرک منعتنا عن الورود فی لجّة بحر احدیّتک و التّسبّح فی غمرات عزّ رحمتک ولکن یا الهی یشهد السننا و قلوبنا و جوارحنا بانّ رحمتک احاطت کلّ الاشیآء و رأفتک سبقت من فی الارض و السّمآء.
output: Though for such as are like unto us, O my God, it beseemeth not to claim to be related to Thee, inasmuch as our misdeeds and our waywardness have hindered us from reaching the depths of the ocean of Thy oneness, and from immersing ourselves beneath the waters of Thy transcendent mercy, yet our tongues, O my God, bear witness, and our hearts testify, and our limbs confess that Thy mercy hath enveloped all created things and Thy compassion surpassed all that are in heaven and all that are on earth.

input: اسئلک باسمک الاعظم الّذی به انقلبت الکائنات و اهتزّت الموجودات ان تنزل من سحاب رحمتک ما یطهّر هؤلآء عن کلّ بلآء و مکروه.
output: I beseech Thee, by Thy Most Great Name, through which all created things were rent asunder and the whole creation was shaken, to send down from the clouds of Thy mercy that which will purge them from every ordeal and from whatever is hateful to Thee.

input: ثمّ اصعدهم الی مقام لا یشغلهم البلایا عن بدایع ذکرک و لا الرّزایا عن التّوجّه الی ساحة عزّ احدیّتک.
output: Raise them up, then, to such heights that no amount of tribulation will keep them back from Thy wondrous remembrance, nor any trouble hinder them from turning toward the court of Thy transcendent oneness.

input: فوعزّتک یا محبوب البهآء و مقصود البهآء
output: By Thy might, O Well Beloved of Bahá and His heart's Desire.

input: انّی بنفسی اقول فی کلّ الاحیان یا لیت تقرّبت الیک فی یوم قبل هذا.
output: I myself cry out, under all conditions, unto Thee saying: Would I had, ere this day, drawn nigh unto Thee.
