input: ولکن لمّا اسمع ضجیج المخلصین من بریّتک و المقرّبین من عبادک الّذین ما اتّخذوا لانفسهم ولیّاً الّا انت و لا ملجأ الّا انت ثمّ اختاروا فی سبیلک لانفسهم ما لا اختاره احد عند ظهور مظاهر عزّ احدیّتک و مطالع قدس ربوبیّتک لذا یحزن قلبی و یکدّر فؤادی و انادیک بقدرتک الّتی احاطت کلّ الوجود من الغیب و الشّهود بان تحفظهم عن کلّ ما یکره رضاک.
output: When I hear, however, the sighs of such of Thy people as are wholly devoted to Thee, and those of Thy servants as enjoy near access to Thy court, who have taken no other friend than Thee, and sought no refuge except Thee, and have chosen for themselves, in Thy path, what no man hath chosen in the days of the Manifestations of Thy transcendent unity and the Daysprings of Thy most holy sovereignty, then my heart is saddened and my soul is vexed, and I cry to Thee, imploring Thee to protect them, by Thy power that hath encompassed the entire creation both visible and invisible, from whatsoever may be abhorrent to Thee.

input: و هذا لا لانفسهم بل لیبقی بهم اسمک بین عبادک و ذکرک فی بلادک.
output: This is not for their own sakes, but that Thy name may, through them, abide amongst Thy servants, and Thy remembrance may continue to endure in Thy dominions.

input: و انّک تعلم یا الهی بانّ کلّ العباد قد اعرضوا عنک و قاموا بالمحاربة علی نفسک.
output: Thou knowest, O my God, that all Thy servants have turned back from Thee and risen up against Thee.

input: و لیس لک عباد لیطیعوک الّا هؤلآء و الّذین آمنوا بظهورک الّذی به انقلبت الوجود و اضطربت النّفوس و تبلبلت الرّقود.
output: Thou knowest that Thou hast no one to obey Thee except them and such as have believed in Thy Revelation, through which the foundations of the entire universe have been shaken, and the souls of all men have trembled, and all that lay asleep were quickened.

input: فیا الهی انت الکریم ذو الفضل العظیم.
output: Thou art, O my God, the God of bounty, Whose grace is immense.

input: فانزل علیهم ما یطمئنّ به قلوبهم و تسکن نفوسهم و تجدّد ارواحهم و تطیب أجسادهم.
output: Send down, then, upon them that which will assure their hearts, and quiet their souls, and renew their spirits, and refresh their bodies.

input: انّک انت مولىهم و مولی العالمین.
output: Thou art, verily, their Lord and the Lord of the worlds.

input: سبحانک یا اله العالمین و محبوب العارفین
output: Glory to Thee, O Thou Who art the Lord of all worlds, and the Beloved of all such as have recognized Thee.

input: ترانی جالساً تحت سیف علّق بخیط و تعلم بأنّی فی هذا الحال ما قصّرت فی امرک و بلّغت ذکرک و ثنائک و کلّ ما امرتنی به فی الواحک.
output: Thou seest me sitting under a sword hanging on a thread, and art well aware that in such a state I have not fallen short of my duty towards Thy Cause, nor failed to shed abroad Thy praise, and declare Thy virtues, and deliver all Thou hadst prescribed unto me in Thy Tablets.

input: و اذاً تحت السّیف ادعو احبّائک بکلمات الّتی تنجذب منها القلوب الی افق مجدک و کبریائک.
output: Though the sword be ready to fall on my head, I call Thy loved ones with such a calling that the hearts are carried away towards the horizon of Thy majesty and grandeur.

input: ای ربّ صفّ آذانهم لاصغآء نغمات الّتی ارتفعت عن یمین عرش عظمتک.
output: Purge out thoroughly their ears, O my Lord, that they may hearken unto the sweet melodies that have ascended from the right hand of the throne of Thy glory.

input: لو یسمعها احد ما قدّرته فیها حقّ الاصغآء لیطیر الی ملکوت امرک الّذی ینطق فیه کلّ ما خلق فیه بأنّک انت اللّه لا اله الّا انت المقتدر المهیمن القیّوم.
output: Were any one to attune his ears to their harmony he would soar up to the kingdom of Thy revelation, wherein every created thing proclaimeth that Thou art God, and that there is none other God save Thee, the Omnipotent, the Help in Peril, the Self Subsisting.

input: یا الهی طهّر ابصار عبادک ثمّ اجتذبهم بآیاتک علی شأن لا یمنعهم البلایا عن التّوجّه الیک و عن النّظر الی افق امرک.
output: Cleanse Thou, O my God, the eyes of Thy servants, and so transport them by the sweetness of Thine utterances that calamities will be powerless to hinder them from turning unto Thee, and from directing their eyes towards the horizon of Thy Revelation.

input: یا الهی قد احاطت الظّلمة کلّ البلاد و بها اضطربت اکثر العباد.
output: Darkness hath encompassed every land, O my God, and caused most of Thy servants to tremble.

input: اسألک باسمک الأعظم بأن تخلق فی کلّ بلد خلقاً لیتوجّهنّ الیک و یذکرنّک بین عبادک و یرفعنّ رایات نصرتک بالحکمة و البیان و ینقطعنّ عن الأکوان.
output: I beseech Thee, by Thy Most Great Name, to raise in every city a new creation that shall turn towards Thee, and shall remember Thee amidst Thy servants, and shall unfurl by virtue of their utterances and wisdom the ensigns of Thy victory, and shall detach themselves from all created things.

input: سبحانک یا من بیدک جبروت العزّ و ملکوت الخلق.
output: Glory be to Thee, Thou in Whose hand are the heaven of omnipotence and the kingdom of creation.

input: تفعل ما تشآء بسلطانک و تحکم ما ترید بقدرتک.
output: Thou doest, by Thy sovereignty, what Thou willest, and ordainest, through the power of Thy might, what Thou pleasest.

input: لم تزل کنت مقدّساً عن ذکر الممکنات و لا تزال تکون متعالیاً عن ذکر الموجودات.
output: From eternity Thou hast been exalted above the praise of all created things, and wilt to eternity remain far above the glorification of any one of Thy creatures.

input: انّ الوجود بنفسه یشهد انّه معدوم تلقآء ظهورات عزّ وحدانیّتک و الموجود بنفسه یشهد بأنّه مفقود لدی تجلّیات انوار قدس فردانیّتک.
output: Existence itself testifieth to its non existence when face to face with the manifold revelations of Thy transcendent oneness, and every created thing confesseth, by its very nature, its nothingness when compared with the sacred splendors of the light of Thy unity.

input: کنت بنفسک مستغنیاً عن دونک و بذاتک غنیّاً عمّا سواک.
output: Thou hast, in Thyself, been independent of any one besides Thee and rich enough, in Thine own essence, to dispense with any one except Thy Self.

input: و کلّ ما یصفنّک به الموحّدون و یذکرنّک به المخلصون انّه ظهر من القلم الّذی حرّکته اصابع قدرتک و انامل قوّتک الّتی کانت مقهورة تحت ذراع امرک بحرکة عضد اقتدارک.
output: Every description by which they who adore Thy unity describe Thee, and every praise wherewith they who are devoted unto Thee praise Thee, are but the traces of the pen which the fingers of Thy strength and power have set in motion—fingers whose movement is controlled by the arm of Thy decree—the arm itself animated by the potency of Thy might.

input: بعد علمی بذلک لا اجد نفسی مستطیعاً علی ذکرک و ثنائک.
output: How can I, aware as I am of this truth, hope to befittingly make mention of Thee and celebrate Thy praise

input: ولو اصفک بوصف و اذکرک بذکر اجد نفسی خجلاً عمّا تحرّک به لسانی و جری علیه قلمی.
output: Howsoever I describe Thee, whichever of Thy virtues I recount, I cannot but blush and feel ashamed of what my tongue hath uttered or my pen written.

input: ای ربّ کینونة العرفان تشهد بعجزها عن عرفانک و انّیّة الحیرة تشهد بحیرتها لظهورات سلطنتک و کینونة الذّکر تشهد بنسیانها و محوها عند ظهورات آیاتک و بروزات ذکرک.
output: The quintessence of knowledge, O my Lord, proclaimeth its powerlessness to know Thee, and perplexity, in its very soul, confesseth its bewilderment in the face of the revelations of Thy sovereign might, and remembrance, in its inmost spirit, acknowledgeth its forgetfulness and effacement before the manifestations of Thy signs and the evidences of Thy praise.

input: فلمّا کان الأمر کذلک ما یفعل هذا الفقیر و بأیّ حبل یتمسّک هذا المسکین.
output: What, then, can this poor creature hope to achieve, and to what cord must this wretched soul cling

input: اسألک یا اله العالمین و یا محبوب العارفین و مقصود من فی السّموات و الأرضین باسمک الّذی به ارتقی کلّ ندآء الی سمآء عزّ احدیّتک و طار کلّ مقبل فی هوآء وحدتک و کبریائک و به کمل کلّ ناقص و عزّ کلّ ذلیل و نطق کلّ کلیل و برئ کلّ علیل و قبل ما لم یکن قابلاً لحضرتک و لایقاً لعظمتک و سلطانک بأن تنصرنا بجنود غیبک و بقبیل من ملائکة امرک.
output: I beseech Thee, O Thou Who art the Lord of the worlds, and the Beloved of such as have recognized Thee, and the Desire of all that are in heaven and on earth, by Thy Name through which the cry of every suppliant hath ascended into the heaven of Thy transcendent holiness, through which every seeker hath soared to the sublimities of Thy unity and grandeur, through which the imperfect have been perfected, and the abased exalted, and the tongue of every stammerer unloosed, and the sick made whole, and whatever was unworthy of Thy highness and beseemed not Thy greatness and Thy sovereignty made acceptable unto Thee,—I beseech Thee to aid us by Thine invisible hosts and by a company of the angels of Thy Cause.

input: ثمّ اقبل منّا ما عملناه فی حبّک و رضائک.
output: Do Thou, then, accept the works we have performed for love of Thee, and for the sake of Thy pleasure.

input: و لا تطردنا یا الهی عن باب رحمتک و لا تخیّبنا من بدایع فضلک و مواهبک.
output: Cast us not away, O my God, from the door of Thy mercy, and break not our hopes in the wonders of Thy grace and favors.

input: ای ربّ تشهد ارکاننا و جوارحنا بوحدانیّتک و فردانیّتک.
output: Our limbs, our members, O my Lord, bear witness to Thy unity and oneness.

input: فأنزل علینا قوّة من عندک و قدرة من لدنک لنستقیم علی امرک و ننصرک بین عبادک.
output: Send down upon us Thy strength and power, that we may become steadfast in Thy Faith and may aid Thee among Thy servants.

input: ای ربّ نوّر ابصارنا بأنوار جمالک و قلوبنا بأنوار معرفتک و عرفانک.
output: Illumine our eyes, O my Lord, with the effulgence of Thy beauty, and enlighten our hearts with the splendors of Thy knowledge and wisdom.

input: ثمّ اکتبنا مع الّذین هم وفوا بمیثاقک فی ایّامک و بحبّک انقطعوا عن العالمین.
output: Write us up, then, with those who have fulfilled their pledge to Thy Covenant in Thy days, and who, through their love for Thee, have detached themselves from the world and all that is therein.

input: لا اله الّا انت القادر العالم الحاکم المهیمن القیّوم.
output: No God is there beside Thee, the All Powerful, the Omniscient, the Supreme Ruler, the Help in Peril, the Self Subsisting.

input: یا من قربک رجائی و وصلک املی و ذکرک منائی و الورود فی ساحة عزّک مقصدی و شطرک مطلبی و اسمک شفائی و حبّک نور صدری و القیام فی حضورک غایة مطلبی.
output: Thou Whose nearness is my wish, Whose presence is my hope, Whose remembrance is my desire, Whose court of glory is my goal, Whose abode is my aim, Whose name is my healing, Whose love is the radiance of my heart, Whose service is my highest aspiration.

input: اسئلک باسمک الّذی به طیّرت العارفین فی هواء عزّ عرفانک و عرّجت المقدّسین الی بساط قدس افضالک بان تجعلنی متوجّهاً الی وجهک و ناظراً الی شطرک و ناطقاً بثنائک.
output: I beseech Thee by Thy Name, through which Thou hast enabled them that have recognized Thee to soar to the sublimest heights of the knowledge of Thee and empowered such as devoutly worship Thee to ascend into the precincts of the court of Thy holy favors, to aid me to turn my face towards Thy face, to fix mine eyes upon Thee, and to speak of Thy glory.

input: ای ربّ انا الّذی نسیت دونک و اقبلت الی افق فضلک و ترکت ما سواک رجآء لقربک.
output: I am the one, O my Lord, who hath forgotten all else but Thee, and turned towards the Dayspring of Thy grace, who hath forsaken all save Thyself in the hope of drawing nigh unto Thy court.

input: اذاً اکون مقبلاً الی مقرّ الّذی فیه استضآء انوار وجهک.
output: Behold me, then, with mine eyes lifted up towards the Seat that shineth with the splendors of the light of Thy Face.

input: فانزل یا محبوبی علیّ ما یثبّتنی علی امرک لئلّا یمنعنی شبهات المشرکین عن التّوجّه الیک.
output: Send down, then, upon me, O my Beloved, that which will enable me to be steadfast in Thy Cause, so that the doubts of the infidels may not hinder me from turning towards Thee.

input: و انّک انت المقتدر المهیمن العزیز القدیر.
output: Thou art, verily, the God of Power, the Help in Peril, the All Glorious, the Almighty.

input: انت الّذی بعزّتک تعزّز اولو العزّة و الاعزاز و بقدرتک استقدر اولو القدرة و الاقتدار و بأمرک استعلی مظاهر امرک علی من فی الأرض و السّمآء و من کوثر مدادک استحیت افئدة اهل ملکوت الانشآء.
output: Thou art He the excellence of Whose glory hath exalted them who are the sources of authority and honor, the potency of Whose might hath empowered them who are the fountainheads of energy and strength, the dominion of Whose will hath elevated the Exponents of Thy Cause above all that are in heaven and on earth, and the life giving effusions of Whose Pen have quickened the souls of the denizens of the kingdom of creation.

input: ای ربّ انا الّذی توجّهت الیک خالصاً لوجهک و اقبلت الی حرم الأنس و کعبة القدس.
output: I am he, O my Lord, who, wholly for Thy sake, hath turned his face unto Thee, and who, while acknowledging Thy power and Thy sovereignty, hath directed his steps towards Thy dearly loved Sanctuary, and Thine adored and hallowed Court.

input: مقرّاً بقدرتک و سلطنتک الی ان وردت المدینة الّتی فیها تجلّیت علی کلّ الأشیآء بکلّ اسمائک.
output: In this state I have reached the City Baghdád wherein, in the full glory of Thy names, Thou didst reveal Thy Self unto all created things.

input: و عاشرت مع احبّائک و وجدت من البیت نفحات قدسک و فوحات انسک.
output: In it I have communed with Thy loved ones, and from the House within its walls I have inhaled the breaths of Thy holiness and perceived the fragrances of Thy fellowship.

input: ای ربّ لا تخیّبنی عن بابک و لا تطردنی عن شاطئ حبّک و رضائک.
output: Cast me not from Thy presence, O my Lord, neither do Thou drive me away from the shores of Thy love and Thy good pleasure.

input: لأنّ الفقیر لا یجد لنفسه ملجأ الّا باب غنائک و انّ المطرود لا تستقرّ نفسه الّا فی جوار عنایتک.
output: For the poor can find no refuge unless he knocketh at the door of Thy wealth, and the outcast can find no peace until he be admitted to the court of Thy favor.

input: ای ربّ لک الحمد بما عرّفتنی مظهر نفسک و جعلتنی موقناً بآیاتک.
output: Magnified be Thy name, O my Lord, for Thou hast enabled me to recognize the Manifestation of Thine own Self, and hast caused me to be assured of the truth of the verses which have descended upon Thee.

input: اسألک ان تجعلنی ثابتاً علی ما امرتنی به.
output: Empower me, I implore Thee, to cling steadfastly unto whatsoever Thou hast bidden me observe.

input: و حافظاً للآلئ حبّک الّتی جعلت قلبی مخزنها و مکمنها.
output: Help me to guard the pearls of Thy love which, by Thy decree, Thou hast enshrined within my heart.

input: ثمّ انزل یا الهی فی کلّ حین ما یحفظنی عن دونک و یستقیمنی علی امرک.
output: Send down, moreover, every moment of my life, O my God, that which will preserve me from any one but Thee, and will set my feet firm in Thy Cause.

input: و انّک انت العزیز و انّک انت القدیر و انّک انت الحکیم و انّک انت العلیم لا اله الّا انت المعطی الباذل المقتدر الغفّار.
output: Thou art, verily, the God of glory, the God of power, the God of knowledge and wisdom. No God is there beside Thee, the Great Giver, the All Bountiful, the Almighty, the Ever Forgiving.

input: و الحمد للّه العزیز الجبّار.
output: Praised be God, the All Glorious, the All Compelling.

input: لک الحمد بما اظهرتنی فی ایّامک و القیت علیّ حبّک و عرفانک.
output: I give Thee thanks inasmuch as Thou hast called me into being in Thy days, and infused into me Thy love and Thy knowledge.

input: اسألک باسمک الّذی به ظهرت لآلئ الحکمة و البیان من خزائن افئدة المقرّبین من عبادک و اشرقت شمس اسمک الرّحمن علی من فی ارضک و سمائک بأن ترزقنی من بدایع نعمائک المکنونة بفضلک و عطائک.
output: I beseech Thee, by Thy name whereby the goodly pearls of Thy wisdom and Thine utterance were brought forth out of the treasuries of the hearts of such of Thy servants as are nigh unto Thee, and through which the Daystar of Thy name, the Compassionate, hath shed its radiance upon all that are in Thy heaven and on Thy earth, to supply me, by Thy grace and bounty, with Thy wondrous and hidden bounties.

input: فیا الهی هذا اوّل ایّامی قد اتّصلت بأیّامک.
output: These are the earliest days of my life, O my God, which Thou hast linked with Thine own days.

input: فلمّا شرّفتنی بهذا الفضل العظیم لا تمنعنی عمّا قدّرته لأصفیائک.
output: Now that Thou hast conferred upon me so great an honor, withhold not from me the things Thou hast ordained for Thy chosen ones.

input: و یا الهی انّی حبّة قد زرعتها فی ارض حبّک و انبتّها بید احسانک.
output: I am, O my God, but a tiny seed which Thou hast sown in the soil of Thy love, and caused to spring forth by the hand of Thy bounty.

input: اذاً تطلب بکینونتها مآء رحمتک و کوثر فضلک.
output: This seed craveth, therefore, in its inmost being, for the waters of Thy mercy and the living fountain of Thy grace.

input: فأنزل علیها من سمآء عنایتک ما یربّیها فی ظلّک و جوارک.
output: Send down upon it, from the heaven of Thy loving kindness, that which will enable it to flourish beneath Thy shadow and within the borders of Thy court.

input: و انّک انت مسقی قلوب العارفین مآء الکوثر و التّسنیم.
output: Thou art He Who watereth the hearts of all that have recognized Thee from Thy plenteous stream and the fountain of Thy living waters.

input: ربّ اسألک بذکرک الّذی به بعثت الممکنات و استضآءت الوجوه بأن لا تخیّبنی عمّا عندک.
output: I beseech Thee, O my Lord, by that Remembrance of Thee through which all things have been raised to life, and through which all faces have been made to shine, not to frustrate the hopes I have set on the things Thou dost possess.

input: ثمّ ادخلنی برحمتک فی ظلّک الممدود.
output: Cause me, then, by Thy mercy, to enter beneath Thy shadow that shadoweth all things.

input: ای ربّ فاجعل رجائی انت و قصدی انت و املی انت و مقصدی انت و بیتی انت و کعبتی انت.
output: Be Thou, O my Lord, my sole Desire, my Goal, mine only Hope, my constant Aim, my Habitation and my Sanctuary.

input: و مطلبی جمالک المشرق العزیز المحمود.
output: Let the object of mine ardent quest be Thy most resplendent, Thine adorable, and ever blessed Beauty.

input: ای ربّ اسألک بما انت علیه بأن ترسل عن یمین قدرتک ما تعزّز به احبّائک و تخذل به اعدائک.
output: I implore Thee, O my Lord, by whatsoever is of Thee, to send, from the right hand of Thy might, that which will exalt Thy loved ones and abase Thine enemies.

input: لا اله الّا انت و انّک انت محبوبی فی الدّنیا و الآخرة.
output: No God is there beside Thee, Thou alone art my Beloved in this world and in the world which is to come.

input: و انّک انت مقصود العارفین.
output: Thou alone art the Desire of all them that have recognized Thee.

input: لک الحمد یا الهی بما وفیت بما رقم من قلم امرک فی الألواح الّتی ارسلتها الی خیرة خلقک الّذین بهم فتحت ابواب رحمتک و اشرقت شمس هدایتک.
output: Praised be Thou, O my God, that Thou hast been true to what the Pen of Thy Revelation hath inscribed upon the Tablets sent down by Thee unto Them Whom Thou hast chosen above all Thy creatures, and through Whom Thou hast unlocked the doors of Thy mercy, and shed abroad the radiance of the light of Thy guidance.

input: و لک الحمد یا الهی علی ما اظهرت ما کان مکنوناً فی ازل الآزال فی سرادق العزّة و العظمة و الاجلال و به زیّنت سمآء امرک و الواح کتاب برهانک.
output: Glory to Thee that Thou hast laid bare what had from eternity been wrapped up within the Tabernacle of Thy majesty, Thine omnipotence and glory, and through which Thou hadst decked forth the heaven of Thy Revelation and adorned the pages of the book of Thy testimony.

input: فلمّا جآء الوعد و ظهر الموعود انکروه عبادک الّذین یدّعون الایمان بمظهر نفسک الّذی جعلته مبشّراً لهذا الظّهور الّذی منه قرّت عیون اهل خبآء احدیّتک.
output: And when the Pledge was fulfilled and the Promised One appeared, He was rejected by such of Thy servants as profess to have believed in Him in Whom Thy Godhead was manifested, Whom Thou didst ordain to be the Herald of this Revelation, and through Whose advent the eyes of the inmates of the sanctuary of Thy unity were cheered.

input: ای ربّ لم ادر بأیّ حجّة آمنوا بک و بآیاتک و بأی برهان کفروا بسلطانک.
output: I know, O my Lord, neither their reasoning with which they have acknowledged Thee and believed in Thy signs, nor their argument whereby they have repudiated Thy sovereignty.

input: کلّما ادعوهم الیک و اقول یا قوم.
output: Every time I call them to Thee and say: O people.

input: فانظروا بما عندکم من آیات اللّه ربّکم و بما نزّل من سمآء المشیّة و الاقتدار یعترضون علیک و یعرضون عنک بعد الّذی انت تعلم بأنّ کلّ کلمة من کلمات الّتی خرجت من فم ارادتک تتضوّع منها نفحات رحمتک.
output: Consider the utterances of the Lord your God which are in your possession and those that have been sent down from the heaven of His will and power, they cavil at Thee, and turn their backs to Thee, though—as Thou art aware—each of the words that have gone out of the mouth of Thy will sheddeth the fragrance of the breaths of Thy mercy.

input: و منهم من تمسّک بالّذی لم یکن له شأن لیتکلّم عند احد من خدّام بابک و کیف مقام الّذی فیه ینطق لسان عظمتک.
output: Some have chosen to cleave to him who is counted unworthy to converse with any of Thy servants that watch at Thy door Mírzá Yahyá, how much more to enter into the court in which the Tongue of Thy majesty speaketh.

input: ای ربّ طهّر قلوبهم و ابصارهم لینظروا بعیونهم و یفقهوا بقلوبهم لعلّ یجذبهم آیاتک الی مشرق وحیک و یقرّبهم الی سلسبیل عرفانک.
output: Cleanse Thou their hearts and their eyes, O my Lord, that they may see with their eyes and understand with their hearts, that haply they may be attracted by Thine utterances to the Dayspring of Thine inspiration, and draw nigh unto the soft flowing stream of Thy knowledge.

input: ای ربّ انت الّذی اخذت عهدی منهم فی کلّ سطر من کتابک و اکّدت ذلک علی شأن انقطع عنه اعتذار خلقک.
output: Thou art He, O my Lord, Who hath, in every line of Thy Book, entered into covenant with them for me, and made it so sure that none of Thy creatures can any longer evade it.

input: قلت و قولک الحقّ لا یعادل بکلمة من عنده ما نزّل فی البیان.
output: Thou didst say—and Thy word is the truth: One single letter from Him excelleth all that hath been sent down in the Bayán.

input: اذاً تری یا الهی ما ارتکبوا فی امرک و بما اکتسبت ایدیهم فی ایّامک.
output: Thou dost consider, therefore, O my God, how they have transgressed against Thy Cause, and beholdest what their hands have wrought in Thy days.

input: ینوح من ظلمهم سدرة امرک و سکّان سرادق عظمتک و اهل مداین اسمائک.
output: They have so grievously wronged me that the Lote Tree of Thy Revelation moaneth, and the inmates of the Tabernacle of Thy majesty and the dwellers of the cities of Thy names lament.

input: لم ادر یا الهی بأیّ حجّة قاموا علی الظّلم و بأیّ برهان اعرضوا عن مطلع آیاتک.
output: I know not, O my God, for what reason they have risen up to oppress me, and by what proof they have turned aside from Him Who is the Dayspring of Thy signs.

input: اسألک یا مالک الأسمآء و فاطر السّمآء ان تؤیّدهم علی الانصاف فی امرک لعلّ یجدون عرف قمیص رحمتک و یتوجّهون الی افق الّذی فیه اضآء انوار طلعتک.
output: I beseech Thee, O Thou Who art the Lord of all names and the Creator of the heavens, to aid them to act equitably in Thy Cause, that haply they may discover the sweet smell of the robe of Thy mercy, and set their faces towards the horizon that shineth with the brightness of the light of Thy face.

input: ای ربّ انّهم ضعفآء و انت القویّ القدیر.
output: Weak are they, O my Lord, and Thou art the Lord of strength and power.

input: و هم فقرآء و انت الغنیّ الکریم.
output: They are but paupers, and Thou art the All Possessing, the Most Generous.

input: و انت تعلم یا الهی بأنّی ما اردت لنفسی امراً فی ایّامی.
output: Thou art well aware, O my God, that throughout my life I have sought no advantage for myself.

input: فدیت روحی و ذاتی لاعلآء کلمتک بین خلقک و ارتفاع ذکرک بین عبادک.
output: I have offered up my spirit and my whole being for the exaltation of Thy word amidst Thy creatures and the glorification of Thy name among Thy servants.

input: و ارسلتنی بحجّة بها اهتزّ من الشّوق مطالع وحیک و مشارق الهامک.
output: Thou didst send me with such a Testimony that They Who are the Exponents of Thy Revelation and the Daysprings of Thine inspiration were stirred up with vehement longing.

input: و بها ثبت برهانک و تمّت نعمتک و کمل امرک و نزّلت آیاتک و ظهرت بیّناتک.
output: Through it, Thy proof was established, and Thy bounty fulfilled, and Thy Cause perfected, and Thine utterances released, and Thy clear tokens uncovered.

input: و انت تعلم یا الهی بأنّی ما اردت الّا ما اردت و ما ارید الّا ما ترید.
output: Thou knowest, O my God, that I have wished only what Thou hast wished, and desire what Thou dost desire.

input: ان انطق بین عبادک ما الهمتنی بجودک و امرتنی بذکره بین خلقک یعترض علیّ طغاة بریّتک.
output: Were I to speak forth before Thy servants the things wherewith Thou didst, through Thy bounty, inspire me and which Thou didst command me to utter amidst Thy creatures, the oppressors among Thy people would cavil at me.

input: و ان اصمت عن بدایع ذکرک یقوم کلّ جوارحی بثنائک.
output: And were I to hold my peace and cease to celebrate the wonders of Thy praise, all the limbs of my body would be stirred up to extol Thee.

input: لم ادر بأیّ مآء خلقتنی و بأیّ نار اوقدتنی.
output: I know not what the water is with which Thou didst create me, or what the fire Thou didst kindle within me.

input: لا اصمت عن ذکرک ولو یقوم علیّ من فی سمائک و ارضک.
output: I shall not cease to mention Thee, though all that are in Thy heaven and on Thy earth rise up against me.

input: اذکرک فی کلّ الأحوال منقطعاً عن العالمین.
output: Thee will I magnify, in all circumstances, with a heart wholly rid of all attachment to the world and all that is therein.

input: و الحمد لک یا محبوب افئدة العارفین.
output: Praised be Thou, the Well Beloved of the hearts of all such as have recognized Thee.

input: تری بأنّ طرف البهآء متوجّه الی شطر عنایتک و عینه الی افق فضلک و الطافک و یده مرتفعة الی سمآء مواهبک.
output: Thou beholdest how my gaze is fixed toward Thy tender mercies, and how mine eyes are bent upon the horizon of Thy grace, and Thy loving kindness, and how my hands are stretched out unto the heaven of Thy bestowals.

input: کلّ عضو من اعضائی ینادیک و یقول یا محبوب العالمین و اله من فی السّموات و الأرضین و رجآء افئدة المخلصین.
output: Every limb of my body crieth out to Thee and saith: O Thou Who art the Well Beloved of the worlds, and the Lord of all that are in heaven and on earth, and the one Desire of the hearts which are devoted to Thee.

input: اسألک ببحرک الّذی الیه دعوت من فی سمائک و ارضک بأن تنصر عبادک الّذین منعوا عن التّوجّه الیه و التّقرّب الی شطره.
output: I implore Thee, by Thine Ocean unto which Thou didst summon all the inmates of heaven and all the dwellers of the earth, to help Thy servants who have been kept back from turning unto it and from approaching its shores.

input: ثمّ اجعلهم یا الهی منقطعاً عمّن سواک و ناطقاً بذکرک و مثنیاً بثنائک.
output: Make them, then, O my God, to be detached from all else but Thee, and enable them to speak forth Thy praise and extol Thy virtues.

input: فارزقهم یا الهی رحیق رحمتک لیجعلهم غافلاً عن دونک و قائماً علی امرک و مستقیماً علی حبّک.
output: Supply them, moreover, O my God, with the choice Wine of Thy mercy, that it may cause them to be forgetful of any one except Thee, and to arise to serve Thy Cause, and to be steadfast in their love for Thee.

input: انّک انت الههم و معبودهم.
output: Thou art, verily, the Lord of their lives and the Object of their adoration.

input: لو تطردهم من ینظر الیهم و لو تبعدهم من یقرّبهم.
output: If they be driven away by Thee, who will then look upon them. and if they be removed far from Thee, who is there that can help them to approach Thy Presence

input: لا مهرب الّا انت و لا ملجأ الّا الیک و لا عاصم الّا انت.
output: No refuge is there to flee to except Thee, and no shelter to seek except Thy shelter, and no protection except Thy protection.

input: فویل لمن اتّخذ لنفسه من دونک ولیّاً و نعیم للّذین انقطعوا عن کلّ من فی ارضک و تمسّکوا بذیل عطائک.
output: Woe betide him who hath taken as Lord any one beside Thee, and blessed are the ones who have rid themselves of all attachment to all the dwellers of Thine earth, and clung to the hem of Thy bounteousness.

input: اولئک.
output: These.

input: اهل البهآء بین الأرض و السّمآء.
output: the people of Bahá, before all that are in heaven and all that are on earth.

input: لم ادر یا الهی انطق ببدایع ذکرک بین عبادک و اعرّفهم خفیّات رحمتک و اسرار امرک او اجعل قلبی وعائها.
output: I know not, O my God, whether I should speak forth the wonders of Thy praise among Thy servants, and lay bare before them the secrets of Thy mercy and the mysteries of Thy Cause, or keep them wrapped up within the receptacle of my heart.

input: ولو انّ المحبّ لا یحبّ ان یسمع احد حدیث محبوبه ولکن لمّا جآء امرک المبرم باظهار امرک لا اتوقّف ابداً.
output: Though the lover be loth to share with any one the intimate conversation of his beloved, yet at whatever time Thine inescapable commandment to declare Thy Cause reacheth me, I will unhesitatingly obey it.

input: و اذکرک ولو تنزل علیّ من سحاب القضآء سهام البلآء.
output: I would proclaim Thee, undeterred by the darts of affliction that may rain down upon me from the clouds of Thy decree.

input: لا یمنعنی عن ذکر ما امرت به جنود السّموات و الأرضین.
output: Neither the hosts of the earth nor those of heaven can keep me back from revealing the things I am commanded to manifest.

input: مع ارادتک لیس لی ارادة و عند مشیّتک لیس لی مشیّة .
output: I have no will before Thy will, and can cherish no desire in the face of Thy desire.

input: اکون بفضلک فی کلّ الأحوال حاضراً لخدمتک و منقطعاً عمّا سواک.
output: By Thy grace I am, at all times, ready to serve Thee and am rid of all attachment to any one except Thee.

input: ولکن یا الهی احبّ ان تأمرنی باظهار ما هو المکنون فی علمک لیطیرنّ المخلصون من الاشتیاق الی هوآء احدیّتک و یضطربنّ المشرکون و یرجعنّ الی اسفل الجحیم مقام الّذی قدّرت لهم بسلطانک
output: What I desire, however, O my God, is that Thou shouldst bid me unveil the things which lie hid in Thy knowledge, so that they who are wholly devoted to Thee may, in their longing for Thee, soar up into the atmosphere of Thy oneness, and the infidels may be seized with trembling and may return to the nethermost fire, the abode ordained for them by Thee through the power of Thy sovereign might.

input: ای ربّ تری احبّائک بین ایدی اعدائک و تسمع ضجیجهم من کلّ الأشطار بما ورد علیهم فی سبیلک.
output: Thou dost consider, O my Lord, how Thy dear ones are sore pressed by Thine enemies, and hearest from all sides their sighing by reason of what hath befallen them in Thy path.

input: ای ربّ انت تعلم بأنّهم ما ارادوا الّا وجهک و ما اقبلوا الّا الی حضرتک.
output: Thou knowest, O my Lord, that their one desire was to seek Thy face, and that the sole Object of their adoration was Thee.

input: و الّذین ظلموهم ما ارادوا بذلک الّا الاعراض عنک و اخماد نار الّتی اشتعلتها بأیدی قدرتک.
output: They who wronged them had no other purpose except to turn them away from Thee, and to extinguish the fire which Thou hadst kindled with the hands of Thine almighty power.

input: ای ربّ فأخرج من شفتی مشیّتک کلمة و سخّر بها من علی الأرض کلّها الی متی یا الهی تنظر و تصبر.
output: Unseal the lips of Thy will, O my Lord, and let a word proceed therefrom that shall subject unto itself the world and all that is therein. How long shalt Thou behold these things and tarry, O my God

input: قد اخذت الظّلمة کلّ الجهات و کاد ان تنعدم آثارک فی بلادک.
output: Darkness hath enveloped the whole earth, and Thy tokens are ready to be blotted out throughout Thy realm.

input: استغفرک یا الهی عمّا ذکرت لأنّک انت العلیم و عندک من خفیّات الأمور ما لا عند غیرک.
output: Forgive me, O my God, for what I have spoken, for Thou art the One that knoweth all things, and in Thee are wrapped up the secrets that are hid from all else except Thyself.

input: اذا اتی الوعد تظهر ما ترید و تسخّر کیف تحبّ.
output: When Thy promise shall come to pass, Thou wilt manifest what Thou wilt, and subdue as Thou pleasest.

input: لیس لنا ان نرید الّا ما انت اردت لنا.
output: We should wish only what Thou hast wished for us.

input: عندک علم کلّ شیء تعلم عاقبة الأمور.
output: In Thee is the knowledge of all things, and with Thee is the issue of all things.

input: فاغفر لی و لأحبّتی ثمّ ارزقهم خیر الدّنیا و الآخرة.
output: Forgive me, then, my sins and the sins of them that love me, and supply them with the good of this world and of the next.

input: تری ضعف احبّائک و قدرة اعدائک و ذلّة اصفیائک و عزّة الّذین جحدوا امرک و کفروا بآیاتک.
output: Thou beholdest both the helplessness of Thy dear ones and the ascendancy of Thy foes, both the wretchedness of Thy chosen ones and the glory of them who gainsaid Thy Cause and repudiated Thy signs.

input: انّهم ینکرون آیاتک بما اعطیتهم من النّعم الفانیة و هؤلآء یشکرونک بما ورد علیهم ابتغآء ما عندک من النّعم الباقیة.
output: The latter deny Thy tokens, and fail to repay Thee for the temporal benefits Thou didst bestow upon them, while the former yield Thee thanks for what hath befallen them in their eagerness to partake of the everlasting gifts Thou dost possess.

input: و ما احلی ذکرک فی الشّدّة و البلآء و ثنائک عند هبوب اریاح القضآء.
output: How sweet is the thought of Thee in times of adversity and trial, and how delightful to glorify Thee when compassed about with the fierce winds of Thy decree.

input: و انت تعلم یا الهی بأنّ البهآء لا یجزع عمّا ورد علیه فی سبیلک.
output: Thou knowest full well, O my God, that I endure patiently whatsoever toucheth me in Thy path.

input: بل اجد کلّ اعضائی و جوارحی یشتاق البلآء لاظهار امرک یا مالک الأسمآء.
output: Nay, I perceive that all the members and limbs of my body long for tribulation, that I may manifest Thy Cause, O Thou Who art the Lord of all names.

input: من مآء حبّک استبقی البهآء فی ملکوت الانشآء و من نار ذکرک اشتعل البهآء بین الأرض و السّمآء.
output: The waters of Thy love have preserved me in the kingdom of Thy creation, and the fire of my remembrance of Thee hath set me ablaze before all that are in heaven and on earth.

input: طوبی لی و لهذه النّار الّتی تسمع من زفیرها لا اله الّا انت المحبوب فی صدر البهآء و المذکور فی قلب البهآء.
output: Great is my blessedness, and great the blessedness of this fire whose flame crieth out: No God is there save Thee, Who art the Object of my heart's adoration, and the Source and Center of my soul.

input: لو یجتمعنّ من فی السّموات و الأرض علی ان یمنعنّ البهآء عن ذکرک و ثنائک لا یستطیعنّ و لا یقدرنّ.
output: Were all that are in the heavens and all that are on earth to unite and seek to hinder me from remembering Thee and from celebrating Thy praise, they would assuredly have no power over me, and would fail in their purpose.

input: لو یقتلوننی المشرکون اذاً دمی ینطق باذنک و یقول لا اله الّا انت یا مقصود البهآء.
output: And were the infidels to slay me, my blood would, at Thy command, lift up its voice and proclaim: There is no God but Thee, O Thou Who art all my heart's Desire.

input: و لو یطبخوننی فی قدر البغضآء قتار الّذی یفوح من لحمی یتوجّه الیک و ینادی این انت یا مولی العالمین و مقصود العارفین.
output: And were my flesh to be boiled in the cauldron of hate, the smell which it would send forth would rise towards Thee and cry out: Where art Thou, O Lord of the worlds, Thou One Desire of them that have known Thee.

input: و لو یحرقوننی بالنّار فوعزّتک رمادی ینطق باذنک و یقول قد فاز الغلام بما اراد من ربّه العزیز العلّام.
output: And were I to be cast into fire, my ashes would—I swear by Thy glory—declare: The Youth hath, verily, attained that for which he had besought his Lord, the All Glorious, the Omniscient.

input: و الّذی کان کذلک هل یخوّفه اجتماع الملوک علی ضرّه فی امرک. لا فونفسک یا مالک الملوک.
output: How, then, can such a man be fearful of the combination of the kings to injure him in Thy Cause No, no, I swear by Thyself, O Thou Who art the King of kings.

input: لا یجزعنی سطوة العالمین فی حبّک.
output: Such is my love for Thee that I can fear no one, though the powers of all the worlds be arrayed against me.

input: و قمت بنفسی علی امرک بحولک
output: Alone and unaided I have, by the power of Thy might, arisen to proclaim Thy Cause,

input: و لا یضطربنی جنود الظّالمین.
output: unafraid of the host of my oppressors.

input: و انادی من فی الأرض یا عباد اللّه اتّقوا اللّه و لا تحرموا انفسکم من هذا الرّحیق الّذی جری عن یمین عرش رحمة ربّکم الرّحمن.
output: To all that dwell on earth I cry aloud and say: Fear ye God, O ye servants of God, and suffer not yourselves to be kept back from this pure Wine that hath flowed from the right hand of the throne of the mercy of your Lord, the Most Merciful.

input: تاللّه.
output: I swear by God.

input: ما عنده خیر لکم عمّا عندکم و عمّا اردتم و تریدونه فی الحیوة الباطلة.
output: Better for you is what He possesseth than the things ye yourselves possess and the things ye have sought and are now seeking in this vain and empty life.

input: دعوا الدّنیا و توجّهوا الی الأفق الأعلی.
output: Forsake the world, and set your faces towards the all glorious Horizon.

input: انّ الّذی شرب خمر ذکره یغفل عن ذکر ما سواه و الّذی عرفه ینقطع عن الدّنیا و ما فیها.
output: Whoso hath partaken of the wine of His remembrance will forget every other remembrance, and whoso hath recognized Him will rid himself of all attachment to this life and to all that pertaineth unto it.

input: یا الهی و سیّدی اسألک بالکلمة التّی بها طار الموحّدون فی هوآء عرفانک و عرج المخلصون الی سمآء احدیّتک ان تلهم احبّتک ما تطمئنّ به قلوبهم علی امرک.
output: I implore Thee, O my God and my Master, by Thy word through which they who have believed in Thy unity have soared up into the atmosphere of Thy knowledge, and they who are devoted to Thee have ascended into the heaven of Thy oneness, to inspire Thy loved ones with that which will assure their hearts in Thy Cause.

input: ثمّ استقمهم علی شأن لا یمنعهم شیء عن التّوجّه الیک.
output: Endue them with such steadfastness that nothing whatsoever will hinder them from turning towards Thee.

input: انّک انت المعطی الباذل الغفور الرّحیم.
output: Thou art, verily, the Bountiful, the Munificent, the Forgiving, the Compassionate.

input: یا الهی تری بأنّ السّکر اخذ عبادک الّذین اعرضوا عن جمالک و اعترضوا علی ما نزّل عن یمین عرش عظمتک.
output: Thou beholdest, O my God, how bewildered in their drunkenness are Thy servants who have turned back from Thy beauty and caviled at what hath been sent down from the right hand of the throne of Thy majesty.

input: قد اتیت یا الهی علی ظلل المعانی و البیان اذاً اضطربت اهل الأکوان و تزلزلت ارکان الّذین کفروا ببرهانک یا من فی قبضتک من فی الامکان.
output: Thou didst come, O my God, in the clouds of Thy spirit and Thine utterance, and lo, the entire creation shook and trembled, and the limbs of them who repudiated Thy testimonies were made to quiver, O Thou in Whose grasp is the lordship of all things.

input: انت الّذی یا الهی نادیت الکلّ الی شطر رحمتک و دعوتهم الی افق فضلک و الطافک.
output: Thou art He, O my God, Who hast summoned all men to turn in the direction of Thy mercy, and called them unto the horizon of Thy grace and bounties.

input: و ما اجابک الّا الّذین انقطعوا عن دونک و سرعوا الی مشرق جمالک و مطلع وحیک و الهامک.
output: None, however, heeded Thy call, except such as have forsaken all things save Thee, and hastened unto the Dayspring of Thy beauty, and the Dawning Place of Thine inspiration and Thy revelation.

input: تعلم یا الهی لیس علی وجه الأرض من یذکرک الّا هؤلآء.
output: Thou knowest, O my God, that none can be found on the face of the earth to remember Thee except them.

input: و تراهم بین ایدی الظّالمین من خلقک.
output: Thou seest how the oppressors among Thy creatures have laid hold on them.

input: و منهم یا الهی من سفک دمه فی سبیلک و منهم من خرج عن دیاره متوجّهاً الی مقرّ عرشک و منع عن الدّخول فی فنآء عظمتک و منهم فی السّلاسل و الأغلال و منهم بین ایادی الفجّار.
output: Some, O my God, have shed their blood in Thy path, others have abandoned their homes and set their faces towards the seat of Thy throne, and were hindered from stepping into the court of Thy great glory, while still others have been cast into prison and are at the mercy of the workers of iniquity.

input: اسألک یا من بیدک زمام الاختیار ان تنصرهم ببدایع نصرتک.
output: I implore Thee, O Thou Who holdest in Thy hands the reins of unconstrained power, to succor them through the wondrous potency of Thy might.

input: ای ربّ قد اخذتهم الذّلّة فی سبیلک عزّزهم بسلطانک و قد اخذهم الضّعف فی حبّک فأغلبهم علی الأعدآء بقدرتک و اقتدارک.
output: Misery, O my Lord, hath taken hold on them in Thy path, exalt them by the power of Thy sovereignty. and weariness hath afflicted them in their love for Thee, render them victorious, through Thy strength and Thine omnipotence, over Thine enemies.

input: ولو انّی یا الهی اعلم بأنّک قدّرت لهم ما لا یعادل به ما فی سمائک و ارضک ولکن احبّ بأن تراهم فی العزّة و الاقتدار فی ایّامک انّک انت المقتدر علی خلقک.
output: Aware as I am, O my God, that Thou hast decreed for them that which excelleth whatsoever is in Thy heaven and on Thy earth, I still cherish the desire that Thou mayest behold them in Thy days exalted and honored by Thy creatures. Supreme art Thou over Thy creation.

input: کلّ فی قبضتک و فی کفّ اقتدارک.
output: All are held within Thy grasp, and lie prisoned in the hollow of Thy hand.

input: اشهد بأنّ العباد لو یتوجّهون الیک ببصر الّذی خلقت فیهم و سمع الّذی اعطیتهم لتجذبهم کلمة واحدة الّتی نزّلت عن یمین عرش عظمتک.
output: I testify that if Thy servants were to turn towards Thee with the eyes Thou didst create in them and with the ears wherewith Thou didst endow them, they would all be carried away by a single word sent down from the right hand of the throne of Thy majesty.

input: و بها تستضیء وجوههم و تطمئنّ قلوبهم و تطیر ارواحهم فی هوآء عزّ احدیّتک و سمآء ربوبیّتک.
output: That word alone would suffice to brighten their faces, and to assure their hearts, and to cause their souls to soar up to the atmosphere of Thy great glory, and to ascend into the heaven of Thy sovereignty.

input: اسألک یا مالک الأسمآء و ملیک الأرض و السّمآء ان تجعل احبّائک کؤوس رحمتک فی ایّامک لیحیینّ بهم قلوب عبادک.
output: I pray Thee, O Thou Who art the Lord of all names and the Ruler of both earth and heaven, to grant that all who are dear to Thee may each become a cup of Thy mercy in Thy days, that they may quicken the hearts of Thy servants.

input: ثمّ اجعلهم یا الهی امطار سحاب فضلک و اریاح ربیع عنایتک لیخضرّ بهم اراضی قلوب خلقک و بریّتک و ینبت منها ما تفوح نفحاتها فی مملکتک لیجدنّ کلّ رایحة قمیص امرک.
output: Empower them also, O my God, to be as the rain that poureth down from the clouds of Thy grace, and as the winds that waft the vernal fragrances of Thy loving kindness, that through them the soil of the hearts of Thy creatures may be clad with verdure, and may bring forth the things that will shed their fragrance over all Thy dominion, so that every one may perceive the sweet smell of the Robe of Thy Revelation.

input: انّک انت المقتدر علی ما ترید.
output: Potent art Thou to do what Thou willest.

input: من شرب من الکأس الّتی تدور بها ید رحمتک ینقطع عن دونک و ینجذب بکلمة منه عبادک الّذین رقدوا فی مهاد الغفلة و النّسیان و یتوجّهون الی شطر آیتک الکبری و لا یریدون منک الّا انت و لا یطلبون الّا ما قدّرت لهم من قلم قضائک فی لوح تقدیرک.
output: Whoso hath drunk of the cup which the hand of Thy mercy hath borne round will strip himself of all things except Thee, and will be able, through a word of his mouth, to enrapture the souls of such of Thy servants as have slumbered on the bed of forgetfulness and negligence, and to cause them to turn their faces toward Thy most Great Sign, and seek from Thee naught else except Thyself, and ask of Thee only what Thou hast determined for them by the pen of Thy judgment and hast prescribed in the Tablet of Thy decree.

input: اذاً یا الهی باسمک الأعظم فأنزل علی احبّتک ما یقرّبهم الیک فی کلّ الأحوال.
output: Send down, then, O my God, through Thy Most Great Name, upon Thy loved ones what will, under all conditions, draw them nearer unto Thee.

input: و انّک انت المقتدر العزیز المستعان.
output: Thou art, verily, the Almighty, the All Glorious, Whose help is implored by all men.

input: یا الهی قرّت عین البهآء بالنّظر الی افق البلآء الّذی اتی من سمآء قضائک و اخذه من کلّ الجهات بما رقم من قلم تقدیرک.
output: Mine eyes are cheered, O my God, when I contemplate the tribulations that descend upon me from the heaven of Thy decree, and which have encompassed me on every side according to what Thy pen hath irrevocably established.

input: فونفسک ما ینسب الیک انّه لمحبوب البهآء ولو یکون سمّ الرّدی
output: I swear by Thy Self. Whatsoever is of Thee is well pleasing unto me, though it involve the bitterness of mine own death.

input: یا الهی انّ الرّوح فی لیلة الّتی انتهت الیها ایّامه قد خرج فی ظلمتها الی العرآء وحده اکبّ بوجهه علی التّراب و قال یا ربّی و محبوبی ان ترید ان تردّ هذه الکأس فأرجعها عنّی بفضلک و احسانک.
output: He Who was Thy Spirit Jesus, O my God, withdrew all alone in the darkness of the night preceding His last day on earth, and falling on His face to the ground besought Thee saying: If it be Thy will, O my Lord, my Well Beloved, let this cup, through Thy grace and bounty, pass from me.

input: فوجمالک یا مالک الأسمآء و فاطر السّمآء.
output: By Thy beauty, O Thou Who art the Lord of all names and the Creator of the heavens.

input: انّ البهآء یجد نفحات کلماته الّتی خرجت من فمه فی حبّک و یجد التهاب الّذی اخذه فی شوقه الی لقائک و اشتیاقه الی مطلع نور فردانیّتک و مشرق عزّ وحدانیّتک.
output: I can smell the fragrance of the words which, in His love for Thee, His lips have uttered, and can feel the glow of the fire that had inflamed His soul in its longing to behold Thy face and in its yearning after the Dayspring of the light of Thy oneness, and the Dawning Place of Thy transcendent unity.

input: و انّی ونفسک اقول یا ربّی و سیّدی و مولای لیس لی ارادة تلقآء ظهور ارادتک و لا لی مشیّة عند طلوع مشیّتک.
output: As to me—and to this Thou art Thyself my witness—I call upon Thee saying: I have no will of mine own, O my Lord, and my Master and my Ruler, before the indications of Thy will, and can have no purpose in the face of the revelation of Thy purpose.

input: لا ارید الّا ما انت ترید و لا احبّ الّا ما انت تحبّ.
output: I wish only what Thou wishest, and cherish only what Thou cherishest.

input: انّ مختار البهآء ما اخترته لنفس البهآء یا مالک البهآء.
output: What I have chosen for myself is what Thou hast Thyself chosen for me, O Thou the Possessor of my soul.

input: بل لا اجد لنفسی ذکراً تلقآء ظهورات اسمائک کیف لدی تجلّی انوار ذاتک.
output: Nay, I find myself to be altogether nothing when face to face with the manifold revelations of Thy names, how much less when confronted with the effulgent splendors of the light of Thine own Self.

input: فآه آه لو اذکرک نفس الذّکر یدلّ علی شرکی و یشهد علی غفلتی عند ظهور نور توحیدک.
output: O miserable me. Were I to attempt merely to describe Thee, such an attempt would itself be an evidence of my impiety, and would attest my heedlessness in the face of the clear and resplendent tokens of Thy oneness.

input: هل یکون لدونک من ظهور لدی ظهورک او لغیرک من وجود لیذکرک او یباهی بثنائه ایّاک
output: Who else except Thee can claim to be worthy of any notice in the face of Thine own revelation, and who is he that can be deemed sufficiently qualified to adequately praise Thee, or to pride himself on having befittingly described Thy glory

input: لا فونفسک قد ثبت بالبرهان بأنّک انت الواحد الفرد المستعان.
output: Nay—and to this Thou dost Thyself bear witness—it hath incontrovertibly been made evident that Thou art the one God, the Incomparable, Whose help is implored by all men.

input: لم تزل کنت بلا ذکر شیء معک و لا تزال تکون بلا وجود شیء عندک .
output: From everlasting Thou wert alone, with none to describe Thee, and wilt abide for ever the same with no one else to equal or rival Thee.

input: لو یثبت غیرک کیف یثبت تقدیس ذاتک عن الأمثال و تنزیه نفسک عن الأشباه.
output: Were the existence of any coequal with Thee to be recognized, how could it then be maintained that Thou art the Incomparable, or that Thy Godhead is immeasurably exalted above all peers or likeness

input: و انّ اعلی افئدة الموحّدین لا یرتقی الی هوآء علم الّذی خلقته بکلمة امرک و کیف الی علم الّذی ینسب الی ذاتک.
output: The contemplation of the highest minds that have recognized Thy unity failed to attain unto the comprehension of the One Thou hast created through the word of Thy commandment, how much more must it be powerless to soar into the atmosphere of the knowledge of Thine own Being.

input: کلّ الأذکار و الأفکار منقطعة من هذا المقام الّذی خلق من قلمک الأعلی فکیف مقام الّذی قدّسته عن الذّکر و البیان.
output: Every praise which any tongue or pen can recount, every imagination which any heart can devise, is debarred from the station which Thy most exalted Pen hath ordained, how much more must it fall short of the heights which Thou hast Thyself immensely exalted above the conception and the description of any creature

input: و انّ ذکر العدم آیات القدم کحرکة القطرة عند تموّجات ابحر احدیّتک.
output: For the attempt of the evanescent to conceive the signs of the Uncreated is as the stirring of the drop before the tumult of Thy billowing oceans

input: استغفرک یا الهی من هذا التّشبیه لأنّ التّشبیه و التّمثیل من شؤونات خلقک.
output: Nay, forbid it, O my God, that I should thus venture to describe Thee, for every similitude and comparison must pertain to what is essentially created by Thee

input: کیف یتقرّب الیک و یصعد الی نفسک.
output: How can then such similitude and comparison ever befit Thee, or reach up unto Thy Self

input: مع علمی و ایقانی بأنّ ذکر دونک لن یصل الیک و ثنآء غیرک لا یتعارج الی سمآء قربک لو اصمت من ثنائک و بدایع ذکرک لیحترق کبدی و تذوب نفسی.
output: Though I recognize and firmly believe that no description which any except Thyself can give of Thee can beseem Thy grandeur, and that no glory ascribed to Thee by any save Thyself can ever ascend into the atmosphere of Thy presence, yet were I to hold my peace, and cease to glorify Thee and to recount Thy wondrous glory, my heart would be consumed, and my soul would melt away.

input: بذکرک یا الهی یسکن عطشی و یستریح فؤادی.
output: My remembrance of Thee, O my God, quencheth my thirst, and quieteth my heart.

input: و به آنس البهآء کأنس الرّضیع الی ثدی رحمتک و به اشتاق البهآء کاشتیاق الظّمآن الی کوثر عطائک یا رحمن یا من بیدک جبروت الامکان.
output: My soul delighteth in its communion with Thee, as the sucking child delighteth itself in the breasts of Thy mercy.and my heart panteth after Thee even as one sore athirst panteth after the living waters of Thy bounty, O Thou Who art the God of mercy, in Whose hand is the lordship of all things!

input: لک الحمد یا الهی بما اذنتنی بذکرک.
output: I give thanks to Thee, O my God, that Thou hast suffered me to remember Thee.

input: لولاه لما یستأنس البهآء و یفرح قلب البهآء.
output: What else but remembrance of Thee can give delight to my soul or gladness to my heart

input: بذکرک جعلت غنیّاً عن ذکر العالمین و بحبّک لا اجزع عن ضرّ الظّالمین.
output: Communion with Thee enableth me to dispense with the remembrance of all Thy creatures, and my love for Thee empowereth me to endure the harm which my oppressors inflict upon me.

input: فأرسل یا الهی علی احبّتی ما تفرح به قلوبهم و تستنیر به وجوههم و تسترّ به ذواتهم و انت تعلم یا الهی انّ فرحهم فی استعلآء امرک و اعلآء کلمتک.
output: Send, therefore, unto my loved ones, O my God, what will cheer their hearts, and illumine their faces, and delight their souls.Thou knowest, O my Lord, that their joy is to behold the exaltation of Thy Cause and the glorification of Thy word.

input: فأظهر یا الهی ما تقرّ به عیونهم و قدّر لهم خیر الدّنیا و الآخرة.
output: Do Thou unveil, therefore, O my God, what will gladden their eyes, and ordain for them the good of this world and of the world which is to come.

input: انّک انت العزیز المقتدر الوهّاب.
output: Thou art, verily, the God of power, of strength and of bounty.

input: تری یا الهی کیف حال بین عبادک و مظهر نفسک ظلم المعرضین من خلقک.
output: Thou seest, O my God, how the wrongs committed by such of Thy creatures as have turned their backs to Thee have come in between Him in Whom Thy Godhead is manifest and Thy servants.

input: ای ربّ فأنزل علیهم ما یشغلهم بأنفسهم.
output: Send down upon them, O my Lord, what will cause them to be busied with each others' concerns.

input: ثمّ اجعل بأسهم بینهم لتستریح بذلک الأرض و من علیها.
output: Let, then, their violence be confined to their own selves, that the land and they that dwell therein may find peace.

input: ای ربّ انّ امة من امائک ارادت وجهک و طارت فی هوآء رضاک.
output: One of Thy handmaidens, O my Lord, hath sought Thy face, and soared in the atmosphere of Thy pleasure.

input: ای ربّ لا تحرمها عمّا قدّرته لخیرة امائک.
output: Withhold not from her, O my Lord, the things Thou didst ordain for the chosen ones among Thy handmaidens.

input: ثمّ اجتذبها بآیاتک علی شأن تذکرک بین امائک.
output: Enable her, then, to be so attracted by Thine utterances that she will celebrate Thy praise amongst them.

input: یا الهی و محبوبی.
output: My God, my Well Beloved.

input: لا مفرّ لأحد عند نزول احکامک و لا مهرب لنفس لدی صدور اوامرک.
output: No place is there for any one to flee to when once Thy laws have been sent down, and no refuge can be found by any soul after the revelation of Thy commandments.

input: اوحیت القلم اسرار القدم و امرته ان یعلّم الانسان ما لم یعلم و یشربهم کوثر المعانی من کأس وحیک و الهامک.
output: Thou hast inspired the Pen with the mysteries of Thine eternity, and bidden it teach man that which he knoweth not, and caused him to partake of the living waters of truth from the cup of Thy Revelation and Thine inspiration.

input: فلمّا ظهر منه علی اللّوح حرف من علمک المکنون ارتفع ضجیج العشّاق من کلّ الأشطار.
output: No sooner, however, had the Pen traced upon the tablet one single letter of Thy hidden wisdom, than the voice of the lamentation of Thine ardent lovers was lifted up from all directions.

input: و بذلک ورد علی الأخیار ما بکت عنه سکّان سرادق مجدک و ناحت اهل مداین امرک.
output: Thereupon, there befell the just what hath caused the inmates of the tabernacle of Thy glory to weep and the dwellers of the cities of Thy revelation to groan.

input: تری یا الهی فی تلک الأیّام مطلع اسمائک تحت سیوف اعدائک.
output: Thou dost consider, O my God, how He Who is the Manifestation of Thy names is in these days threatened by the swords of Thine adversaries.

input: و فی هذه الحالة ینادی من فی ارضک و سمائک و یدعوهم الیک.
output: In such a state He crieth out and summoneth all the inhabitants of Thine earth and the denizens of Thy heaven unto Thee.

input: فیا الهی طهّر قلوب بریّتک بسلطنتک و اقتدارک لیؤثّر فیهم کلماتک.
output: Purify, O my God, the hearts of Thy creatures with the power of Thy sovereignty and might, that Thy words may sink deep into them.

input: لم ادر یا الهی ما فی قلوبهم و ما یظنّون فی حقّک.
output: I know not what is in their hearts, O my God, nor can tell the thoughts they think of Thee.

input: کأنّهم ظنّوا بأنّک تدعوهم الی افقک الأعلی لیزداد بذلک شأنک و عزّک.
output: Methinks that they imagine that Thy purpose in calling them to Thine all highest horizon is to heighten the glory of Thy majesty and power.

input: لأنّهم لو علموا انّک تدعوهم الی ما یحیی به قلوبهم و تبقی به انفسهم ما فرّوا عن حکومتک و ما تبعّدوا عن ظلّ سدرة فردانیّتک.
output: For had they been satisfied that Thou summonest them to that which will recreate their hearts and immortalize their souls, they would never have fled from Thy governance, nor deserted the shadow of the tree of Thy oneness.

input: فاکشف یا الهی ابصار خلقک لیروا مظهر نفسک مقدّساً عمّا عندهم و ما یدعوهم الی افق وحدانیّتک الّا خالصاً لوجهک فی حین الّذی لا یطمئنّ لنفسه حیوة فی اقلّ من ساعة.
output: Clear away, then, the sight of Thy creatures, O my God, that they may recognize Him Who showeth forth the Godhead as One Who is sanctified from all that pertaineth unto them, and Who, wholly for Thy sake, is summoning them to the horizon of Thy unity, at a time when every moment of His life is beset with peril.

input: لو یرید نفسه ما یلقیها بین ایدی اعدائک.
output: Had His aim been the preservation of His own Self, He would never have left it at the mercy of Thy foes.

input: قبلت البلایا لاحیآء من فی سمائک و ارضک.
output: I have accepted to be tried by manifold adversities for no purpose except to regenerate all that are in Thy heaven and on Thy earth.

input: انّ الّذی احبّک لا یحبّ نفسه الّا لاعلآء امرک و الّذی عرفک لا یعرف سواک و لا یلتفت الی دونک.
output: Whoso hath loved Thee, can never feel attached to his own self, except for the purpose of furthering Thy Cause. and whoso hath recognized Thee can recognize naught else except Thee, and can turn to no one save Thee.

input: عرّف یا الهی عبادک ما اردت لهم فی ملکوتک.
output: Enable Thy servants, O my God, to discover the things Thou didst desire for them in Thy Kingdom.

input: ثمّ عرّفهم ما حمله مصدر اسمائک الحسنی لأحیآء انفسهم حبّاً لنفسک لعلّ الی کوثر الحیوان هم یقصدون و الی شطر اسمک الرّحمن یتوجّهون.
output: Acquaint them, moreover, with what He Who is the Origin of Thy most excellent titles hath, in His love for Thee, been willing to bear for the sake of the regeneration of their souls, that they may haste to attain the River that is Life indeed, and turn their faces in the direction of Thy Name, the Most Merciful.

input: ای ربّ لا تدعهم بأنفسهم.
output: Abandon them not to themselves, O my God.

input: فاجذبهم بجودک الی افق سمآء وحیک.
output: Draw them, by Thy bountiful favor, to the heaven of Thine inspiration.

input: هم الفقرآء و انّک انت الغنیّ الغفور الرّحیم.
output: They are but paupers, and Thou art the All Possessing, the ever Forgiving, the Most Compassionate.

input: قد ظهرت طلایع ربیع فضلک و اخضرّت بها اراضی مملکتک.
output: The first stirrings of the spring of Thy grace have appeared and clothed Thine earth with verdure.

input: و امطرت سحاب سمآء کرمک علی هذه المدینة الّتی فیها حبس من اراد عتق بریّتک.
output: The clouds of the heaven of Thy bounty have rained their rain on this City within whose walls is imprisoned Him Whose desire is the salvation of Thy creatures.

input: و به تزیّنت ارضها و تردّی اشجارها و استفرحت أهلها.
output: Through it the soil of this City hath been decked forth, and its trees clothed with foliage, and its inhabitants gladdened.

input: ولکنّ قلوب احبّتک لا تسترّ الّا من ربیع عواطفک الّذی به تخضرّ القلوب و تجدّد النّفوس و تثمر اشجار الوجود.
output: The hearts of Thy dear ones, however, will rejoice only at the Divine Springtime of Thy tender mercies, whereby the hearts are quickened, and the souls are renewed, and the trees of human existence bear their fruits.

input: ای ربّ قد اصفرّ نبات قلوب احبّتک.
output: The plants that have sprung forth, O my Lord, in the hearts of Thy loved ones have withered away.

input: فامطر علیهم من سحاب المعانی ما ینبت من صدورهم کلأ علمک و حکمتک.
output: Send down upon them, from the clouds of Thy spirit, that which will cause the tender herbs of Thy knowledge and wisdom to grow within their breasts.

input: ثمّ اسررهم باظهار امرک و استعلآء سلطنتک.
output: Rejoice, then, their hearts with the proclamation of Thy Cause and the exaltation of Thy sovereignty.

input: ای ربّ کلّ مترصّد الی شطر جودک و متوجّه الی افق فضلک.
output: Their eyes, O my Lord, are expectantly turned in the direction of Thy bounty, and their faces are set towards the horizon of Thy grace.

input: لا تحرمهم باحسانک.
output: Suffer them not, through Thy bounty, to be deprived of Thy grace.

input: انّک انت المقتدر بسلطانک.
output: Potent art Thou, by Thy sovereign might, over all things.

input: تری یا الهی عبادک تمسّکوا بأسمائک و یدعونها فی اللّیالی و الأیّام.
output: Thou seest, O my God, how Thy servants have been cleaving fast to Thy names, and have been calling on them in the daytime and in the night season.

input: و اذا ظهر من خلق بکلمة من عنده ملکوت الأسمآء و جبروت البقآء انفضّوا عن حوله و کفروا بآیاتک الکبری.
output: No sooner, however, had He been made manifest through Whose word the kingdom of names and the heaven of eternity were created, than they broke away from Him and disbelieved in the greatest of Thy signs.

input: الی ان اخرجوه من دیاره و ادخلوه الی اخرب بلادک بعد الّذی عمّرت الدّنیا لنفسه.
output: They finally banished Him from the land of His birth, and caused Him to dwell within the most desolate of Thy cities, though all the world had been built up by Thee for His sake.

input: و یکون جالساً فی هذا السّجن الأعظم.
output: Within this, the Most Great Prison, He hath established His seat.

input: و مع هذا البلآء الّذی ما رأت شبهه عین الابداع یدعو النّاس الیک یا مالک الاختراع.
output: Though sore tried by trials, the like of which the eye of creation hath not seen, He summoneth the people unto Thee, O Thou Who art the Fashioner of the universe.

input: اسألک یا خالق الأمم و محیی الرّمم بأن تؤیّد عبادک علی عرفان مظهر ذاتک و مطلع قیّومیّتک لیکسّروا بقدرتک اصنام الهوی و یدخلوا فی ظلّ رحمتک الکبری الّتی سبقت الأشیآء باسمک العلیّ الأبهی.
output: I beseech Thee, O Thou the Shaper of all the nations and the Quickener of every moldering bone, to graciously enable Thy servants to recognize Him Who is the Manifestation of Thy Self and the Revealer of Thy transcendent might, that they may cut down, by Thy power, all the idols of their corrupt inclinations, and enter beneath the shadow of Thine all encompassing mercy, which, by virtue of Thy name, the Most Exalted, the All Glorious, hath surpassed the entire creation.

input: لم ادر یا الهی الی متی یرقدون بریّتک علی فراش الغفلة و الهوی و الی متی ینامون علی بساط البعد و النّوی.
output: I know not, O my God, how long will Thy creatures continue to slumber on the bed of forgetfulness and evil desires, and remain far removed from Thee and shut out from Thy presence.

input: قرّبهم یا الهی الی المنظر الأعلی و اجتذبهم من نفحات وحیک الّتی بها طار الموحّدون الی هوآء الاشتیاق و المخلصون الی مطلع نیّر الآفاق.
output: Draw them nearer, O my God, unto the scene of Thine effulgent glory, and enrapture their hearts with the sweet savors of Thine inspiration, through which they who adore Thy unity have soared on the wings of desire towards Thee, and they who are devoted to Thee have reached unto Him Who is the Dawning Place of the Daystar of Thy creation.

input: ای ربّ فاخرق حجباتهم لیروک مشرقاً عن افق احدیّتک و طالعاً عن فجر ربوبیّتک.
output: Cleave asunder, O my Lord, the veils that shut them out from Thee, that they may behold Thee shining above the horizon of Thy oneness and shedding Thy radiance from the dawning place of Thy sovereignty.

input: لو وجدوا حلاوة ذکرک و ما ینزل علیهم عن یمین عرش عظمتک لیضعون ما عندهم و یسرعون فی بیدآء الاشتیاق لیرتدّ الیهم لحظات اعین مرحمتک و یتجلّی علیهم شمس جمالک.
output: Were they to discover the sweetness of Thy remembrance and apprehend the excellence of the things that are sent down upon them from the right hand of the throne of Thy majesty, they would cast away all that they possess, and would rush forth into the wilderness of their longing after Thee, that the glance of Thy loving kindness may be directed towards them and the radiance of the Daystar of Thy beauty may be shed upon them.

input: ای ربّ فاجذب افئدتهم بذکرک ثمّ اجعلهم غنیّاً بغنائک و مؤیّداً علی اظهار امرک بین خلقک.
output: Let their hearts, O my Lord, be carried away by Thy remembrance, and their souls enriched by Thy riches, and their wills strengthened to proclaim Thy Cause amidst Thy creatures.

input: انّک انت المعطی الغفور الرّحیم.
output: Thou art, verily, the Great Giver, the Ever Forgiving, the Most Compassionate.

input: تری کیف ابتلیت بین عبادک و ما ورد علیّ فی سبیلک.
output: Thou seest how I have been sorely vexed among Thy servants, and beholdest the things that have befallen me in Thy path.

input: انت تعلم بأنّی ما تکلّمت الّا باذنک و ما یفکّ شفتای الّا بأمرک و ارادتک و ما تنفّست الّا بذکرک و ثنائک و ما دعوت الکلّ الّا الی ما دعی به اصفیائک فی ازل الآزال و ما امرتهم الّا بما یقرّبهم الی مشرق عنایتک و مطلع الطافک و افق غنائک و مظهر وحیک و الهامک.
output: Thou knowest full well that I have not spoken a word but by Thy leave, that my lips have never been opened except at Thy bidding and in accordance with Thy pleasure, that every breath I have breathed hath been animated with Thy praise and Thy remembrance, that I have summoned all men to naught else except that whereunto Thy chosen ones have through all eternity been summoned, and that I have bidden them observe only the things that would draw them nearer unto the Dayspring of Thy loving kindness, and the Dawning Place of Thy favors, and the Horizon of Thy riches, and the Manifestation of Thine inspiration and Thy revelation.

input: و انت تعلم یا الهی بأنّی ما قصّرت فی امرک.
output: Thou art well aware, O my God, that I have not failed in my duty towards Thy Cause.

input: ارسلت فی کلّ الأحیان نفحات وحیک علی الأشطار و عرف قمیص رحمانیّتک الی الأقطار لعلّ یجدونه عبادک و یتوجّهون به الیک.
output: At all times and under all conditions I have wafted, in every direction, the breezes of Thine inspiration, and shed abroad the sweet smell of the raiment of Thy mercy, that haply Thy servants may discover its fragrance, and through it be enabled to turn towards Thee.

input: اسألک یا الهی بأنوار احدیّتک و مهابط وحیک ان تنزل من سحاب رحمتک ما یطهّر به قلوب الّذین توجّهوا الیک.
output: I implore Thee, O my God, by the Lights of Thy unity and the Repositories of Thy revelation, to send down from the clouds of Thy mercy that which will cleanse the hearts of all such as have turned towards Thee.

input: ثمّ امح عن صدورهم ما یعترض به العباد فی امرک.
output: Blot out, then, from their hearts all that may induce Thy servants to cavil at Thy Cause.

input: یا الهی غلبت ارادتک ارادتی و ظهر منّی ما ابتلیت به.
output: Thy will hath overruled my will, O my God, and I have shown forth what hath grievously vexed me.

input: فارحمنی یا ارحم الرّاحمین.
output: Have mercy, then, upon me, O Thou Who of all those who show mercy art the Most Merciful.

input: وفّق یا الهی عبادک علی نصرة امرک ثمّ اشربهم ما تحیی به قلوبهم فی مملکتک لئلّا یمنعهم شیء عن ذکرک و ثنائک یخرجون من اماکنهم باسمک و یدعون الکلّ الیک.
output: Assist Thou Thy servants, O my God, to help Thy Cause, and give them to drink what will quicken their hearts in Thy realm, lest anything hinder them from remembering Thee and from extolling Thy virtues, that they may quit their homes in Thy name, and summon all the multitudes unto Thee.

input: ای ربّ طهّر وجوههم عن التّوجّه الی غیرک و آذانهم عن اصغآء کلمات الّذین اعرضوا عن جمالک و کفروا بآیاتک.
output: Guard their faces, O my God, from turning to any one save Thee, and their ears from hearkening unto the sayings of all such as have turned away from Thy beauty and repudiated Thy signs.

input: انّک انت المقتدر علی کلّ شیء.
output: Supreme art Thou over all things.

input: تری مقرّی و مقامی و تشهد اضطرابی و اضطراری و ضرّی و ابتلائی بین عبادک الّذین یقرؤون آیاتک و یکفرون بمنزلها و یدعون اسمائک و یعترضون علی موجدها و یستقربون باسمک الحبیب و یقتلون محبوب العالمین.
output: Thou beholdest my low estate and the habitation wherein I dwell, and bearest witness unto my perplexity, my crying needs, my troubles, and the afflictions I suffer among Thy servants who recite Thy verses and repudiate their Revealer, who call on Thy names and cavil at their Creator, who seek to draw nigh unto Him Who is Thy Friend and put to death Him Who is the Best Beloved of the worlds.

input: الهی و سیّدی ان افتح عیونهم لمشاهدة جمالک او ارجعهم الی مقرّهم فی اسفل النّیران.
output: Open Thou their eyes, O my God, and My Master, that they may gaze on Thy beauty, or cause them to return unto the lowest abyss of the fire.

input: کلّما ارید ان اذکرک یمنعنی علوّک و اقتدارک و کلّما ارید ان اصمت ینطقنی حبّک و ارادتک.
output: Every time I attempt to remember Thee, I find myself over powered by the sublimity of Thy station and the immensity of Thy might. and every time I hold my peace, lo, I am impelled by my love for Thee and by the potency of Thy will, to unloose my tongue and mention Thee.

input: فیا الهی انّ المسکین یدعو مولاه الغنیّ و العاجز یذکر مولاه القویّ.
output: He who is poor and needy, O my God, is calling for his Lord, the All Possessing. and he who is destitute of all strength remembereth his Master, the All Powerful.

input: ان قبل منه انّه خیر معطی و ان اطرده انّه خیر عادل.
output: If He deign to accept His servant's supplication, He is, verily, of unsurpassed bounteousness. and if He cast him out, He is of those who judge equitably the best.

input: و المقبول یا الهی من اقبل الیک و المحروم من غفل عن ذکرک فی ایّامک.
output: He indeed is acceptable, O my God, who hath set his face towards Thee, and he is truly deprived who hath been careless of the remembrance of Thee in Thy days.

input: طوبی لمن ذاق حلاوة ذکرک و ثنائک.
output: Blessed is he that hath tasted of the sweetness of Thy remembrance and praise.

input: انّه لا یمنعه شیء عن التّوجّه الی مناهج رضائک و مسالک امرک ولو یحاربه من علی الأرض کلّها.
output: Nothing, not even the arising of all the peoples of the whole world to assail him, can hinder such a man from directing his steps towards the paths of Thy pleasure and the ways of Thy Cause.

input: فانظر دموع البهآء یا محبوب البهآء ثمّ انظر زفرات قلب البهآء یا مقصود البهآء.
output: Look, then, O Thou Who art the Well Beloved of Bahá, upon the tears he sheddeth before Thee, and behold the sighs which he uttereth, O Thou Who art his heart's Desire.

input: فوعزّتک و عظمتک و جلالک.
output: I swear by Thy might, and Thy majesty and Thy glory.

input: لو تورثنی الجنان کلّها بدوام نفسک و انّها تشغلنی عن ذکرک فی اقلّ من آن اترکها و لن اتوجّه الیها ابداً.
output: Were I to inherit from Thee all the delights of Paradise, and to keep them in my possession as long as Thine own Being endureth, and were I to become, for less than a moment, careless of the remembrance of Thee, I would, of a certainty, cast them away from me and cease to consider them.

input: انا الّذی یا الهی بحبّک منعت عن الدّنیا و العافیة فیها و بذکرک قبلت البلایا کلّها.
output: I am the one, O my God, who for love of Thee hath forsaken the world and all its benefits, and willingly accepted every tribulation for the sake of Thy remembrance.

input: اسألک یا انیس البهآء و محبوب البهآء بأن تکشف الحجاب الّذی حال بینک و بین عبادک لیعرفنّک بعینک و ینقطعنّ عمّا سواک.
output: I entreat Thee, O Thou Who art my Companion and my Best Beloved, to lift the veil that hath come in between Thee and Thy servants, that they may recognize Thee with Thine own eye and rid themselves of all attachment to any one but Thee.

input: و انّک انت المقتدر الغفور الرّحیم.
output: Thou art, verily, the Almighty, the Ever Forgiving, the Most Compassionate.

input: لا اله الّا انت المتعالی المتکافی المتباهی العزیز العلیم.
output: No God is there beside Thee, the Most Exalted, the Self Sufficing, the Self Exalting, the All Glorious, the All Wise.

input: و الحمد لک اذ انّک انت ربّ السّموات و الأرضین.
output: Praise be unto Thee, for Thou art, in truth, the Lord of earth and heaven.

input: انا الّذی اردت رضائک و اقبلت الی شطر افضالک.
output: I am the one who hath sought the good pleasure of Thy will, and directed his steps towards the seat of Thy gracious favors.

input: و قد جئتک منقطعاً عمّا سواک و لائذاً بحضرتک و مقبلاً الی حرم امرک و کعبة عزّک.
output: I am he who hath forsaken his all, who hath fled to Thee for shelter, who hath set his face towards the tabernacle of Thy revelation and the adored sanctuary of Thy glory.

input: ای ربّ اسألک بندائک الّذی به سرع الموحّدون الی ظلّ عنایتک الکبری و هرب المخلصون من انفسهم الی اسمک العلیّ الأبهی و به نزّلت آیاتک و حقّقت کلماتک و ظهر برهانک و اشرقت شمس جمالک و ثبتت حجّتک و لاح دلیلک بأن تجعلنی من الّذین هم شربوا خمر الحیوان من ایادی احسانک و انقطعوا عن الأکوان فی سبیلک و اخذهم سکر خمر معارفک علی شأن سرعوا الی مشهد الفدآء ناطقین بثنائک و ذاکرین بذکرک ثمّ انزل یا الهی علیّ ما یجعلنی مطهّراً عن غیرک ثمّ خلّصنی من اعدائک الّذین کفروا بک و بآیاتک.
output: I beseech Thee, O my Lord, by Thy call whereby they who recognized Thy unity have sought the shadow of Thy most gracious providence, and the sincere have fled far from themselves unto Thy name, the Most Exalted, the All Glorious, through which Thy verses were sent down, and Thy word fulfilled, and Thy proof manifested, and the sun of Thy beauty risen, and Thy testimony established, and Thy signs uncovered,—I beseech Thee to grant that I may be numbered with them that have quaffed the wine that is life indeed from the hands of Thy gracious providence, and have rid themselves, in Thy path, of all attachment to Thy creatures, and been so inebriated with Thy manifold wisdom that they hastened to the field of sacrifice with Thy praise on their lips and Thy remembrance in their hearts. Send down, also, upon me, O my God, that which will wash me from anything that is not of Thee, and deliver me from Thine enemies who have disbelieved in Thy signs.

input: تری و تعلم بأنّی ما دعوت عبادک الّا الی شطر مواهبک و ما امرتهم الّا ما امرت به فی محکم کتابک الّذی نزّل من قدرک المحتوم و قضائک المرقوم.
output: Thou seest and knowest that I have called upon Thy servants to turn nowhere except in the direction of Thy bestowals, and have bidden them observe naught save the things Thou didst prescribe in Thy Perspicuous Book, the Book which hath been sent down according to Thine inscrutable decree and irrevocable purpose.

input: فیا الهی لیس لی من ذکر الّا باذنک و لا لی من حرکة الّا بأمرک.
output: I can utter no word, O my God, unless I be permitted by Thee, and can move in no direction until I obtain Thy sanction.

input: فیا الهی انت اظهرتنی بقدرتک و اقمتنی لاظهار امرک.
output: It is Thou, O my God, Who hast called me into being through the power of Thy might, and hast endued me with Thy grace to manifest Thy Cause.

input: و بذلک ابتلیت علی شأن منعت لسانی عن ذکرک و ثنائک.
output: Wherefore I have been subjected to such adversities that my tongue hath been hindered from extolling Thee and from magnifying Thy glory.

input: لک الحمد یا الهی علی ما قدّرت لی بأمرک و سلطانک.
output: All praise be to Thee, O my God, for the things Thou didst ordain for me through Thy decree and by the power of Thy sovereignty.

input: اسألک بأن تثبّتنی و احبّائی علی حبّک و امرک.
output: I beseech Thee that Thou wilt fortify both myself and them that love me in our love for Thee, and wilt keep us firm in Thy Cause.

input: انّ الذّلّة فی احتجاب العبد عنک و العزّة فی عرفانه ایّاک
output: O my God. Thy servant's shame is to be shut out as by a veil from Thee, and his glory is to know Thee.

input: مع اسمک لا یضرّنی شیء و مع حبّک لا یجزعنی بلآء العالمین.
output: Armed with the power of Thy name nothing can ever hurt me, and with Thy love in my heart all the world's afflictions can in no wise alarm me.

input: ای ربّ فأنزل علیّ و علی احبّتی ما یحفظنا عن شرّ الّذین هم اعرضوا عنک و کفروا بآیاتک.
output: Send down, therefore, O my Lord, upon me and upon my loved ones that which will protect us from the mischief of those that have repudiated Thy truth and disbelieved in Thy signs.

input: قد قدّرت لعبادک المقرّبین فی رضوانک الأعلی مقامات لو یظهر مقام منها لینصعق من فی السّموات و الأرض.
output: Thou hast, in Thine all highest Paradise, assigned unto Thy servants such stations that if any one of them were to be unveiled to men's eyes all who are in heaven and all who are on earth would be dumbfounded.

input: لو یرونه الملوک لینقطعنّ عن ممالکهم و یتوجّهنّ الی المملوک الّذی استظلّ فی جوار رحمتک الکبری فی ظلّ اسمک الأبهی.
output: Were kings to witness so great a glory they would, assuredly, rid themselves of their dominions and cleave to such of their subjects as have entered beneath the shadow of Thine immeasurable mercy and sought the shelter of Thine all glorious name.

input: اسألک یا محبوب العالمین و مقصود العارفین باسمک الّذی به تقلّب من تشآء و تقرّب من تشآء بأن تفتح ابصار احبّتک لئلّا یحتجبوا کما احتجب من فی البلاد و یروا آثار قدرتک ظاهراً و ما قدّرت لهم فی ممالک عزّک باطنا.ً
output: I implore Thee, O Thou Who art the Beloved of the worlds and the Desire of all that have recognized Thee, by Thy name, through which Thou stirrest up whom Thou willest and drawest toward Thee whom Thou pleasest, to open the eyes of all that are dear to Thee, that haply they may not be veiled from Thee as the peoples of the earth are, but may outwardly perceive the signs and tokens of Thy power, and inwardly apprehend the things Thou didst ordain for them in the realms of Thy glory.

input: و انّک انت المحبوب فی الآخرة و الأولی
output: Thou art the one alone Beloved in both this world and in the next.

input: لا اله الّا انت العلیّ الأبهی.
output: No God is there but Thee, the Most Exalted, the All Glorious.

input: کلّما ارید ان اذکرک تمنعنی خطیئاتی الکبری و جریراتی العظمی و بها اجد نفسی محرومة عنک و ممنوعة عن ذکرک.
output: Every time I venture to make mention of Thee, I am held back by my mighty sins and grievous trespasses against Thee, and find myself wholly deprived of Thy grace, and utterly powerless to celebrate Thy praise.

input: ولکن ایقانی بکرمک یشجّعنی و اطمینانی بجودک یطمعنی بأن اذکرک و اطلب منک ما عندک.
output: My great confidence in Thy bounty, however, reviveth my hope in Thee, and my certitude that Thou wilt bountifully deal with me emboldeneth me to extol Thee, and to ask of Thee the things Thou dost possess.

input: اسألک یا الهی برحمتک الّتی سبقت الأشیآء و یشهد بها من فی لجج الأسمآء بأن لا تدعنی بنفسی لأنّها امّارة بالسّوء.
output: I implore Thee, O my God, by Thy mercy that hath surpassed all created things, and to which all that are immersed beneath the oceans of Thy names bear witness, not to abandon me unto my self, for my heart is prone to evil.

input: فاحفظنی فی حصن عصمتک و کنف حمایتک.
output: Guard me, then, within the stronghold of Thy protection and the shelter of Thy care.

input: انا الّذی یا الهی ما ارید الّا ما انت قضیته بقدرتک.
output: I am he, O my God, whose only wish is what Thou hast determined by the power of Thy might.

input: و هذا ما اخترته لنفسی ان یؤیّدنی حسن قضائک و تقدیرک و یسعدنی شؤونات امضائک و اذنک.
output: All I have chosen for myself is to be assisted by Thy gracious appointments and the ruling of Thy will, and to be aided with the tokens of Thy decree and judgment.

input: اسألک یا حبیب قلوب المشتاقین بمظاهر امرک و مهابط وحیک و مطالع عزّک و مخازن علمک بأن لا تجعلنی محروماً عن بیتک الحرام و المشعر و المقام.
output: I beseech Thee, O Thou Who art the Beloved of the hearts which long for Thee, by the Manifestations of Thy Cause and the Daysprings of Thine inspiration, and the Exponents of Thy majesty, and the Treasuries of Thy knowledge, not to suffer me to be deprived of Thy holy Habitation, Thy Fane and Thy Tabernacle.

input: ای ربّ وفّقنی علی الورود فی ساحة قدسه و الطّواف فی حوله و القیام تلقآء بابه.
output: Aid me, O my Lord, to attain His hallowed court, and to circle round His person, and to stand humbly at His door.

input: انّک انت الّذی لم تزل کنت مقتدراً و لا تزال تکون مهیمناً.
output: Thou art He Whose power is from everlasting to everlasting.

input: لا یعزب عن علمک من شیء.
output: Nothing escapeth Thy knowledge.

input: و انّک انت المقتدر العزیز العلیم.
output: Thou art, verily, the God of power, the God of glory and wisdom.

input: یا من کلّ شیء مضطرب من خشیتک و کلّ الوجوه ساجدة عند ظهورات انوار وجهک و کلّ الأعناق خاضعة لسلطنتک و کلّ القلوب منقادة لحکومتک و کلّ الأرکان مضطربة من سطوتک و کلّ الأریاح مسخّرات بأمرک.
output: Thou the dread of Whom hath fallen upon all things, before the splendors of Whose face the countenances of all men are downcast, at the revelations of Whose sovereignty all necks have humbly bowed, to the ruling of Whose will all hearts have been subdued, the awfulness of Whose majesty hath caused the foundations of all things to tremble, and to the power of Whose authority the winds have been subjected.

input: اسألک بنفاذ امرک و اقتدارک و اعلآء کلمتک و سلطانک بأن تجعلنا من الّذین ما منعتهم الدّنیا عن التّوجّه الیک.
