output: I beseech Thee by the compelling force of Thy Revelation, and by the power of Thy might, and by the exaltation of Thy word, and by the sublimity of Thy sovereignty, to number us with them whom the world hath been powerless to hinder from turning towards Thee.

input: ای ربّ فاجعلنی من الّذین جاهدوا فی سبیلک بأموالهم و انفسهم.
output: Cause me, O my Lord, to be of those who, with their substance and their own selves, have fought valiantly in Thy path.

input: ثمّ اکتب لی اجر هؤلآء فی لوح قضائک.
output: Write down, then, for me the recompense Thou didst ordain for them in the Tablet of Thy decree.

input: ثمّ اجعل لی مقعد صدق عندک ثمّ الحقنی بعبادک المخلصین.
output: Stablish me also on the seat of truth in Thy presence, and join me with the sincere among Thy servants.

input: ای ربّ اسألک برسلک و اصفیائک و بالّذی ختمت به مظاهر امرک بین بریّتک و زیّنته بخاتم القبول بین اهل ارضک و سمائک بأن توفّقنی علی ما قدّرته لعبادک و امرتهم به فی الواحک.
output: I implore Thee, O my Lord, by Thy Messengers, and Thy Chosen Ones, and by Him through Whom Thou hast affixed Thy seal upon the Manifestations of Thy Cause among Thy creatures, and Whom Thou hast adorned with the ornament of Thine acceptance among all that dwell in Thy heaven and on Thy earth, to graciously assist me to attain unto what Thou hast ordained for Thy servants and bidden them observe in Thy Tablets.

input: ثمّ اغفر لی یا الهی بفضلک و جودک ثمّ اجعلنی من الّذین لا خوف علیهم و لا هم یحزنون.
output: Wash away, then, my sins, O my God, by Thy grace and bounty, and reckon me among such as are not overtaken by fear nor put to grief.

input: و انّک انت المقتدر المهیمن القیّوم.
output: Thou art, verily, the Almighty, the Help in Peril, the Self Subsisting.

input: انت الّذی من نار حبّک اشتعل افئدة الموحّدین و بأنوار وجهک استضآءت وجوه المقرّبین.
output: Thou art He the fire of Whose love hath set ablaze the hearts of them who have recognized Thy unity, and the splendors of Whose countenance have illuminated the faces of such as have drawn nigh unto Thy court.

input: فما اعظم یا الهی کوثر عرفانک.
output: How plenteous, O my God, is the stream of Thy knowledge.

input: و ما احلی یا محبوبی سهام الأشقیآء فی حبّک و رضائک.
output: How sweet, O my Beloved, is the injury which, in my love for Thee, and for the sake of Thy pleasure, I suffer from the darts of the wicked doers.

input: فما الذّ سیف المشرکین فی سبیلک و اظهار امرک.
output: How pleasing are the wounds which, in Thy path and in order to proclaim Thy Faith, I sustain from the swords of the infidels.

input: اسألک باسمک الّذی به تبدّل الاضطراب بالاطمینان و الخوف بالأمان و الضّعف بالقدرة و الذّلّة بالعزّة بأن تؤیّدنی و عبادک علی اعلآء ذکرک و ابلاغ کلمتک و اظهار امرک بحیث لا یمنعنا یا محبوبی سطوة الظّالمین و غضب المشرکین.
output: I beseech Thee, by Thy name through which Thou turnest restlessness into tranquility, fear into confidence, weakness into strength, and abasement into glory, that Thou of Thy grace wilt aid me and Thy servants to exalt Thy name, to deliver Thy Message, and to proclaim Thy Cause, in such wise that we may remain unmoved by either the assaults of the transgressors or the wrath of the infidels, O Thou Who art my Well Beloved.

input: ای ربّ انا امتک الّتی سمعت ندائک و سرعت الیک هاربة من نفسی و مقبلة الیک.
output: I am, O my Lord, Thy handmaiden, who hath hearkened to Thy call, and hastened unto Thee, fleeing from herself and resting her heart upon Thee.

input: ای ربّ اسألک باسمک الّذی منه ظهرت کنوز الأرض کلّها بأن تحفظنی من اشارات الّذین هم کفروا بنفسک و اعرضوا عنک.
output: I implore Thee, O my Lord, by Thy name out of which all the treasures of the earth were brought forth, to shield me from the hints of such as have disbelieved in Thee and repudiated Thy truth.

input: لم ادر ایّ نار اشتعلت فی صدری.
output: How mysterious the Fire which Thou hast enkindled within my heart.

input: بحیث یسمع من کلّ ارکانی زفیرها و یشهد لهیبها.
output: My very limbs testify to the intensity of its heat, and evince the consuming power of its flame.

input: لو یذکرک لسانی بأنّک انت کنت قادراً فوق کلّ ذی قدرة یخاطبنی لسان قلبی هذه کلمة ترجع الی شکلها و مثلها و انّه لهو المقدّس عن ذکر العالمین.
output: Should my bodily tongue ever attempt to describe Thee as the One Whose strength hath ever excelled the strength of the most mighty amongst men, the tongue of my heart would address me, saying: These are but words which can only be adequate to such things as are of the same likeness and nature as themselves. But He, of a truth, is infinitely exalted above the mention of all His creatures.

input: اجد فی کلّ ارکانی لساناً و یکون ناطقاً بذکرک و ثنائک.
output: Every limb of my body, methinks, is endowed with a tongue that glorifieth Thee and magnifieth Thy name.

input: بحبّک لا یجزعنی بغض اعدائک و بذکرک لا یحزننی شؤونات قضائک.
output: Armed with the power of Thy love, the hatred which moveth them that are against Thee can never alarm me.

input: فأثبت فی قلبی حبّک ثمّ دعنی لیرد علیّ سیوف من علی الأرض کلّها.
output: and with Thy praise on my lips, the rulings of Thy decree can in no wise fill me with sorrow. Fortify, therefore, Thy love within my breast, and suffer me to face the assaults which all the peoples of the earth may launch against me.

input: کلّ شعر من اشعاری یقول لو لا البلایا فی سبیلک ما لذّ لی حبّک و عشقک.
output: Every hair of my head proclaimeth: But for the adversities that befall me in Thy path, how could I ever taste the divine sweetness of Thy tenderness and love

input: ای ربّ فأنزل علیّ و علی احبّتی ما یستقیمهم علی امرک.
output: Send down, therefore, O my Lord, upon me and upon them that love me, that which will cause us to become steadfast in Thy Faith.

input: ثمّ اجعلهم ایادی امرک بین عبادک لینتشر منهم آثارک و یظهر سلطانک.
output: Enable them, then, to become the Hands of Thy Cause amongst Thy servants, that they may scatter abroad Thy signs, and show forth Thy sovereignty.

input: لا اله الّا انت المقتدر علی ما ترید.
output: There is no God but Thee, Who art powerful to do whatsoever Thou willest.

input: و انّک انت العزیز الحمید.
output: Thou art, in truth, the All Glorious, the All Praised.

input: انّی عبد من عبادک آمنت بک و آیاتک.
output: I am one of Thy servants, who hath believed on Thee and on Thy signs.

input: و ترانی یا الهی مقبلاً الی باب رحمتک و شطر عنایتک.
output: Thou seest how I have set myself towards the door of Thy mercy, and turned my face in the direction of Thy loving kindness.

input: اسألک بأسمائک الحسنی و صفاتک العلیا بأن تفتح علی وجهی ابواب الخیرات.
output: I beseech Thee, by Thy most excellent titles and Thy most exalted attributes, to open to my face the portals of Thy bestowals.

input: ثمّ وفّقنی علی الحسنات یا مالک الأسمآء و الصّفات.
output: Aid me, then, to do that which is good, O Thou Who art the Possessor of all names and attributes.

input: ای ربّ انا الفقیر و انت الغنیّ قد توجّهت الیک منقطعاً عمّا سواک.
output: I am poor, O my Lord, and Thou art the Rich. I have set my face towards Thee, and detached myself from all but Thee.

input: اسألک بأن لا تحرمنی من نفحات رحمة رحمانیّتک و لا تمنعنی عمّا قدّرته لخیرة عبادک.
output: Deprive me not, I implore Thee, of the breezes of Thy tender mercy, and withhold not from me what Thou didst ordain for the chosen among Thy servants.

input: ای ربّ فاکشف غطآء عینی لأری ما اردته لبریّتک و اشاهد آثار قدرتک فی مظاهر صنعک.
output: Remove the veil from mine eyes, O my Lord, that I may recognize what Thou hast desired for Thy creatures, and discover, in all the manifestations of Thy handiwork, the revelations of Thine almighty power.

input: ای ربّ فاجذبنی بآیاتک الکبری ثمّ انقذنی من غمرات النّفس و الهوی.
output: Enrapture my soul, O my Lord, with Thy most mighty signs, and draw me out of the depths of my corrupt and evil desires.

input: ثمّ اکتب لی خیر الدّنیا و الآخرة.
output: Write down, then, for me the good of this world and of the world to come.

input: ای ربّ لک الحمد بما ایقظتنی عن النّوم بحیث انتبهت و اردت ان اعرف ما غفل عنه اکثر عبادک.
output: I yield Thee thanks, O my Lord, that Thou hast wakened me from my sleep, and stirred me up, and created in me the desire to perceive what most of Thy servants have failed to apprehend.

input: ای ربّ فاجعلنی مستقیماً علی ما اردته فی حبّک و رضائک.
output: Make me able, therefore, O my Lord, to behold, for love of Thee and for the sake of Thy pleasure, whatsoever Thou hast desired.

input: انّک انت الّذی یشهد کلّ شیء بقدرتک و سلطانک.
output: Thou art He to the power of Whose might and sovereignty all things testify.

input: لا اله الّا انت المتعالی العزیز المنّان.
output: There is none other God but Thee, the Almighty, the Beneficent.

input: تری عبادک الأخیار تحت ایادی الأشرار الّذین کفروا باسمک المختار و انکروا عظمتک و اختیارک و قدرتک و اقتدارک.
output: Thou seest how Thy righteous servants have fallen into the hands of the wicked doers, who have disbelieved in Thy name, the Unconstrained, and denied Thy majesty, and Thine unrestrained authority, and Thy strength, and Thy sovereign might.

input: و یقولون ما قاله الیهود من قبل.
output: Their mouths utter what the mouths of the Jews uttered aforetime.

input: ای ربّ فأخرج ید قدرتک من ردآء عظمتک ثمّ انصر بها احبّتک الّذین ما منعوا عن افق وحیک بعد الّذی ورد علیهم فی سبیلک ما ناح به سکّان ملکوت امرک.
output: Put forth, therefore, out of the bosom of Thy glory, O my Lord, the hand of Thine omnipotence, and through it assist Thou Thy loved ones who, though sore tried in Thy path with such trials as have caused the inmates of the kingdom of Thy Cause to groan, were not deterred from turning towards the horizon of Thy Revelation.

input: ای ربّ فاختم قلوبهم بخاتم عصمتک لئلّا یدخل فیها ذکر غیرک.
output: Set, then, the seal of Thine unerring protection on their hearts, O my Lord, lest perchance the remembrance of aught else except Thee enter therein.

input: ثمّ اجعلهم منادیاً باسمک بین خلقک ثمّ ارزقهم خیر ما قدّرته للمقرّبین من اصفیائک.
output: Make them able, moreover, to proclaim Thy name amidst Thy creatures, and supply them with the best of what Thou hast destined for such of Thy chosen ones as enjoy near access to Thee.

input: و انّک انت العزیز المستعان.
output: Thou truly art the All Glorious, to whom all cry for help.

input: تری کیف احاطت البلایا عبادک فی کلّ الأطراف و کلّ قاموا علیهم بالاعتساف.
output: Thou seest how Thy servants have everywhere been compassed with tribulations, how their adversaries have all risen up against them and grievously wronged them.

input: لو یجتمع علینا اشقیآء الأرض کلّهم و یحرقوننا بأشدّ ما یمکن فی الابداع لا یحوّل ابصارنا عن النّظر الی افق اسمک العلیّ الأعلی و لا یقلّب قلوبنا عن التّوجّه الی منظرک الأبهی.
output: Were all the wicked doers of the earth to band themselves against us, and to cast us into a fire such as no man hath kindled, they would be powerless to distract our gaze from the horizon of Thy name, the Most Exalted, the Most High, and would fail to turn aside our hearts from the seat of Thine effulgent glory.

input: انّ السّهام فی سبیلک دیباج لهیکلنا و الرّماح فی حبّک حریر لأبداننا.
output: The arrows that transfix us in Thy path are the ornaments of our temples, and the spears which pierce us in our love for Thee are as silk unto our bodies.

input: لا ینبغی لأحبّائک الّا ما سطر من قلم تقدیرک فی هذا اللّوح العزیز العظیم.
output: Nothing whatsoever can beseem Thy servants except what the pen of Thine irrevocable decree hath traced in this priceless and exalted Tablet.

input: و الحمد لنفسک فی کلّ الأحوال.
output: All praise be to Thy Self at all times and under all conditions.

input: تری بهائک فی حصن العکّا مسجوناً و مظلوماً بما اکتسبت ایدی الأشقیآء الّذین منعهم الهوی عن التّوجّه الیک یا مالک الأسمآء.
output: Thou seest how He Who is Thy Light hath been shut up in the fortress town of 'Akká, and been sore oppressed by reason of what the hands of the wicked doers have wrought, whose corrupt desires have kept them back from turning towards Thee, O Thou Who art the King of all names.

input: لا یمنعنی البلآء عن ذکرک و ثنائک.
output: Tribulations, however woeful, can never hinder me from remembering Thee or from celebrating Thy praise.

input: انّ البلیّة فی حبّک رحمتک علی خلقک و الرّزیّة فی سبیلک نعمتک لأصفیائک.
output: Every vexation borne for love of Thee is a token of Thy mercy unto Thy creatures, and every ordeal suffered in Thy path is but a gift from Thee bestowed on Thy chosen ones.

input: اشهد بأنّ بالبلآء اضآء وجه البهآء عن مشرق البقآء و به زیّن هیکله بین الأرض و السّمآء.
output: I testify that my countenance, which shineth above the Dayspring of eternity, hath been irradiated by adversity, and my body hath been adorned by it before all who are in heaven and all who are on earth.

input: ای ربّ اسألک باسمک الأعظم ان تؤیّد الّذین آمنوا بک و بآیاتک علی الاستقامة علی حبّک و التّوجّه الی مطلع شمس عنایتک.
output: I pray Thee, by Thy Most Great Name, to aid all them that have believed on Thee and on Thy signs to be steadfast in Thy love and to set themselves towards the Dawning Place of the Daystar of Thy loving kindness.

input: فألهمهم یا الهی بما ینطقهم بذکرک و یقرّبهم الیک فی الدّنیا و الآخرة.
output: Inspire them, then, O my God, with what will unloose their tongue to praise Thee, and will draw them nigh unto Thee in the life that now is and the life that is to come.

input: انّک انت المقتدر العزیز المنّان.
output: Thou truly art the Almighty, the All Glorious, the Beneficent.

input: سبحانک اللّهمّ یا الهی
output: Glorified be Thy name, O Lord my God.

input: اسألک بقدرتک الّتی احاطت الممکنات و بسلطانک الّذی استعلی علی الموجودات و بکلمتک الّتی کانت مکنونة فی علمک و بها خلقت سمائک و ارضک ان تجعلنا مستقیمین علی حبّک و رضائک و ناظرین الی وجهک و ناطقین بثنآء نفسک.
output: I beseech Thee by Thy power that hath encompassed all created things, and by Thy sovereignty that hath transcended the entire creation, and by Thy Word which was hidden in Thy wisdom and whereby Thou didst create Thy heaven and Thy earth, both to enable us to be steadfast in our love for Thee and in our obedience to Thy pleasure, and to fix our gaze upon Thy face, and celebrate Thy glory.

input: ثمّ اجعلنا یا الهی ناشری آثارک بین بریّتک و حافظی دینک فی مملکتک.
output: Empower us, then, O my God, to spread abroad Thy signs among Thy creatures, and to guard Thy Faith in Thy realm.

input: و انّک انت کنت من دون ذکر شیء و تکون بمثل ما کنت فی ازل الآزال.
output: Thou hast ever existed independently of the mention of any of Thy creatures, and wilt remain as Thou hast been for ever and ever.

input: علیک توکّلت و الیک توجّهت و بحبل عطوفتک تمسّکت و الی ظلّ رحمتک سرعت.
output: In Thee I have placed my whole confidence, unto Thee I have turned my face, to the cord of Thy loving providence I have clung, and towards the shadow of Thy mercy I have hastened.

input: لا تطردنی یا الهی عن بابک خائباً و لا تمنعنی عن فضلک لأنّی کنت راجیاً.
output: Cast me not as one disappointed out of Thy door, O my God, and withhold not from me Thy grace, for Thee alone do I seek.

input: و الحمد لک یا محبوب العارفین.
output: Praise be to Thee, O Thou Who art the Beloved of them that have known Thee.

input: یا من بلائک دوآء المقرّبین و سیفک رجآء العاشقین و سهمک محبوب المشتاقین و قضائک امل العارفین.
output: Thou Whose tests are a healing medicine to such as are nigh unto Thee, Whose sword is the ardent desire of all them that love Thee, Whose dart is the dearest wish of those hearts that yearn after Thee, Whose decree is the sole hope of them that have recognized Thy truth.

input: اسألک بمحبوبیّة نفسک و بأنوار وجهک بأن تنزل علینا عن شطر احدیّتک ما یقرّبنا الی نفسک.
output: I implore Thee, by Thy divine sweetness and by the splendors of the glory of Thy face, to send down upon us from Thy retreats on high that which will enable us to draw nigh unto Thee.

input: ثمّ استقم یا الهی ارجلنا علی امرک و نوّر قلوبنا بأنوار معرفتک و صدورنا بتجلّیات اسمائک.
output: Set, then, our feet firm, O my God, in Thy Cause, and enlighten our hearts with the effulgence of Thy knowledge, and illumine our breasts with the brightness of Thy names.

input: ای ربّ انا الّذی وجّهت وجهی الیک و اکون آملاً بدایع فضلک و ظهورات کرمک.
output: I am he, O my Lord, that hath set his face towards Thee, and fixed his hope on the wonders of Thy grace and the revelations of Thy bounty.

input: اسألک بأن لا تخیّبنی عن باب رحمتک و لا تدعنی بین المشرکین من خلقک.
output: I pray Thee that Thou wilt not suffer me to turn away disappointed from the door of Thy mercy, nor abandon me to such of Thy creatures as have repudiated Thy Cause.

input: فیا الهی انا عبدک و ابن عبدک.
output: I am, O my God, Thy servant and the son of Thy servant.

input: اعترفت بک فی ایّامک و اقبلت الی شاطئ توحیدک معترفاً بفردانیّتک و مذعناً بوحدانیّتک و آملاً عفوک و غفرانک.
output: I have recognized Thy truth in Thy days, and have directed my steps towards the shores of Thy oneness, confessing Thy singleness, acknowledging Thy unity, and hoping for Thy forgiveness and pardon.

input: و انّک انت المقتدر علی ما تشآء لا اله الّا انت العزیز الغفور.
output: Powerful art Thou to do what Thou willest. no God is there beside Thee, the All Glorious, the Ever Forgiving.

input: اشهد انّک انت اللّه لا اله الّا انت.
output: I testify that Thou art God, and that there is none other God besides Thee.

input: لم تزل کنت مقدّساً عن ذکر غیرک و متعالیاً عن وصف خلقک.
output: Thou hast from eternity been immeasurably exalted above the praise of any one except Thee, and far above the description of any of Thy creatures.

input: قد اعترف کلّ شیء بوحدانیّتک و اقرّ من فی الملک بفردانیّتک.
output: All created things have borne witness to Thy unity, and every dweller in Thy kingdom hath confessed Thy oneness.

input: لم یصعد الیک حقایق العرفان من اولی الایقان من خلقک و لا یتعارج الی هوآء قدسک جواهر الذّکر و التّبیان من بریّتک
output: The essence of the apprehension of the assured among Thy creatures can never attain unto Thee, and the gem like utterances with which Thy people have praised and glorified Thee can never hope to ascend unto the atmosphere of Thy holiness.

input: لأنّ العرفان کان وصف خلقک کیف یصل الیک.
output: For men's apprehension of Thee is but the apprehension of Thine own creation. how can it reach up to Thee

input: و الذّکر و التّبیان ینسب الی عبادک کیف یلیق لساحة احدیّتک.
output: And all human praise and glorification of Thee pertain unto Thy servants. how can they be deemed worthy of the court of Thy oneness

input: عجزت کینونة العرفان عن عرفان نفسک و قصرت ذاتیّة الأذکار عن بساط عزّک و جبّاریّتک.
output: The quintessence of knowledge is powerless to comprehend Thy nature, and the inmost reality of every praise of Thee falleth short of the seat of Thy great glory and of Thine all compelling power.

input: کلّ ما یذکر بالبیان او یدرک بالعرفان انّه وصف خلقک و کان مخلوقاً بمشیّتک و مجعولاً بارادتک.
output: Every utterance that seeketh to describe Thee, and every knowledge that attempteth to comprehend Thee, is but an expression of Thine own creating, and is begotten by Thy will, and fashioned in conformity with Thy purpose.

input: اسألک یا من لا تعرف بغیرک و لا تدرک بسواک بمظلومیّة مطلع امرک بین اراذل خلقک و بما ورد علیه فی سبیلک بأن تجعلنی فی کلّ الأحوال راضیاً برضائک و ناظراً الی افق مشیّتک و مستقیماً علی محبّتک.
output: I implore Thee, O Thou Who art inscrutable to all except Thee, and can be comprehended through naught else save Thyself, by the wrongs which He Who is the Dayspring of Thy Cause hath suffered at the hands of the ignoble among Thy creatures, and by what hath befallen Him in Thy path, to grant that I may, at all times, be wholly dissolved in Thee, and fix my gaze upon the horizon of Thy will and be steadfast in Thy love.

input: ای ربّ قد توجّهت الیک کما امرتنی فی کتابک و اقبلت الی افق عنایتک بما اذنت لی فی الواحک.
output: I have, O my Lord, turned unto Thee according to what Thou hast commanded me in Thy Book, and have set my face towards the horizon of Thy loving kindness even as Thou hast permitted me in Thy Tablets.

input: اسألک بأن لا تطردنی عن باب فضلک و تکتب لی اجر من فاز بلقائک و قام علی خدمتک و اخذته رشحات بحر الطافک فی ایّامک و اشراقات شمس مواهبک عند ظهور انوار وجهک.
output: Cast me not out of the door of Thy grace, I beseech Thee, and write down for me the recompense destined for him who hath entered Thy presence, and hath risen to serve Thee, and hath been carried away by the drops sprinkled upon him from the Ocean of Thy favors in Thy days, and by the splendors of the Daystar of Thy gifts that have been shed upon him at the revelation of the light of Thy countenance.

input: انا عبدک الّذی تمسّکت بحبل الطافک و تشبّثت بذیل افضالک.
output: I am Thy servant who hath laid hold on the cord of Thy tender mercies, and clung to the hem of Thy bounteousness.

input: اسألک باسمک الّذی سخّرت به الوجود من الغیب و الشّهود و به مرّت نفحة الحیوان علی من فی الامکان بأن تجعلنی قویّاً بقوّتک الّتی احاطت الأرض و السّمآء و تحفظنی عن کلّ سقم و بلآء.
output: I entreat Thee by Thy name whereby Thou hast subjected all created things, both visible and invisible, and through which the breath that is life indeed was wafted over the entire creation, to strengthen me by Thy power which hath encompassed the heavens and the earth, and to guard me from all sickness and tribulation.

input: اشهد انّک انت مالک الأسمآء و الحاکم علی ما تشآء.
output: I bear witness that Thou art the Lord of all names, and the Ordainer of all that may please Thee.

input: ای ربّ قدّر لی ما ینفعنی فی کلّ عالم من عوالمک.
output: Do Thou ordain for me, O my Lord, what will profit me in every world of Thy worlds.

input: ثمّ ارزقنی ما کتبته لأصفیآء خلقک الّذین ما منعتهم فی اللّه لومة لائم و لا شماتة مشرک و لا اعراض معرض.
output: Supply me, then, with what Thou hast written down for the chosen ones among Thy creatures, whom neither the blame of the blamer, nor the clamor of the infidel, nor the estrangement of such as have withdrawn from Thee, hath deterred from turning towards Thee.

input: انّک انت المهیمن بسلطانک.
output: Thou, truly, art the Help in Peril through the power of Thy sovereignty.

input: لک الحمد بما عرّفتنی مطلع رحمتک و مشرق فضلک و مصدر امرک.
output: I yield Thee thanks that Thou hast made known unto me Him Who is the Dayspring of Thy mercy, and the Dawning Place of Thy grace, and the Repository of Thy Cause.

input: اسألک باسمک الّذی به ابیضّت وجوه المقرّبین و طارت افئدة المخلصین بأن تجعلنی فی کلّ الأحوال متمسّکاً بحبلک و منقطعاً عن دونک و ناظراً الی افق وحیک و عاملاً بما امرتنی به فی الواحک.
output: I beseech Thee by Thy Name, through which the faces of them that are nigh unto Thee have turned white, and the hearts of such as are devoted to Thee have winged their flight towards Thee, to grant that I may, at all times and under all conditions, lay hold on Thy cord, and be rid of all attachment to anyone except Thee, and may keep mine eyes directed towards the horizon of Thy Revelation, and may carry out what Thou hast prescribed unto me in Thy Tablets.

input: ای ربّ زیّن ظاهری و باطنی بردآء الطافک و عنایتک.
output: Attire, O my Lord, both my inner and outer being with the raiment of Thy favors and Thy loving kindness.

input: ثمّ احفظنی عمّا لا یحبّه رضائک و ایّدنی و اهلی علی طاعتک و التّجنّب عمّا تشتهی به النّفس و الهوی.
output: Keep me safe, then, from whatsoever may be abhorrent unto Thee, and graciously assist me and my kindred to obey Thee, and to shun whatsoever may stir up any evil or corrupt desire within me.

input: انّک انت مولی الوری و مالک الآخرة و الأولی.
output: Thou, truly, art the Lord of all mankind, and the Possessor of this world and of the next.

input: اللّهمّ یا اله الأسمآء و فاطر السّمآء.
output: God, and the God of all Names, and Maker of the heavens.

input: اسألک باسمک الّذی به ظهر مطلع قوّتک و مشرق اقتدارک و جری کلّ جسم و حیّ کلّ جسد و ثبت کلّ روح بأن تجعلنی منقطعاً الیک و خادماً لأمرک و مریداً ما اردته بسلطانک و عاملاً ما یحبّه رضائک.
output: I entreat Thee by Thy Name through which He Who is the Dayspring of Thy might and the Dawning Place of Thy power hath been manifested, through which every solid thing hath been made to flow, and every dead corpse hath been quickened, and every moving spirit confirmed—I entreat Thee to enable me to rid myself of all attachment to any one but Thee, and to serve Thy Cause, and to wish what Thou didst wish through the power of Thy sovereignty, and to perform what is the good pleasure of Thy will.

input: ثمّ اسألک یا الهی بأن تقدّر لی ما یجعلنی غنیّاً عن دونک.
output: I beseech Thee, moreover, O my God, to ordain for me what will make me rich enough to dispense with any one save Thee.

input: یا الهی ترانی متوجّهاً الیک و متمسّکاً بحبل افضالک.
output: Thou seest me, O my God, with my face turned towards Thee, and my hands clinging to the cord of Thy grace.

input: انزل علیّ رحمة من عندک ثمّ اکتب لی ما کتبته لأصفیائک.
output: Send down upon me Thy mercy, and write down for me what Thou hast written down for Thy chosen ones.

input: سبحانک یا من سخّرت ملأ الانشآء من حرکة قلمک الأعلی و اظهرت لآلئ بحر العرفان اذ نطق لسانک بین الأرض و السّمآء.
output: Glory be to Thee, O Thou Who hast, through the movement of Thy most august pen, subdued the concourse of Thy creation, and manifested the pearls of the ocean of Thy wisdom through the words which Thy tongue hath spoken before all who are in heaven and on earth.

input: اشهد انّ قدرتک احاطت الکائنات و رحمتک سبقت الممکنات.
output: I testify that Thy might hath encompassed the whole universe, and Thy mercy surpassed all created things.

input: ما عجّزک سطوة اهل العالم و ما منعک ضوضآء الأمم.
output: The powers of the earth have never prevailed against Thee, nor hath the tumult of the nations frustrated Thy purpose.

input: اظهرت فی الملک ما اردته بسلطانک و حکمت بما تعلّق به مشیّتک.
output: Thou hast revealed in Thy realm whatsoever Thou hadst desired through the power of Thy sovereignty, and hast ordained all things according to the good pleasure of Thy will.

input: انّک کنت لم تزل فی علوّ القدرة و الاستقلال و لا تزال فی سموّ العظمة و الاجلال.
output: From eternity Thou hast inhabited the loftiest heights of Thy dominion and of Thine unfettered sovereignty, and wilt unto eternity continue to abide in the inaccessible retreats of Thy majesty and glory.

input: اسألک باسمک الّذی به تضوّعت نفحات قمیص وصلک و مرّت علی هیاکل الوجود اریاح جودک و فضلک بأن تجعلنی فی کلّ الأحوال مؤیّداً لخدمة امرک و موفّقاً علی ذکرک و ثنائک.
output: I implore Thee, by Thy Name through which the fragrance of the raiment of Thy presence was wafted, and the gentle winds of Thy bountiful grace passed over all created things, to graciously assist me, at all times and under all conditions, to serve Thy Cause, and to enable me to remember Thee and to extol Thy virtues.

input: ثمّ احفظنی یا الهی بذراعی قدرتک و قدّر لی ما ینبغی لجودک فی کلّ عالم من عوالمک.
output: Let, then, Thine almighty arms enfold me, O my God, and ordain for me what beseemeth Thy bounty in every world of Thy worlds.

input: ای ربّ ترانی مقبلاً الی بحر فضلک و کعبة عطائک .
output: Thou beholdest, O my Lord, how I have set myself towards the ocean of Thy grace and the adored sanctuary of Thy favors.

input: اسألک بأن لا تجعلنی محروماً عن ترشّحات بحر جودک و لا ممنوعاً عن امطار سحاب مرحمتک.
output: Deny me not, I pray Thee, the drops which are sprinkled from the ocean of Thy gifts. neither do Thou withhold from me the outpourings of the clouds of Thy tender mercies.

input: انا الّذی یا الهی تشبّثت بذیلک المنیر و تمسّکت بحبلک المحکم المتین.
output: I am he, O my God, that hath clung to the resplendent hem of Thy robe, and taken hold on Thy strong cord that none can sever.

input: اشهد انّک خلقتنی و رزقتنی و ربّیتنی و اطعمتنی و اغذیتنی لعرفان مطلع آیاتک و مظهر بیّناتک.
output: I testify that Thou hast created me, and nourished me, and brought me up, and fed me, and sustained me, that I may recognize Him Who is the Dayspring of Thy signs, and the Revealer of Thy clear tokens.

input: فأحمدک اللّهمّ یا الهی بما جعلتنی فائزاً بهذا المقام الأعلی و هذه الرّتبة العلیا انّک انت المعطی المقتدر الباذل الغفور الکریم.
output: I offer unto Thee, therefore, most high praise, O Lord my God, that Thou hast suffered me to attain unto this most sublime station and this most august seat. Thou, truly, art the Great Giver, the Almighty, the All Bountiful, the Ever Forgiving, the Most Generous.

input: ای ربّ نوّر بصری بأنوار افق ظهورک و قلبی بتشعشعات شمس علمک و حکمتک لأکون بکلّی متوجّهاً الی وجهک و منقطعاً عن دونک بحیث لا تمنعنی الشّؤونات عن عرفان مظهر نفسک و مطلع آیاتک و مشرق وحیک و مصدر امرک.
output: Illumine mine eyes, O my Lord, with the splendors of the horizon of Thy Revelation, and brighten my heart with the effulgence of the Daystar of Thy knowledge and wisdom, that I may set myself wholly towards Thy face, and be rid of all attachment to any one except Thee, in such wise that the changes and chances of the world will be powerless to hinder me from recognizing Him Who is the Manifestation of Thine own Self, and the Revealer of Thy signs, and the Dayspring of Thy Revelation, and the Repository of Thy Cause.

input: انّک انت المقتدر المهیمن المتعالی العزیز الحکیم.
output: Thou art, verily, the Almighty, the Protector, the All Glorious, the All Wise.

input: قد اعترف عبدک هذا بأنّک لا توصف بسواک و لا تذکر بدونک.
output: This servant of Thine testifieth that naught else except Thee can ever express Thee, nor canst Thou be described by any one save Thyself.

input: کلّما یتعارج اهل الحقیقة الی سمآء ذکرک لا یصلنّ الّا الی مقام الّذی خلق فی افئدتهم بأمرک و تقدیرک.
output: The thoughts of them that have recognized Thy reality, however much they may ascend towards the heaven of Thy praise, can never hope to pass beyond the bounds which, by Thy behest and decree, have been fixed within their own hearts.

input: کیف یقدر العدم ان یعرف القدم او یصفه بما ینبغی لسلطانه و عظمته و کبریائه.
output: How can the creature who is as nothing comprehend Him Who is the Ancient of Days, or succeed in describing the full measure of His sovereignty, His glory, and His grandeur

input: لا ونفسک یا مالک الأمم.
output: Nay, and to this Thou Thyself dost witness, O Thou Who art the Governor of nations.

input: قد شهد الکلّ بعجز نفسه و اقتدار نفسک و دنوّ ذاته و علوّ ذاتک.
output: Every created thing hath recognized its own impotence, and the power of Thy might, and hath confessed its own abasement and Thy great glory.

input: اسألک بآخریّتک الّتی کانت نفس اوّلیّتک و ظاهریّتک الّتی کانت عین باطنیّتک بأن تجعل احبّائک و ابنائهم و ذوی قرابتهم مظاهر تقدیسک بین خلقک و مطالع تنزیهک بین عبادک.
output: I beseech Thee by Thy Lastness which is the same as Thy Firstness, and by Thy Revelation which is identical with Thy Concealment, to grant that they who are dear to Thee, and their children, and their kindred, may become the revealers of Thy purity amidst Thy creatures, and the manifestations of Thy sanctity amongst Thy servants.

input: لک الحمد یا الهی بما جعلتنی هدفاً لسهام اعدائک فی سبیلک.
output: I give Thee thanks, O my God, for that Thou hast made me to be a target for the darts of Thine adversaries in Thy path.

input: اشکرک یا عالم الغیب و الشّهود و مالک الوجود بما جعلتنی مسجوناً فی حبّک و سقیتنی کأس البلایا لاظهار امرک و اعلآء کلمتک.
output: I offer Thee most high praise, O Thou Who art the Knower of the seen and unseen and the Lord of all being, that Thou hast suffered me to be cast into prison for love of Thee, and caused me to quaff the cup of woe, that I may reveal Thy Cause and glorify Thy word.

input: ای ربّ ایّ بلائی اذکر تلقآء وجهک. أ اذکر ما ورد علیّ من قبل من اشقیآء خلقک او ما احاطنی فی هذه الأیّام فی سبیل رضائک.
output: Which of my tribulations am I to recount before Thy face, O my Lord Am I to recite before Thee what in days of old befell me at the hands of the workers of iniquity among Thy creatures, or to describe the vexations which have compassed me about in these days for the sake of Thy good pleasure

input: اشکرک یا اله الأسمآء و احمدک یا فاطر السّمآء بما رأیت فی هذه الأیّام من طغاة عبادک و بغاة بریّتک.
output: Thanks be to Thee, O Thou the Lord of all names. and glory be to Thee, O Maker of the heavens, for all that I have sustained in these days at the hands of such of Thy servants as have transgressed against Thee, and of Thy people that have dealt frowardly towards Thee.

input: اسألک بأن تجعلنا من الّذین استقاموا علی امرک الی ان طارت ارواحهم الی سمآء فضلک و هوآء عنایتک.
output: Number us, we implore Thee, with them who have stood fast in Thy Cause until their souls finally winged their flight unto the heaven of Thy grace and the atmosphere of Thy loving kindness.

input: قد توجّه وجه البهآء الی وجهک و وجهک وجهه و ندائک ندائه و ظهورک ظهوره و نفسک نفسه و امرک امره و حکمک حکمه و جمالک جماله و سلطانک سلطانه و عزّک عزّه و قدرتک قدرته.
output: My face hath been set towards Thy face, and my face is, verily, Thy face, and my call is Thy call, and my Revelation Thy Revelation, and my self Thy Self, and my Cause Thy Cause, and my behest Thy behest, and my Being Thy Being, and my sovereignty Thy sovereignty, and my glory Thy glory, and my power Thy power.

input: اسألک یا خالق الأمم و مالک القدم بأن تحفظ امائک فی سرادق عصمتک و کفّر عنهنّ ما لا ینبغی فی ایّامک.
output: I implore Thee, O Thou Fashioner of the nations and the King of eternity, to guard Thy handmaidens within the tabernacle of Thy chastity, and to cancel such of their deeds as are unworthy of Thy days.

input: فاجعلهنّ یا الهی طاهرات من الأریاب و الشّبهات و مقدّسات عمّا لا ینبغی لنسبتهنّ الیک یا مالک الأسمآء و منزل الآیات.
output: Purge out, then, from them, O my God, all doubts and idle fancies, and sanctify them from whatsoever becometh not their kinship with Thee, O Thou Who art the Lord of names, and the Source of utterance.

input: انّک انت الّذی فی قبضتک زمام الممکنات.
output: Thou art He in Whose grasp are the reins of the entire creation.

input: لا اله الّا انت المقتدر المتعالی المهیمن العزیز القیّوم.
output: No God is there but Thee, the Almighty, the Most Exalted, the All Glorious, the Self Subsisting.

input: اسألک باسمک الرّحمن بأن تحفظ عبادک و امائک عند هبوب اریاح الامتحان و ظهور شؤونات الافتتان.
output: I beg of Thee by Thy name, the Most Merciful, to protect Thy servants and Thy handmaidens when the tempests of trials pass over them, and Thy manifold tests assail them.

input: ثمّ اجعلهم یا الهی من المتحصّنین فی حصن حبّک و امرک علی شأن لا یسلّط علیهم اعادی نفسک و اشرار عبادک الّذین نقضوا عهدک و میثاقک و قاموا بأعلی الاستکبار علی مطلع ذاتک و مظهر اجلالک.
output: Enable them, then, O my God, so to seek refuge within the stronghold of Thy love and of Thy Revelation, that neither Thine adversaries nor the wicked doers among Thy servants, who have broken Thy Covenant and Thy Testament, and turned away most disdainfully from the Dayspring of Thine Essence and the Revealer of Thy glory, may prevail against them.

input: ای ربّ هم قد قاموا لدی باب فضلک.
output: They themselves, O my Lord, have waited at the door of Thy grace.

input: ان افتح علی وجوههم بمفاتیح الطافک.
output: Do Thou open it to their faces with the keys of Thy bountiful favors.

input: ای ربّ هؤلآء قد توجّهوا الیک و اقبلوا الی مقرّک.
output: These are the ones, O my Lord, who have set their faces towards Thee, and turned unto Thy habitation.

input: فاعمل بهم ما ینبغی لرحمتک الّتی سبقت العالمین.
output: Do with them, therefore, as becometh Thy mercy, which hath surpassed the worlds.

input: فیا الهی و سیّدی.
output: my God and my Master.

input: قد قمت عن الفراش فی هذا الفجر الّذی فیه اشرقت شمس احدیّتک عن افق سمآء مشیّتک و استضآء منها الآفاق بما قدّر فی صحایف قضائک.
output: I have risen from my couch at this dawntide when the Daystar of Thy oneness hath shone forth from the Dayspring of Thy will, and hath shed its radiance upon the whole world, according to what had been ordained in the Books of Thy Decree.

input: لک الحمد یا الهی علی ما اصبحنا مستضیئاً بنور عرفانک و صمنا خالصاً لوجهک.
output: Praise be unto Thee, O my God, that we have wakened to the splendors of the light of Thy knowledge.

input: ای ربّ فأنزل علینا ما یجعلنا غنیّاً عمّا سواک و منقطعاً عن دونک ثمّ اکتب لی و لأحبّتی و ذوی قرابتی من کلّ ذکر و انثی خیر الآخرة و الأولی.
output: Send down, then, upon us, O my Lord, what will enable us to dispense with anyone but Thee, and will rid us of all attachment to aught except Thyself. Write down, moreover, for me, and for such as are dear to me, and for my kindred, man and woman alike, the good of this world and the world to come.

input: ثمّ اعصمنا یا محبوب الابداع و مقصود الاختراع بعصمتک الکبری من الّذین جعلتهم مظاهر الخنّاس و یوسوسون فی صدور النّاس.
output: Keep us safe, then, through Thine unfailing protection, O Thou the Beloved of the entire creation and the Desire of the whole universe, from them whom Thou hast made to be the manifestations of the Evil Whisperer, who whisper in men's breasts.

input: صلّ اللّهمّ یا الهی علی من جعلته قیّوماً علی اسمائک الحسنی و به فصّلت بین الأتقیآء و الأشقیآء بأن توفّقنا علی ما تحبّ و ترضی.
output: Bless Thou, O Lord my God, Him Whom Thou hast set over Thy most excellent Titles, and through Whom Thou hast divided between the godly and the wicked, and graciously aid us to do what Thou lovest and desirest.

input: و صلّ اللّهمّ یا الهی علی کلماتک و حروفاتک و علی الّذین توجّهوا الیک و اقبلوا الی وجهک و سمعوا ندائک و انّک انت مالک العباد و سلطانهم.
output: Bless Thou, moreover, O my God, them Who are Thy Words and Thy Letters, and them who have set their faces towards Thee, and turned unto Thy face, and hearkened to Thy Call. Thou art, truly, the Lord and King of all men,

input: و انّک انت علی کلّ شیء قدیر.
output: and art potent over all things.

input: لا تبعد عنّی لأنّ الشّداید بکلّها احاطتنی.
output: Be Thou not far from me, for tribulation upon tribulation hath gathered about me.

input: لا تدعنی بنفسی لأنّ المکاره بأسرها اخذتنی.
output: Leave me not to myself, for the extreme of adversity hath come upon me.

input: و من زلال ثدیی عنایتک فأشربنی لأنّ الاعطاش بأتمّها احرقتنی.
output: Out of the pure milk, drawn from the breasts of Thy loving kindness, give me to drink, for my thirst hath utterly consumed me.

input: و فی ظلّ جناحی رحمتک فأظللنی لأنّ الأعدآء بأجمعها ارادتنی.
output: Beneath the shadow of the wings of Thy mercy shelter me, for all mine adversaries with one consent have fallen upon me.

input: و عند عرش العظمة تلقآء تظهّر آیات عزّک فاحفظنی لأنّ الذّلّة بأکملها مسّتنی.
output: Keep me near to the throne of Thy majesty, face to face with the revelation of the signs of Thy glory, for wretchedness hath grievously touched me.

input: و من اثمار شجرة ازلیّتک فأطعمنی لأنّ الضّعف بألطفها قربتنی.
output: With the fruits of the Tree of Thine Eternity nourish me, for uttermost weakness hath overtaken me.

input: و من کؤوس السّرور من ایادی رأفتک فارزقنی لأنّ الهموم بأعظمها اخذتنی.
output: From the cups of joy, proffered by the hands of Thy tender mercies, feed me, for manifold sorrows have laid mighty hold upon me.

input: و من سنادس سلطان ربوبیّتک فاخلعنی لأنّ الافتقار بجوهرها عرّتنی.
output: With the broidered robe of Thine omnipotent sovereignty attire me, for poverty hath altogether despoiled me.

input: و عند تغنّی ورقآء صمدیّتک فأرقدنی لأنّ البلایا بأکبرها وردتنی.
output: Lulled by the cooing of the Dove of Thine Eternity, suffer me to sleep, for woes at their blackest have befallen me.

input: و فی عرش الأحدیّة عند تشعشع طلعة الجمال فأسکنّی لأنّ الاضطراب بأقومها اهلکتنی.
output: Before the throne of Thy oneness, amid the blaze of the beauty of Thy countenance, cause me to abide, for fear and trembling have violently crushed me.

input: و فی ابحر الغفریّة تلقآء تهیّج حوت الجلال فاغمسنی لأنّ الخطایا بأطودها اماتتنی.
output: Beneath the ocean of Thy forgiveness, faced with the restlessness of the leviathan of glory, immerse me, for my sins have utterly doomed me.

input: فسبحانک اللّهمّ یا الهی.
output: Glory be to Thee, O Lord my God.

input: اسألک باسمک الّذی به استقرّ جمالک علی عرش امرک و باسمک الّذی به تبدّل کلّ شیء و تحشر کلّ شیء و تسأل عن کلّ شیء و تجزی کلّ شیء و تحفظ کلّ شیء و ترزق کلّ شیء و ترفع کلّ شیء بأن تحفظ هذه الأمة الّتی لاذت بجنابک و التجأت بمظهر نفسک و توکّلت بذاتک.
output: I beg of Thee by Thy Name through which He Who is Thy Beauty hath been stablished upon the throne of Thy Cause, and by Thy Name through which Thou changest all things, and gatherest together all things, and callest to account all things, and rewardest all things, and preservest all things, and sustainest all things—I beg of Thee to guard this handmaiden who hath fled for refuge to Thee, and hath sought the shelter of Him in Whom Thou Thyself art manifest, and hath put her whole trust and confidence in Thee.

input: فیا الهی هذه مریض استظلّت فی ظلّ شجرة شفائک و علیل قد هربت الی مدین حراستک و سقیم ارادت تسنیم مواهبک و وجعان سرعت الی منبع سکینتک و عاص توجّهت الی شطر غفرانک.
output: She is sick, O my God, and hath entered beneath the shadow of the Tree of Thy healing. afflicted, and hath fled to the City of Thy protection. diseased, and hath sought the Fountainhead of Thy favors. sorely vexed, and hath hasted to attain the Wellspring of Thy tranquility. burdened with sin, and hath set her face toward the court of Thy forgiveness.

input: اذاً یا الهی و محبوبی فألبسها بسلطان عنایتک قمیص بردک و شفائک ثمّ اشربها من کأس رحمتک و الطافک ثمّ احفظها عن کلّ دآء و سقم و وجع و علّة و عن کلّ ما یکرهه رضاک.
output: Attire her, by Thy sovereignty and Thy loving kindness, O my God and my Beloved, with the raiment of Thy balm and Thy healing, and make her quaff of the cup of Thy mercy and Thy favors. Protect her, moreover, from every affliction and ailment, from all pain and sickness, and from whatsoever may be abhorrent unto Thee.

input: و انّک انت المقدّس عمّا سواک.
output: Thou, in truth, art immensely exalted above all else except Thyself.

input: و انّک انت الشّافی الکافی الحافظ الغفور الرّحیم.
output: Thou art, verily, the Healer, the All Sufficing, the Preserver, the Ever Forgiving, the Most Merciful.

input: انت الّذی یا الهی بأسمائک یبرأ کلّ علیل و یشفی کلّ مریض و یسقی کلّ ظمآن و یستریح کلّ مضطرب و یهدی کلّ مضلّ و یعزّ کلّ ذلیل و یغنی کلّ فقیر و یفقه کلّ جاهل و یتنوّر کلّ ظلمة و یفرح کلّ محزون و یستبرد کلّ محرور و یسترفع کلّ دان.
output: Thou art He, O my God, through Whose names the sick are healed and the ailing are restored, and the thirsty are given drink, and the sore vexed are tranquilized, and the wayward are guided, and the abased are exalted, and the poor are enriched, and the ignorant are enlightened, and the gloomy are illumined, and the sorrowful are cheered, and the chilled are warmed, and the downtrodden are raised up.

input: و باسمک یا الهی تحرّکت الموجودات و رفعت السّموات و استقرّت الأرض و رفعت السّحاب و امطرت علی کلّ الأراض.
output: Through Thy name, O my God, all created things were stirred up, and the heavens were spread, and the earth was established, and the clouds were raised and made to rain upon the earth.

input: و هذا من فضلک علی الخلائق اجمعین.
output: This, verily, is a token of Thy grace unto all Thy creatures.

input: فلمّا کان الأمر کذلک اسألک باسمک الّذی به اظهرت نفسک و ارفعت امرک علی کلّ الممکنات ثمّ بکلّ اسمائک الحسنی و صفاتک العلیا و اذکار نفسک العلیّ الأعلی بأن تنزل فی هذا اللّیل من سحاب رحمتک امطار شفائک علی هذا الرّضیع الّذی نسبته الی نفسک الأبهی فی ملکوت الانشآء.
output: I implore Thee, therefore, by Thy name through which Thou didst manifest Thy Godhead, and didst exalt Thy Cause above all creation, and by each of Thy most excellent titles and most august attributes, and by all the virtues wherewith Thy transcendent and most exalted Being is extolled, to send down this night from the clouds of Thy mercy the rains of Thy healing upon this suckling, whom Thou hast related unto Thine all glorious Self in the kingdom of Thy creation.

input: ثمّ البسه یا الهی من فضلک قمیص العافیة و السّلامة ثمّ احفظه یا محبوبی عن کلّ بلآء و سقم و مکروه.
output: Clothe him, then, O my God, by Thy grace, with the robe of well being and health, and guard him, O my Beloved, from every affliction and disorder, and from whatsoever is obnoxious unto Thee.

input: و انّک انت المقتدر علی کلّ شیء.
output: Thy might, verily, is equal to all things.

input: و انّک انت المقتدر القیّوم.
output: Thou, in truth, art the Most Powerful, the Self Subsisting.

input: ثمّ انزل علیه یا الهی خیر الدّنیا و الآخرة و خیر الأوّلین و الآخرین.
output: Send down, moreover, upon him, O my God, the good of this world and of the next, and the good of the former and latter generations.

input: و انّک علی ذلک لقدیر حکیم.
output: Thy might and Thy wisdom are, verily, equal unto this.

input: اسألک باسمک الّذی به ارفعت اعلام هدایتک و اشرقت انوار عنایتک و اظهرت سلطان ربوبیّتک و به ظهر مصباح اسمائک فی مشکاة صفاتک و به طلع هیکل التّوحید و مظهر التّجرید و به رفع مناهج الهدایة و ظهر سبل الارادة و به تزلزلت ارکان الضّلالة و انهدمت آثار الشّقاوة و به تفجّرت ینابیع الحکمة و تنزّلت مائدة السّمائیّة و به حفظت عبادک و نزّلت شفائک و به ظهرت مرحمتک علی عبادک و مغفرتک بین خلقک بأن تحفظ الّذی توسّل الیک و رجع علیک و تمسّک برحمتک و تشبّث بذیل عطوفتک.
output: I implore Thee by Thy Name, through which Thou didst lift up the ensigns of Thy guidance, and didst shed the radiance of Thy loving kindness, and didst reveal the sovereignty of Thy Lordship. through which the lamp of Thy names hath appeared within the niche of Thine attributes, and He Who is the Tabernacle of Thy unity and the Manifestation of detachment hath shone forth. through which the ways of Thy guidance were made known, and the paths of Thy good pleasure were marked out. through which the foundations of error have been made to tremble, and the signs of wickedness have been abolished. through which the fountains of wisdom have burst forth, and the heavenly table hath been sent down. through which Thou didst preserve Thy servants and didst vouchsafe Thy healing. through which Thou didst show forth Thy tender mercies unto Thy servants and revealedst Thy forgiveness amidst Thy creatures—I implore Thee to keep safe him who hath held fast and returned unto Thee, and clung to Thy mercy, and seized the hem of Thy loving providence.

input: ثمّ انزل علیه شفآءً من عندک و سلامةً من لدنک و صبراً من جانبک و سکوناً من حضرتک
output: Send down, then, upon him Thy healing, and make him whole, and endue him with a constancy vouchsafed by Thee, and a tranquility bestowed by Thy highness.

input: اذ انّک انت الشّافی الکافی الحافظ النّاصر القادر المقتدر العزیز العلیم.
output: Thou art, verily, the Healer, the Preserver, the Helper, the Almighty, the Powerful, the All Glorious, the All Knowing.

input: لک الحمد بما انطقتنی بآیاتک و اظهرتنی بحجّتک و برهانک علی شأن طاف کلّ حجّة حول ارادتی و کلّ برهان حول مشیّتی.
output: I give praise to Thee, that Thou hast made me able so to reveal Thine utterances, and manifest Thy proofs and Thy testimonies, that every proof hath been made to circle round my will, and every testimony to compass my pleasure.

input: ای ربّ ترانی بین اعادی نفسک الّذین انکروا آیاتک و ادحضوا برهانک و اعرضوا عن جمالک و قاموا علی سفک دمک.
output: Thou seest me, O my Lord, lying at the mercy of Thine adversaries, who have repudiated Thy signs, and refuted Thy testimony, and turned back from Thy beauty, and resolved to shed Thy blood.

input: اسألک یا مالک الأسمآء باسمک الّذی سخّرت به الأشیآء بأن تؤیّد عبادک و احبّائک علی الاستقامة علی امرک.
output: I beseech Thee, O Thou Who art the Lord of all names, by Thy name through which Thou hast subdued all created things, to graciously aid Thy servants and Thy loved ones to cleave steadfastly to Thy Cause.

input: ثمّ اشربهم ما تحیی به افئدتهم فی ایّامک.
output: Give them, then, to drink what will quicken their hearts in Thy days.

input: ای ربّ فاجعلهم فی کلّ الأحوال ناظرین الی رضائک و شاکرین لظهورات قضائک.
output: Enable them, moreover, O my Lord, to fix their gaze at all times upon Thy pleasure, and to yield Thee thanks for the evidences of Thine irrevocable decree.

input: لأنّک انت المحمود فیما فعلت و تفعل و المطاع فیما اردت و ترید و المحبوب فیما شئت و تشآء
output: For Thou art, verily, praiseworthy in all that Thou hast done in the past, or wilt do in the future, and art to be obeyed in whatsoever Thou hast wished or wilt wish, and to be loved in all that Thou hast desired or wilt desire.

input: تنظر احبّائک بلحظات اعین الطافک. و لا تنزل لهم الّا ما هو خیر لهم بفضلک و مواهبک.
output: Thou lookest upon them that are dear to Thee with the eyes of Thy loving kindness, and sendest down for them only that which will profit them through Thy grace and Thy gifts.

input: نسألک یا غیث الجود و غیاث المنجود بأن توفّقنا علی ذکرک و اظهار امرک و القیام علی نصرتک.
output: We entreat Thee, O Thou Who art the Cloud of Bounty and the Succorer of the distressed, that Thou wilt aid us to remember Thee, and to make known Thy Cause, and to arise to help Thee.

input: ولو انّا ضعفآء ولکن تمسّکنا باسمک القویّ القدیر.
output: Though all weakness, we yet have clung to Thy Name, the Most Powerful, the Almighty.

input: صلّ یا الهی علی الّذین استقاموا علی امرک و ما منعتهم اشارات الفجّار عن التّوجّه الی وجهک سرعوا بالقلوب الی شطر فضلک الی ان شربوا کوثر الحیوان من ایادی عطائک.
output: Bless Thou, O my God, them that have stood fast in Thy Cause, and whom the evil suggestions of the workers of iniquity have failed to deter from turning towards Thy face, and who have hastened with their whole hearts toward Thy grace, until they finally quaffed the water that is life indeed from the hands of Thy bounty.

input: یا الهی لک الحمد بما اخذنی عرف عنایتک و قلّبتنی نفحات رحمتک الی شطر الطافک.
output: I give praise to Thee, O my God, that the fragrance of Thy loving kindness hath enraptured me, and the gentle winds of Thy mercy have inclined me in the direction of Thy bountiful favors.

input: ایربّ فأشربنی من انامل عطائک الکوثر الّذی من شرب منه انقطع عمّا سواک طائراً فی هوآء انقطاعک و ناظراً الی شطر رأفتک و مواهبک.
output: Make me to quaff, O my Lord, from the fingers of Thy bounteousness the living waters which have enabled every one that hath partaken of them to rid himself of all attachment to any one save Thee, and to soar into the atmosphere of detachment from all Thy creatures, and to fix his gaze upon Thy loving providence and Thy manifold gifts.

input: ایربّ فاجعلنی فیکلّ الأحوال مستعدّاً للقیام علی خدمتک و الاقبال الی کعبة امرک وجمالک.
output: Make me ready, in all circumstances, O my Lord, to serve Thee and to set myself towards the adored sanctuary of Thy Revelation and of Thy Beauty.

input: لو ترید فاجعلنی نبات ریاض فضلک لتحرّکنی اریاح مشیّتک کیف تشآء بحیث لا یبقی فی قبضتی اختیار الحرکة و السّکون.
output: If it be Thy pleasure, make me to grow as a tender herb in the meadows of Thy grace, that the gentle winds of Thy will may stir me up and bend me into conformity with Thy pleasure, in such wise that my movement and my stillness may be wholly directed by Thee.

input: انّک انت الّذی باسمک ظهر السّرّ المکنون و الاسم المخزون و فکّ الانآء المختوم و تعطّر به ما کان و ما یکون.
output: Thou art He, by Whose name the Hidden Secret was divulged, and the Well Guarded Name was revealed, and the seals of the sealed up Goblet were opened, shedding thereby its fragrance over all creation, whether of the past or of the future.

input: ایربّ قد سرع الظّمآن الی کوثر افضالک و اراد المسکین التّغمّس فی بحر غنائک.
output: He who was athirst, O my Lord, hath hasted to attain the living waters of Thy grace, and the wretched creature hath yearned to immerse himself beneath the ocean of Thy riches.

input: قد اخذنی حزن الفراق فی الأیّام الّتی فیها اشرقت شمس الوصال لبریّتک.
output: I am sore afflicted by the grief of my separation from Thee, in the days when the Daystar of Thy presence hath shed its radiance upon Thy people.

input: فاکتب لی اجر من فاز بحضورک و دخل ساحة العرش باذنک و حضر لدی الوجه بأمرک.
output: Write down, then, for me the recompense decreed for such as have gazed on Thy face, and have, by Thy leave, gained admittance into the court of Thy throne, and have, at Thy bidding, met Thee face to face.

input: ایربّ اسئلک باسمک الّذی به انارت الأرضون و السّموات بأن تجعلنی راضیاً بما قدّرته فی الواحک بحیث لن اجد فی نفسی مراداً الّا ما انت اردته بسلطانک و مشیّةً الّا ما انت قضیته بمشیّتک.
output: I implore Thee, O my Lord, by Thy name the splendors of which have encompassed the earth and the heavens, to enable me so to surrender my will to what Thou hast decreed in Thy Tablets, that I may cease to discover within me any desire except what Thou didst desire through the power of Thy sovereignty, and any will save what Thou didst destine for me by Thy will.

input: الی من اتوجّه یا الهی بعد الّذی لا اجد سبیلاً الّا ما بیّنته لأصفیائک.
output: Whither shall I turn, O my God, powerless as I am to discover any other way except the way Thou didst set before Thy chosen Ones

input: یشهد کلّ الذّرّات بأنّک انت اللّه لا اله الّا انت.
output: All the atoms of the earth proclaim Thee to be God, and testify that there is none other God besides Thee.

input: لم تزل کنت مقتدراً علی ما تشآء و حاکماً علی ما ترید.
output: Thou hast from eternity been powerful to do what Thou hast willed, and to ordain what Thou hast pleased.

input: قدّر لی یا الهی ما یجعلنی فیکلّ الأحوال متوجّهاً الی شطرک و متمسّکاً بحبل فضلک و منادیاً باسمک و منتظراً ما یجری من قلمک.
output: Do Thou destine for me, O my God, what will set me, at all times, towards Thee, and enable me to cleave continually to the cord of Thy grace, and to proclaim Thy name, and to look for whatsoever may flow down from Thy pen.

input: ایربّ انا الفقیر و انت الغنیّ المتعال فارحمنی ببدایع رحمتک ثمّ ارسل علیّ فی کلّ آن ما احییت به قلوب الموحّدین من خلقک و المخلصین من بریّتک.
output: I am poor and desolate, O my Lord, and Thou art the All Possessing, the Most High. Have pity, then, upon me through the wonders of Thy mercy, and send down upon me, every moment of my life, the things wherewith Thou hast recreated the hearts of all Thy creatures who have recognized Thy unity, and of all Thy people who are wholly devoted to Thee.

input: تعلم بلائی و ما ورد علیّ من الّذین طافوا حولی من العباد الّذین کفروا بآیاتک الکبری و اعرضوا عن طلعتک النّورآء.
output: Thou beholdest my tribulations and all that hath befallen me at the hands of such of Thy servants as keep company with me, who have disbelieved in Thy most resplendent signs, and turned back from Thy most effulgent Beauty.

input: قد بلغت البلایا الی مقام لا تحصی و لا تجری من قلم الانشآء
output: Such are the troubles that vex me, that no pen in the entire creation can either reckon or describe them.

input: اسألک یا مالک الأسمآء و فاطر الأرض و السّمآء بأن تؤیّدنی علی شأن لا یمنعنی شیء عن ذکرک و ثنائک و لا یشغلنی امر عمّا امرتنی به فی الواحک اقوم علی امرک علی شأن اعرّی رأسی و اطلع من البیت صائحاً باسمک بین خلقک و ناطقاً بذکرک بین عبادک.
output: I implore Thee, O Thou Who art the King of names and the Creator of earth and heaven, so to assist me by Thy strengthening grace that nothing whatsoever will have the power to hinder me from remembering Thee, or celebrating Thy praise, or to keep me back from observing what Thou hast prescribed unto me in Thy Tablets, that I may so arise to serve Thee that with bared head I will hasten forth from my habitation, cry out in Thy name amidst Thy creatures, and proclaim Thy virtues among Thy servants.

input: و اذا قضیت ما قضیت و ادّیت ما کتبت اذاً یجتمع علیّ اشرار بریّتک و یفعلون ما یشاؤون فی سبیلک.
output: Having accomplished what Thou hadst decreed, and delivered the thing Thou hadst written down, the wicked doers among Thy people would, then, compass me about and would do with me in Thy path as would please them.

input: ای ربّ انا المشتاق فی حبّک بما لا یشتاقه احد.
output: In the love I bear to Thee, O my Lord, my heart longeth for Thee with a longing such as no heart hath known.

input: هذا جسدی بین یدیک و روحی تلقآء وجهک.
output: Here am I with my body between Thy hands, and my spirit before Thy face.

input: فافعل بهما ما شئت لاعلآء کلمتک و ابراز ما کنز فی خزائن علمک.
output: Do with them as it may please Thee, for the exaltation of Thy word, and the revelation of what hath been enshrined within the treasuries of Thy knowledge.

input: انّک انت المقتدر علی ما تشآء. و انّک انت المهیمن علی ما ترید.
output: Potent art Thou to do what Thou willest, and able to ordain what Thou pleasest.

input: لا اجد فی مملکتک من یقدر ان یقبل الیک حقّ الاقبال او یستمع ما خرج من فم مشیّتک حقّ الاستماع
output: I can discover no one in Thy realm who can befittingly turn unto Thee, or is able to adequately hearken unto what hath gone out of the mouth of Thy will.

input: اذاً اسألک یا مالک الابداع و ملیک الاختراع بأن تؤیّدهم علی ما تحبّ و ترضی لیقومنّ علی امرک بین خلقک و ینطقنّ بذکرک بین السّموات و الأرضین.
output: I beseech Thee, therefore, O Thou Who art the Possessor of the entire creation and the King of the realm of Thine invention, graciously to aid Thy creatures to accomplish that which is pleasing and acceptable unto Thee, that they may arise to serve Thy Cause amidst Thy creatures, and to speak forth Thy praise before all who are in heaven and on earth.

input: ای ربّ انت الّذی سبق کرمک و علت قدرتک و احاطت رحمتک.
output: Thou art He, O my Lord, Whose bounty hath surpassed all things, and Whose power hath transcended all things, and Whose mercy hath encompassed all things.

input: فانظر الی بریّتک بلحظات اعین الطافک و لا تدعهم بأنفسهم و اهوائهم فی ایّامک.
output: Look, then, upon Thy people with the eyes of Thy tender mercies, and leave them not to themselves and to their corrupt desires in Thy days.

input: ولو انّهم یا الهی بعدوا عن قربک و اعرضوا عن وجهک ولکن انت الکریم فی ذاتک و الرّحیم فی نفسک.
output: How farsoever they may have strayed from Thee, and however grievously they have turned back from Thy face, yet Thou, in Thine essence, art the All Bountiful, and, in Thine inmost spirit, art the Most Merciful.

input: عاملهم بخفیّات جودک و مواهبک.
output: Deal with them according to the unrevealed tokens of Thy bounty and Thy gifts.

input: انّک انت الّذی اقرّ کلّ شیء بقدرتک و اعترف کلّ شیء لعظمتک و اقتدارک.
output: Thou art, verily, the One to the power of Whose might all things have testified, and to Whose majesty and omnipotence the whole creation hath borne witness.

input: الها معبودا مسجودا مقتدرا
output: My God, Thou Whom I adore and worship, Who art Most Powerful.

input: شهادت میدهم که تو بوصف ممکنات معروف نشوی و باذکار موجودات موصوف نگردی.
output: I testify that no description by any created thing can ever reveal Thee, and no praise which any being is able to utter can express Thee.

input: ادراکات عالم و عقول امم بساحت قدست علی ما ینبغی راه نیابد و پی‌نبرد.
output: Neither the comprehension of any one in the whole world, nor the intelligence of any of its peoples, can, as it befitteth Thee, gain admittance into the court of Thy holiness, or unravel Thy mystery.

input: آیا چه خطا اهل مدینهٴ اسماء را از افق اعلایت منع نمود و از تقرّب ببحر اعظمت محروم ساخت.
output: What sin hath kept the inmates of the city of Thy names so far from Thine all glorious Horizon, and deprived them of access to Thy most great Ocean

input: یک حرف از کتابت امّ البیان و یک کلمهٴ از آن موجد امکان.
output: One single letter of Thy Book is the mother of all utterances, and a word therefrom the begetter of all creation.

input: چه ناسپاسی از عبادت ظاهر که کل را از شناسائیت بازداشتی.
output: What ingratitude have Thy servants shown forth that Thou hast withheld them, one and all, from recognizing Thee

input: یک قطره از دریای رحمتت نار جحیم را بیفسرد و یک جذوه از نار محبّتت عالم را برافروزد.
output: A drop out of the ocean of Thy mercy sufficeth to quench the flames of hell, and a spark of the fire of Thy love is enough to set ablaze a whole world.

input: ای علیم.
output: Thou Who art the All Knowing.

input: اگرچه غافلیم ولکن بکرمت متشبّث و اگرچه جاهلیم ببحر علمت متوجّه.
output: Wayward though we be, we still cling to Thy bounty. and though ignorant, we still set our faces toward the ocean of Thy wisdom.

input: توئی آن جوادی که کثرت خطا ترا از عطا بازندارد و اعراض اهل عالم نعمتت را سد ننماید.
output: Thou art that All Bountiful Who art not deterred by a multitude of sins from vouchsafing Thy bounty, and the flow of Whose gifts is not arrested by the withdrawal of the peoples of the world.

input: باب فضلت لازال مفتوح بوده.
output: From eternity the door of Thy grace hath remained wide open.

input: شبنمی از دریای رحمتت کل را بطراز تقدیس مزیّن فرماید و رشحی از بحر جودت تمام وجود را بغنای حقیقی فائز نماید.
output: A dewdrop out of the ocean of Thy mercy is able to adorn all things with the ornament of sanctity, and a sprinkling of the waters of Thy bounty can cause the entire creation to attain unto true wealth.

input: ای ستّار پرده برمدار.
output: Lift not the veil, O Thou Who art the Concealer.

input: لازال ظهورات کرمت عالم را احاطه نموده و انوار اسم اعظمت بر کل تابیده.
output: From eternity the tokens of Thy bounty have encompassed the universe, and the splendors of Thy Most Great Name have been shed over all created things.

input: عبادت را از بدایع فضلت محروم منما.
output: Deny not Thy servants the wonders of Thy grace.

input: و آگاهی بخش تا بر وحدانیّتت گواهی دهند و شناسائی ده تا بسویت بشتابند.
output: Cause them to be made aware of Thee, that they may bear witness to Thy unity, and enable them to recognize Thee, that they may hasten towards Thee.

input: رحمتت ممکنات را احاطه نموده و فضلت کل را اخذ کرده.
output: Thy mercy hath embraced the whole creation, and Thy grace hath pervaded all things.

input: از امواج بحر بخششت بحور طلب و طمع ظاهر.
output: From the billows of the ocean of Thy generosity the seas of eagerness and enthusiasm were revealed.

input: هر چه هستی توئی مادونت لایق ذکر نه
output: Thou art what Thou art. Aught except Thee is unworthy of any mention

input: الّا بالدّخول فی ظلّک و الورود فی بساطک.
output: unless it entereth beneath Thy shadow, and gaineth admittance into Thy court.

input: در هر حال آمرزش قدیمت را میطلبیم و فضل عمیمت را میجوئیم.
output: Whatever betide us, we beseech Thine ancient forgiveness, and seek Thine all pervasive grace.

input: امید چنان که نفسی را از فضلت محروم نسازی و از طراز عدل و انصاف منع ننمائی.
output: Our hope is that Thou wilt deny no one Thy grace, and wilt deprive no soul of the ornament of fairness and justice.

input: توئی سلطان کرم و مالک عطا و المهیمن علی من فی الأرض و السّمآء .
output: Thou art the King of all bounty, and the Lord of all favors, and supreme over all who are in heaven and on earth.

input: الهی الهی فرّج همّی بجودک و عطائک و ازل کربتی بسلطنتک و اقتدارک.
output: Dispel my grief by Thy bounty and Thy generosity, O God, my God, and banish mine anguish through Thy sovereignty and Thy might.

input: ترانی یا الهی مقبلاً الیک حین اذ احاطت بی الأحزان من کلّ الجهات.
output: Thou seest me, O my God, with my face set towards Thee at a time when sorrows have compassed me on every side.

input: اسألک یا مالک الوجود و المهیمن علی الغیب و الشّهود باسمک الّذی به سخّرت الأفئدة و القلوب و بأمواج بحر رحمتک و اشراقات انوار نیّر عطائک ان تجعلنی من الّذین ما منعهم شیء من الأشیآء عن التّوجّه الیک یا مولی الأسمآء و فاطر السّمآء.
output: I implore Thee, O Thou Who art the Lord of all being, and overshadowest all things visible and invisible, by Thy Name whereby Thou hast subdued the hearts and the souls of men, and by the billows of the Ocean of Thy mercy and the splendors of the Daystar of Thy bounty, to number me with them whom nothing whatsoever hath deterred from setting their faces toward Thee, O Thou Lord of all names and Maker of the heavens.

input: ای ربّ تری ما ورد علیّ فی ایّامک.
output: Thou beholdest, O my Lord, the things which have befallen me in Thy days.

input: اسألک بمشرق اسمائک و مطلع صفاتک ان تقدّر لی ما یجعلنی قائماً علی خدمتک و ناطقاً بثنائک.
output: I entreat Thee, by Him Who is the Dayspring of Thy names and the Dawning Place of Thine attributes, to ordain for me what will enable me to arise to serve Thee and to extol Thy virtues.

input: ثمّ اسألک فی آخر عرضی بأنوار وجهک ان تصلح اموری و تقضی دینی و حوائجی.
output: And, finally, I beg of Thee by the light of Thy countenance to bless my affairs, and redeem my debts, and satisfy my needs.

input: انّک انت الّذی شهد کلّ ذی لسان بقدرتک و قوّتک و ذی درایة بعظمتک و سلطانک.
output: Thou art He to Whose power and to Whose dominion every tongue hath testified, and Whose majesty and Whose sovereignty every understanding heart hath acknowledged.

input: قلباً طاهراً فاخلق فیّ یا الهی سرّاً ساکناً جدّد فیّ یا منائی.
output: Create in me a pure heart, O my God, and renew a tranquil conscience within me, O my Hope.

input: و بروح القوّة ثبّتنی علی امرک یا محبوبی و بنور العظمة فاشهدنی علی صراطک یا رجائی.
output: Through the spirit of power confirm Thou me in Thy Cause, O my Best Beloved, and by the light of Thy glory reveal unto me Thy path, O Thou the Goal of my desire.

input: و بسلطان الرّفعة الی سمآء قدسک عرّجنی یا اوّلی و باریاح الصّمدیّة فابهجنی یا آخری.
output: Through the power of Thy transcendent might lift me up unto the heaven of Thy holiness, O Source of my being, and by the breezes of Thine eternity gladden me, O Thou Who art my God.

input: و بنغمات الازلیّة فاسترحنی یا مُونسی و بغنآء طلعتک القدیمة نجّنی عن دونک یا سیّدی و بظهور کینونتک الدّائمة بشّرنی یا ظاهر فوق ظاهری و الباطن دون باطنی.
output: Let Thine everlasting melodies breathe tranquility on me, O my Companion, and let the riches of Thine ancient countenance deliver me from all except Thee, O my Master, and let the tidings of the revelation of Thine incorruptible Essence bring me joy, O Thou Who art the most manifest of the manifest and the most hidden of the hidden.

input: لک الحمد یا الهی بما ایقظتنی بعد نومی و اظهرتنی بعد غیبتی و اقمتنی بعد رقدی.
output: I give praise to Thee, O my God, that Thou hast awakened me out of my sleep, and brought me forth after my disappearance, and raised me up from my slumber.

input: اصبحت متوجّهاً الی انوار فجر ظهورک الّذی به انارت آفاق سموات قدرتک و عظمتک و معترفاً بآیاتک و موقناً بکتابک و متمسّکاً بحبلک.
output: I have wakened this morning with my face set toward the splendors of the Daystar of Thy Revelation, through Which the heavens of Thy power and Thy majesty have been illumined, acknowledging Thy signs, believing in Thy Book, and holding fast unto Thy Cord.

input: اسألک باقتدار مشیّتک و نفوذ ارادتک بأن تجعل ما اریتنی فی منامی امتن اساس لبیوت حبّک فی افئدة اولیائک و احسن اسباب لظهورات فضلک و عنایتک.
output: I beseech Thee, by the potency of Thy will and the compelling power of Thy purpose, to make of what Thou didst reveal unto me in my sleep the surest foundation for the mansions of Thy love that are within the hearts of Thy loved ones, and the best instrument for the revelation of the tokens of Thy grace and Thy loving kindness.

input: ای ربّ قدّر لی من قلمک الأعلی خیر الآخرة و الأولی اشهد انّ فی قبضتک زمام الأمور.
output: Do Thou ordain for me through Thy most exalted Pen, O my Lord, the good of this world and of the next. I testify that within Thy grasp are held the reins of all things.

input: تبدّلها کیف تشآء.
output: Thou changest them as Thou pleasest.

input: لا اله الّا انت القویّ الأمین.
output: No God is there save Thee, the Strong, the Faithful.

input: انت الّذی بأمرک تبدّل الذّلّة بالعزّة و الضّعف بالقوّة و العجز بالاقتدار و الاضطراب بالاطمینان و الرّیب بالایقان.
output: Thou art He Who changeth through His bidding abasement into glory, and weakness into strength, and powerlessness into might, and fear into calm, and doubt into certainty.

input: لا اله الّا انت العزیز المنّان.
output: No God is there but Thee, the Mighty, the Beneficent.

input: لا تخیّب من سألک و لا تمنع من ارادک.
output: Thou disappointest no one who hath sought Thee, nor dost Thou keep back from Thee anyone who hath desired Thee.

input: قدّر ما ینبغی لسمآء جودک و بحر کرمک.
output: Ordain Thou for me what becometh the heaven of Thy generosity, and the ocean of Thy bounty.

input: شهادت میدهم بوحدانیّت تو و فردانیّت تو و بخششهای قدیم و جدید تو.
output: I bear witness unto Thy unity and Thy oneness, and acknowledge Thy gifts, both in the past and in the present.

input: توئی آن کریمی که امطار سحاب سماء رحمتت بر شریف و وضیع باریده و اشراقات انوار آفتاب بخششت بر عاصی و مطیع تابیده.
output: Thou art the All Bountiful, the overflowing showers of Whose mercy have rained down upon high and low alike, and the splendors of Whose grace have been shed over both the obedient and the rebellious.

input: ای رحیمی که ساذج رحمت بابت را ساجد و جوهر عنایت کعبهٴ امرت را طائف از تو سؤال مینمائیم فضل قدیمت را میطلبیم و جود جدیدت را میجوئیم که بر مظاهر وجود رحم فرمائی و از فیوضات ایّامت محروم نسازی. جمیع محتاج و فقیرند
output: God of mercy, before Whose door the quintessence of mercy hath bowed down, and round the sanctuary of Whose Cause loving kindness, in its inmost spirit, hath circled, we beseech Thee, entreating Thine ancient grace, and seeking Thy present favor, that Thou mayest have mercy upon all who are the manifestations of the world of being, and to deny them not the outpourings of Thy grace in Thy days. All are but poor and needy,

input: و انت الغنیّ الغالب القدیر.
output: and Thou, verily, art the All Possessing, the All Subduing, the All Powerful.

input: یا الهی اصبحت فی جوارک و الّذی استجارک ینبغی ان یکون فی کنف حفظک و حصن حمایتک.
output: I have wakened in Thy shelter, O my God, and it becometh him that seeketh that shelter to abide within the Sanctuary of Thy protection and the Stronghold of Thy defense.

input: ای ربّ نوّر باطنی بأنوار فجر ظهورک کما نوّرت ظاهری بنور صباح عطائک.
output: Illumine my inner being, O my Lord, with the splendors of the Dayspring of Thy Revelation, even as Thou didst illumine my outer being with the morning light of Thy favor.

input: الها کریما رحیما.
output: my God, the God of bounty and mercy.

input: توئی آن سلطانی که بیک کلمه‌ات وجود موجود گشت و توئی آن کریمیکه اعمال بندگان بخششت را منع ننمود و ظهورات جودت را بازنداشت.
output: Thou art that King by Whose commanding word the whole creation hath been called into being. and Thou art that All Bountiful One the doings of Whose servants have never hindered Him from showing forth His grace, nor have they frustrated the revelations of His bounty.

input: از تو سؤال مینمایم این عبد را فائز فرمائی بآنچه سبب نجاتست در جمیع عوالم تو.
output: Suffer this servant, I beseech Thee, to attain unto that which is the cause of his salvation in every world of Thy worlds.

input: توئی مقتدر و توانا و توئی عالم و دانا.
output: Thou art, verily, the Almighty, the Most Powerful, the All Knowing, the All Wise.

input: جانها از تو و اقتدارها در قبضهٴ قدرت تو.
output: All life is of Thee and all power lieth within the grasp of Thine omnipotence.

input: هر که را بلند کنی از ملک بگذرد و بمقام رفعناه مقاماً علیّا رسد
output: Whosoever Thou exaltest is raised above the angels, and attaineth the station: Verily, We uplifted him to a place on high.

input: با تباه‌کاری و گناهکاری و عدم پرهیزکاری مقعد صدق میطلبیم و لقای ملیک مقتدر میجوئیم.
output: Though wicked, sinful, and intemperate, we still seek from Thee a seat of truth, and long to behold the countenance of the Omnipotent King.

input: امر امر تو است و حکم آن تو و عالم قدرت زیر فرمان تو.
output: It is Thine to command, and all sovereignty belongeth to Thee, and the realm of might boweth before Thy behest.

input: یک تجلّی از تجلّیات اسم رحمانت رسم عصیان را از جهان براندازد و محو نماید و یک نسیم از نسائم یوم ظهورت عالم را بخلعت تازه مزیّن فرماید.
output: One gleam from the splendors of Thy Name, the All Merciful, sufficeth to banish and blot out every trace of sinfulness from the world, and a single breath from the breezes of the Day of Thy Revelation is enough to adorn all mankind with a fresh attire.

input: ای توانا ناتوانانرا توانائی بخش و مردگان را زندگی عطا فرما شاید تو را بیابند و بدریای آگاهیت راه یابند و بر امرت مستقیم مانند.
output: Vouchsafe Thy strength, O Almighty One, unto Thy weak creatures, and quicken them who are as dead, that haply they may find Thee, and may be led unto the ocean of Thy guidance, and may remain steadfast in Thy Cause.

input: اگر از لغاة مختلفهٴ عالم عرف ثنای تو متضوّع شود همه محبوب جان و مقصود روان. چه تازی چه فارسی
output: Should the fragrance of Thy praise be shed abroad by any of the divers tongues of the world, out of the East or out of the West, it would, verily, be prized and greatly cherished.

input: اگر از آن محروم ماند قابل ذکر نه چه الفاظ چه معانی.
output: If such tongues, however, be deprived of that fragrance, they assuredly would be unworthy of any mention, be they words or thoughts.

input: ای پروردگار از تو میطلبیم کلّ را راه نمائی و هدایت فرمائی.
output: We beg of Thee, O Providence, to show Thy way unto all men, and to guide them aright.

input: لک الحمد یا الهی علی ما قلّبت وجوه عبادک الی یمین عرش الطافک و قدّستهم عمّا دونک لسلطنتک و اجلالک.
output: Praise be to Thee, O my God, inasmuch as Thou hast turned the faces of Thy servants towards the right hand of the throne of Thy gifts, and hast caused them to be detached from all else besides Thee, that they may recognize Thy sovereignty and acknowledge Thy glory.

input: اشهد بأنّ امرک نافذ و حکمک جاری و مشیّتک ثابتة و ما اردت هو باقی.
output: I testify to the potency of Thy Cause, the pervasive influence of Thy decree, the immutability of Thy will, the endlessness of Thy purpose.

input: کلّ شیء فی قبضة قدرتک اسیر و کلّ لدی ظهور غنائک فقیر.
output: All things lie prisoned within the grasp of Thy might, and the whole creation is destitute when brought face to face with the evidences of Thy wealth.

input: فیا الهی و محبوبی و غایة املی افعل بعبادک و بریّتک ما ینبغی لجمالک و عظمتک و ما یلیق لکرمک و مواهبک.
output: Deal Thou, therefore, O my God, my Beloved, my supreme Desire, with Thy servants and with all that were created by Thee as would beseem Thy beauty and Thy greatness, and would be worthy of Thy generosity and gifts.

input: انّک انت الّذی سبقت رحمتک العالمین و احاط فضلک من فی السّموات و الأرضین.
output: Thou art, in truth, He Whose mercy hath encompassed all the worlds, and Whose grace hath embraced all that dwell on earth and in heaven.

input: من الّذی ناداک و ما اجبته.
output: Who is there that hath cried after Thee, and whose prayer hath remained unanswered

input: و من الّذی اقبل الیک و ما تقرّبت الیه.
output: Where is he to be found who hath reached forth towards Thee, and whom Thou hast failed to approach

input: و من الّذی توجّه بوجهه الی وجهک و ما توجّهت الیه لحظات عنایتک.
output: Who is he that can claim to have fixed his gaze upon Thee, and toward whom the eye of Thy loving kindness hath not been directed

input: اشهد حینئذ بأنّ اقبالک عبادک سبق اقبالهم ایّاک و ذکرک ایّاهم کان قبل ذکرهم ایّاک.
output: I bear witness that Thou hadst turned toward Thy servants ere they had turned toward Thee, and hadst remembered them ere they had remembered Thee.

input: و لک الفضل یا من بیدک ملکوت العطآء و جبروت القضآء.
output: All grace is Thine, O Thou in Whose hand is the kingdom of Divine gifts and the source of every irrevocable decree.

input: فأنزل یا الهی علی قاصدیک ما یقدّسهم عن دونک و یقرّبهم الی نفسک
output: Send down, therefore, O my God, upon all that seek Thee that which will entirely strip them of all that pertaineth not unto Thee, and will draw them nigh unto Thy Self.

input: و ایّدهم علی حبّک و رضائک ثمّ استقمهم علی صراط امرک الّذی زلّ عنه اقدام المریبین من بریّتک و المعرضین من عبادک.
output: Assist them, by Thy grace, to love Thee and to conform unto that which shall please Thee. Grant, then, that they may go straight on in the path of Thy Cause, the path wherein have slipped the footsteps of the doubters among Thy people and the froward among Thy servants.

input: و انّک انت المقتدر العزیز العظیم.
output: Thou art, verily, the All Powerful, the Almighty, the Most Great.

input: اسألک بزفرات قلوب العاشقین و دموع عیون المشتاقین ان لا تجعلنی محروماً من نفحات رحمانیّتک فی ایّامک و نغمات ورقآء وحدانیّتک عند ظهور انوار وجهک.
output: I entreat Thee by the sighing of Thy lovers and by the tears shed by them that long to behold Thee, not to withhold from me Thy tender mercies in Thy Day, nor to deprive me of the melodies of the Dove that extolleth Thy oneness before the light that shineth from Thy face.

input: فیا الهی انا المسکین.
output: I am the one who is in misery, O God.

input: قد تشبّثت بذیل اسمک الغنیّ.
output: Behold me cleaving fast to Thy Name, the All Possessing.

input: و انا الفانی قد تمسّکت بحبل اسمک الباقی.
output: I am the one who is sure to perish. behold me clinging to Thy Name, the Imperishable.

input: اذاً اسألک بنفسک العلیّ الأعلی ان لا تدعنی بنفسی و هوای.
output: I implore Thee, therefore, by Thy Self, the Exalted, the Most High, not to abandon me unto mine own self and unto the desires of a corrupt inclination.

input: خذ یدی بأیادی اقتدارک و خلّصنی عن غمرات الظّنون و الأوهام و طهّرنی عن کلّ ما یکرهه رضاک.
output: Hold Thou my hand with the hand of Thy power, and deliver me from the depths of my fancies and idle imaginings, and cleanse me of all that is abhorrent unto Thee.

input: ثمّ اجعلنی مقبلاً الیک و متوکّلاً علیک و لائذاً بحضرتک و هارباً الی نفسک.
output: Cause me, then, to turn wholly unto Thee, to put my whole trust in Thee, to seek Thee as my Refuge, and to flee unto Thy face.

input: و انّک انت الّذی تفعل ما تشآء بقدرتک و تحکم ما ترید بارادتک.
output: Thou art, verily, He Who, through the power of His might, doeth whatsoever He desireth, and commandeth, through the potency of His will, whatsoever He chooseth.

input: لا مانع لما قضیت و لا رادّ لما امضیت.
output: None can withstand the operation of Thy decree. none can divert the course of Thine appointment

input: ترانی مقبلاً الیک و متوجّهاً الی شطر فضلک و الطافک
output: Thou seest how I have turned myself toward Thee, and set my face in the direction of Thy grace and Thy gifts.

input: اسألک باسمک الّذی به سقیت الموحّدین خمر رحمتک و المقرّبین کوثر عنایتک بأن تجعلنی بکلّی منقطعاً عن الأوهام و مقبلاً الی شطر فضلک یا مولی الأنام.
output: I implore Thee, by Thy name through which Thou didst enable all them that have recognized Thy unity to partake of the wine of Thy mercy, and all such as have drawn nigh unto Thee to quaff the living waters of Thy loving kindness, to rid me entirely of all vain imaginings, and to incline me in the direction of Thy grace, O Thou Who art the Lord of all men.

input: یا الهی ایّدنی فی ایّام ظهور مظهر امرک و مطلع وحیک لأخرق الحجبات الّتی منعتنی عن الاقبال الیک و الانغماس فی بحر عرفانک.
output: Graciously assist me, O my God, in the days of the Manifestation of Thy Cause and of the Dayspring of Thy Revelation, to tear asunder the veils which have hindered me from recognizing Thee, and from immersing myself beneath the ocean of Thy knowledge.

input: خذ یدی بأیادی قدرتک ثمّ اجعلنی منجذباً من نغمات ورقآء احدیّتک بحیث لا اری فی الوجود الّا طلعتک یا مقصود و لا فی الشّهود الّا ظهورات قدرتک یا ودود.
output: Hold Thou me with the hands of Thy power, and grant that I may be so carried away by the sweet melodies of the Dove of Thy oneness, that I will cease to regard in all creation any face except Thy face, O Thou the Goal of my desire, and will recognize in the visible world naught else save the evidences of Thy might, O Thou Who art the God of mercy.

input: ای ربّ انا المسکین و انت الغنیّ المتعال و انا الضّعیف و انت القویّ الحاکم فی المبدإ و المآب لا تجعلنی محروماً من نفحات وحیک و لا مأیوساً من الفیوضات الّتی نزّلت من سمآء الطافک.
output: I am but a wretched creature, O my Lord, and Thou art the All Possessing, the Most High. and I am all weakness, and Thou art the Almighty, and the Supreme Ordainer in both the beginning and the end. Withhold not from me the fragrances of Thy Revelation, and shatter not my hopes in the outpourings which have been sent down out of the heaven of Thy gifts.

input: قدّر لی یا الهی خیر الدّنیا و الآخرة و ما ینفعنی فی کلّ عالم من عوالمک لأنّی لا اعلم نفعی و ضرّی
output: Ordain Thou for me, O my God, the good of this world and the world to come, and grant me what will profit me in every world of Thy worlds, for I know not what will help or harm me.

input: و انّک انت العلیم الخبیر.
