input: ثمّ ارحم هذا المفتقر الّذی ما اتّخذ لنفسه ولیّاً دونک و لا انیساً سواک و لا مصاحباً غیرک و لا محبوباً الّا انت و لا مقصوداً الّا ایّاک.
output: Have mercy, then, upon this poor and desolate soul who hath sought no friend but Thee, and no companion except Thee, and no comforter save Thee, and no beloved apart from Thee, nor cherished any desire but Thyself.

input: ثمّ انظرنی یا الهی بلحظات رحمتک ثمّ اغفر جریراتی و جریرات احبّتک الّتی حالت بیننا و بین انزال نصرک و افضالک.
output: Cast, then, upon me, O my God, the glances of Thy mercy, and forgive me my trespasses and the trespasses of them that are dear to Thee, and which come in between us and the revelation of Thy triumph and Thy grace.

input: ثمّ کفّر عنّا سیّئات الّتی احتجبت بها وجوهنا عن ملاحظة انوار شمس الطافک.
output: Cancel Thou, moreover, our sins which have shut off our faces from the splendors of the Daystar of Thy favors.

input: و تحکم کیف تشآء لا تسأل عمّا شئت بسلطانک و لا تردّ عمّا قضیت بقضائک. لا اله الّا انت العزیز القادر الحیّ الرّؤف
output: Thou ordainest what Thou willest, and art not asked of what Thou wishest through the power of Thy sovereignty, nor canst Thou be frustrated in whatsoever Thou prescribest through Thine irrevocable decree. No God is there save Thee, the Almighty, the Most Powerful, the Ever-living, the Most Compassionate

input: لوح ابن ذئب
output: Epistle to the Son of the Wolf

input: بسم الله الفرد الواحد المقتدر العلیم الحکیم.
output: In the name of God, the One, the Incomparable, the All-Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

input: الحمد لله الباقی بلا فنآء و الدّائم بلا زوال و القائم بلا انتقال.
output: Praise be to God, the Eternal that perisheth not, the Everlasting that declineth not, the Self-Subsisting that altereth not.

input: المهیمن بسلطانه و الظّاهر بآیاته و الباطن بأسراره.
output: He it is Who is transcendent in His sovereignty, Who is manifest through His signs, and is hidden through His mysteries.

input: الّذى بأمره ارتفعت رایة الکلمة العلیا فى ناسوت الانشآء و نصب علم یفعل ما یشآء بین الوری.
output: He it is at Whose bidding the standard of the Most Exalted Word hath been lifted up in the world of creation, and the banner of He doeth whatsoever He willeth raised amidst all peoples.

input: هو الّذى اظهر امره لهدایة خلقه و انزل آیاته اظهاراً لحجّته و برهانه و زیّن دیباج کتاب الانسان بالبیان بقوله الرّحمن علّم القرآن خلق الانسان علّمه البیان.
output: He it is Who hath revealed His Cause for the guidance of His creatures, and sent down His verses to demonstrate His Proof and His Testimony, and embellished the preface of the Book of Man with the ornament of utterance through His saying: The God of Mercy hath taught the Qur'án, hath created man, and taught him articulate speech.

input: لا اله الّا هو الفرد الواحد المقتدر العزیز المنّان.
output: No God is there but Him, the One, the Peerless, the Powerful, the Mighty, the Beneficent.

input: النّور السّاطع من افق سمآء العطآء و الصّلوة المشرقة من مطلع ارادة الله مالک ملکوت الأسمآء على الواسطة الکبری و القلم الأعلی الّذی جعله الله مطلع اسمائه الحسنی و مشرق صفاته العلیا.
output: The light that is shed from the heaven of bounty, and the benediction that shineth from the dawning-place of the will of God, the Lord of the Kingdom of Names, rest upon Him Who is the Supreme Mediator, the Most Exalted Pen, Him Whom God hath made the Dawning-Place of His most excellent names and the Dayspring of His most exalted attributes.

input: و به اشرق نور التّوحید من افق العالم و حکم التّفرید بین الأمم الّذین اقبلوا بوجوه نورآء الی الأفق الأعلی و اعترفوا بما نطق به لسان البیان فى ملکوت العرفان الملک و الملکوت و العظمة و الجبروت لله المقتدر العزیز الفیاض!
output: Through Him the light of unity hath shone forth above the horizon of the world, and the law of oneness hath been revealed amidst the nations, who, with radiant faces, have turned towards the Supreme Horizon, and acknowledged that which the Tongue of Utterance hath spoken in the kingdom of His knowledge: Earth and heaven, glory and dominion, are God's, the Omnipotent, the Almighty, the Lord of grace abounding!

input: یا ایّها العالم الجلیل اسمع ندآء المظلوم.
output: Give ear, O distinguished divine, unto the voice of this Wronged One.

input: انّه ینصحک لوجه الله و یعظک بما یقرّبک الیه فی کلّ الأحوال.
output: He verily, counselleth thee for the sake of God, and exhorteth thee unto that which will cause thee to draw nigh unto Him under all conditions.

input: انّه هو الغنیّ المتعال.
output: He, in truth, is the All-Possessing, the Exalted.

input: اعلم انّ الآذان خلقت لاصغآء النّدآء فی هذا الیوم الّذی کان مذکوراً فى الکتب و الزّبر و الألواح.
output: Know thou that the ear of man hath been created that it may hearken unto the Divine Voice on this Day that hath been mentioned in all the Books, Scriptures, and Tablets.

input: فی اوّل الأمر طهّر نفسک بمآء الانقطاع و زیّن رأسک باکلیل التّقوی و هیکلک بطراز التّوکّل علی الله.
output: Purify thou, first, thy soul with the waters of renunciation, and adorn thine head with the crown of the fear of God, and thy temple with the ornament of reliance upon Him.

input: ثمّ قم عن مقامک مقبلاً الی البیت الأعظم مطاف من فی العالم من لدن مالک القدم و قل
output: Arise, then, and, with thy face set towards the Most Great House, the Spot round which, as decreed by the Eternal King, all that dwell on earth must circle, recite:

input: الهی الهی و مقصودی و معبودی و سیّدی و سندی و غایة املی و رجائی!
output: O God, my God, and my Desire, and my Adored One, and my Master, and my Mainstay, and my utmost Hope, and my supreme Aspiration!

input: ترانی مقبلاً الیک و متمسّکاً بحبل جودک و متشبّثاً بذیل عطائک و معترفاً بتقدیس نفسک و تنزیه ذاتک مقرّاً بوحدانیّتک و فردانیّتک.
output: Thou seest me turning towards Thee, holding fast unto the cord of Thy bounty, clinging to the hem of Thy generosity, acknowledging the sanctity of Thy Self and the purity of Thine Essence, and testifying to Thy unity and Thy oneness.

input: اشهد انّک انت الفرد الواحد الأحد الصّمد.
output: I bear witness that Thou art the One, the Single, the Incomparable, the Ever-Abiding.

input: ما اتّخذت لنفسک شریکاً فی الملک و لا نظیراً فی الأرض.
output: Thou didst not take unto Thyself a partner in Thy dominion, nor didst Thou choose a peer for Thyself upon earth.

input: قد شهدت الکائنات بما شهد به لسان عظمتک قبلها.
output: All created things have borne witness unto that which the Tongue of Thy grandeur hath testified ere their creation.

input: انّک انت الله لا اله الّا انت!
output: Verily Thou art God; there is none other God but Thee!

input: لم تزل کنت مقدّساً عن ذکر عبادک و متعالیاً عن وصف خلقک.
output: From everlasting Thou wast sanctified from the mention of Thy servants, and exalted above the description of Thy creatures.

input: ای ربّ تری الجاهل قصد بحر علمک و العطشان کوثر بیانک و الذّلیل خبآء عزّک و الفقیر کنز غنائک و السّائل مشرق حکمتک و الضّعیف مطلع قدرتک و المسکین سمآء کرمک و الکلیل ملکوت ذکرک.
output: Thou beholdest, O Lord, the ignorant seeking the ocean of Thy knowledge, the sore athirst the living waters of Thine utterance, the abased the tabernacle of Thy glory, the poor the treasury of Thy riches, the suppliant the dawning-place of Thy wisdom, the weak the source of Thy strength, the wretched the heaven of Thy bounty, the dumb the kingdom of Thy mention.

input: اشهد یا الهی و سلطانی بأنّک خلقتنی لذکرک و ثنائک و نصرة امرک.
output: I testify, O my God, and my King, that Thou hast created me to remember Thee, to glorify Thee, and to aid Thy Cause.

input: و انّى نصرت اعدائک الّذین نقضوا عهدک و نبذوا کتابک و کفروا بک و بآیاتک.
output: And yet, I have aided Thine enemies, who have broken Thy Covenant, who have cast away Thy Book, disbelieved in Thee, and repudiated Thy signs.

input: آه آه من غفلتی و خجلتی و خطیئتی و جریرتی الّتی منعتنی عن الورود فی طمطام بحر احدیّتک و قمقام یمّ رحمتک.
output: Alas, alas, for my waywardness, and my shame, and my sinfulness, and my wrong-doing that have withheld me from the depths of the ocean of Thy unity and from fathoming the sea of Thy mercy.

input: فآه آه!
output: Wherefore, alas, alas!

input: ثمّ آه آه!
output: and again alas, alas!

input: من سوء حالی و کبر عصیانی!
output: for my wretchedness and the grievousness of my transgressions!

input: قد اظهرتنی یا الهی لاعلآء کلمتک و اظهار امرک.
output: Thou didst call me into being, O my God, to exalt Thy Word, and to manifest Thy Cause.

input: ولکن غفلتی منعتنی و احاطت بی بحیث قمت على محو آثارک و سفک دمآء اولیائک و مطالع آیاتک و مشارق وحیک و مخازن اسرارک.
output: My heedlessness, however, hath deterred me and compassed me about, in such wise that I have arisen to blot out Thy signs, and to shed the blood of Thy loved ones, and of the dawning-places of Thy signs, and of the daysprings of Thy revelation, and of the repositories of Thy mysteries.

input: ای ربّ ای ربّ!
output: O Lord, my Lord!

input: ای ربّ ای ربّ ای ربّ!
output: and again, O Lord, my Lord!

input: ای ربّ ای ربّ ای ربّ ای ربّ!
output: and yet again, O Lord, my Lord!

input: فآه آه من ظلمی!
output: O the cruelties, the glaring cruelties, I inflicted!

input: فآه آه من بعدی و غفلتی و جهلی و ذلّتی و اعراضی و اعتراضی!
output: Woe is me, woe is me, for my remoteness from Thee, and for my waywardness, and mine ignorance, and my baseness, and my repudiation of Thee, and my protests against Thee!

input: کم من ایّام فیها امرت عبادک و اولیائک علی حفظی و انّی امرتهم بضرّک و ضرّ امنائک!
output: How many the days during which Thou didst bid Thy servants and Thy loved ones to protect me, whilst I commanded them to harm Thee and to harm them that Thou didst trust!

input: و کم من لیال فیها ذکرتنی بفضلک و دللتنی الی صراطک و انّی اعرضت عنک و عن آیاتک!
output: And how numerous the nights during which Thou didst graciously remember me, and didst show me Thy path, whilst I turned away from Thee and from Thy signs!

input: وعزّتک!
output: By Thy glory!

input: یا امل الموحّدین و رجآء افئدة المنقطعین!
output: O Thou Who art the Hope of such as have acknowledged Thy unity, and the Desire of the hearts of them that are rid of all attachment to any save Thee!

input: لا اجد لنفسی دونک معیناً و لا سواک سلطاناً و لا ملجأً و لا ملاذاً.
output: I find no succorer except Thee, nor king, nor refuge, nor haven besides Thyself.

input: اعراضی احرق ستر عصمتی و اعتراضی شقّ حجاب حرمتی.
output: My turning away from Thee hath burnt up the veil of mine integrity, and my denial of Thee hath rent asunder the covering cast over mine honor.

input: یا لیت کنت تحت اطباق التّراب و ما ظهر سوء اعمالی بین عبادک!
output: O would that I were beneath the depths of the earth, so that my evil deeds would remain unknown to Thy servants!

input: جریراتی العظمی منعتنی عن التّقرّب الی بساط رحمتک و خطیئاتی الکبری ابعدتنی عن ساحة قربک.
output: My mighty sins have prevented me from approaching the court of Thy mercy, and my monstrous deeds have caused me to stray far from the sanctuary of Thy presence.

input: کلّما زادت شقوتی زاد حلمک و کلّما اشتعلت نار عصیانی سترها عفوک و فضلک.
output: As mine iniquities waxed greater and greater, Thy forbearance towards me augmented, and as the fire of my rebelliousness grew fiercer, the more did Thy forgiveness and Thy grace seek to smother up its flame.

input: یا مقصود العالم و محبوب الأمم!
output: O Thou Who art the desire of the world and the Best-Beloved of the nations!

input: صبرک غرّنی و اصطبارک شجّعنی.
output: Thy long-suffering hath puffed me up, and Thy patience hath emboldened me.

input: وعظمتک!
output: I swear by the greatness of Thy majesty!

input: لا اجد لنفسی مقرّاً الّا ظلّ بساط کرمک و لا مهرباً الّا تحت قباب رحمتک.
output: I can find for myself no habitation save beneath the shadow of the court of Thy bounty, nor any refuge except under the canopy of Thy mercy.

input: ترانی فی بحر الیأس و القنوط بعدما اسمعتنی کلمة لا تقنطوا.
output: Thou seest me in the midst of a sea of despair and of hopelessness, after Thou didst cause me to hear Thy words Despair not.

input: ظلمی قطع حبل املی و عصیانی سوّد وجهی امام کرسیّ عدلک.
output: My sore injustice hath severed the cord of my hope, and my rebellion hath darkened my face before the throne of Thy justice.

input: ای ربّ تری المیّت مطروحاً لدی باب عطائک و یستحیی ان یطلب کوثر عفوک من ید فضلک.
output: Thou beholdest, O my God, him who is as one dead fallen at the door of Thy favor, ashamed to seek from the hand of Thy loving-kindness the living waters of Thy pardon.

input: قد اعطیتنی لساناً لذکرک و ثنائک و انّه نطق بما ذابت به اکباد المقرّبین من اصفیائک و احترقت افئدة المخلصین من اهل حظائر قدسک.
output: Thou hast given me a tongue wherewith to remember and praise Thee, and yet it uttereth that which hath caused the souls of such of Thy chosen ones as are nigh unto Thee to melt, and the hearts of the sincere amongst the dwellers of the habitations of holiness to be consumed.

input: لم ادر یا الهی ایّ عصیانی اذکره تلقآء امواج بحر جودک و ایّ خطأی انطق به عند تجلّیات انوار شموس مواهبک و الطافک.
output: I know not, O my God, which among my evildoings to mention before the billowing ocean of Thy favor, nor which of my trespasses to declare when face to face with the splendors of the suns of Thy goodly gifts and bounties.

input: اسألک فى هذا الحین بأسرار کتابک و ما کان مکنوناً فی علمک و باللّآلئ المستورة فی اصداف عمّان رحمتک ان تجعلنی من الّذین ذکرتهم فی کتابک و وصفتهم فی الواحک.
output: I beseech Thee, this very moment, by the mysteries of Thy Book, and by the things hid in Thy knowledge, and by the pearls that lie concealed within the shells of the ocean of Thy mercy, to reckon me among such as Thou didst mention in Thy Book and describe in Thy Tablets.

input: هل قدّرت لی یا الهی بعد هذا الحزن من سرور و بعد هذا القبض من بسط و بعد هذا العسر من یسر؟ فآه آه!
output: Hast Thou decreed for me, O my God, any joy after this tribulation, or any relief to succeed this affliction, or any ease to follow this trouble? Alas, alas!

input: قد جعلت المنابر لذکرک و ارتفاع کلمتک و اظهار امرک و انّی ارتقیت الیها لاعلآء نقض عهدک و القیت علی العباد ما ناح به اهل سرادق عظمتک و سکّان مدائن علمک.
output: Thou hast ordained that every pulpit be set apart for Thy mention, and for the glorification of Thy Word, and the revelation of Thy Cause, but I have ascended it to proclaim the violation of Thy Covenant, and have spoken unto Thy servants such words as have caused the dwellers of the Tabernacles of Thy majesty and the denizens of the Cities of Thy wisdom to lament.

input: کم من اوقات انزلت فیها مائدة بیانک من سمآء عطائک و انّی کفرت بها و کم من احیان دعوتنی فیها الی فرات رحمتک و انّی اعرضت عنه بما اتّبعت النّفس و الهوی!
output: How often hast Thou sent down the food of Thine utterance out of the heaven of Thy bounty, and I denied it; and how numerous the occasions on which Thou hast summoned me to the soft flowing waters of Thy mercy, and I have chosen to turn away therefrom, by reason of my having followed my own wish and desire!

input: لم ادر من ایّ ذنب استغفرک و اتوب الیک و من ایّ ظلم ارجع الی بساط جودک و ساحة کرمک.
output: I know not for which sin to beg Thy forgiveness and implore Thy pardon, nor from which of mine iniquities to turn aside unto the Court of Thy bounteousness and the Sanctuary of Thy favor.

input: قد بلغت جریراتی و خطیئاتی مقاماً عجز المحصون عن احصائها و المحرّرون عن تحریرها.
output: Such are my sins and trespasses that no man can number them, nor pen describe them.

input: اسألک یا مبدّل الظّلمة بالنّور و مظهر الأسرار فی الطّور ایّدنی فی کلّ الأحوال علی التّوکّل علیک و تفویض الأمور الیک.
output: I implore Thee, O Thou that turnest darkness into light, and revealest Thy mysteries on the Sinai of Thy Revelation, to aid me, at all times, to put my trust in Thee, and to commit mine affairs unto Thy care.

input: ثمّ اجعلنی یا الهی راضیاً بما رقم من قلم قضائک و یراعة تقدیرک.
output: Make me, then, O my God, content with that which the finger of Thy decree hath traced, and the pen of Thy ordinance hath written.

input: انّک انت المقتدر علی ما تشآء و فی قبضتک زمام من فی السّموات و الأرضین.
output: Potent art Thou to do what pleaseth Thee, and in Thy grasp are the reins of all that are in heaven and on earth.

input: لا اله الّا انت العلیم الحکیم.
output: No God is there but Thee, the All-knowing, the All-Wise.

input: یا شیخ!
output: O Shaykh!

input: اعلم انّ مفتریات العباد و اعراضهم و اعتراضهم لا تضرّ من تمسّک بحبل العنایة و تشبّث بأذیال رحمة مالک البریّة.
output: Know thou that neither the calumnies which men may utter, nor their denials, nor any cavils they may raise, can harm him that hath clung to the cord of the grace, and seized the hem of the mercy, of the Lord of creation.

input: لعمر الله!
output: By God!

input: انّ البهآء ما نطق عن الهوی.
output: He, the Glory of God (Bahá), hath spoken not from mere impulse.

input: قد انطقه الّذی انطق الأشیآء بذکره و ثنائه.
output: He that hath given Him a voice is He that hath given a voice unto all things, that they may praise and glorify Him.

input: لا اله الّا هو الفرد الواحد المقتدر المختار.
output: There is none other God but Him, the One, the Incomparable, the Lord of strength, the Unconditioned.

input: صاحبان ابصار حدیده و آذان واعیه و قلوب منیره و صدور منشرحه صدق را از کذب بشناسند و تمیز دهند.
output: They whose sight is keen, whose ears are retentive, whose hearts are enlightened, and whose breasts are dilated, recognize both truth and falsehood, and distinguish the one from the other.

input: این مناجات را که از لسان مظلوم جاری شده قرائت نمائید و بقلب فارغ و سمع طاهر مقدّس در آن تفکّر فرمائید شاید نفحات انقطاع را بیابید و بر خود و عباد رحم کنید
output: Recite thou this prayer that hath flowed from the tongue of this Wronged One, and ponder thereon with a heart rid of all attachment, and with ears that are pure and sanctified, be attentive to its meaning, that haply thou mayest inhale the breath of detachment and have pity upon thyself and upon others:

input: الها معبودا مقصودا کریما رحیما!
output: My God, the Object of my adoration, the Goal of my desire, the All-Bountiful, the Most Compassionate!

input: جانها از تو و اقتدارها در قبضهٔ قدرت تو.
output: All life is of Thee, and all power lieth within the grasp of Thine omnipotence.

input: هر که را بلند کنی از ملک بگذرد و بمقام و رفعناه مقاماً علیّاً رسد!
output: Whosoever Thou exaltest is raised above the angels, and attaineth the station: Verily, We uplifted him to a place on high!

input: و هر که را بیندازی از خاک پستتر بلکه هیچ از او بهتر.
output: and whosoever Thou dost abase is made lower than dust, nay, less than nothing.

input: پروردگارا!
output: O Divine Providence!

input: با تباه‌کاری و گناهکاری و عدم پرهیزکاری مقعد صدق میطلبیم و لقاء اولیائت را میجوئیم.
output: Though wicked, sinful, and intemperate, we still seek from Thee a 'seat of truth,' and long to behold the countenance of the Omnipotent King.

input: امر امر تو و حکم آن تو و عالم قدرت زیر فرمان تو.
output: It is Thine to command, and all sovereignty belongeth to Thee, and the realm of might boweth before Thy behest.

input: هر چه کنی عدل صرفست بل فضل محض.
output: Everything Thou doest is pure justice, nay, the very essence of grace.

input: یک تجلّی از تجلّیات اسم رحمانت رسم عصیان را از جهان براندازد و محو نماید و یک نسیم از نسائم یوم ظهورت عالم را بخلعت تازه مزیّن نماید.
output: One gleam from the splendors of Thy Name, the All-Merciful, sufficeth to banish and blot out every trace of sinfulness from the world, and a single breath from the breezes of the Day of Thy Revelation is enough to adorn all mankind with a fresh attire.

input: ای توانا ناتوانان را توانائی بخش و مردگان را زندگی عطا فرما شاید ترا بیابند و بدریای آگاهیت راه یابند و بر امرت مستقیم مانند.
output: Vouchsafe Thy strength, O Almighty One, unto Thy weak creatures, and quicken them who are as dead, that haply they may find Thee, and may be led unto the ocean of Thy guidance, and may remain steadfast in Thy Cause.

input: اگر از لغات مختلفهٔ عالم عرف ثنای تو متضوّع شود همه محبوب جان و مقصود روان چه تازی چه پارسی.
output: Should the fragrance of Thy praise be shed abroad by any of the divers tongues of the world, out of the East or out of the West, it would, verily, be prized and greatly cherished.

input: اگر از آن محروم ماند قابل ذکر نه چه الفاظ چه معانی.
output: If such tongues, however, be deprived of that fragrance, they assuredly would be unworthy of any mention, in word or yet in thought.

input: ای پروردگار از تو میطلبم کل را راه نمائی و هدایت فرمائی.
output: We beg of Thee, O Providence, to show Thy way unto all men, and to guide them aright.

input: توئی قادر و توانا و عالم و بینا.
output: Thou art, verily, the Almighty, the Most Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Seeing.

input: نسأل الله ان یؤیّدک علی العدل و الانصاف و یعرّفک ما کان مستوراً عن العیون و الأبصار.
output: We beseech God to aid thee to be just and fair-minded, and to acquaint thee with the things that were hidden from the eyes of men.

input: انّه هو العزیز المختار.
output: He, in truth, is the Mighty, the Unconstrained.

input: استدعا آنکه در آنچه ظاهر شده تفکّر نمایند و بعدل و انصاف تکلّم فرمایند شاید تجلّیات انوار آفتاب صدق و صفا پرتو افکند و از تاریکی نادانی نجات بخشد و عالم را بنور دانائی روشن فرماید.
output: We ask thee to reflect upon that which hath been revealed, and to be fair and just in thy speech, that perchance the splendors of the daystar of truthfulness and sincerity may shine forth, and may deliver thee from the darkness of ignorance, and illumine the world with the light of knowledge.

input: این مظلوم مدارس نرفته مباحث ندیده.
output: This Wronged One hath frequented no school, neither hath He attended the controversies of the learned.

input: لعمری!
output: By My life!

input: انّی ما اظهرت نفسی بل الله اظهرنی کیف اراد.
output: Not of Mine own volition have I revealed Myself, but God, of His own choosing, hath manifested Me.

input: در لوح حضرت سلطان ایّده الله تبارک و تعالى این کلمات از لسان مظلوم جاری
output: In the Tablet, addressed to His Majesty the Sháh—may God, blessed and glorified be He, assist him—these words have streamed from the tongue of this Wronged One:

input: یا سلطان!
output: O King!

input: انّی کنت کأحد من العباد و راقداً على المهاد مرّت علیّ نسائم السّبحان و علّمنی علم ما کان.
output: I was but a man like others, asleep upon My couch, when lo, the breezes of the All-Glorious were wafted over Me, and taught Me the knowledge of all that hath been.

input: لیس هذا من عندی بل من لدن عزیز علیم.
output: This thing is not from Me, but from One Who is Almighty and All-Knowing.

input: و امرنی بالنّدآء بین الأرض و السّمآء بذلک ورد علیّ ما ذرفت به دموع العارفین.
output: And He bade Me lift up My voice between earth and heaven, and for this there befell Me what hath caused the tears of every man of understanding to flow.

input: ما قرأت ما عند النّاس من العلوم و ما دخلت المدارس.
output: The learning current amongst men I studied not; their schools I entered not.

input: فاسأل المدینة الّتی کنت فیها لتوقن بأنّی لست من الکاذبین.
output: Ask of the city wherein I dwelt, that thou mayest be well assured that I am not of them who speak falsely.

input: هذه ورقة حرّکتها اریاح مشیّة ربّک العزیز الحمید.
output: This is but a leaf which the winds of the will of thy Lord, the Almighty, the All-Praised, have stirred.

input: هل لها استقرار عند هبوب اریاح عاصفات؟ لا ومالک الأسمآء و الصّفات!
output: Can it be still when the tempestuous winds are blowing? Nay, by Him Who is the Lord of all Names and Attributes!

input: بل تحرّکها کیف ترید.
output: They move it as they list.

input: لیس للعدم وجود تلقآء القدم.
output: The evanescent is as nothing before Him Who is the Ever-Abiding.

input: قد جآء امره المبرم و انطقنی بذکره بین العالمین.
output: His all-compelling summons hath reached Me, and caused Me to speak His praise amidst all people.

input: انّی لم اکن الّا کالمیّت تلقآء امره.
output: I was indeed as one dead when His behest was uttered.

input: قلّبتنی ید ارادة ربّک الرّحمن الرّحیم.
output: The hand of the will of thy Lord, the Compassionate, the Merciful, transformed Me.

input: حال بهتر آنکه آن جناب خود را بماء انقطاع که از معین قلم اعلی جاری شده طاهر نمایند و لوجه الله در آنچه از قبل و بعد ظاهر شده و یا نازل گشته تفکّر کنند و بعد بحکمت و بیان در اخماد نار ضغینه و بغضا که در قلوب احزاب عالم مکنونست بقدر مقدور ساعى و جاهد شوند.
output: Now is the moment in which to cleanse thyself with the waters of detachment that have flowed out from the Supreme Pen, and to ponder, wholly for the sake of God, those things which, time and again, have been sent down or manifested, and then to strive, as much as lieth in thee, to quench, through the power of wisdom and the force of thy utterance, the fire of enmity and hatred which smouldereth in the hearts of the peoples of the world.

input: مقصود از ارسال رسل و انزال کتب معرفة الله و الفت و اتّحاد عباد بوده.
output: The Divine Messengers have been sent down, and their Books were revealed, for the purpose of promoting the knowledge of God, and of furthering unity and fellowship amongst men.

input: حال ملاحظه میشود شریعت الهی را سبب و علّت بغضا و عناد نموده‌اند.
output: But now behold, how they have made the Law of God a cause and pretext for perversity and hatred.

input: زهی حسرت و ندامت که اکثری به ما عندهم متمسّک و مشغول و از ما عند الله غافل و محجوب!
output: How pitiful, how regrettable, that most men are cleaving fast to, and have busied themselves with, the things they possess, and are unaware of, and shut out as by a veil from, the things God possesseth!

input: قل الهی الهی!
output: Say: O God, my God!

input: زیّن رأسی باکلیل العدل و هیکلی بطراز الانصاف.
output: Attire mine head with the crown of justice, and my temple with the ornament of equity.

input: انّک انت مالک المواهب و الألطاف.
output: Thou, verily, art the Possessor of all gifts and bounties.

input: عدل و انصاف دو حارسند از برای حفظ عباد.
output: Justice and equity are twin Guardians that watch over men.

input: و از این دو کلمات محکمهٔ مبارکه که علّت صلاح عالم و حفظ امم است ظاهر گردد.
output: From them are revealed such blessed and perspicuous words as are the cause of the well-being of the world and the protection of the nations.

input: در یکی از الواح از قلم مظلوم این کلمات جاری حقّ جلّ جلاله از برای ظهور جواهر معانی از معدن انسانی آمده یعنی مشارق امر و مخازن لآلی علم او چه که انّه تعالی غیب مکنون مستور عن الأنظار.
output: These words have streamed from the pen of this Wronged One in one of His Tablets: The purpose of the one true God, exalted be His glory, hath been to bring forth the Mystic Gems out of the mine of man—they Who are the Dawning-Places of His Cause and the Repositories of the pearls of His knowledge; for, God Himself, glorified be He, is the Unseen, the One concealed and hidden from the eyes of men.

input: انظر ما انزله الرّحمن فی الفرقان لا تدرکه الأبصار و هو یدرک الأبصار و هو اللّطیف الخبیر!
output: Consider what the Merciful hath revealed in the Qur'án: No vision taketh in Him, but He taketh in all vision, and He is the Subtile, the All-Informed!'

input: الیوم دین الله و مذهب الله آنکه مذاهب مختلفه و سبل متعدّده را سبب و علّت بغضا ننمایند.
output: That the divers communions of the earth, and the manifold systems of religious belief, should never be allowed to foster the feelings of animosity among men, is, in this Day, of the essence of the Faith of God and His Religion.

input: این اصول و قوانین و راههای محکم متین از مطلع واحد ظاهر و از مشرق واحد مشرق.
output: These principles and laws, these firmly-established and mighty systems, have proceeded from one Source, and are rays of one Light.

input: و این اختلافات نظر بمصالح وقت و زمان و قرون و اعصار بوده.
output: That they differ one from another is to be attributed to the varying requirements of the ages in which they were promulgated.

input: ای اهل بها کمر همّت را محکم نمائید که شاید جدال و نزاع مذهبی از بین اهل عالم مرتفع شود و محو گردد.
output: Gird up the loins of your endeavor, O people of Bahá, that haply the tumult of religious dissension and strife that agitateth the peoples of the earth may be stilled, that every trace of it may be completely obliterated.

input: حبّاً لله و لعباده بر این امر عظیم خطیر قیام نمائید.
output: For the love of God, and them that serve Him, arise to aid this sublime and momentous Revelation.

input: ضغینه و بغضای مذهبی ناریست عالم‌سوز و اطفاء آن بسیار صعب.
output: Religious fanaticism and hatred are a world-devouring fire, whose violence none can quench.

input: مگر ید قدرت الهی ناس را از این بلاء عقیم نجات بخشد.
output: The Hand of Divine power can, alone, deliver mankind from this desolating affliction.

input: در محاربهٔ واقعهٔ بین دولتین ملاحظه نمائید طرفین از مال و جان گذشتند.
output: Consider the war that hath involved the two Nations, how both sides have renounced their possessions and their lives.

input: چه مقدار قریه‌ها کأن لم یکن ملاحظه شد!
output: How many the villages that were completely wiped out!

input: مشکوة بیان را این کلمه بمثابهٔ مصباح است ای اهل عالم همه بار یک دارید و برگ یک شاخسار.
output: The utterance of God is a lamp, whose light is these words: Ye are the fruits of one tree, and the leaves of one branch.

input: بکمال محبّت و اتّحاد و مودّت و اتّفاق سلوک نمائید.
output: Deal ye one with another with the utmost love and harmony, with friendliness and fellowship.

input: قسم بآفتاب حقیقت!
output: He Who is the Daystar of Truth beareth Me witness!

input: نور اتّفاق آفاق را روشن و منوّر سازد.
output: So powerful is the light of unity that it can illuminate the whole earth.

input: حقّ آگاه گواه این گفتار بوده و هست.
output: The One true God, He Who knoweth all things, Himself testifieth to the truth of these words.

input: جهد نمائید تا باین مقام بلند اعلی که مقام صیانت و حفظ عالم انسانیست فائز شوید.
output: Exert yourselves that ye may attain this transcendent and most sublime station, the station that can insure the protection and security of all mankind.

input: این قصد سلطان مقاصد و این امل ملیک آمال.
output: This goal excelleth every other goal, and this aspiration is the monarch of all aspirations.

input: ولکن تا افق آفتاب عدل از سحاب تیرهٔ ظلم فارغ نشود ظهور این مقام مشکل بنظر میآید.
output: So long, however, as the thick clouds of oppression, which obscure the daystar of justice, remain undispelled, it would be difficult for the glory of this station to be unveiled to men's eyes.

input: و سحاب تیره مظاهر ظنون و اوهامند یعنی علمای ایران.
output: These thick clouds are the exponents of idle fancies and vain imaginings, who are none other but the divines of Persia.

input: گاهی بلسان شریعت و هنگامی بلسان حقیقت و طریقت نطق نمودیم و مقصد اقصی و غایت قصوی ظهور این مقام بلند اعلى بوده.
output: At one time We spoke in the language of the lawgiver; at another in that of the truth-seeker and the mystic, and yet Our supreme purpose and highest wish hath always been to disclose the glory and sublimity of this station.

input: و کفی بالله شهیداً!
output: God, verily, is a sufficient witness!

input: ای اهل بها با جمیع اهل عالم بروح و ریحان معاشرت نمائید.
output: Consort with all men, O people of Bahá, in a spirit of friendliness and fellowship.

input: اگر نزد شما کلمه‌ئی و یا جوهریست که دون شما از آن محروم بلسان محبّت و شفقت القا نمائید و بنمائید.
output: If ye be aware of a certain truth, if ye possess a jewel, of which others are deprived, share it with them in a language of utmost kindliness and goodwill.

input: اگر قبول شد و اثر نمود مقصد حاصل.
output: If it be accepted, if it fulfill its purpose, your object is attained.

input: والّا او را باو گذارید و در بارهٔ او دعا نمائید.
output: If anyone should refuse it, leave him unto himself, and beseech God to guide him.

input: نه جفا.
output: Beware lest ye deal unkindly with him.

input: لسان شفقت جذّاب قلوبست.
output: A kindly tongue is the lodestone of the hearts of men.

input: و مائدهٔ روح و بمثابهٔ معانی است از برای الفاظ و مانند افق است از برای اشراق آفتاب حکمت و دانائی.
output: It is the bread of the spirit, it clotheth the words with meaning, it is the fountain of the light of wisdom and understanding.

input: مقصود از علما در این موارد که ذکر شده نفوسی هستند که خود را در ظاهر بلباس علم میآرایند و در باطن از آن محروم.
output: By divines in the passage cited above is meant those men who outwardly attire themselves with the raiment of knowledge, but who inwardly are deprived therefrom.

input: در ذکر این مقام در لوح حضرت سلطان چند فقره از فقرات کلمات مکنونه که باسم صحیفهٔ فاطمیّه صلوات الله علیها از قلم ابهی ظاهر ذکر میشود!
output: In this connection, We quote from the Tablet addressed to His Majesty the Sháh, certain passages from the Hidden Words which were revealed by the Abhá Pen under the name of the Book of Fátimih, the blessings of God be upon her!

input: ای بیوفایان!
output: O ye that are foolish, yet have a name to be wise!

input: چرا در ظاهر دعوی شبانی کنید و در باطن ذئب اغنام من شده‌اید؟ مثل شما مثل ستارهٔ قبل از صبح است که در ظاهر درّی و روشن است و در باطن سبب اضلال و هلاکت کاروانهای مدینه و دیار منست.
output: Wherefore do ye wear the guise of the shepherd, when inwardly ye have become wolves, intent upon My flock? Ye are even as the star, which riseth ere the dawn, and which, though it seem radiant and luminous, leadeth the wayfarers of My city astray into the paths of perdition.

input: و همچنین میفرماید ای بظاهر آراسته و بباطن کاسته!
output: And likewise He saith: O ye seeming fair yet inwardly foul!

input: مثل تو مثل آب تلخ صافیست که کمال لطافت و صفا از آن در ظاهر مشاهده شود و چون بدست صرّاف ذائقهٔ احدیّه افتد قطره‌ئی از آن را قبول نفرماید.
output: Ye are like clear but bitter water, which to outward seeming is crystal pure but of which, when tested by the Divine Assayer, not a drop is accepted.

input: تجلّی آفتاب در تراب و مرآت هر دو موجود ولکن از فرقدان تا ارض فرق دان بلکه فرق بی‌منتهى در میان!
output: Yea, the sunbeam falls alike upon the dust and the mirror, yet differ they in reflection even as doth the star from the earth: nay, immeasurable is the difference!

input: و همچنین میفرماید ای پسر دنیا!
output: And also He saith: O essence of desire!

input: بسا سحرگاهان تجلّی عنایت من از مشرق لامکان بمکان تو آمد و ترا در بستر راحت بغیر مشغول دید.
output: At many a dawn have I turned from the realms of the Placeless unto thine abode, and found thee on the bed of ease busied with others than Myself.

input: و چون برق روحانی بمقرّ عزّ نورانی رجوع نمود و در مکامن قرب نزد جنود قدس اظهار نداشتم و خجلت ترا نپسندیدم.
output: Thereupon, even as the flash of the spirit, I returned to the realms of celestial glory, and breathed it not in My retreats above unto the hosts of holiness.

input: و همچنین میفرماید ای مدّعی دوستی من!
output: And again He saith: O bond slave of the world!

input: در سحرگاهان نسیم عنایت من بر تو مرور نمود و ترا در فراش غفلت خفته یافت.
output: Many a dawn hath the breeze of My loving-kindness wafted over thee and found thee upon the bed of heedlessness fast asleep.

input: و بر حال تو گریست و بازگشت.
output: Bewailing then thy plight it returned whence it came.

input: امّا علمائی که فی‌الحقیقه بطراز علم و اخلاق مزیّنند ایشان بمثابهٔ رأسند از برای هیکل عالم و مانند بصرند از برای امم.
output: Those divines, however, who are truly adorned with the ornament of knowledge and of a goodly character are, verily, as a head to the body of the world, and as eyes to the nations.

input: لازال هدایت عباد بآن نفوس مقدّسه بوده و هست.
output: The guidance of men hath, at all times, been, and is, dependent upon such blessed souls.

input: نسأل الله ان یوفّقهم علی ما یحبّ و یرضى.
output: We beseech God to graciously aid them to do His will and pleasure.

input: انّه هو مولی الوری و ربّ الآخرة و الأولی.
output: He, in truth, is the Lord of all men, the Lord of this world and of the next.

input: انّا سمعنا انّ جنابک اعرضت عنّا و اعترضت علینا حیث امرت النّاس بسبّی و افتیت علی سفک دمآء العباد لله.
output: We have learned that thou hast turned away from Us, and protested against Us, in such wise that thou hast bidden the people to curse Me, and decreed that the blood of the servants of God be shed.

input: درّ من قال
output: God requite him who said:

input: طوعاً لقاض اتی فی حکمه عجباً
output: Willingly will I obey the judge who hath so strangely decreed

input: افتی بسفک دمی فی الحلّ و الحرم!
output: that my blood be spilt at Hill and at Haram!

input: براستی میگویم آنچه در سبیل الهی وارد شود محبوب جانست و مقصود روان.
output: Verily I say: Whatever befalleth in the path of God is the beloved of the soul and the desire of the heart.

input: سمّ مهلک در سبیلش شهدیست فائق و عذابش عذبیست لائق.
output: Deadly poison in His path is pure honey, and every tribulation a draught of crystal water.

input: در لوح حضرت سلطان ذکر شده ونفسه الحقّ!
output: In the Tablet to His Majesty the Sháh it is written: By Him Who is the Truth!

input: لا اجزع من البلایا فی سبیله و لا من الرّزایا فی حبّه.
output: I fear no tribulation in His path, nor any affliction in My love for Him.

input: قد جعل الله البلآء غادیة لهذه الدّسکرة الخضرآء و ذبالة لمصباحه الّذی به اشرقت الأرض و السّمآء.
output: Verily God hath made adversity as a morning dew upon His green pasture, and a wick for His lamp which lighteth earth and heaven.

input: اقبل بقلبک الی شطر کعبة الله المهیمن القیّوم ثمّ ارفع یدیک باستقامة ترتفع بها ایادی الممکنات الی سمآء فضل الله ربّ العالمین.
output: Set thine heart towards Him Who is the Kaaba of God, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting, and raise thou thine hands with such firm conviction as shall cause the hands of all created things to be lifted up towards the heaven of the grace of God, the Lord of all worlds.

input: ثمّ وجّه الیه بتوجّه تتوجّه به الکائنات الی افقه المشرق المنیر و قل ای ربّ ترانی مقبلاً الی سمآء جودک و بحر عطائک و معرضاً عن دونک.
output: Turn, then, thy face towards Him in such wise that the faces of all beings will turn in the direction of His shining and luminous Horizon, and say: Thou seest me, O my Lord, with my face turned towards the heaven of Thy bounty and the ocean of Thy favor, withdrawn from all else beside Thee.

input: اسألک بتجلّیات نیّر ظهورک فی الطّور و باشراقات شمس فضلک من افق اسمک الغفور ان تغفر لی و ارحمنی.
output: I ask of Thee, by the splendors of the Sun of Thy revelation on Sinai, and the effulgences of the Orb of Thy grace which shineth from the horizon of Thy Name, the Ever-Forgiving, to grant me Thy pardon and to have mercy upon me.

input: ثمّ اکتب لی من قلمک الأعلی ما یرفعنی باسمک فی ناسوت الانشآء.
output: Write down, then, for me with Thy pen of glory that which will exalt me through Thy Name in the world of creation.

input: ای ربّ وفّقنی علی التّوجّه الیک و اصغآء ندآء اولیائک الّذین ما اضعفتهم قوّة العالم و ما منعتهم سطوة الأمم اقبلوا و قالوا الله ربّنا و ربّ من فی السّموات و الأرضین!
output: Aid me, O my Lord, to set myself towards Thee, and to hearken unto the voice of Thy loved ones, whom the powers of the earth have failed to weaken, and the dominion of the nations has been powerless to withhold from Thee, and who, advancing towards Thee, have said: 'God is our Lord, the Lord of all who are in heaven and all who are on earth!'

input: براستی میگویم ختم رحیق مختوم باسم قیّوم برداشته شد خود را محروم منما.
output: Verily I say, the seal of the Choice Wine hath, in the name of Him Who is the Self-Subsisting, been broken; withhold not thyself therefrom.

input: این مظلوم لوجه الله میگوید تو هم لوجه الله در آنچه نازل شده و ظاهر گشته تفکّر نما شاید از فیوضات فیّاض حقیقی در این یوم مبارک نصیب برداری و محروم نمانی.
output: This Wronged One speaketh wholly for the sake of God; thou too shouldst, likewise, for the sake of God, meditate upon those things that have been sent down and manifested, that haply thou mayest, on this blessed Day, take thy portion of the liberal effusions of Him Who is truly the All-Bountiful, and mayest not remain deprived thereof.

input: لیس هذا علی الله بعزیز.
output: This indeed would not be hard for God.

input: آدم خاکی از کلمهٔ الهی عرشی شد و صیّاد ماهی دارای حکمت ربّانی گشت حضرت ابوذر راعی غنم بود سیّد امم شد!
output: Dust-made Adam was raised up, through the Word of God, to the heavenly throne, and a mere fisherman was made the repository of Divine wisdom, and Abú-Dhar, the shepherd, became a prince of the nations!

input: یا شیخ امروز روز علوم و فنون ظاهره نبوده و نیست چه که ملاحظه شد نفسی که بیک کلمه از آن علوم آگاه نه بر کرسیّ عقیان در صدر مجلس عرفان مستوی و صاحب علوم و دارای فنون محروم.
output: This Day, O Shaykh, hath never been, nor is it now, the Day whereon man-made arts and sciences can be regarded as a true standard for men, since it hath been recognized that He Who was wholly unversed in any of them hath ascended the throne of purest gold, and occupied the seat of honor in the council of knowledge, whilst the acknowledged exponent and repository of these arts and sciences remained utterly deprived.

input: مقصود از این علوم علومىیست که از لفظ ابتدا شود و بلفظ منتهی گردد.
output: By arts and sciences is meant those which begin with words and end with words.

input: ولکن علومی که اثر و ثمر از آن ظاهر و سبب راحت و آسایش عباد است عندالله مقبول بوده و هست.
output: Such arts and sciences, however, as are productive of good results, and bring forth their fruit, and are conducive to the well-being and tranquility of men have been, and will remain, acceptable before God.

input: لو تسمع ندائی تدع ما عندک و تتوجّه الى مقام ماج فیه بحر الحکمة و البیان و هاج عرف عنایة ربّک الرّحمن.
output: Wert thou to give ear to My voice, thou wouldst cast away all thy possessions, and wouldst set thy face towards the Spot wherein the ocean of wisdom and of utterance hath surged, and the sweet savors of the loving-kindness of thy Lord, the Compassionate, have wafted.

input: در این مقام بنظر آمد فی‌الجمله از امور گذشته ذکر شود شاید سبب ظهور عدل و انصاف گردد.
output: We deem it advisable, in this connection, to recount briefly some past events, that perchance they may be the means of vindicating the cause of equity and justice.

input: این مظلوم در ایّامی که حضرت سلطان ایّده الله ربّه الرّحمن عزم توجّه به اصفهان نموده اذن حاصل کرده قصد زیارت بقاع مقدّسهٔ منوّرهٔ ائمّه صلوات الله علیهم نموده!
output: At the time when His Majesty the Sháh, may God, his Lord, the Most Merciful, aid him through His strengthening grace, was planning a journey to Isfahán, this Wronged One, having obtained his permission, visited the holy and luminous resting-places of the Imáms, may the blessings of God be upon them!

input: و بعد از رجوع نظر بگرمی هواء دارالخلافة و شدّت آن به لواسان رفتیم.
output: Upon Our return, We proceeded to Lavásán on account of the excessive heat prevailing in the capital.

input: و بعد از توجّه حکایت حضرت سلطان ایّده الله تبارک و تعالی واقع.
output: Following Our departure, there occurred the attempt upon the life of His Majesty, may God, exalted and glorified be He, assist him.

input: و در آن ایّام امور منقلب و نار غضب مشتعل.
output: Those days were troublous days, and the fires of hatred burned high.

input: جمعی را اخذ نمودند از جمله این مظلوم را.
output: Many were arrested, among them this Wronged One.

input: ابداً داخل آن امر منکر نبودیم و در مجالس تحقیق هم عدم تقصیر ثابت.
output: We were in no wise connected with that evil deed, and Our innocence was indisputably established by the tribunals.

input: مع‌ذلک ما را اخذ نمودند و از نیاوران که در آن ایّام مقرّ سلطنت بوده سر برهنه و پای برهنه پیاده با زنجیر بسجن طهران بردند.
output: Nevertheless, they apprehended Us, and from Níyávarán, which was then the residence of His Majesty, conducted Us, on foot and in chains, with bared head and bare feet, to the dungeon of Tihrán.

input: چه که یک ظالمی سواره همراه کلاه از سر برداشت و بسرعت تمام با جمعى از میرغضبان و فرّاشان ما را بردند.
output: A brutal man, accompanying Us on horseback, snatched off Our hat, whilst We were being hurried along by a troop of executioners and officials.

input: و چهار شهر در مقامی که شبه و مثل نداشت مقرّ معیّن نمودند.
output: We were consigned for four months to a place foul beyond comparison.

input: امّا سجن که محلّ مظلوم و مظلومان بوده فى‌الحقیقه دخمهٔ تنگ تاریک از آن افضل بوده.
output: As to the dungeon in which this Wronged One and others similarly wronged were confined, a dark and narrow pit were preferable.

input: و چون وارد حبس شدیم بعد از ورود ما را داخل دالانی ظلمانی نمودند از آنجا از سه پلّهٔ سراشیب گذشتیم و بمقرّی که معیّن نموده بودند رسیدیم.
output: Upon Our arrival We were first conducted along a pitch-black corridor, from whence We descended three steep flights of stairs to the place of confinement assigned to Us.

input: امّا محل تاریک و معاشر قریب صد و پنجاه نفس از سارقین اموال و قاتلین نفوس و قاطعین طرق بوده.
output: The dungeon was wrapped in thick darkness, and Our fellow prisoners numbered nearly a hundred and fifty souls: thieves, assassins and highwaymen.

input: مع این جمعیّت محل منفذ نداشت جز طریقی که وارد شدیم.
output: Though crowded, it had no other outlet than the passage by which We entered.

input: اقلام از وصفش عاجز و روائح منتنه‌اش خارج از بیان.
output: No pen can depict that place, nor any tongue describe its loathsome smell.

input: و آن جمع اکثری بى لباس و فراش.
output: Most of these men had neither clothes nor bedding to lie on.

input: الله یعلم ما ورد علینا فى ذاک المقام الأنتن الأظلم!
output: God alone knoweth what befell Us in that most foul-smelling and gloomy place!

input: و در ایّام و لیالی در سجن مذکور در اعمال و احوال و حرکات حزب بابی تفکّر مینمودیم که مع علوّ و سموّ و ادراک آن حزب آیا چه شده که از ایشان چنین عملی ظاهر یعنى جسارت و حرکت آن حزب نسبت بذات شاهانه.
output: Day and night, while confined in that dungeon, We meditated upon the deeds, the condition, and the conduct of the Bábís, wondering what could have led a people so high-minded, so noble, and of such intelligence, to perpetrate such an audacious and outrageous act against the person of His Majesty.

input: و بعد این مظلوم اراده نمود که بعد از خروج از سجن بتمام همّت در تهذیب آن نفوس قیام نماید.
output: This Wronged One, thereupon, decided to arise, after His release from prison, and undertake, with the utmost vigor, the task of regenerating this people.

input: و در شبی از شبها در عالم رؤیا از جمیع جهات این کلمهٔ علیا اصغا شد انّا ننصرک بک و بقلمک.
output: One night, in a dream, these exalted words were heard on every side: Verily, We shall render Thee victorious by Thyself and by Thy Pen.

input: لا تحزن عمّا ورد علیک و لا تخف انّک من الآمنین.
output: Grieve Thou not for that which hath befallen Thee, neither be Thou afraid, for Thou art in safety.

input: سوف یبعث الله کنوز الأرض و هم رجال ینصرونک بک و باسمک الّذی به احیا الله افئدة العارفین.
output: Erelong will God raise up the treasures of the earth—men who will aid Thee through Thyself and through Thy Name, wherewith God hath revived the hearts of such as have recognized Him.

input: و چون مظلوم از سجن خارج حسب الأمر حضرت پادشاه حرسه الله تعالى مع غلام دولت علیّهٔ ایران و دولت بهیّهٔ روس به عراق عرب توجّه نمودیم.
output: And when this Wronged One went forth out of His prison, We journeyed, in pursuance of the order of His Majesty the Sháh—may God, exalted be He, protect him—to 'Iráq, escorted by officers in the service of the esteemed and honored governments of Persia and Russia.

input: و بعد از ورود باعانت الهی و فضل و رحمت ربّانی آیات بمثل غیث هاطل نازل و باطراف ارض ارسال شد.
output: After Our arrival, We revealed, as a copious rain, by the aid of God and His Divine Grace and mercy, Our verses, and sent them to various parts of the world.

input: و جمیع عباد را مخصوص این حزب را بمواعظ حکیمانه و نصایح مشفقانه نصیحت نمودیم و از فساد و نزاع و جدال و محاربه منع کردیم.
output: We exhorted all men, and particularly this people, through Our wise counsels and loving admonitions, and forbade them to engage in sedition, quarrels, disputes and conflict.

input: تا آنکه از فضل الهی غفلت و نادانی ببر و دانائی بدل گشت و سلاح باصلاح.
output: As a result of this, and by the grace of God, waywardness and folly were changed into piety and understanding, and weapons converted into instruments of peace.

input: و در ایّام توقّف در سجن ارض طاء اگرچه نوم از زحمت سلاسل و روائح منتنه قلیل بود ولکن بعضى از اوقات که دست میداد احساس میشد از جهت اعلای رأس چیزى بر صدر میریخت بمثابهٔ رودخانهٔ عظیمى که از قلّهٔ جبل باذخ رفیعی بر ارض بریزد.
output: During the days I lay in the prison of Tihrán, though the galling weight of the chains and the stench-filled air allowed Me but little sleep, still in those infrequent moments of slumber I felt as if something flowed from the crown of My head over My breast, even as a mighty torrent that precipitateth itself upon the earth from the summit of a lofty mountain.

input: و بآن جهت از جمیع اعضا آثار نار ظاهر.
output: Every limb of My body would, as a result, be set afire.

input: و در آن حین لسان قرائت مینمود آنچه را که بر اصغاء آن احدى قادر نه.
output: At such moments My tongue recited what no man could bear to hear.

input: و بعضی از بیانات که در الواح مخصوص این حزب نازل ذکر میشود تا بیقین مبین کل بدانند که این مظلوم عمل نموده آنچه را که نزد عقلا و مظاهر عدل و انصاف محبوب و مقبول بوده
output: We shall herewith cite a few passages from Tablets specifically revealed to this people, so that every one may know of a certainty that this Wronged One hath acted in a manner which hath been pleasing and acceptable unto men endued with insight, and unto such as are the exponents of justice and equity:

input: یا اولیآء الله فى بلاده و احبّائه فى دیاره!
output: O ye friends of God in His cities and His loved ones in His lands!

input: یوصیکم المظلوم بالأمانة و الدّیانة.
output: This Wronged One enjoineth on you honesty and piety.

input: طوبی لمدینة فازت بأنوارهما.
output: Blessed the city that shineth by their light.

input: بهما یرتفع مقام الانسان و یفتح باب الاطمینان على من فى الامکان.
output: Through them man is exalted, and the door of security is unlocked before the face of all creation.

input: طوبی لمن تمسّک بهما و عرف شأنهما و ویل لمن انکر مقامهما.
output: Happy the man that cleaveth fast unto them, and recognizeth their virtue, and woe betide him that denieth their station.

input: و در مقام دیگر این کلمات نازل انّا نأمر عباد الله و امائه بالعصمة و التّقوى لیقومنّ من رقد الهوی و یتوجّهنّ الى الله فاطر الأرض و السّمآء.
output: And in another connection these words were revealed: We enjoin the servants of God and His handmaidens to be pure and to fear God, that they may shake off the slumber of their corrupt desires, and turn toward God, the Maker of the heavens and of the earth.

input: کذلک امرنا العباد حینما اشرق نیّر الآفاق من جهة العراق.
output: Thus have We commanded the faithful when the Daystar of the world shone forth from the horizon of 'Iráq.

input: لیس ضرّی سجنی و بلائی و ما ورد علیّ من طغاة العباد.
output: My imprisonment doeth Me no harm, neither the tribulations I suffer, nor the things that have befallen Me at the hands of My oppressors.

input: بل عمل الّذین ینسبون انفسهم الی نفسی و یرتکبون ما ینوح به قلبی و قلمی.
output: That which harmeth Me is the conduct of those who, though they bear My name, yet commit that which maketh My heart and My pen to lament.

input: انّ الّذین یفسدون فى الأرض و یتصرّفون فى اموال النّاس و یدخلون البیوت من غیر اذن صاحبها انّى بریء منهم الّا ان یتوبوا و یرجعوا الى الله الغفور الرّحیم.
output: They that spread disorder in the land, and lay hands on the property of others, and enter a house without leave of its owner, We, verily, are clear of them, unless they repent and return unto God, the Ever-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.

input: و در مقام دیگر یا ملأ الأرض!
output: And in another connection: O peoples of the earth!

input: سارعوا الى مرضاة الله و جاهدوا حقّ الجهاد فی اظهار امره المبرم المتین.
output: Haste ye to do the pleasure of God, and war ye valiantly, as it behooveth you to war, for the sake of proclaiming His resistless and immovable Cause.

input: قد قدّرنا الجهاد فی سبیل الله بجنود الحکمة و البیان و بالأخلاق و الأعمال.
output: We have decreed that war shall be waged in the path of God with the armies of wisdom and utterance, and of a goodly character and praiseworthy deeds.

input: کذلک قضی الأمر من لدن قویّ قدیر.
output: Thus hath it been decided by Him Who is the All-Powerful, the Almighty.

input: لیس الفخر لمن یفسد فى الأرض بعد اصلاحها.
output: There is no glory for him that committeth disorder on the earth after it hath been made so good.

input: اتّقوا الله یا قوم و لا تکونوا من الظّالمین.
output: Fear God, O people, and be not of them that act unjustly.

input: و در مقام دیگر لا تسبّوا احداً بینکم.
output: And again in another connection: Revile ye not one another.

input: قد جئنا لاتّحاد من علی الأرض و اتّفاقهم.
output: We, verily, have come to unite and weld together all that dwell on earth.

input: یشهد بذلک ما ظهر من بحر بیانی بین العباد ولکنّ القوم اکثرهم فى بعد مبین.
output: Unto this beareth witness what the ocean of Mine utterance hath revealed amongst men, and yet most of the people have gone astray.

input: ان یسبّکم احد او یمسّکم ضرّ فى سبیل الله اصبروا و توکّلوا علی السّامع البصیر.
output: If anyone revile you, or trouble touch you, in the path of God, be patient, and put your trust in Him Who heareth, Who seeth.

input: انّه یشهد و یری و یعمل ما اراد بسلطان من عنده.
output: He, in truth, witnesseth, and perceiveth, and doeth what He pleaseth, through the power of His sovereignty.

input: انّه هو المقتدر القدیر.
output: He, verily, is the Lord of strength, and of might.

input: قد منعتم عن النّزاع و الجدال فی کتاب الله العزیز العظیم.
output: In the Book of God, the Mighty, the Great, ye have been forbidden to engage in contention and conflict.

input: تمسّکوا بما تنتفع به انفسکم و اهل العالم.
output: Lay fast hold on whatever will profit you, and profit the peoples of the world.

input: کذلک یأمرکم مالک القدم الظّاهر بالاسم الأعظم.
output: Thus commandeth you the King of Eternity, Who is manifest in His Most Great Name.

input: انّه هو الآمر الحکیم.
output: He, verily, is the Ordainer, the All-Wise.

input: و در مقام دیگر ایّاکم ان تسفکوا الدّمآء.
output: And yet again in another connection: Beware lest ye shed the blood of any one.

input: اخرجوا سیف اللّسان عن غمد البیان لأنّ به تفتح مدائن القلوب.
output: Unsheathe the sword of your tongue from the scabbard of utterance, for therewith ye can conquer the citadels of men's hearts.

input: انّا رفعنا حکم القتل عن بینکم.
output: We have abolished the law to wage holy war against each other.

input: انّ الرّحمة سبقت الممکنات ان کنتم تعلمون.
output: God's mercy hath, verily, encompassed all created things, if ye do but understand.

input: و در مقام دیگر یا قوم!
output: And yet again in another connection: O people!

input: لا تفسدوا فی الأرض و لا تسفکوا الدّمآء و لا تأکلوا اموال النّاس بالباطل و لا تتّبعوا کلّ ناعق رجیم.
output: Spread not disorder in the land, and shed not the blood of any one, and consume not the substance of others wrongfully, neither follow every accursed prattler.

input: و در مقام دیگر آفتاب بیان الهی را غروب اخذ ننماید و افول از پی درنیاید.
output: And still again in another connection: The Sun of Divine Utterance can never set, neither can its radiance be extinguished.

input: امروز این کلمهٔ علیا از سدرهٔ منتهى اصغا شد انّى لمن احبّنی و اخذ اوامری و نبذ ما نهی عنه فى کتابی.
output: These sublime words have, in this day, been heard from the Lote-Tree beyond which there is no passing: I belong to him that loveth Me, that holdeth fast My commandments, and casteth away the things forbidden him in My Book.

input: و در مقام دیگر امروز روز ذکر و ثنا و روز خدمتست خود را محروم منمائید.
output: And still again in another connection: This is the day to make mention of God, to celebrate His praise, and to serve Him; deprive not yourselves thereof.

input: شمائید حروفات کلمات و کلمات کتاب.
output: Ye are the letters of the words, and the words of the Book.

input: و شما نهالهائی هستید که از دست عنایت در ارض رحمت کشته شده‌اید و از امطار کرم نموّ نموده‌اید.
output: Ye are the saplings which the hand of Loving-kindness hath planted in the soil of mercy, and which the showers of bounty have made to flourish.

input: شما را از عاصفات شرک و قاصفات کفر حفظ فرمود و بایادی شفقت تربیت نمود.
output: He hath protected you from the mighty winds of misbelief, and the tempestuous gales of impiety, and nurtured you with the hands of His loving providence.

input: حال وقت اثمار و اوراقست.
output: Now is the time for you to put forth your leaves, and yield your fruit.

input: و اثمار سدرهٔ انسانی اعمال طیّبه و اخلاق مرضیّه بوده و هست.
output: The fruits of the tree of man have ever been and are goodly deeds and a praiseworthy character.

input: این اثمار را از غافلین منع منمائید.
output: Withhold not these fruits from the heedless.

input: اگر پذیرفتند مقصود حاصل و حیات ظاهر.
output: If they be accepted, your end is attained, and the purpose of life achieved.

input: والّا ذروهم فى خوضهم یلعبون.
output: If not, leave them in their pastime of vain disputes.

input: یا حزب الله جهد نمائید شاید قلوب احزاب مختلفهٔ عالم بآب بردباری و شفقت شما از ضغینه و بغضا پاک و پاکیزه شود و قابل و لائق تجلّیات آفتاب حقیقت گردد.
output: Strive, O people of God, that haply the hearts of the divers kindreds of the earth may, through the waters of your forbearance and loving-kindness, be cleansed and sanctified from animosity and hatred, and be made worthy and befitting recipients of the splendors of the Sun of Truth.

input: در اشراق چهارم از اشراقات ذکر نمودیم از برای هر امری ناصری لازم.
output: In the fourth Ishráq splendor of the Ishráqát Tablet of Splendors We have mentioned: Every cause needeth a helper.

input: و جنود منصوره در این ظهور اعمال و اخلاق پسندیده است.
output: In this Revelation the hosts which can render it victorious are the hosts of praiseworthy deeds and upright character.

input: و قائد و سردار این جنود تقوی الله بوده اوست دارای کل و حاکم بر کل.
output: The leader and commander of these hosts hath ever been the fear of God, a fear that encompasseth all things, and reigneth over all things.

input: در تجلّی سوّم از کتاب تجلّیات ذکر نمودیم سبب علوّ وجود و سموّ آن علوم و فنون و صنائع است.
output: In the third Tajallí effulgence of the Book of Tajallíyát Book of Effulgences We have mentioned: Arts, crafts and sciences uplift the world of being, and are conducive to its exaltation.

input: علم بمنزلهٔ جناحست از برای وجود و مرقاتست از برای صعود.
output: Knowledge is as wings to man's life, and a ladder for his ascent.

input: تحصیلش بر کل لازم.
output: Its acquisition is incumbent upon everyone.

input: ولکن علومی که اهل ارض از آن منتفع شوند نه علومی که از حرف ابتدا شود و بحرف منتهی گردد.
output: The knowledge of such sciences, however, should be acquired as can profit the peoples of the earth, and not those which begin with words and end with words.

input: صاحبان علوم و صنائع را حقّ عظیم است بر اهل عالم.
output: Great indeed is the claim of scientists and craftsmen on the peoples of the world.

input: یشهد بذلک امّ البیان فى هذا المقام المبین.
output: Unto this beareth witness the Mother Book in this conspicuous station.

input: فی‌الحقیقه کنز حقیقی از برای انسان علم اوست و اوست علّت عزّت و نعمت و فرح و نشاط و بهجت و انبساط.
output: In truth, knowledge is a veritable treasure for man, and a source of glory, of bounty, of joy, of exaltation, of cheer and gladness unto him.

input: طوبی لمن تمسّک به و ویل للغافلین.
output: Happy the man that cleaveth unto it, and woe betide the heedless.

input: آن جناب باید در جمیع احوال عباد را بآنچه سبب ظهور اخلاق روحانیّه و اعمال طیّبه است دعوت فرمایند تا کل آگاه شوند بآنچه که سبب ارتفاع وجود است و بهمّت کامل قصد مقام اعلى و ذروهٔ علیا نمایند.
output: It is incumbent upon thee to summon the people, under all conditions, to whatever will cause them to show forth spiritual characteristics and goodly deeds, so that all may become aware of that which is the cause of human upliftment, and may, with the utmost endeavor, direct themselves towards the most sublime Station and the Pinnacle of Glory.

input: و آنچه سبب اوّل است از برای تربیت خلق خشیة الله بوده.
output: The fear of God hath ever been the prime factor in the education of His creatures.

input: طوبی للفائزین!
output: Well is it with them that have attained thereunto!

input: کلمهٔ اولی که در ورق اوّل فردوس از قلم ابهی مذکور و مسطور اینست براستی میگویم حفظ مبین و حصن متین از برای عموم اهل عالم خشیة الله بوده.
output: The first word which the Abhá Pen hath revealed and inscribed on the first leaf of Paradise is this: Verily I say: The fear of God hath ever been a sure defence and a safe stronghold for all the peoples of the world.

input: اوست سبب اکبر از برای حفظ بشر و علّت کبری از برای صیانت وری.
output: It is the chief cause of the protection of mankind, and the supreme instrument for its preservation.

input: بلی در وجود آیتی موجود و آن انسان را از آنچه شایسته و لائق نیست منع مینماید و حراست میفرماید و نام آن را حیا گذارده‌اند.
output: Indeed, there existeth in man a faculty which deterreth him from, and guardeth him against, whatever is unworthy and unseemly, and which is known as his sense of shame.

input: ولکن این فقره محدود است بمعدودی کل دارای این مقام نبوده و نیستند.
output: This, however, is confined to but a few; all have not possessed, and do not possess, it.

input: باید سلاطین ایّام و علمای انام به دین تمسّک نمایند چه که اوست علّت ظهور خشیة الله فیما سواه.
output: It is incumbent upon the kings and the spiritual leaders of the world to lay fast hold on religion, inasmuch as through it the fear of God is instilled in all else but Him.

input: کلمهٔ ثانی که در ورق ثانی از فردوس ذکر نمودیم اینست قلم بیان در این حین مظاهر قدرت و مشارق اقتدار یعنی حضرات ملوک و سلاطین ایّدهم الله را نصیحت مینماید و به دین و تمسّک بآن وصیّت میکند.
output: The second word We have recorded on the second leaf of Paradise is the following: The Pen of the Divine Expounder exhorteth, at this moment, the manifestations of authority and the sources of power, namely the kings and rulers of the earth—may God assist them—and enjoineth them to uphold the cause of religion, and to cleave unto it.

input: اوست سبب بزرگ از برای نظم جهان و اطمینان من فی الامکان.
output: Religion is, verily, the chief instrument for the establishment of order in the world, and of tranquillity amongst its peoples.

input: سستی ارکان دین سبب قوّت جهّال و جرئت و جسارت شده.
output: The weakening of the pillars of religion hath strengthened the foolish, and emboldened them, and made them more arrogant.

input: براستى میگویم آنچه از مقام بلند دین کاست بر غفلت اشرار افزود.
output: Verily I say: The greater the decline of religion, the more grievous the waywardness of the ungodly.

input: و نتیجه بالأخره هرج و مرج است.
output: This cannot but lead in the end to chaos and confusion.

input: اسمعوا یا اولی الأبصار ثمّ اعتبروا یا اولی الأنظار!
output: Hear Me, O men of insight, and be warned, ye who are endued with discernment!

input: امید آنکه آن جناب در آنچه ذکر شد باذن واعیه اصغا فرمایند شاید عباد را از ما عندهم به ما عند الله آگاه نمایند.
output: It is Our hope that thou wilt hear with attentive ears the things We have mentioned unto thee, that perchance thou mayest turn men away from the things they possess to the things that God possesseth.

input: از حقّ میطلبیم نور انصاف و آفتاب عدل را از سحاب تیرهٔ غفلت نجات بخشد و ظاهر فرماید.
output: We entreat God to deliver the light of equity and the sun of justice from the thick clouds of waywardness, and cause them to shine forth upon men.

input: هیچ نوری بنور عدل معادله نمینماید.
output: No light can compare with the light of justice.

input: آنست سبب نظم عالم و راحت امم.
output: The establishment of order in the world and the tranquillity of the nations depend upon it.

input: در صحیفهٔ بیان این کلمهٔ علیا مسطور و مرقوم بگو ای دوستان!
output: In the Book of Utterance these exalted words have been written down and recorded: Say, O friends!

input: جهد نمائید شاید مصیباتی که فی سبیل الله بر مظلوم و شما وارد شده بین ناس ضایع نشود.
output: Strive that haply the tribulations suffered by this Wronged One and by you, in the path of God, may not prove to have been in vain.

input: بذیل عفّت تمسّک نمائید و همچنین بحبل امانت و دیانت.
output: Cling ye to the hem of virtue, and hold fast to the cord of trustworthiness and piety.

input: صلاح عالم را ملاحظه نمائید نه هوای نفس را.
output: Concern yourselves with the things that benefit mankind, and not with your corrupt and selfish desires.

input: یا حزب المظلوم!
output: O ye followers of this Wronged One!

input: شمائید رعاة عالم اغنام را از ذئب نفس و هوی مقدّس دارید و بطراز تقوی الله مزیّن نمائید.
output: Ye are the shepherds of mankind; liberate ye your flocks from the wolves of evil passions and desires, and adorn them with the ornament of the fear of God.

input: اینست حکم محکم که از قلم قدم در این حین جاری شده.
output: This is the firm commandment which hath, at this moment, flowed out from the Pen of Him Who is the Ancient of Days.

input: سیف الأخلاق و الآداب احدّ من سیوف الحدید.
output: The sword of a virtuous character and upright conduct is sharper than blades of steel.

input: انّ الفطرة فی هذا الحین تنادی و تقول یا قوم!
output: The voice of the true Faith calleth aloud, at this moment, and saith: O people!

input: قد اتی الیوم و اظهرنی ربّی بنور کسفت عند اشراقه شموس البیان.
output: Verily, the Day is come, and My Lord hath made Me to shine forth with a light whose splendor hath eclipsed the suns of utterance.

input: اتّقوا الرّحمن و لا تکونوا من الغافلین.
output: Fear ye the Merciful, and be not of them that have gone astray.

input: کلمهٔ سوّم که در ورق سوّم فردوس ذکر نمودیم اینست یا ابن الانسان!
output: The third word we have recorded on the third leaf of Paradise is this: O son of man!

input: لو تکون ناظراً الی الفضل ضع ما ینفعک و خذ ما ینتفع به العباد.
output: If thine eyes be turned towards mercy, forsake the things that profit thee, and cleave unto that which will profit mankind.

input: و ان تکن ناظراً الى العدل اختر لدونک ما تختاره لنفسک.
output: And if thine eyes be turned towards justice, choose thou for thy neighbor that which thou choosest for thyself.

input: انّ الانسان مرّةً یرفعه الخضوع الی سمآء العزّة و الاقتدار و اخری ینزله الغرور الی مقام الذّلّة و الانکسار.
output: Humility exalteth man to the heaven of glory and power, whilst pride abaseth him to the depths of wretchedness and degradation.

input: یوم عظیم است و ندا بزرگ!
output: Great is the Day, and mighty the Call!

input: در لوحی از الواح این کلمهٔ علیا را ذکر نمودیم اگر عالم روح بتمامه بقوّهٔ سامعه تبدیل شود میتوان گفت لائق اصغاء این ندا است که از افق اعلی مرتفع والّا این آذانهای آلوده بقصص کاذبه لائق نبوده و نیست.
output: In one of Our Tablets We have revealed these exalted words: Were the world of the spirit to be wholly converted into the sense of hearing, it could then claim to be worthy to hearken unto the Voice that calleth from the Supreme Horizon; for otherwise, these ears that are defiled with lying tales have never been, nor are they now, fit to hear it.

input: طوبی للسّامعین و ویل للغافلین.
output: Well is it with them that hearken; and woe betide the wayward.

input: از حقّ جلّ جلاله سائل و آمل که مشارق ثروت و اقتدار و مطالع عزّت و اختیار یعنی ملوک ارض ایّدهم الله را بر صلح اکبر تأیید فرماید.
output: We pray God—exalted be His glory—and cherish the hope that He may graciously assist the manifestations of affluence and power and the daysprings of sovereignty and glory, the kings of the earth—may God aid them through His strengthening grace—to establish the Lesser Peace.

input: اینست سبب اعظم از برای راحت امم.
output: This, indeed, is the greatest means for insuring the tranquillity of the nations.

input: سلاطین آفاق وفّقهم الله باید باتّفاق باین امر که سبب اعظم است از برای حفظ عالم تمسّک فرمایند.
output: It is incumbent upon the Sovereigns of the world—may God assist them—unitedly to hold fast unto this Peace, which is the chief instrument for the protection of all mankind.

input: امید آنکه قیام نمایند بر آنچه سبب آسایش عباد است.
output: It is Our hope that they will arise to achieve what will be conducive to the well-being of man.

input: باید مجلس بزرگی ترتیب دهند و حضرات ملوک و یا وزرا در آن مجلس حاضر شوند و حکم اتّحاد و اتّفاق را جاری فرمایند.
output: It is their duty to convene an all-inclusive assembly, which either they themselves or their ministers will attend, and to enforce whatever measures are required to establish unity and concord amongst men.

input: و از سلاح باصلاح توجّه کنند.
output: They must put away the weapons of war, and turn to the instruments of universal reconstruction.

input: و اگر سلطانی بر سلطانی برخیزد سلاطین دیگر بر منع او قیام نمایند.
output: Should one king rise up against another, all the other kings must arise to deter him.

input: در این صورت عساکر و آلات و ادوات حرب لازم نه الّا علی قدر مقدور لحفظ بلادهم.
output: Arms and armaments will, then, be no more needed beyond that which is necessary to insure the internal security of their respective countries.

input: و اگر باین خیر اعظم فائز شوند اهل مملکت کل براحت و مسرّت بامور خود مشغول گردند و نوحه و ندبهٔ اکثری از عباد ساکن شود.
output: If they attain unto this all-surpassing blessing, the people of each nation will pursue, with tranquillity and contentment, their own occupations, and the groanings and lamentations of most men would be silenced.

input: نسأل الله ان یؤیّدهم على ما یحبّ و یرضی.
output: We beseech God to aid them to do His will and pleasure.

input: انّه هو ربّ العرش و الثّری و مالک الآخرة و الأولی.
output: He, verily, is the Lord of the throne on high and of earth below, and the Lord of this world and of the world to come.

input: احسن و اولی آنکه در آن مجلس خود سلاطین عظام حاضر شوند و حکم فرمایند.
output: It would be preferable and more fitting that the highly honored kings themselves should attend such an assembly, and proclaim their edicts.

input: و هر یک از سلاطین که بر این امر و اجرای آن قیام فرماید او سیّد سلاطین است عند الله.
output: Any king who will arise and carry out this task, he verily will, in the sight of God, become the cynosure of all kings.

input: طوبی له و نعیماً له!
output: Happy is he, and great is his blessedness!

input: در این اراضی هر هنگام نوبت عسکریّه میشود از هر جهتی فزع اکبر ظاهر.
output: In this land, every time men are conscripted for the army, a great terror seizeth the people.

input: و هر یک از دول در هر سنه بر عساکر میافزاید چه که وزرای حرب در این فقره حریصند و به هل من مزید ناطق.
output: Every nation augmenteth, each year, its forces, for their ministers of war are insatiable in their desire to add fresh recruits to their battalions.

input: از قرار مذکور دولت ایران ایّدها الله هم اراده نموده‌اند بر عسکر بیفزایند.
output: We have learned that the government of Persia—may God assist them—have, likewise decided to reinforce their army.

input: نزد مظلوم حال صدهزار عسکر منظّم مرتّب کفایت مینماید.
output: In the opinion of this Wronged One a force of one hundred thousand fully-equipped and well-disciplined men would suffice.

input: امید آنکه آن حضرت بر نور عدل بیفزایند.
output: We hope that thou wilt cause the light of justice to shine more brightly.

input: عدل جندیست قویّ.
output: Justice is a powerful force.

input: اوست در مقام اوّل و رتبهٔ اولی فاتح افئده و قلوب و اوست مبیّن اسرار وجود و دارای رایت محبّت و جود.
output: It is, above all else, the conqueror of the citadels of the hearts and souls of men, and the revealer of the secrets of the world of being, and the standard-bearer of love and bounty.

input: و در خزائن علوم الهی علمی موجود که عمل بآن خوف را زائل مینماید ولکن على قدر مقدور.
output: In the treasuries of the knowledge of God there lieth concealed a knowledge which, when applied, will largely, though not wholly, eliminate fear.

input: و آن ترتیبی است که باید از ایّام طفولیّت بآن عمل شود بسیار فرق مینماید.
output: This knowledge, however, should be taught from childhood, as it will greatly aid in its elimination.

input: و آنچه از آن بکاهد بر جرئت میافزاید.
output: Whatever decreaseth fear increaseth courage.

input: اگر ارادهٔ الهی مدد فرماید شرح مبسوطى در آنچه ذکر شد از قلم بیان جاری میگردد و شاید در مراتب علوم و فنون هم ظاهر شود آنچه که سبب تجدید عالم و امم گردد.
output: Should the Will of God assist Us, there would flow out from the Pen of the Divine Expounder a lengthy exposition of that which hath been mentioned, and there would be revealed, in the field of arts and sciences, what would renew the world and the nations.

input: و همچنین کلمه‌ئی در صحیفهٔ حمرا از قلم اعلی مرقوم و مسطور و آن کلمه قوّت مکنونهٔ در عباد را بتمامها ظاهر فرماید بلکه مثل آن بر آن بیفزاید.
output: A word hath, likewise, been written down and recorded by the Pen of the Most High in the Crimson Book which is capable of fully disclosing that force which is hid in men, nay of redoubling its potency.

input: .نسأل الله تبارک و تعالی ان یؤیّد عباده علی ما یحبّ و یرضی
output: We implore God—exalted and glorified be He—to graciously assist His servants to do that which is pleasing and acceptable unto Him.

input: این ایّام از جمیع جهات اعدا ظاهر و نار بغضا مشتعل.
output: In these days enemies have compassed Us about, and the fire of hatred is kindled.

input: ای اهل ارض!
output: O peoples of the earth!

input: لعمری و عمرکم!
output: By My life and by your own!

input: این مظلوم خیال ریاست نداشته و ندارد.
output: This Wronged One hath never had, nor hath He now any desire for leadership.

input: و مقصود رفع آنچه سبب اختلاف احزاب عالم و تفریق امم است بوده و هست تا کل فارغ و آزاد شوند و بخود پردازند.
output: Mine aim hath ever been, and still is, to suppress whatever is the cause of contention amidst the peoples of the earth, and of separation amongst the nations, so that all men may be sanctified from every earthly attachment, and be set free to occupy themselves with their own interests.

input: استدعا آنکه دوستان این ذیل را بغبار اکاذیب نیالایند و بذکر خوارق عادات که نزد ایشان است از شأن و مقام و تقدیس و تنزیه نکاهند.
output: We entreat Our loved ones not to besmirch the hem of Our raiment with the dust of falsehood, neither to allow references to what they have regarded as miracles and prodigies to debase Our rank and station, or to mar the purity and sanctity of Our name.

input: سبحان‌الله!
output: Gracious God!

input: امروز روزیست که عقلا از این مظلوم اخذ رأی نمایند و از حقّ بطلبند آنچه را که سبب عزّت و آسایش است.
output: This is the day whereon the wise should seek the advice of this Wronged One, and ask Him Who is the Truth what things are conducive to the glory and tranquillity of men.

input: ولکن کل برعکس بر اطفاء این نور ساطع لمیع جاهد و ساعی و هر نفسی در صدد آنست که تقصیری ثابت نماید و یا ایرادی وارد آورد.
output: And yet, all are earnestly striving to put out this glorious and shining light, and are diligently seeking either to establish Our guilt, or to voice their protest against Us.

input: امر بمقامی رسیده که از جمیع اطوار این مظلوم اظهار نموده‌اند آنچه را که ذکر آن شایسته نیست.
output: Matters have come to such a pass, that the conduct of this Wronged One hath, in every way, been grossly misrepresented, and in a manner which it would be unseemly to mention.

input: یکی از دوستان از نفسی از نفوس مجتمعه در مدینهٔ کبیره ذکر نموده که گفته در هر سنه مبلغ پنجاه‌هزار تومان از وطن به عکّا میرود و بکمال افسوس این فقره را ذکر نمود!
output: One of Our friends hath reported that among the residents of the Great City Constantinople he had heard with the greatest regret someone state that, each year, a sum of fifty thousand tumans was being despatched from his native land to 'Akká!

input: معلوم نشد محاسب که بوده و دفتردار که!
output: It hath not, however, been made clear who had disbursed the sum, nor through whose hands it had passed!

input: باری این مظلوم در جمیع آنچه وارد آورده‌اند و گفته‌اند صابر و صامت چه که اراده آنکه از عنایت حقّ جلّ جلاله و رحمت مسبوقه حکم جدال و نزاع و سفک دماء را از عالم بقوّهٔ بیان محو نمائیم.
output: Briefly, this Wronged One hath, in the face of all that hath befallen Him at their hands, and all that hath been said of Him, endured patiently, and held His peace, inasmuch as it is Our purpose, through the loving providence of God—exalted be His glory—and His surpassing mercy, to abolish, through the force of Our utterance, all disputes, war, and bloodshed, from the face of the earth.

input: در جمیع احوال در آنچه گفته‌اند بصبر جمیل تمسّک جسته‌ایم و بحقّ گذارده‌ایم.
output: Under all conditions We have, in spite of what they have said, endured with seemly patience, and have left them to God.

input: ولکن در جواب این فقره ذکر نمودیم اگر فی‌الحقیقه در آنچه ذکر نموده صادقست باید مالک وجود و سلطان غیب و شهود را شکر نماید که نفسی را از ایران مبعوث فرموده که در سجن من غیر ناصر و معین ایران را تصرّف فرموده و یک مالیات هر سنه از آن اخذ میفرماید.
output: In answer to this particular imputation, however, We have replied, that if that which he affirmeth be true, it behooveth him to be thankful to Him Who is the Lord of all being, and the King of the seen and unseen, for having raised up in Persia One Who, though a prisoner and with none to help and assist Him, hath succeeded in establishing His ascendency over that land, and in drawing from it a yearly revenue.

input: این مقام ستایش است نه نکوهش لو یکون من المنصفین.
output: Such an achievement should be praised rather than censured, if he be of them that judge equitably.

input: و اگر نفسی اراده نماید بر امور این مظلوم واقف شود جواب اینست که در بعضی از لیالی و ایّام اسرای عالم و مظلومهای امم بی‌قوت شب را بروز آورده‌اند و روز را بشب.
output: Should anyone seek to be acquainted with the condition of this Wronged One, let him be told that these captives whom the world hath persecuted and the nations wronged have, for days and nights, been entirely denied the barest means of subsistence.

input: این اذکار را دوست نداشته و نداریم و از گوینده هم شکایت ننموده و نمینمائیم.
output: We are loth to mention such things, neither have We had, nor do We have now, any desire to complain against Our accuser.

input: در این سجن شخص معزّزی چندی از سنگ‌تراشی کسب معاش مینمود و در بعضى از اوقات هم بعضی بطعام الله مرزوق یعنى جوع!
output: Within the walls of this prison a highly esteemed man was for some time obliged to break stones that he might earn a living, whilst others had, at times, to nourish themselves with that Divine sustenance which is hunger!

input: نسأل الله تبارک و تعالی ان یؤیّد الکلّ علی العدل و الانصاف و یوفّقهم علی الانابة و الرّجوع.
output: We entreat God—exalted and glorified be He—to aid all men to be just and fair-minded, and to graciously assist them to repent and return unto Him.

input: انّه هو السّامع المجیب.
output: He, verily, heareth, and is ready to answer.

input: سبحانّک اللّهمّ یا الهی!
output: Glorified art Thou, O Lord my God!

input: تری ما ورد علی المظلوم من الّذین ما عاشرونی و قاموا علی ضرّی و مسکنتی بحیث عجزت الأقلام عن ذکره و الألسن عن بیانه و الألواح عن حمله.
output: Thou seest what hath befallen this Wronged One at the hands of them that have not associated with Me, and who have arisen to harm and abase Me, in a manner which no pen can describe, nor tongue recount, nor can any Tablet sustain its weight.

input: تسمع حنین قلبی و ضجیج کینونتی و ما ورد علی امنائک فی بلادک و اصفیائک فی مملکتک من الّذین نقضوا عهدک و میثاقک.
output: Thou hearest the cry of Mine heart, and the groaning of Mine inmost being, and the things that have befallen Thy trusted ones in Thy cities and Thy chosen ones in Thy land, at the hands of such as have broken Thy Covenant and Thy Testament.

input: ای ربّ اسألک بضجیج العشّاق فی الآفاق و بحنینهم فی بعدهم عن ساحة قربک و بالدّمآء الّتی سفکت فی حبّک و بالأکباد الّتی ذابت فی سبیلک ان تحفظ اولیائک من ظلم الّذین غفلوا من اسرار اسمک المختار.
output: I beseech Thee, O my Lord, by the sighs of Thy lovers throughout the world, and by their lamentation in their remoteness from the court of Thy presence, and by the blood that hath been shed for love of Thee, and by the hearts that have melted in Thy path, to protect Thy loved ones from the cruelty of such as have remained unaware of the mysteries of Thy Name, the Unconstrained.

input: ای ربّ ایّدهم بقدرتک الّتی غلبت الأشیآء و وفّقهم علی الصّبر و الاصطبار.
