output: Say: Whether ye rejoice or whether ye burst for fury, the heavens are cleft asunder, and God hath come down, invested with radiant sovereignty.

input: تنطق الأشیآء کلّها الملک لله المقتدر العلیم الحکیم.
output: All created things are heard exclaiming: The Kingdom is God's, the Almighty, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

input: ثمّ اعلم بأنّا فی سجن عظیم و احاطتنا جنود الظّلم بما اکتسبت ایدی المشرکین.
output: Know thou, moreover, that We have been cast into an afflictive Prison, and are encompassed with the hosts of tyranny, as a result of what the hands of the infidels have wrought.

input: ولکنّ الغلام فی بهجة لا یعادلها ما فی الأرض کلّها.
output: Such is the gladness, however, which the Youth hath tasted that no earthly joy can compare unto it.

input: فی سبیل الله لا یحزنه ضرّ الّذین ظلموا و لا سطوة المنکرین.
output: The harm He suffereth at the hands of the oppressor can never grieve His heart, nor can He be saddened by the ascendancy of such as have repudiated His truth.

input: قل انّ البلآء افق لهذا الأمر.
output: Say: Tribulation is a horizon unto My Revelation.

input: و منه استشرقت شمس الفضل بضیآء لا تمنعه سبحات الأوهام و لا ظنون المعتدین.
output: The daystar of grace shineth above it, and sheddeth a light which neither the clouds of men's idle fancy nor the vain imaginations of the aggressor can obscure.

input: ان اتّبع مولاک ثمّ ذکّر العباد کما انّه یذکرک تحت السّیف و ما منعه نعاق الغافلین....ان انشر نفحات ربّک فی الأطراف و لا توقّف فی امره اقلّ من آن.
output: Follow thou the footsteps of thy Lord, and remember His servants even as He doth remember thee, undeterred by either the clamor of the heedless ones or the sword of the enemy.... Spread abroad the sweet savors of thy Lord, and hesitate not, though it be for less than a moment, in the service of His Cause.

input: سوف یأتی نصرة ربّک الغفور الکریم.
output: The day is approaching when the victory of thy Lord, the Ever-Forgiving, the Most Bountiful, will be proclaimed.

input: قل انّا انزلنا من جهة العرش مآء البیان لینبت به من قلوبکم نبات الحکمة و التّبیان.
output: Say: We have caused the rivers of Divine utterance to proceed out of Our throne, that the tender herbs of wisdom and understanding may spring forth from the soil of your hearts.

input: أ فلا تشکرون.
output: Will ye not be thankful.

input: انّ الّذین استنکفوا عن عبادة ربّهم اولئک قوم مدحضون.
output: They who disdain to worship their Lord shall be of those who are cast off.

input: و اذا تتلی علیهم الآیات یصرّون مستکبرین و یصرّون علی الحنث و لا یشعرون.
output: And oft as Our verses are rehearsed unto them, they persist in proud disdain, and in their gross violation of His law, and know it not.

input: و الّذین کفروا اولئک فی ظلّ من یحموم.
output: As for them who have disbelieved in Him, they shall be in the shadow of a black smoke.

input: قد اتت السّاعة و هم یلعبون.
output: The Hour hath come upon them, while they are disporting themselves.

input: قد اخذوا بناصیتهم و لا یعرفون.
output: They have been seized by their forelock, and yet know it not.

input: قد وقعت الواقعة و هم عنها یفرّون.
output: The thing that must come hath come suddenly.

input: و جآءت الحاقّة و هم عنها معرضون.
output: behold how they flee from it.

input: هذا یوم یهرب فیه کلّ مرء من نفسه و کیف ذوی القربی لو انتم تفقهون.
output: The inevitable hath come to pass. witness how they have cast it behind their backs. This is the Day whereon every man will fly from himself, how much more from his kindred, could ye but perceive it.

input: قد نفخ فی الصّور و نری النّاس هم منصعقون.
output: The blast hath been blown on the trumpet, and lo, mankind hath swooned away before us.

input: و صاح الصّائح و ناد المناد الملک لله المقتدر المهیمن القیّوم.
output: The Herald hath cried out, and the Summoner raised His voice saying: The Kingdom is God's, the Most Powerful, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting.

input: هذا یوم فیه شاخصت الأبصار و فزع من فی الأرض الّا من شآء ربّک العلیم الحکیم.
output: This is the Day on which all eyes shall stare up with terror, the Day in which the hearts of them that dwell on earth shall tremble, save them whom thy Lord, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise, pleaseth to deliver.

input: قد اسودّت الوجوه الّا من اتی الرّحمن بقلب منیر.
output: All faces have turned black except those to whom the God of Mercy hath vouchsafed a radiant heart.

input: قد سکّرت ابصار الّذینهم کفروا عن النّظر الی الله العزیز الحمید.
output: Drunken are the eyes of those men that have openly refused to behold the face of God, the All-Glorious, the All-Praised.

input: قل اما قرأتم القرآن.
output: Say: Perused ye not the Qur'án.

input: فاقرؤوا لعلّ تجدون الحقّ انّه لصراط مستقیم.
output: Read it, that haply ye may find the Truth, for this Book is verily the Straight Path.

input: هذا صراط الله لمن فی السّموات و الأرضین.
output: This is the Way of God unto all who are in the heavens and all who are on the earth.

input: ان نسیتم القرآن لیس البیان عنکم ببعید.
output: If ye have been careless of the Qur'án, the Bayán cannot be regarded to be remote from you.

input: انّه بین ایدیکم.
output: Behold it open before your eyes.

input: ان اقرؤوه لعلّ لا ترتکبوا ما ینوح به المرسلون.
output: Read ye its verses, that perchance ye may desist from committing that which will cause the Messengers of God to mourn and lament.

input: قوموا من الأجداث.
output: Speed out of your sepulchers.

input: الی متی ترقدون.
output: How long will ye sleep.

input: هذه نفخة اخری.
output: The second blast hath been blown on the trumpet.

input: الی من تنظرون.
output: On whom are ye gazing.

input: هذا ربّکم الرّحمن.
output: This is your Lord, the God of Mercy.

input: و انتم تجحدون.
output: Witness how ye gainsay His signs.

input: قد زلزلت الأرض و اخرجت اثقالها.
output: The earth hath quaked with a great quaking, and cast forth her burdens.

input: أ فأنتم تنکرون.
output: Will ye not admit it.

input: قل اما ترون الجبال کالعهن و القوم من سطوة الأمر مضطربون.
output: Say: Will ye not recognize how the mountains have become like flocks of wool, how the people are sore vexed at the awful majesty of the Cause of God.

input: تلک بیوتهم خاویة علی عروشها و هم جند مغرقون.
output: Witness how their houses are empty ruins, and they themselves a drowned host.

input: هذا یوم فیه اتی الرّحمن علی ظلل العرفان بسلطان مشهود.
output: This is the Day whereon the All-Merciful hath come down in the clouds of knowledge, clothed with manifest sovereignty.

input: انّه لهو الشّاهد علی الأعمال. و انّه لهو المشهود لو انتم تعرفون.
output: He well knoweth the actions of men. He it is Whose glory none can mistake, could ye but comprehend it.

input: قد انفطرت سمآء الأدیان و انشقّت ارض العرفان و الملائکة منزلون.
output: The heaven of every religion hath been rent, and the earth of human understanding been cleft asunder, and the angels of God are seen descending.

input: قل هذا یوم التّغابن الی من تهربون.
output: Say: This is the Day of mutual deceit. whither do ye flee.

input: قد مرّت الجبال و طویت السّمآء و الأرض فی قبضته لو انتم تعلمون.
output: The mountains have passed away, and the heavens have been folded together, and the whole earth is held within His grasp, could ye but understand it.

input: هل لأحد من عاصم.
output: Who is it that can protect you.

input: لا فونفسه الرّحمن.
output: None, by Him Who is the All-Merciful.

input: الّا الله المقتدر العزیز المنّان.
output: None, except God, the Almighty, the All-Glorious, the Beneficent.

input: قد وضعت کلّ ذات حمل حملها.
output: Every woman that hath had a burden in her womb hath cast her burden.

input: و نری النّاس سکاری فی هذا الیوم الّذی فیه اجتمع الانس و الجانّ.
output: We see men drunken in this Day, the Day in which men and angels have been gathered together.

input: قل أ فی الله شکّ ها.
output: Say: Is there any doubt concerning God.

input: انّه قد اتی عن مطلع الفضل بقدرة و سلطان.
output: Behold how He hath come down from the heaven of His grace, girded with power and invested with sovereignty.

input: ام فی آیاته.
output: Is there any doubt concerning His signs.

input: ان افتحوا الأبصار انّ هذا لهو البرهان.
output: Open ye your eyes, and consider His clear evidence.

input: قد ازلفت الجنّة عن الیمین و سعّرت الجحیم.
output: Paradise is on your right hand, and hath been brought nigh unto you, while Hell hath been made to blaze.

input: و تلک هی النّیران.
output: Witness its devouring flame.

input: ان ادخلوا الجنّة رحمة من عندنا و اشربوا فیها خمر الحیوان من ید الرّحمن.
output: Haste ye to enter into Paradise, as a token of Our mercy unto you, and drink ye from the hands of the All-Merciful the Wine that is life indeed.

input: هنیئاً لکم یا اهل البهآء.
output: Drink with healthy relish, O people of Bahá.

input: تالله انتم الفائزون.
output: Ye are indeed they with whom it shall be well.

input: هذا ما فاز به المقرّبون.
output: This is what they who have near access to God have attained.

input: و انّه لمآء مسکوب الّذی وعدتم به فی الفرقان ثمّ فی البیان جزآء من ربّکم الرّحمن.
output: This is the flowing water ye were promised in the Qur'án, and later in the Bayán, as a recompense from your Lord, the God of Mercy.

input: طوبی للشّاربین.
output: Blessed are they that quaff it.

input: ان یا عبد النّاظر ان اشکر الله بما نزل لک فی السّجن هذا اللّوح لتذکّر النّاس بأیّام ربّک العزیز العلیم.
output: O My servant that hath turned thy face towards Me. Render thanks unto God for having sent down unto thee this Tablet in this Prison, that thou mayest remind the people of the days of thy Lord, the All-Glorious, the All-Knowing.

input: کذلک اسّسنا لک بنیان الایمان من مآء الحکمة و البیان.
output: Thus have We established for thee, through the waters of Our wisdom and utterance, the foundations of thy belief.

input: و هذا مآء کان مستوی عرش ربّک الرّحمن.
output: This, verily, is the water whereon the Throne of thy Lord hath been raised.

input: و کان عرشه علی المآء.
output: His Throne had stood upon the waters.

input: فکّر لتعرف.
output: Ponder this in thine heart, that thou mayest comprehend its meaning.

input: و قل الحمد لله ربّ العالمین.
output: Say: Praise be to God, the Lord of all worlds.

input: و بر اولی العلم و افئدهٔ منیره واضحست که غیب هویّه و ذات احدیّه مقدّس از بروز و ظهور و صعود و نزول و دخول و خروج بوده و متعالیست از وصف هر واصفی و ادراک هر مدرکی لم‌یزل در ذات خود غیب بوده و هست.
output: To every discerning and illuminated heart it is evident that God, the unknowable Essence, the Divine Being, is immensely exalted beyond every human attribute, such as corporeal existence, ascent and descent, egress and regress.

input: و لا‌یزال بکینونت خود مستور از ابصار و انظار خواهد بود.
output: Far be it from His glory that human tongue should adequately recount His praise, or that human heart comprehend His fathomless mystery. He is, and hath ever been, veiled in the ancient eternity of His Essence, and will remain in His Reality everlastingly hidden from the sight of men.

input: لا تدرکه الأبصار و هو یدرک الأبصار و هو اللّطیف الخبیر....
output: No vision taketh in Him, but He taketh in all vision.

input: و ایشانند مخازن علوم ربّانی و مواقع حکمت صمدانی.
output: They are the Treasuries of Divine knowledge, and the Repositories of celestial wisdom.

input: و مظاهر فیض نامتناهی و مطالع شمس لایزالی....و این هیاکل قدسیّه مرایای اوّلیّهٴ ازلیّه هستند که حکایت نموده‌اند از غیب الغیوب.
output: Through them is transmitted a grace that is infinite, and by them is revealed the Light that can never fade.... These Tabernacles of Holiness, these Primal Mirrors which reflect the light of unfading glory, are but expressions of Him Who is the Invisible of the Invisibles.

input: لهذا بر همهٴ این وجودات منیره و طلعات بدیعه حکم جمیع صفات الله از سلطنت و عظمت و امثال آن جاریست اگرچه بر حسب ظاهر بسلطنت ظاهره و غیر آن ظاهر نشوند....
output: Therefore, these illuminated Souls, these beauteous Countenances have, each and every one of them, been endowed with all the attributes of God, such as sovereignty, dominion, and the like, even though to outward seeming they be shorn of all earthly majesty....

input: انّ الغیب لم یکن له من هیکل لیظهر به انّه لم یزل کان مقدّساً عمّا یذکر و یبصر انّه لبالمنظر الأکبر ینطق انّی انا الله
output: Know thou of a certainty that the Unseen can in no wise incarnate His Essence and reveal it unto men. He is, and hath ever been, immensely exalted beyond all that can either be recounted or perceived. From His retreat of glory His voice is ever proclaiming: Verily, I am God.

input: لا اله الّا انا العلیم الحکیم. قد اظهرت نفسی و مطلع آیاتی.
output: there is none other God besides Me, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. I have manifested Myself unto men, and have sent down Him Who is the Dayspring of the signs of My Revelation.

input: و به انطقت کلّ شیء علی انّه لا اله الّا هو الفرد الواحد العلیم الخبیر.
output: Through Him I have caused all creation to testify that there is none other God except Him, the Incomparable, the All-Informed, the All-Wise.

input: انّ الغیب یعرف بنفس الظّهور و الظّهور بکینونته لبرهان الأعظم بین الأمم.
output: He Who is everlastingly hidden from the eyes of men can never be known except through His Manifestation, and His Manifestation can adduce no greater proof of the truth of His Mission than the proof of His own Person.

input: ای سلمان.
output: O Salmán.

input: سبیل کلّ بذات قدم مسدود بوده.
output: The door of the knowledge of the Ancient Being hath ever been, and will continue forever to be, closed in the face of men.

input: و طریق کلّ مقطوع خواهد بود.
output: No man's understanding shall ever gain access unto His holy court.

input: و محض فضل و عنایت شموس مشرقه از افق احدیّه را بین ناس ظاهر فرموده و عرفان این انفس مقدّسه را عرفان خود قرار فرموده.
output: As a token of His mercy, however, and as a proof of His loving-kindness, He hath manifested unto men the Daystars of His divine guidance, the Symbols of His divine unity, and hath ordained the knowledge of these sanctified Beings to be identical with the knowledge of His own Self.

input: من عرفهم فقد عرف الله.
output: Whoso recognizeth them hath recognized God.

input: و من سمع کلماتهم فقد سمع کلمات الله و من اقرّ بهم فقد اقرّ بالله.
output: Whoso hearkeneth to their call, hath hearkened to the Voice of God, and whoso testifieth to the truth of their Revelation, hath testified to the truth of God Himself.

input: و من اعرض عنهم فقد اعرض عن الله و من کفر بهم فقد کفر بالله.
output: Whoso turneth away from them, hath turned away from God, and whoso disbelieveth in them, hath disbelieved in God.

input: و هم صراط الله بین السّموات و الأرض و میزان الله فی ملکوت الأمر و الخلق.
output: Every one of them is the Way of God that connecteth this world with the realms above, and the Standard of His Truth unto every one in the kingdoms of earth and heaven.

input: و هم ظهور الله و حججه بین عباده و دلائله بین بریّته....
output: They are the Manifestations of God amidst men, the evidences of His Truth, and the signs of His glory.

input: معلوم آن جناب بوده که حاملان امانت احدیّه که در عوالم ملکیّه بحکم جدید و امر بدیع ظاهر میشوند.
output: The Bearers of the Trust of God are made manifest unto the peoples of the earth as the Exponents of a new Cause and the Revealers of a new Message.

input: و همچنین ثابت است در هر ظهور بعد صدق رجوع ظهور قبل....
output: In like manner, in every subsequent Revelation, the return of the former Revelation is a fact, the truth of which is firmly established....

input: منهم من کلّم‌‌‌ الله ‌‌و رفع بعضهم درجات.
output: To some God hath spoken, some He hath raised and exalted.

input: و آتینا عیسی بن مریم البیّنات و ایّدناه بروح القدس.
output: And to Jesus, Son of Mary, We gave manifest signs, and We strengthened Him with the Holy Spirit.

input: یعنی ظهور الله بظهورشان ظاهر و جمال ‌الله از جمالشان باهر چنانچه نغمات ربوبیّه از این هیاکل احدیّه ظاهر شد.
output: Through their appearance the Revelation of God is made manifest, and by their countenance the Beauty of God is revealed. Thus it is that the accents of God Himself have been heard uttered by these Manifestations of the Divine Being.

input: چنانچه میفرماید انّی عبد الله.
output: Even as He saith: I am the servant of God.

input: و ما انا الّا بشر مثلکم....
output: I am but a man like you....

input: و اگر شنیده شود از مظاهر جامعه انّی انا الله حقّ است و ریبی در آن نیست.
output: Were any of the all-embracing Manifestations of God to declare: I am God, He, verily, speaketh the truth, and no doubt attacheth thereto.

input: و این نزد واصلان بس خطا چه جای آنکه ذکر غیر شود.
output: In the eyes of them that have attained unto that Court, such a suggestion is itself a grievous transgression.

input: و قلب و لسان و دل و جان بغیر ذکر جانان مشغول گردد و یا چشم غیر جمال او ملاحظه نماید و یا گوش غیر نغمهٔ او شنود و یا رجل در غیر سبیل او مشی نماید....
output: How much more grievous would it be, were aught else to be mentioned in that Presence, were man's heart, his tongue, his mind, or his soul, to be busied with anyone but the Well-Beloved, were his eyes to behold any countenance other than His beauty, were his ear to be inclined to any melody but His Voice, and were his feet to tread any way but His way....

input: در قرون اولی تفکّر نما.
output: Consider the former generations.

input: هر هنگام که آفتاب عنایت الهی از افق ظهور طالع شد ناس بر اعراض و اعتراض قیام نمودند.
output: Witness how every time the Daystar of Divine bounty hath shed the light of His Revelation upon the world, the people of His Day have arisen against Him, and repudiated His truth.

input: و نفوسی که پیشوای خلق بودند لم‌یزل و لا‌یزال ناس را از توجّه ببحر اعظم منع مینمودند.
output: They who were regarded as the leaders of men have invariably striven to hinder their followers from turning unto Him Who is the Ocean of God's limitless bounty.

input: خلیل زمان را بفتوای علمای عصر بنار انداختند
output: Behold how the people, as a result of the verdict pronounced by the divines of His age, have cast Abraham, the Friend of God, into fire.

input: و کلیم را بکذب و افترا نسبت دادند.
output: how Moses, He Who held converse with the Almighty, was denounced as liar and slanderer.

input: در روح تفکّر نما مع آنکه بکمال رأفت و شفقت ظاهر شد.
output: Reflect how Jesus, the Spirit of God, was, notwithstanding His extreme meekness and perfect tender-heartedness, treated by His enemies.

input: بشأنی بر ضدّ آن جوهر وجود و مالک غیب و شهود قیام نمودند که مقرّ سکون از برای خود نیافت.
output: So fierce was the opposition which He, the Essence of Being and Lord of the visible and invisible, had to face, that He had nowhere to lay His head.

input: در هر یوم بشطری توجّه فرمود و در محلّی ساکن شد.
output: He wandered continually from place to place, deprived of a permanent abode.

input: در خاتم انبیا روح ما سواه فداه نظر نما.
output: Ponder that which befell Muhammad, the Seal of the Prophets, may the life of all else be a sacrifice unto Him.

input: که بعد از القای کلمهٴ مبارکهٴ توحید از علمای اصنام و یهود بر آن سلطان وجود چه وارد شد.
output: How severe the afflictions which the leaders of the Jewish people and of the idol-worshipers caused to rain upon Him, Who is the sovereign Lord of all, in consequence of His proclamation of the unity of God and of the truth of His Message.

input: ینوح القلم و یصیح الأشیآء بما ورد علیه من الّذین نقضوا میثاق الله و عهده و انکروا برهانه و جادلوا بآیاته.
output: My Pen groaneth, and all created things weep with a great weeping, as a result of the woes He suffered at the hands of them that have broken the Covenant of God, violated His Testament, rejected His proofs, and disputed His signs.

input: کذلک نقصّ لک ما قضی من قبل لتکون من العارفین.
output: Thus recount We unto thee the tale of that which happened in days past, haply thou mayest comprehend.

input: مظلومیّت انبیا و اصفیا و اولیای الهی را استماع نمودی.
output: Thou hast known how grievously the Prophets of God, His Messengers and Chosen Ones, have been afflicted.

input: تفکّر نما که سبب چه بود و علّت چه.
output: Meditate awhile on the motive and reason which have been responsible for such a persecution.

input: در هیچ عهد و عصری انبیا از شماتت اعدا و ظلم اشقیا و اعراض علما که در لباس زهد و تقوی ظاهر بودند آسود‌گی نیافتند.
output: At no time, in no Dispensation, have the Prophets of God escaped the blasphemy of their enemies, the cruelty of their oppressors, the denunciation of the learned of their age, who appeared in the guise of uprightness and piety.

input: در لیالی و ایّام ببلایائی مبتلا بودند که جز علم حقّ جلّ جلاله احصا ننموده و نخواهد نمود.
output: Day and night they passed through such agonies as none can ever measure, except the knowledge of the one true God, exalted be His glory.

input: حال در این مظلوم ملاحظه کن.
output: Consider this wronged One.

input: مع آنکه بآیات بیّنات ظاهر شده و آنچه در ارض واقع گشته از قبل بکمال تصریح خبر داده و مع آنکه از اهل علم نبوده و بمدارس نرفته و مباحث ندیده فنون و علوم ربّانیّه بمثابهٴ غیث هاطل مابین عباد نازل و جاری شده
output: Though the clearest proofs attest the truth of His Cause. though the prophecies He, in an unmistakable language, hath made have been fulfilled. though, in spite of His not being accounted among the learned, His being unschooled and inexperienced in the disputations current among the divines, He hath rained upon men the showers of His manifold and Divinely inspired knowledge.

input: چگونه بر اعراض و اعتراض قیام نمودند.
output: yet, behold how this generation hath rejected His authority, and rebelled against Him.

input: اکثر ایّام در دست اعدا مبتلا.
output: He hath, during the greater part of His life, been sore-tried in the clutches of His enemies.

input: و در آخر بظلم مبین در این سجن عظیم ساکن.
output: His sufferings have now reached their culmination in this afflictive Prison, into which His oppressors have so unjustly thrown Him.

input: انشآءالله ببصر حدید و قلب منیر در آنچه از قبل و بعد ظاهر شده نظر نمائی و تفکّر کنی تا آگاه شوی بر آنچه الیوم اکثر خلق از آن غافلند.
output: God grant that, with a penetrating vision and radiant heart, thou mayest observe the things that have come to pass and are now happening, and, pondering them in thine heart, mayest recognize that which most men have, in this Day, failed to perceive.

input: انشآءالله از نفحات ایّام الهی محروم نمانی و از فیوضات نامتناهیه ممنوع نشوی از عنایت حقّ از بحر اعظم که الیوم باسم مالک قدم در عالم ظاهر است بیاشامی و بر امر الله مثل جبل ثابت و راسخ و مستقیم مانی.
output: Please God, He may enable thee to inhale the sweet fragrance of His Day, to partake of the limitless effusions of His grace, to quaff thy fill, through His gracious favor, from the most great Ocean that surgeth in this Day in the name of the Ancient King, and to remain firm and immovable as the mountain in His Cause.

input: قل سبحانک یا من اعترف الأولیآء بعجزهم عند ظهورات قدرتک و اقرّ الأصفیآء بفنائهم لدی بروزات انوار شمس بقائک.
output: Say: Glory be to Thee Who hast caused all the holy Ones to confess their helplessness before the manifold revelations of Thy might, and every Prophet to acknowledge His nothingness at the effulgence of Thine abiding glory.

input: اسألک بالاسم الّذی به فتح باب السّمآء و انجذب الملأ الأعلی بأن تؤیّدنی علی خدمتک فی ایّامک و توفّقنی علی العمل بما امرتنی به فی کتابک.
output: I beseech Thee, by Thy name that hath unlocked the gates of Heaven and filled with ecstasy the Concourse on high, to enable me to serve Thee, in this Day, and to strengthen me to observe that which Thou didst prescribe in Thy Book.

input: ای ربّ انت تعلم ما عندی
output: Thou knowest, O my Lord, what is in me.

input: و لا اعلم ما عندک. انّک انت العلیم الخبیر.
output: but I know not what is in Thee. Thou art the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.

input: ایّاکم یا ملأ التّوحید لا تفرّقوا فی مظاهر امر الله و لا فیما نزّل علیهم من الآیات.
output: Beware, O believers in the Unity of God, lest ye be tempted to make any distinction between any of the Manifestations of His Cause, or to discriminate against the signs that have accompanied and proclaimed their Revelation.

input: و هذا حقّ التّوحید ان انتم لمن الموقنین.
output: This indeed is the true meaning of Divine Unity, if ye be of them that apprehend and believe this truth.

input: و کذلک فی افعالهم و اعمالهم و کلّما ظهر من عندهم و یظهر من لدنهم کلّ من عند الله و کلّ بأمره عاملین.
output: Be ye assured, moreover, that the works and acts of each and every one of these Manifestations of God, nay whatever pertaineth unto them, and whatsoever they may manifest in the future, are all ordained by God, and are a reflection of His Will and Purpose.

input: و من فرّق بینهم و بین کلماتهم و ما نزّل علیهم او فی احوالهم و افعالهم فی اقلّ ممّا یحصی لقد اشرک بالله و آیاته و برسله و کان من المشرکین.
output: Whoso maketh the slightest possible difference between their persons, their words, their messages, their acts and manners, hath indeed disbelieved in God, hath repudiated His signs, and betrayed the Cause of His Messengers.

input: شکّی نبوده و نیست که ایّام مظاهر حقّ جلّ جلاله بحقّ منسوب و در مقامی بایّام الله مذکور.
output: It is evident that every age in which a Manifestation of God hath lived is divinely ordained, and may, in a sense, be characterized as God's appointed Day.

input: ولکن این یوم غیر ایّام است.
output: This Day, however, is unique, and is to be distinguished from those that have preceded it.

input: از ختمیّت خاتم مقام این یوم ظاهر و مشهود.
output: The designation Seal of the Prophets fully revealeth its high station.

input: نبوّت ختم شد.
output: The Prophetic Cycle hath, verily, ended.

input: حقّ با رایة اقتدار از مشرق امر ظاهر و مشرق.
output: The Eternal Truth is now come. He hath lifted up the Ensign of Power, and is now shedding upon the world the unclouded splendor of His Revelation.

input: حمد مقدّس از عرفان ممکنات و منزّه از ادراک مدرکات ملیک عزّ بی‌مثالی را سزا است که لم‌یزل مقدّس از ذکر دون خود بوده.
output: Praise be to God, the All-Possessing, the King of incomparable glory, a praise which is immeasurably above the understanding of all created things, and is exalted beyond the grasp of the minds of men.

input: و لایزال متعالی از وصف ماسوی خواهد بود احدی بسموات ذکرش کما هو ینبغی ارتقا نجسته.
output: None else besides Him hath ever been able to sing adequately His praise, nor will any man succeed at any time in describing the full measure of His glory.

input: و نفسی بمعارج وصفش علی ما هو علیه عروج ننموده.
output: Who is it that can claim to have attained the heights of His exalted Essence, and what mind can measure the depths of His unfathomable mystery.

input: و از هر شأنی از شئونات عزّ احدیّتش تجلّیات قدس لانهایه مشهود گشته و از هر ظهوری از ظهورات عزّ قدرتش انوار لابدایه ملحوظ آمده.
output: From each and every revelation emanating from the Source of His glory, holy and never-ending evidences of unimaginable splendor have appeared, and out of every manifestation of His invincible power oceans of eternal light have poured.

input: چه بلند است بدایع ظهورات عزّ سلطنت او که جمیع آنچه در آسمانها و زمین است نزد ادنی تجلّی آن معدوم صرف گشته.
output: How immensely exalted are the wondrous testimonies of His almighty sovereignty, a glimmer of which, if it but touched them, would utterly consume all that are in the heavens and in the earth.

input: و چه مقدار مرتفع است شئونات قدرت بالغهٴ او که جمیع آنچه خلق شده از اوّل لا اوّل الی آخر لا آخر از عرفان ادنی آیهٴ آن عاجز و قاصر بوده و خواهد بود.
output: How indescribably lofty are the tokens of His consummate power, a single sign of which, however inconsiderable, must transcend the comprehension of whatsoever hath, from the beginning that hath no beginning, been brought into being, or will be created in the future till the end that hath no end.

input: هیاکل اسماء لب‌تشنه در وادی طلب سرگردان و مظاهر صفات در طور تقدیس ربّ ارنی بر لسان.
output: All the Embodiments of His Names wander in the wilderness of search, athirst and eager to discover His Essence, and all the Manifestations of His Attributes implore Him, from the Sinai of Holiness, to unravel His mystery.

input: موجی از طمطام رحمت بی‌زوالش جمیع ممکنات را بطراز عزّ هستی مزیّن نموده و نفحه‌ئی از نفحات رضوان بی‌مثالش تمام موجودات را بخلعت عزّ قدسی مکرّم داشته.
output: A drop of the billowing ocean of His endless mercy hath adorned all creation with the ornament of existence, and a breath wafted from His peerless Paradise hath invested all beings with the robe of His sanctity and glory.

input: و برشحهٴ مطفحه‌ئی از قمقام بحر مشیّت سلطان احدیّتش خلق لا نهایه بما لا نهایه را از عدم محض بعرصهٴ وجود آورده.
output: A sprinkling from the unfathomed deep of His sovereign and all-pervasive Will hath, out of utter nothingness, called into being a creation which is infinite in its range and deathless in its duration.

input: لم‌یزل بدایع جودش را تعطیل اخذ ننموده و لایزال ظهورات فیض فضلش را وقوف ندیده.
output: The wonders of His bounty can never cease, and the stream of His merciful grace can never be arrested.

input: از اوّل لا اوّل خلق فرموده و الی آخر لا آخر خلق خواهد فرمود.
output: The process of His creation hath had no beginning, and can have no end.

input: و در هر دوری از ادوار و کوری از اکوار از تجلّیات ظهورات فطرتهای بدیع خود خلق را جدید فرموده تا جمیع آنچه در سموات و ارضین‌اند چه از آیات عزّ آفاقیّه و چه از ظهورات قدس انفسیّه از بادهٴ رحمت خمخانهٴ عزّ احدیّتش محروم نمانند و از رشحات فیوضات سحاب مکرمتش مأیوس نگردند.
output: In every age and cycle He hath, through the splendorous light shed by the Manifestations of His wondrous Essence, recreated all things, so that whatsoever reflecteth in the heavens and on the earth the signs of His glory may not be deprived of the outpourings of His mercy, nor despair of the showers of His favors.

input: چه ‌قدر محیط است بدایع فضل بی‌منتهایش.
output: How all-encompassing are the wonders of His boundless grace.

input: که جمیع آفرینش را احاطه نموده.
output: Behold how they have pervaded the whole of creation.

input: بر مقامی که ذرّه‌ئی در ملک مشهود نه مگر آنکه حاکی است از ظهورات عزّ احدیّت او و ناطق است بثنای نفس او و مدلّ است بر انوار شمس وحدت او.
output: Such is their virtue that not a single atom in the entire universe can be found which doth not declare the evidences of His might, which doth not glorify His holy Name, or is not expressive of the effulgent light of His unity.

input: و بشأنی صنع خود را جامع و کامل خلق فرموده که اگر جمیع صاحبان عقول و افئده ارادهٴ معرفت پست‌ترین خلق او را علی ما هو علیه نمایند جمیع خود را قاصر و عاجز مشاهده نمایند
output: So perfect and comprehensive is His creation that no mind nor heart, however keen or pure, can ever grasp the nature of the most insignificant of His creatures.

input: تا چه رسد بمعرفت آن آفتاب عزّ حقیقت و آن ذات غیب لایدرک.
output: much less fathom the mystery of Him Who is the Daystar of Truth, Who is the invisible and unknowable Essence.

input: عرفان عرفا و بلوغ بلغا و وصف فصحا جمیع بخلق او راجع بوده و خواهد بود.
output: The conceptions of the devoutest of mystics, the attainments of the most accomplished amongst men, the highest praise which human tongue or pen can render are all the product of man's finite mind and are conditioned by its limitations.

input: صدهزار موسی در طور طلب بندای لن ترانی منصعق و صدهزار روح القدس در سماء قرب از اصغاء کلمهٴ لن تعرفنی مضطرب لم‌یزل بعلوّ تقدیس و تنزیه در مکمن ذات مقدّس خود بوده و لایزال بسموّ تمنیع و ترفیع در مخزن کینونت خود خواهد بود.
output: Ten thousand Prophets, each a Moses, are thunderstruck upon the Sinai of their search at His forbidding voice, Thou shalt never behold Me.. whilst a myriad Messengers, each as great as Jesus, stand dismayed upon their heavenly thrones by the interdiction, Mine Essence thou shalt never apprehend. From time immemorial He hath been veiled in the ineffable sanctity of His exalted Self, and will everlastingly continue to be wrapt in the impenetrable mystery of His unknowable Essence.

input: متعارجان سماء قرب عرفانش جز بسرمنزل حیرت نرسیده‌اند و قاصدان حرم قرب و وصالش جز بوادی عجز و حسرت قدم نگذارده‌اند.
output: Every attempt to attain to an understanding of His inaccessible Reality hath ended in complete bewilderment, and every effort to approach His exalted Self and envisage His Essence hath resulted in hopelessness and failure.

input: چه‌ قدر متحیّر است این ذرّهٴ لاشیء از تعمّق در غمرات لجّهٴ قدس عرفان تو.
output: How bewildering to me, insignificant as I am, is the attempt to fathom the sacred depths of Thy knowledge.

input: و چه مقدار عاجز است از تفکّر در قدرت مستودعه در ظهورات صنع تو.
output: How futile my efforts to visualize the magnitude of the power inherent in Thine handiwork—the revelation of Thy creative power.

input: اگر بگویم ببصر درآئی بصر خود را نبیند چگونه تو را بیند و اگر گویم بقلب ادراک شوی قلب عارف بمقامات تجلّی در خود نشده چگونه تو را عارف شود.
output: How can mine eye, which hath no faculty to perceive itself, claim to have discerned Thine Essence, and how can mine heart, already powerless to apprehend the significance of its own potentialities, pretend to have comprehended Thy nature.

input: اگر گویم معروفی تو مقدّس از عرفان موجودات بوده‌ئی و اگر بگویم غیر معروفی تو مشهودتر از آنی که مستور و غیر معروف مانی.
output: How can I claim to have known Thee, when the entire creation is bewildered by Thy mystery, and how can I confess not to have known Thee, when, lo, the whole universe proclaimeth Thy Presence and testifieth to Thy truth.

input: اگرچه لم‌یزل ابواب فضل وصل و لقایت بر وجه ممکنات مفتوح و تجلّیات انوار جمال بی‌مثالت بر اعراش وجود از مشهود و مفقود مستوی.
output: The portals of Thy grace have throughout eternity been open, and the means of access unto Thy Presence made available, unto all created things, and the revelations of Thy matchless Beauty have at all times been imprinted upon the realities of all beings, visible and invisible.

input: مع ظهور این فضل اعظم و عنایت اتمّ اقوم شهادت میدهم که ساحت جلال قدست از عرفان غیر مقدّس بوده و بساط اجلال انست از ادراک ماسوی منزّه خواهد بود.
output: Yet, notwithstanding this most gracious favor, this perfect and consummate bestowal, I am moved to testify that Thy court of holiness and glory is immeasurably exalted above the knowledge of all else besides Thee, and the mystery of Thy Presence is inscrutable to every mind except Thine own.

input: بکینونت خود معروفی و بذات خود موصوف.
output: No one except Thyself can unravel the secret of Thy nature, and naught else but Thy transcendental Essence can grasp the reality of Thy unsearchable being.

input: و چه‌ قدر از هیاکل عزّ احدیّه که در بیدای هجر و فراقت جان باخته‌اند.
output: How vast the number of those heavenly and all-glorious beings who, in the wilderness of their separation from Thee, have wandered all the days of their lives, and failed in the end to find Thee.

input: و چه مقدار از ارواح قدس صمدیّه که در صحرای شهود مبهوت گشته‌اند.
output: How great the multitude of the sanctified and immortal souls who were lost and bewildered while seeking in the desert of search to behold Thy face.

input: بسا عشّاق با کمال طلب و اشتیاق از شعلهٴ ملتهبهٴ نار فراق محترق شده و چه بسیار از احرار که برجای وصالت جان داده‌اند نه ناله و حنین عاشقین بساحت قدست رسد.
output: Myriad are Thine ardent lovers whom the consuming flame of remoteness from Thee hath caused to sink and perish, and numberless are the faithful souls who have willingly laid down their lives in the hope of gazing on the light of Thy countenance.

input: و نه صیحه و ندبهٴ قاصدین و مشتاقین بمقام قربت درآید.
output: The sighs and moans of these longing hearts that pant after Thee can never reach Thy holy court, neither can the lamentations of the wayfarers that thirst to appear before Thy face attain Thy seat of glory.

input: جواهر توحید و لطائف تحمید متصاعد بساط حضرت سلطان بی‌مثال و ملیک ذو الجلالیست که حقایق ممکنات و دقایق و رقایق اعیان موجودات را از حقیقت نیستی و عدم در عوالم هستی و قدم ظاهر فرمود و از ذلّت بعد و فنا نجات داده بملکوت عزّت و بقا مشرّف نمود.
output: All praise to the unity of God, and all honor to Him, the sovereign Lord, the incomparable and all-glorious Ruler of the universe, Who, out of utter nothingness, hath created the reality of all things, Who, from naught, hath brought into being the most refined and subtle elements of His creation, and Who, rescuing His creatures from the abasement of remoteness and the perils of ultimate extinction, hath received them into His kingdom of incorruptible glory.

input: و این نبود مگر بصرف عنایت سابقه و رحمت منبسطهٴ خود.
output: Nothing short of His all-encompassing grace, His all-pervading mercy, could have possibly achieved it.

input: چنانچه مشهود است که عدم صرف را قابلیّت و استعداد وجود نشاید و فانی بحت را لیاقت کون و انوجاد نباید.
output: How could it, otherwise, have been possible for sheer nothingness to have acquired by itself the worthiness and capacity to emerge from its state of nonexistence into the realm of being.

input: و بعد از خلق کلّ ممکنات و ایجاد موجودات بتجلّی اسم یا مختار انسانرا از بین امم و خلایق برای معرفت و محبّت خود که علّت غائی و سبب خلقت کائنات بود اختیار نمود....زیرا کینونت و حقیقت هر شیئی را باسمی از اسماء تجلّی نمود و بصفتی از صفات اشراق فرمود.
output: Having created the world and all that liveth and moveth therein, He, through the direct operation of His unconstrained and sovereign Will, chose to confer upon man the unique distinction and capacity to know Him and to love Him—a capacity that must needs be regarded as the generating impulse and the primary purpose underlying the whole of creation.... Upon the inmost reality of each and every created thing He hath shed the light of one of His names, and made it a recipient of the glory of one of His attributes.

input: مگر انسان را که مظهر کلّ اسماء و صفات و مرآت کینونت خود قرار فرمود.
output: Upon the reality of man, however, He hath focused the radiance of all of His names and attributes, and made it a mirror of His own Self.

input: و باین فضل عظیم و مرحمت قدیم خود اختصاص نمود.
output: Alone of all created things man hath been singled out for so great a favor, so enduring a bounty.

input: ولکن این تجلّیات انوار صبح هدایت و اشراقات انوار شمس عنایت در حقیقت انسان مستور و محجوبست چنانچه شعله و اشعّه و انوار در حقیقت شمع و سراج مستور است.
output: These energies with which the Daystar of Divine bounty and Source of heavenly guidance hath endowed the reality of man lie, however, latent within him, even as the flame is hidden within the candle and the rays of light are potentially present in the lamp.

input: و تابش و رخشش آفتاب جهانتاب در مرایا و مجالی که از زنگ و غبار شئونات بشری تیره و مظلم گشته مخفی و مهجور است.
output: The radiance of these energies may be obscured by worldly desires even as the light of the sun can be concealed beneath the dust and dross which cover the mirror.

input: حال این شمع و سراج را افروزنده‌ئی باید و این مرایا و مجالی را صیقل‌دهنده‌ئی شاید.
output: Neither the candle nor the lamp can be lighted through their own unaided efforts, nor can it ever be possible for the mirror to free itself from its dross.

input: و واضح است که تا ناری مشتعل ظاهر نشود هرگز سراج نیفروزد و تا آیینه از زنگ و غبار ممتاز نگردد صورت و مثال و تجلّی و اشراق شمس بی‌امس در او منطبع نشود.
output: It is clear and evident that until a fire is kindled the lamp will never be ignited, and unless the dross is blotted out from the face of the mirror it can never represent the image of the sun nor reflect its light and glory.

input: و چون مابین خلق و حقّ و حادث و قدیم و واجب و ممکن بهیچوجه ربط و مناسبت و موافقت و مشابهت نبوده و نیست لهذا در هر عهد و عصر کینونت ساذجی را در عالم ملک و ملکوت ظاهر فرماید.
output: And since there can be no tie of direct intercourse to bind the one true God with His creation, and no resemblance whatever can exist between the transient and the Eternal, the contingent and the Absolute, He hath ordained that in every age and dispensation a pure and stainless Soul be made manifest in the kingdoms of earth and heaven.

input: و این لطیفهٴ ربّانی و دقیقهٴ صمدانی را از دو عنصر خلق فرماید عنصر ترابی ظاهری و عنصر غیبی الهی.
output: Unto this subtle, this mysterious and ethereal Being He hath assigned a twofold nature. the physical, pertaining to the world of matter, and the spiritual, which is born of the substance of God Himself.

input: و دو مقام در او خلق فرماید.
output: He hath, moreover, conferred upon Him a double station.

input: یکمقام حقیقت که مقام لا ینطق الّا عن الله ربّه است.
output: The first station, which is related to His innermost reality, representeth Him as One Whose voice is the voice of God Himself.

input: که در حدیث میفرماید لی مع الله حالات.
output: To this testifieth the tradition: Manifold and mysterious is My relationship with God.

input: انا هو و هو انا الّا انا انا و هو هو.
output: I am He, Himself, and He is I, Myself, except that I am that I am, and He is that He is.

input: و هم‌چنین قف یا محمّد انت الحبیب و انت المحبوب.
output: And in like manner, the words: Arise, O Muhammad, for lo, the Lover and the Beloved are joined together and made one in Thee.

input: و هم‌چنین میفرماید لا فرق بینک و بینهم الّا انّهم عبادک.
output: He similarly saith: There is no distinction whatsoever between Thee and Them, except that They are Thy Servants.

input: و مقام دیگر مقام بشریّت است که میفرماید ما انا الّا بشر مثلکم.
output: The second station is the human station, exemplified by the following verses: I am but a man like you.

input: و قل سبحان ربّی.
output: Say, praise be to my Lord.

input: هل کنت الّا بشراً رسولاً.
output: Am I more than a man, an apostle.

input: و این کینونات مجرّده و حقایق منیره وسایط فیض کلّیّه‌اند.
output: These Essences of Detachment, these resplendent Realities are the channels of God's all-pervasive grace.

input: و بهدایت کبری و ربوبیّت عظمی مبعوث شوند که تا قلوب مشتاقین و حقایق صافین را بالهامات غیبیّه و فیوضات لاریبیّه و نسائم قدسیّه از کدورات عوالم ملکیّه ساذج و منیر گردانند و افئدهٴ مقرّبین را از زنگار حدود پاک و منزّه فرمایند.
output: Led by the light of unfailing guidance, and invested with supreme sovereignty, They are commissioned to use the inspiration of Their words, the effusions of Their infallible grace and the sanctifying breeze of Their Revelation for the cleansing of every longing heart and receptive spirit from the dross and dust of earthly cares and limitations.

input: تا ودیعهٴ الهیّه که در حقایق مستور و مختفی گشته از حجاب ستر و پردهٴ خفا چون اشراق آفتاب نورانی از فجر الهی سر برآرد و علم ظهور بر اتلال قلوب و افئده برافرازد.
output: Then, and only then, will the Trust of God, latent in the reality of man, emerge, as resplendent as the rising Orb of Divine Revelation, from behind the veil of concealment, and implant the ensign of its revealed glory upon the summits of men's hearts.

input: و از این کلمات و اشارات معلوم و ثابت شد که لابدّ در عالم ملک و ملکوت باید کینونت و حقیقتی ظاهر گردد که واسطهٴ فیض کلّیّه و مظهر اسم الوهیّت و ربوبیّت باشد.
output: From the foregoing passages and allusions it hath been made indubitably clear that in the kingdoms of earth and heaven there must needs be manifested a Being, an Essence Who shall act as a Manifestation and Vehicle for the transmission of the grace of the Divinity Itself, the Sovereign Lord of all.

input: تا جمیع ناس در ظلّ تربیت آن آفتاب حقیقت تربیت گردند تا باینمقام و رتبه که در حقایق ایشان مستودع است مشرّف و فائز شوند.
output: Through the Teachings of this Daystar of Truth every man will advance and develop until he attaineth the station at which he can manifest all the potential forces with which his inmost true self hath been endowed.

input: اینست که در جمیع اعهاد و ازمان انبیا و اولیا با قوّت ربّانی و قدرت صمدانی در میان ناس ظاهر گشته.
output: It is for this very purpose that in every age and dispensation the Prophets of God and His chosen Ones have appeared amongst men, and have evinced such power as is born of God and such might as only the Eternal can reveal.

input: و عقل سلیم هرگز راضی نشود که نظر ببعضی کلمات که معانی آن را ادراک ننموده این باب هدایت را مسدود انگارد و از برای این شموس و انوار ابتدا و انتهائی تعقّل نماید.
output: Can one of sane mind ever seriously imagine that, in view of certain words the meaning of which he cannot comprehend, the portal of God's infinite guidance can ever be closed in the face of men. Can he ever conceive for these Divine Luminaries, these resplendent Lights either a beginning or an end.

input: زیرا فیضی اعظم از این فیض کلّیّه نبوده و رحمتی اکبر از این رحمت منبسطهٴ الهیّه نخواهد بود.
output: What outpouring flood can compare with the stream of His all-embracing grace, and what blessing can excel the evidences of so great and pervasive a mercy.

input: و شکّی نیست که اگر در یک آن عنایت و فیض او از عالم منقطع شود البتّه معدوم گردد.
output: There can be no doubt whatever that if for one moment the tide of His mercy and grace were to be withheld from the world, it would completely perish.

input: لهذا لم‌یزل ابواب رحمت حقّ بر وجه کون و امکان مفتوح بوده و لایزال امطار عنایت و مکرمت از غمام حقیقت بر اراضی قابلیّات و حقایق و اعیان متراکم و مفیض خواهد بود.
output: For this reason, from the beginning that hath no beginning the portals of Divine mercy have been flung open to the face of all created things, and the clouds of Truth will continue to the end that hath no end to rain on the soil of human capacity, reality and personality their favors and bounties.

input: اینست سنّت خدا من الأزل الی الأبد.
output: Such hath been God's method continued from everlasting to everlasting.

input: طوبی لنفس قام علی خدمة امری و نطق بثنائی الجمیل.
output: Happy is the man who will arise to serve My Cause, and glorify My beauteous Name.

input: خذ کتابی بقوّتی و تمسّک بما فیه من اوامر ربّک الآمر الحکیم.
output: Take hold of My Book with the power of My might, and cleave tenaciously to whatsoever commandment thy Lord, the Ordainer, the All-Wise, hath prescribed therein.

input: یا محمّد اعمال و اقوال حزب شیعه عوالم روح و ریحان را تغییر داده مکدّر نموده.
output: Behold, O Muhammad, how the sayings and doings of the followers of Shí'ih Islám have dulled the joy and fervor of its early days, and tarnished the pristine brilliancy of its light.

input: در اوّل ایّام که باسم سیّد انام متمسّک بودند هر یوم نصری ظاهر و فتحی باهر.
output: In its primitive days, whilst they still adhered to the precepts associated with the name of their Prophet, the Lord of mankind, their career was marked by an unbroken chain of victories and triumphs.

input: و چون از مولای حقیقی و نور الهی و توحید معنوی گذشته و بمظاهر کلمهٴ او تمسّک جستند قدرت بضعف و عزّت بذلّت و جرئت بخوف تبدیل شد.
output: As they gradually strayed from the path of their Ideal Leader and Master, as they turned away from the Light of God and corrupted the principle of His Divine unity, and as they increasingly centered their attention upon them who were only the revealers of the potency of His Word, their power was turned into weakness, their glory into shame, their courage into fear.

input: تا آنکه امر بمقامی رسید که مشاهده نموده و مینمایند.
output: Thou dost witness to what a pass they have come.

input: از برای نقطهٴ توحید شریکهای متعدّده ترتیب دادند.
output: Behold, how they have joined partners with Him Who is the Focal-Point of Divine unity.

input: و عمل نمودند آنچه را که در یوم قیام حائل شد مابین آن حزب و عرفان حقّ جلّ جلاله.
output: Behold how their evil doings have hindered them from recognizing, in the Day of Resurrection, the Word of Truth, exalted be His glory.

input: امید آنکه از بعد خود را از اوهام و ظنون حفظ نمایند و بتوحید حقیقی فائز شوند.
output: We cherish the hope that this people will henceforth shield themselves from vain hopes and idle fancies, and will attain to a true understanding of the meaning of Divine unity.

input: هیکل ظهور قائم مقام حقّ بوده و هست.
output: The Person of the Manifestation hath ever been the representative and mouthpiece of God.

input: اوست مطلع اسماء حسنی و مشرق صفات علیا.
output: He, in truth, is the Dayspring of God's most excellent Titles, and the Dawning-Place of His exalted Attributes.

input: اگر از برای او شبهی و مثلی باشد کیف یثبت تقدیس ذاته تعالی عن الشّبه و تنزیه کینونته عن المثل.
output: If any be set up by His side as peers, if they be regarded as identical with His Person, how can it, then, be maintained that the Divine Being is One and Incomparable, that His Essence is indivisible and peerless.

input: فکّر فیما انزلناه بالحقّ و کن من العارفین.
output: Meditate on that which We have, through the power of truth, revealed unto thee, and be thou of them that comprehend its meaning.

input: مقصود از آفرینش عرفان حقّ و لقای او بوده و خواهد بود.
output: The purpose of God in creating man hath been, and will ever be, to enable him to know his Creator and to attain His Presence.

input: چنانچه در جمیع کتب الهیّه و صحف متقنهٴ ربّانیّه من غیر حجاب این مطلب احلی و مقصود اعلی مذکور و واضحست.
output: To this most excellent aim, this supreme objective, all the heavenly Books and the divinely revealed and weighty Scriptures unequivocally bear witness.

input: و هر نفسی که بآن صبح هدایت و فجر احدیّت فائز شد بمقام قرب و وصل که اصل جنّت و اعلی الجنانست فائز گردید.
output: Whoso hath recognized the Dayspring of Divine guidance and entered His holy court hath drawn nigh unto God and attained His Presence, a Presence which is the real Paradise, and of which the loftiest mansions of heaven are but a symbol.

input: و بمقام قاب و قوسین که ورای سدرهٴ منتهی است وارد شد.
output: Such a man hath attained the knowledge of the station of Him Who is at the distance of two bows, Who standeth beyond the Sadratu'l-Muntahá.

input: والّا در امکنهٴ بعد که اصل نار و حقیقت نفی است ساکن بوده و خواهد بود.
output: Whoso hath failed to recognize Him will have condemned himself to the misery of remoteness, a remoteness which is naught but utter nothingness and the essence of the nethermost fire.

input: اگرچه در ظاهر بر اکراس رفیعه و اعراش منیعه جالس باشد.
output: Such will be his fate, though to outward seeming he may occupy the earth's loftiest seats and be established upon its most exalted throne.

input: بلی آن سماء حقیقت قادر و مقتدر است که جمیع ناس را از شمال بعد و هوی بیمین قرب و لقا رساند.
output: He Who is the Dayspring of Truth is, no doubt, fully capable of rescuing from such remoteness wayward souls and of causing them to draw nigh unto His court and attain His Presence.

input: لو شآء الله لیکون النّاس امّة واحدة.
output: If God had pleased He had surely made all men one people.

input: ولکن مقصود صعود انفس طیّبه و جواهر مجرّده است که بفطرت اصلیّهٴ خود بشاطی بحر اعظم وارد شوند تا طالبان جمال ذو الجلال از عاکفان امکنهٴ ضلال و اضلال از یکدیگر مفصول و ممتاز شوند.
output: His purpose, however, is to enable the pure in spirit and the detached in heart to ascend, by virtue of their own innate powers, unto the shores of the Most Great Ocean, that thereby they who seek the Beauty of the All-Glorious may be distinguished and separated from the wayward and perverse.

input: کذلک قدّر الأمر من قلم عزّ منیر....
output: Thus hath it been ordained by the all-glorious and resplendent Pen....

input: و همچنین سبب عدم ظهور مظاهر عدل و مطالع فضل باسباب قدرت ظاهریّه و غلبهٴ ملکیّه همین شئونات فصل و تمیز بوده.
output: That the Manifestations of Divine justice, the Daysprings of heavenly grace, have when they appeared amongst men always been destitute of all earthly dominion and shorn of the means of worldly ascendancy, should be attributed to this same principle of separation and distinction which animateth the Divine Purpose.

input: چه اگر آن جوهر قدم علی ما کان علیه ظاهر شود و تجلّی فرماید احدی را مجال انکار و اعراض نماند.
output: Were the Eternal Essence to manifest all that is latent within Him, were He to shine in the plentitude of His glory, none would be found to question His power or repudiate His truth.

input: بلکه جمیع موجودات از مشاهدهٴ انوار او منصعق بلکه فانی محض شوند.
output: Nay, all created things would be so dazzled and thunderstruck by the evidences of His light as to be reduced to utter nothingness.

input: دیگر در این مقام مقبل الی الله از معرض بالله منفصل نگردد.
output: How, then, can the godly be differentiated under such circumstances from the froward.

input: چنانچه در جمیع مظاهر قبل این مطلب وضوح یافته....اینست که مشرکین در هر ظهور بدیع و تجلّی منیع چون آن جمال لایزال و طلعت بیمثال را در لباس ظاهر ملکیّه مثل سایر ناس مشاهده مینمودند بدینجهت محتجب گشتند.
output: This principle hath operated in each of the previous Dispensations and been abundantly demonstrated.... It is for this reason that, in every age, when a new Manifestation hath appeared and a fresh revelation of God's transcendent power was vouchsafed unto men, they that misbelieved in Him, deluded by the appearance of the peerless and everlasting Beauty in the garb of mortal men, have failed to recognize Him.

input: و غفلت نموده بآن سدرهٴ قرب تقرّب نمیجستند.
output: They have erred from His path and eschewed His company—the company of Him Who is the Symbol of nearness to God.

input: بلکه در صدد دفع و قلع و قمع مقبلین الی الله برآمده.
output: They have even arisen to decimate the ranks of the faithful and to exterminate such as believed in Him.

input: چنانچه در این کور ملاحظه شد که این همج رعاع گمان نموده‌اند که بقتل و غارت و نفی احبّای الهی از بلاد توانند سراج قدرت ربّانی را بیفسرند و شمس صمدانی را از نور بازدارند.
output: Behold how in this Dispensation the worthless and foolish have fondly imagined that by such instruments as massacre, plunder and banishment they can extinguish the Lamp which the Hand of Divine power hath lit, or eclipse the Daystar of everlasting splendor.

input: غافل از اینکه جمیع این بلایا بمنزلهٴ دهن است برای اشتعال این مصباح.
output: How utterly unaware they seem to be of the truth that such adversity is the oil that feedeth the flame of this Lamp.

input: کذلک یبدّل الله.
output: Such is God's transforming power.

input: ما یشآء و انّه علی کلّ شیء قدیر....
output: He changeth whatsoever He willeth.

input: در هر حال سلطنت و قدرت و غلبهٴ سلطان حقیقی را ملاحظه فرما.
output: Consider at all times the sovereignty exercised by the Ideal King, and behold the evidences of His power and paramount influence.

input: و گوش را از کلمات مظاهر نفی و مطالع قهر پاک و مقدّس فرمائید.
output: Sanctify your ears from the idle talk of them that are the symbols of denial and the exponents of violence and anger.

input: که عنقریب حقّ را محیط بر جمیع و غالب بر کل خواهید دید.
output: The hour is approaching when ye will witness the power of the one true God triumphing over all created things and the signs of His sovereignty encompassing all creation.

input: و دون آن را مفقود و لاشیء محض ملاحظه خواهید فرمود.
output: On that day ye will discover how all else besides Him will have been forgotten and come to be regarded as utter nothingness.

input: اگرچه بحمد الله حقّ و مظاهر او همیشه در علوّ ارتفاع و سموّ امتناع خود بوده.
output: It should, however, be borne in mind that God and His Manifestation can, under no circumstances, be dissociated from the loftiness and sublimity which They inherently possess.

input: بلکه علوّ و سموّ بقول او خلق شده لو انتم ببصر هذا الغلام تنظرون.
output: Nay, loftiness and sublimity are themselves the creations of His Word, if ye choose to see with My sight not with yours.

input: شهد الله انّه لا اله الّا هو العزیز المحبوب.
output: God witnesseth that there is no God but Him, the Gracious, the Best-Beloved.

input: له الجود و الفضل.
output: All grace and bounty are His.

input: یعطی من یشآء ما یشآء.
output: To whomsoever He will He giveth whatsoever is His wish.

input: و انّه لهو القادر المقتدر المهیمن القیّوم.
output: He, verily, is the All-Powerful, the Almighty, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting.

input: قل انّا آمنّا بالّذی ظهر باسم علیّ من لدن سلطان حقّ محمود.
output: We, verily, believe in Him Who, in the person of the Báb, hath been sent down by the Will of the one true God, the King of Kings, the All-Praised.

input: و بالّذی یأتی فی المستغاث و بالّذی یأتی بعده الی آخر الّذی لا آخر له.
output: We, moreover, swear fealty to the One Who, in the time of Mustagháth, is destined to be made manifest, as well as to those Who shall come after Him till the end that hath no end.

input: و ما نشهد فی ظهورهم الّا ظهور الله و فی بطونهم الّا بطونه ان انتم تعرفون.
output: We recognize in the manifestation of each one of them, whether outwardly or inwardly, the manifestation of none but God Himself, if ye be of those that comprehend.

input: و کلّهم مرایا الله بحیث لا یری فیهم الّا نفس الله و جماله و عزّ الله و بهائه لو انتم تعقلون.
output: Every one of them is a mirror of God, reflecting naught else but His Self, His Beauty, His Might and Glory, if ye will understand.

input: و ما سواهم مرایاهم و هم مرایا الأوّلیّة ان انتم تفقهون.
output: All else besides them are to be regarded as mirrors capable of reflecting the glory of these Manifestations Who are themselves the Primary Mirrors of the Divine Being, if ye be not devoid of understanding.

input: ما سبقهم احد فی شیء و هم یسبقون.
output: No one hath ever escaped them, neither are they to be hindered from achieving their purpose.

input: قل لن ینتهی مرایا القدم و کذلک مرایا جمالهم.
output: These Mirrors will everlastingly succeed each other, and will continue to reflect the light of the Ancient of Days.

input: لأنّ فیض الله لن ینقطع.
output: They that reflect their glory will, in like manner, continue to exist forevermore, for the Grace of God can never cease from flowing.

input: و هذا صدق غیر مکذوب.
output: This is a truth that none can disprove.

input: فانظر بطرف البدء فیما نظرت الی آدم الأولی.
output: Contemplate with thine inward eye the chain of successive Revelations that hath linked the Manifestation of Adam with that of the Báb.

input: ثمّ من بعده الی ان یصل الأمر الی علیّ قبل نبیل قل تالله کلّهم قد جاؤوا عن مشرق الأمر بکتاب و صحیفة و لوح عظیم.
output: I testify before God that each one of these Manifestations hath been sent down through the operation of the Divine Will and Purpose, that each hath been the bearer of a specific Message, that each hath been entrusted with a divinely revealed Book and been commissioned to unravel the mysteries of a mighty Tablet.

input: و اوتوا کلّ واحد منهم علی ما قدّر لهم.
output: The measure of the Revelation with which every one of them hath been identified had been definitely foreordained.

input: و هذا من فضلنا علیهم ان انتم من العارفین....حتّی اذا بلغ الأمر الی وجهه العزیز المقدّس المتعالی المنیر اذاً احتجب نفسه فی الف حجاب لئلّا یعرفه من احد.
output: This, verily, is a token of Our favor unto them, if ye be of those that comprehend this truth.... And when this process of progressive Revelation culminated in the stage at which His peerless, His most sacred, and exalted Countenance was to be unveiled to men's eyes, He chose to hide His own Self behind a thousand veils, lest profane and mortal eyes discover His glory.

input: بعد الّذی کان ینزل علیه الآیات من کلّ الجهات و ما احصاها احد الّا الله ربّک و ربّ العالمین.
output: This He did at a time when the signs and tokens of a divinely appointed Revelation were being showered upon Him—signs and tokens which none can reckon except the Lord, your God, the Lord of all worlds.

input: فلمّا تمّ میقات السّتر اذاً اظهرنا عن خلف الف الف حجاب من النّور نوراً من انوار وجه الغلام اقلّ من سمّ الابرة اذاً انصعقت اهل ملإ العالین ثمّ سجدت وجوه المقرّبین.
output: And when the set time of concealment was fulfilled, We sent forth, whilst still wrapt within a myriad veils, an infinitesimal glimmer of the effulgent Glory enveloping the Face of the Youth, and lo, the entire company of the dwellers of the Realms above were seized with violent commotion and the favored of God fell down in adoration before Him.

input: و ظهر بشأن ما ظهر مثله فی الابداع بحیث قام بنفسه بین السّموات و الأرضین.
output: He hath, verily, manifested a glory such as none in the whole creation hath witnessed, inasmuch as He hath arisen to proclaim in person His Cause unto all who are in the heavens and all who are on the earth.

input: و ما سمعت فی خلیل الرّحمن انّه حقّ لا ریب فیه.
output: That which thou hast heard concerning Abraham, the Friend of the All-Merciful, is the truth, and no doubt is there about it.

input: مأمور شدند بذبح اسمعیل تا آنکه ظاهر شود استقامت و انقطاع او در امر الله بین ما سواه.
output: The Voice of God commanded Him to offer up Ishmael as a sacrifice, so that His steadfastness in the Faith of God and His detachment from all else but Him may be demonstrated unto men.

input: و مقصود از ذبح او هم فدائی بود از برای عصیان و خطاهای من علی الأرض.
output: The purpose of God, moreover, was to sacrifice him as a ransom for the sins and iniquities of all the peoples of the earth.

input: چنانچه عیسی ابن مریم هم این مقام را از حقّ جلّ و عزّ خواستند.
output: This same honor, Jesus, the Son of Mary, besought the one true God, exalted be His name and glory, to confer upon Him.

input: و همچنین رسول الله حسین را فدا نمودند.
output: For the same reason was Husayn offered up as a sacrifice by Muhammad, the Apostle of God.

input: احدی اطّلاع بر عنایات خفیّهٴ حقّ و رحمت محیطهٴ او نداشته و ندارد.
output: No man can ever claim to have comprehended the nature of the hidden and manifold grace of God.

input: نظر بعصیان اهل عالم و خطاهای واقعهٴ در آن و مصیبات واردهٴ بر اصفیا و اولیا جمیع مستحقّ هلاکت بوده و هستند.
output: none can fathom His all-embracing mercy. Such hath been the perversity of men and their transgressions, so grievous have been the trials that have afflicted the Prophets of God and their chosen ones, that all mankind deserveth to be tormented and to perish.

input: ولکن الطاف مکنونهٴ الهیّه بسببی از اسباب ظاهره و باطنه حفظ فرموده و میفرماید.
output: God's hidden and most loving providence, however, hath, through both visible and invisible agencies, protected and will continue to protect it from the penalty of its wickedness.

input: تفکّر لتعرف و کن من الثّابتین....
output: Ponder this in thine heart, that the truth may be revealed unto thee, and be thou steadfast in His path.

input: ولکن قدّرنا ظهور الکلمة و ما قدّر فیها بین العباد علی مقادیر الّتی قدّرت من لدن علیم حکیم.
output: It hath been decreed by Us that the Word of God and all the potentialities thereof shall be manifested unto men in strict conformity with such conditions as have been foreordained by Him Who is the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

input: و جعلنا حجاب وجهها نفسها.
output: We have, moreover, ordained that its veil of concealment be none other except its own Self.

input: و کذلک کنّا قادرین.
output: Such indeed is Our Power to achieve Our Purpose.

input: و انّها لو تتجلّی علی العباد بما فیها لن یحملنّها احد.
output: Should the Word be allowed to release suddenly all the energies latent within it, no man could sustain the weight of so mighty a Revelation.

input: بل یفرّنّ عنها کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرضین.
output: Nay, all that is in heaven and on earth would flee in consternation before it.

input: فانظر الی ما نزّل علی محمّد رسول الله.
output: Consider that which hath been sent down unto Muhammad, the Apostle of God.

input: و انّه حین النّزول قدّر له کنوز المعانی علی ما ینبغی له من لدن مقتدر قدیر.
output: The measure of the Revelation of which He was the bearer had been clearly foreordained by Him Who is the Almighty, the All-Powerful.

input: ولکنّ النّاس ما عرفوا منه الّا علی مراتبهم و مقاماتهم.
output: They that heard Him, however, could apprehend His purpose only to the extent of their station and spiritual capacity.

input: و کذلک انّه ما کشف لهم وجه الحکمة الّا قدر حملهم و طاقته.
output: He, in like manner, uncovered the Face of Wisdom in proportion to their ability to sustain the burden of His Message.

input: فلمّا بلغ النّاس الی البلوغ تجلّی علیهم بما فیه فی سنة السّتّین حین الّذی ظهر جمال القدم باسم علیّ قبل نبیل.
output: No sooner had mankind attained the stage of maturity, than the Word revealed to men's eyes the latent energies with which it had been endowed—energies which manifested themselves in the plenitude of their glory when the Ancient Beauty appeared, in the year sixty, in the person of 'Alí-Muhammad, the Báb.

input: سپاس و ستایش خداوندیرا سزاوار که آفرینش را بتوانائی خود از برهنگی نابودی رهائی داد و بپوشش زندگی سرافرازی بخشید.
output: All praise and glory be to God Who, through the power of His might, hath delivered His creation from the nakedness of nonexistence, and clothed it with the mantle of life.

input: پس گوهر پاک مردمرا از میان آفریدگان برگزید و او را بپوشش بزرگی آرایش فرمود.
output: From among all created things He hath singled out for His special favor the pure, the gem-like reality of man, and invested it with a unique capacity of knowing Him and of reflecting the greatness of His glory.

input: هر که زنگ خواهش از آئینهٴ دل زدود سزاوار این پوشش یزدانی شد.
output: This twofold distinction conferred upon him hath cleansed away from his heart the rust of every vain desire, and made him worthy of the vesture with which his Creator hath deigned to clothe him.

input: و خود را از برهنگی نادانی رهائی داد.
output: It hath served to rescue his soul from the wretchedness of ignorance.

input: این پوشش تن و جان مردمانرا بزرگترین مایهٴ آسایش و پرورش است.
output: This robe with which the body and soul of man hath been adorned is the very foundation of his well-being and development.

input: خوشا روز آنکه بیاری خداوند یکتا از آلایش گیتی و آنچه در او است رهائی یافت و در سایهٴ درخت دانائی بیاسود.
output: Oh, how blessed the day when, aided by the grace and might of the one true God, man will have freed himself from the bondage and corruption of the world and all that is therein, and will have attained unto true and abiding rest beneath the shadow of the Tree of Knowledge.

input: آوای هزاردستان که بر شاخسار دوستی سرایان است بگوش دوستان رسید پس فرمان شد که این بنده بپاسخ برخی از پرسشها لب گشاید و آنچه از رازها که نگارش آن شاید آشکار نماید.
output: The songs which the bird of thine heart had uttered in its great love for its friends have reached their ears, and moved Me to answer thy questions, and reveal to thee such secrets as I am allowed to unfold.

input: در آن نامهٴ دلپسند نگارش رفته بود که کدام از کیش‌آوران بر دیگری برتری دارد.
output: In thine esteemed letter thou hadst inquired which of the Prophets of God should be regarded as superior to others.

input: در اینجا خداوند یگانه میفرماید میان پیمبران جدائی ننهیم.
output: Know thou assuredly that the essence of all the Prophets of God is one and the same.

input: چون خواست همه یکی است و راز همگی یکسان.
output: Their unity is absolute. God, the Creator, saith: There is no distinction whatsoever among the Bearers of My Message. They all have but one purpose. their secret is the same secret.

input: جدائی و برتری میان ایشان روا نه.
output: To prefer one in honor to another, to exalt certain ones above the rest, is in no wise to be permitted.

input: پیمبر راستگو خود را بنام پیمبر پیشین خوانده.
output: Every true Prophet hath regarded His Message as fundamentally the same as the Revelation of every other Prophet gone before Him.

input: پس چون کسی بنهان این گفتار پی‌نبرد بگفته‌های ناشایسته پردازد دانای بینا را از گفتهٴ او لغزش پدیدار نشود.
output: If any man, therefore, should fail to comprehend this truth, and should consequently indulge in vain and unseemly language, no one whose sight is keen and whose understanding is enlightened would ever allow such idle talk to cause him to waver in his belief.

input: اگرچه پیدایش ایشان در جهان یکسان نه.
output: The measure of the revelation of the Prophets of God in this world, however, must differ.

input: و هر یک برفتار و کردار جداگانه پدیدار.
output: Each and every one of them hath been the Bearer of a distinct Message, and hath been commissioned to reveal Himself through specific acts.

input: و در میان خوردی و بزرگی نمودار.
output: It is for this reason that they appear to vary in their greatness.

input: ولی ایشان مانند ماه تابان است.
output: Their Revelation may be likened unto the light of the moon that sheddeth its radiance upon the earth.

input: چنانچه او هر گاهی بنمایش جداگانه پدیدار با آنکه هیچ گاهی او را کاهش و نیستی نه.
output: Though every time it appeareth, it revealeth a fresh measure of its brightness, yet its inherent splendor can never diminish, nor can its light suffer extinction.

input: پس دانسته شد که این نه بیشی و کمی است ولی جهان ناپایدار شایستهٴ اینگونه رفتار است.
output: It is clear and evident, therefore, that any apparent variation in the intensity of their light is not inherent in the light itself, but should rather be attributed to the varying receptivity of an ever-changing world.

input: چه هرگاه که خداوند بیمانند پیمبری را بسوی مردمان فرستاد بگفتار و رفتاری که سزاوار آنروز بود نمودار شد.
output: Every Prophet Whom the Almighty and Peerless Creator hath purposed to send to the peoples of the earth hath been entrusted with a Message, and charged to act in a manner that would best meet the requirements of the age in which He appeared.

input: خواست یزدان از پدیداری فرستادگان دو چیز بود.
output: God's purpose in sending His Prophets unto men is twofold.

input: نخستین رهانیدن مردمان از تیرگی نادانی و رهنمائی بروشنائی دانائی.
output: The first is to liberate the children of men from the darkness of ignorance, and guide them to the light of true understanding.

input: دویم آسایش ایشان و شناختن و دانستن راههای آن.
output: The second is to ensure the peace and tranquillity of mankind, and provide all the means by which they can be established.

input: پیمبران چون پزشگانند که بپرورش گیتی و کسان آن پرداخته‌اند تا بدرمان یگانگی بیماری بیگانگیرا چاره نمایند.
output: The Prophets of God should be regarded as physicians whose task is to foster the well-being of the world and its peoples, that, through the spirit of oneness, they may heal the sickness of a divided humanity.

input: در کردار و رفتار پزشگ جای گفتار نه زیرا که او بر چگونگی کالبد و بیماریهای آن آگاه است.
output: To none is given the right to question their words or disparage their conduct, for they are the only ones who can claim to have understood the patient and to have correctly diagnosed its ailments.

input: و هرگز مرغ بینش مردمان زمین بفراز آسمان دانش او نرسد.
output: No man, however acute his perception, can ever hope to reach the heights which the wisdom and understanding of the Divine Physician have attained.

input: پس اگر رفتار امروز پزشگ را با گذشته یکسان نه‌بینند جای گفتار نه.
output: Little wonder, then, if the treatment prescribed by the physician in this day should not be found to be identical with that which he prescribed before.

input: چه که هر روز بیمار را روش جداگانه سزاوار.
output: How could it be otherwise when the ills affecting the sufferer necessitate at every stage of his sickness a special remedy.

input: و همچنین پیمبران یزدان هرگاه که جهانرا بخورشید تابان دانش درخشان نمودند بهر چه سزاوار آن روز بود مردم را بسوی خداوند یکتا خواندند.
output: In like manner, every time the Prophets of God have illumined the world with the resplendent radiance of the Daystar of Divine knowledge, they have invariably summoned its peoples to embrace the light of God through such means as best befitted the exigencies of the age in which they appeared.

input: و آنها را از تیرگی نادانی بروشنائی دانائی راه نمودند.
output: They were thus able to scatter the darkness of ignorance, and to shed upon the world the glory of their own knowledge.

input: پس باید دیدهٴ مردم دانا بر راز درون ایشان نگران باشد چه که همگی را خواست یکی بوده و آن راهنمائی گم‌گشتگان و آسودگی درماندگان است....
output: It is towards the inmost essence of these Prophets, therefore, that the eye of every man of discernment must be directed, inasmuch as their one and only purpose hath always been to guide the erring, and give peace to the afflicted.... These are not days of prosperity and triumph.

input: مردمانرا بیماری فراگرفته.
output: The whole of mankind is in the grip of manifold ills.

input: بکوشید تا آنها را بآن درمان که ساختهٴ دست توانای پزشگ یزدان است رهائی دهید.
output: Strive, therefore, to save its life through the wholesome medicine which the almighty hand of the unerring Physician hath prepared.

input: باز در چگونگی کیشها نگارش رفته بود.
output: And now concerning thy question regarding the nature of religion.

input: خردمندان گیتی را چون کالبد مردمان دانسته‌اند.
output: Know thou that they who are truly wise have likened the world unto the human temple.

input: چنانکه او را پوشش باید کالبد گیتی را هم پوشش داد و دانش.
output: As the body of man needeth a garment to clothe it, so the body of mankind must needs be adorned with the mantle of justice and wisdom.

input: شاید پس کیش یزدان جامهٴ اوست.
output: Its robe is the Revelation vouchsafed unto it by God.

input: هرگاه کهنه شود بجامهٴ تازه او را بیاراید.
output: Whenever this robe hath fulfilled its purpose, the Almighty will assuredly renew it.

input: هر گاهی را روش جداگانه سزاوار.
output: For every age requireth a fresh measure of the light of God.

input: همیشه کیش یزدانی بآنچه شایستهٴ آنروز است هویدا و آشکار.
output: Every Divine Revelation hath been sent down in a manner that befitted the circumstances of the age in which it hath appeared.

input: دیگر در گفته‌های آیین‌داران گذشته نگاشته بودند.
output: As to thy question regarding the sayings of the leaders of past religions.

input: دانش ستوده از این گفتارهای بیهوده دوری جوید.
output: Every wise and praiseworthy man will no doubt eschew such vain and profitless talk.

input: آفرینندهٴ یکتا مردم را یکسان آفریده و او را بر همهٴ آفریدگان بزرگی داده.
output: The incomparable Creator hath created all men from one same substance, and hath exalted their reality above the rest of His creatures.

input: پس بلندی و پستی و بیشی و کمی بسته بکوشش اوست.
output: Success or failure, gain or loss, must, therefore, depend upon man's own exertions.

input: هر که بیشتر کوشد بیشتر رود.
output: The more he striveth, the greater will be his progress.

input: امیدواریم که از زمین دل بیاری باری ژالهٴ بخشش لالهٴ دانش بروید و مردمرا از تیرگی آلایش بشوید.
output: We fain would hope that the vernal showers of the bounty of God may cause the flowers of true understanding to spring from the soil of men's hearts, and may wash them from all earthly defilements.

input: تفکّر فرمائید.
output: Ponder awhile.

input: که سبب چه بوده که در ازمنهٔ ظهور مظاهر رحمن اهل امکان دوری میجستند.
output: What is it that prompted, in every Dispensation, the peoples of the earth to shun the Manifestation of the All-Merciful.

input: و بر اعراض و اعتراض قیام مینمودند.
output: What could have impelled them to turn away from Him and to challenge His authority.

input: اگر ناس در این فقره که از قلم امر جاری شده تفکّر نمایند جمیع بشریعهٴ باقیهٴ الهیّه بشتابند و شهادت دهند بر آنچه او شهادت داده.
output: Were men to meditate on these words which have flowed from the Pen of the Divine Ordainer, they would, one and all, hasten to embrace the truth of this God-given, and ever-enduring Revelation, and would testify to that which He Himself hath solemnly affirmed.

input: ولکن حجبات اوهام انام را در ایّام ظهور مظاهر احدیّه و مطالع عزّ صمدانیّه منع نموده و مینماید.
output: It is the veil of idle imaginations which, in the days of the Manifestations of the Unity of God and the Daysprings of His everlasting glory, hath intervened, and will continue to intervene, between them and the rest of mankind.

input: چه که در آن ایّام حقّ بآنچه خود اراده فرموده ظاهر میشود نه بارادهٴ ناس.
output: For in those days, He Who is the Eternal Truth manifesteth Himself in conformity with that which He Himself hath purposed, and not according to the desires and expectations of men.

input: چنانچه فرموده أ فکلّما جآءکم رسول بما لا تهوی انفسکم استکبرتم ففریقاً کذّبتم و فریقاً تقتلون.
output: Even as He hath revealed: So oft, then, as an Apostle cometh to you with that which your souls desire not, do ye swell with pride, and treat some as impostors, and slay others.

input: البتّه اگر باوهام ناس در ازمنهٔ خالیه و اعصار ماضیه ظاهر میشدند احدی آن نفوس مقدّسه را انکار نمینمود.
output: There can be no doubt whatever that had these Apostles appeared, in bygone ages and cycles, in accordance with the vain imaginations which the hearts of men had devised, no one would have repudiated the truth of these sanctified Beings.

input: مع آنکه کلّ در لیالی و ایّام بذکر حقّ مشغول بودند و در معابد بعبادت قائم مع‌ذلک از مطالع آیات ربّانیّه و مظاهر بیّنات رحمانیّه بی‌نصیب بودند.
output: Though such men have been, night and day, remembering the one true God, and have been devoutly engaged in the exercise of their devotions, yet they failed in the end to recognize, and partake of the grace of, the Daysprings of the signs of God and the Manifestations of His irrefutable evidences.

input: و آن جناب بر بعضی مطّلعند.
output: Thou hast, no doubt, heard about it.

input: مثلاً در ظهور مسیح.
output: Consider the Dispensation of Jesus Christ.

input: جمیع علمای عصر مع آنکه منتظر ظهور بودند اعراض نمودند.
output: Behold, how all the learned men of that generation, though eagerly anticipating the coming of the Promised One, have nevertheless denied Him.

input: و حنّان که اعلم علمای عصر بود و هم‌چنین قیافا که اقضی القضاة بود حکم بر کفر نمودند و فتوای قتل دادند.
output: Both Annas, the most learned among the divines of His day, and Caiaphas, the high priest, denounced Him and pronounced the sentence of His death.

input: و هم‌چنین در ظهور رسول روح ما سواه فداه علمای مکّه و مدینه در سنین اوّلیّه بر اعراض و اعتراض قیام نمودند و نفوسی که ابداً اهل علم نبودند بایمان فائز شدند.
output: In like manner, when Muhammad, the Prophet of God—may all men be a sacrifice unto Him—appeared, the learned men of Mecca and Medina arose, in the early days of His Revelation, against Him and rejected His Message, while they who were destitute of all learning recognized and embraced His Faith.

input: قدری تفکّر فرمائید.
output: Ponder awhile.

input: بلال حبشی که کلمه‌ئی از علم نخوانده بود بسماء ایمان و ایقان ارتقا نمود و عبدالله ابیّ که از علما بود بنفاق برخاست.
output: Consider how Balál, the Ethiopian, unlettered though he was, ascended into the heaven of faith and certitude, whilst 'Abdu'lláh Ubayy, a leader among the learned, maliciously strove to oppose Him.

input: راعی غنم بنفحات آیات بمقرّ دوست پی‌برد و بمالک امم پیوست و صاحبان علوم و حکم ممنوع و محروم.
output: Behold, how a mere shepherd was so carried away by the ecstasy of the words of God that he was able to gain admittance into the habitation of his Best-Beloved, and was united to Him Who is the Lord of Mankind, whilst they who prided themselves on their knowledge and wisdom strayed far from His path and remained deprived of His grace.

input: اینست که میفرماید حتّی یصیر اعلاکم اسفلکم و اسفلکم اعلاکم.
output: For this reason He hath written: He that is exalted among you shall be abased, and he that is abased shall be exalted.

input: و مضمون این فقره در اکثر کتب الهیّه و بیانات انبیا و اصفیا بوده.
output: References to this theme are to be found in most of the heavenly Books, as well as in the sayings of the Prophets and Messengers of God.

input: براستی میگویم امر بشأنی عظیم است که پدر از پسر و پسر از پدر فرار مینماید.
output: Verily I say, such is the greatness of this Cause that the father flieth from his son, and the son flieth from his father.

input: در حضرت نوح و کنعان مشاهده کنید.
output: Call ye to mind the story of Noah and Canaan.

input: انشآءالله باید در این ایّام روحانی از نسایم سبحانی و فیوضات ربیع رحمانی محروم نمانید.
output: God grant that, in these days of heavenly delight, ye may not deprive yourselves of the sweet savors of the All-Glorious God, and may partake, in this spiritual Springtime, of the outpourings of His grace.

input: باسم معلوم منقطعاً عن العلوم برخیزید و ندا فرمائید.
output: Arise in the name of Him Who is the Object of all knowledge, and, with absolute detachment from the learning of men, lift up your voices and proclaim His Cause.

input: قسم بآفتاب افق امر.
output: I swear by the Daystar of Divine Revelation.

input: در آن حین فرات علوم الهیّه را از قلب جاری مشاهده نمائید و انوار حکمت ربّانیّه را بی‌پرده بیابید.
output: The very moment ye arise, ye will witness how a flood of Divine knowledge will gush out of your hearts, and will behold the wonders of His heavenly wisdom manifested in all their glory before you.
