input: اگر حلاوت بیان رحمن را بیابی از جان بگذری و در سبیل دوست انفاق نمائی.
output: Were ye to taste of the sweetness of the sayings of the All-Merciful, ye would unhesitatingly forsake your selves, and would lay down your lives for the Well-Beloved.

input: این بسی واضح است که این عبد خیالی نداشته و ندارد.
output: Who can ever believe that this Servant of God hath at any time cherished in His heart a desire for any earthly honor or benefit.

input: چه که امرش از شئونات ظاهره خارج است.
output: The Cause associated with His Name is far above the transitory things of this world.

input: چنانچه در سجن اعظم غریب و مظلوم افتاده.
output: Behold Him, an exile, a victim of tyranny, in this Most Great Prison.

input: و از دست اعدا خلاصی نیافته و نخواهد یافت.
output: His enemies have assailed Him on every side, and will continue to do so till the end of His life.

input: لذا آنچه میگوید لوجه الله بوده که شاید ناس از حجبات نفس و هوی پاک شوند و بعرفان حقّ که اعلی المقام است فائز گردند.
output: Whatever, therefore, He saith unto you is wholly for the sake of God, that haply the peoples of the earth may cleanse their hearts from the stain of evil desire, may rend its veil asunder, and attain unto the knowledge of the one true God—the most exalted station to which any man can aspire.

input: لا یضرّنی اعراضهم و لا ینفعنی اقبالهم.
output: Their belief or disbelief in My Cause can neither profit nor harm Me.

input: انّما ندعوهم لوجه الله انّه لغنیّ عن العالمین.
output: We summon them wholly for the sake of God.

input: اعلم بأنّ الابن اذ اسلم الرّوح قد بکت الأشیآء کلّها.
output: Know thou that when the Son of Man yielded up His breath to God, the whole creation wept with a great weeping.

input: ولکن بانفاقه روحه قد استعدّ کلّ شیء.
output: By sacrificing Himself, however, a fresh capacity was infused into all created things.

input: کما تشهد و تری فی الخلایق اجمعین کلّ حکیم.
output: Its evidences, as witnessed in all the peoples of the earth, are now manifest before thee.

input: ظهرت منه الحکمة و کلّ عالم فصّلت منه العلوم و کلّ صانع ظهرت منه الصّنایع و کلّ سلطان ظهرت منه القدرة کلّها من تأیید روحه المتعالی المتصرّف المنیر.
output: The deepest wisdom which the sages have uttered, the profoundest learning which any mind hath unfolded, the arts which the ablest hands have produced, the influence exerted by the most potent of rulers, are but manifestations of the quickening power released by His transcendent, His all-pervasive, and resplendent Spirit.

input: و نشهد بأنّه حین اذ اتی فی العالم تجلّی علی الممکنات.
output: We testify that when He came into the world, He shed the splendor of His glory upon all created things.

input: و به طهّر کلّ ابرص عن دآء الجهل و العمی.
output: Through Him the leper recovered from the leprosy of perversity and ignorance.

input: و برئ کلّ سقیم عن سقم الغفلة و الهوی.
output: Through Him, the unchaste and wayward were healed.

input: و فتحت عین کلّ عمی و تزکّت کلّ نفس من لدن مقتدر قدیر.
output: Through His power, born of Almighty God, the eyes of the blind were opened, and the soul of the sinner sanctified.

input: و فی مقام یطلق البرص علی کلّ ما یحتجب به العبد عن عرفان ربّه.
output: Leprosy may be interpreted as any veil that interveneth between man and the recognition of the Lord, his God.

input: و الّذی احتجب انّه ابرص و لا یذکر فی ملکوت الله العزیز الحمید.
output: Whoso alloweth himself to be shut out from Him is indeed a leper, who shall not be remembered in the Kingdom of God, the Mighty, the All-Praised.

input: و انّا نشهد بأنّ من کلمة الله طهّر کلّ ابرص و برئ کلّ علیل و طاب کلّ مریض.
output: We bear witness that through the power of the Word of God every leper was cleansed, every sickness was healed, every human infirmity was banished.

input: و انّها لمطهّر العالم.
output: He it is Who purified the world.

input: طوبی لمن اقبل الیها بوجه منیر.
output: Blessed is the man who, with a face beaming with light, hath turned towards Him.

input: طوبی لمن اقرّ بالله و آیاته و اعترف بانهّ لا یسئل عمّا یفعل.
output: Blessed is the man that hath acknowledged his belief in God and in His signs, and recognized that He shall not be asked of His doings.

input: هذه کلمة قد جعلها الله طراز العقآئد و اصلها.
output: Such a recognition hath been made by God the ornament of every belief, and its very foundation.

input: و بها یقبل عمل العاملین.
output: Upon it must depend the acceptance of every goodly deed.

input: اجعلوا هذه الکلمة نصب عیونکم لئلّا تزلّکم اشارات المعرضین.
output: Fasten your eyes upon it, that haply the whisperings of the rebellious may not cause you to slip.

input: لو یحلّ ما حرّم فی ازل الآزال او بالعکس لیس لاحد ان یعترض علیه.
output: Were He to decree as lawful the thing which from time immemorial had been forbidden, and forbid that which had, at all times, been regarded as lawful, to none is given the right to question His authority.

input: و الّذی توقّف فی اقلّ من آن انّه من المعتدین.
output: Whoso will hesitate, though it be for less than a moment, should be regarded as a transgressor.

input: و الّذی ما فاز بهذا الاصل الاسنی و المقام الاعلی تحرّکه اریاح الشّبهات و تقلّبه مقالات المشرکین.
output: Whoso hath not recognized this sublime and fundamental verity, and hath failed to attain this most exalted station, the winds of doubt will agitate him, and the sayings of the infidels will distract his soul.

input: من فاز بهذا الاصل قد فاز بالاستقامة الکبری.
output: He that hath acknowledged this principle will be endowed with the most perfect constancy.

input: حبّذا هذا المقام الابهی الّذی بذکره زیّن کلّ لوح منیع.
output: All honor to this all-glorious station, the remembrance of which adorneth every exalted Tablet.

input: کذلک یعلّمکم الله ما یخلّصکم عن الرّیب و الحیرة و ینجّیکم فی الدّنیا و الآخرة.
output: Such is the teaching which God bestoweth on you, a teaching that will deliver you from all manner of doubt and perplexity, and enable you to attain unto salvation in both this world and in the next.

input: انّه هو الغفور الکریم.
output: He, verily, is the Ever-Forgiving, the Most Bountiful.

input: انّک ایقن بأنّ ربّک فی کلّ ظهور یتجلّی علی العباد علی مقدارهم.
output: Know of a certainty that in every Dispensation the light of Divine Revelation hath been vouchsafed unto men in direct proportion to their spiritual capacity.

input: مثلاً فانظر الی الشّمس.
output: Consider the sun.

input: فانّها حین طلوعها عن افقها تکون حرارتها و اثرها قلیلة.
output: How feeble its rays the moment it appeareth above the horizon.

input: و تزداد درجة بعد درجة لیستأنس بها الأشیآء قلیلاً قلیلاً الی ان یبلغ الی قطب الزّوال.
output: How gradually its warmth and potency increase as it approacheth its zenith, enabling meanwhile all created things to adapt themselves to the growing intensity of its light.

input: ثمّ تنزل بدرایج مقدّرة الی ان یغرب فی مغربها.
output: How steadily it declineth until it reacheth its setting point.

input: کلّ ذلک من حکمة الله ان انتم من العارفین و انّها لو تطلع بغتةً فی وسط السّمآء یضرّ حرارتها الأشیآء.
output: Were it, all of a sudden, to manifest the energies latent within it, it would, no doubt, cause injury to all created things.... In like manner, if the Sun of Truth were suddenly to reveal, at the earliest stages of its manifestation, the full measure of the potencies which the providence of the Almighty hath bestowed upon it, the earth of human understanding would waste away and be consumed.

input: کذلک فانظر فی شمس المعانی لتکون من المطّلعین فانّها لو تستشرق فی اوّل فجر الظّهور بأنوار الّتی قدّر الله لها لیحترق ارض العرفان من قلوب العباد لأنّهم لن یقدرنّ ان یحملنّها او یستعکسنّ منها.
output: for men's hearts would neither sustain the intensity of its revelation, nor be able to mirror forth the radiance of its light.

input: بل یضطربنّ منها و یکوننّ من المعدومین.
output: Dismayed and overpowered, they would cease to exist.

input: ای ربّ لک الحمد علی بدایع قضایاک و جوامع رزایاک.
output: Praise be to Thee, O Lord My God, for the wondrous revelations of Thy inscrutable decree and the manifold woes and trials Thou hast destined for myself.

input: مرّةً اودعتنی بید النّمرود ثمّ بید الفرعون.
output: At one time Thou didst deliver me into the hands of Nimrod. at another Thou hast allowed Pharaoh's rod to persecute me.

input: و وردا علیّ ما انت احصیته بعلمک و احطته بارادتک.
output: Thou, alone, canst estimate, through Thine all-encompassing knowledge and the operation of Thy Will, the incalculable afflictions I have suffered at their hands.

input: و مرّةً اودعتنی فی سجن المشرکین بما قصصت علی اهل العمآء حرفاً من الرّؤیا الّذی الهمتنی بعلمک و عرّفتنی بسلطانک.
output: Again Thou didst cast me into the prison-cell of the ungodly, for no reason except that I was moved to whisper into the ears of the well-favored denizens of Thy Kingdom an intimation of the vision with which Thou hadst, through Thy knowledge, inspired me, and revealed to me its meaning through the potency of Thy might.

input: و مرّةً قطعت رأسی بأیدی الکافرین.
output: And again Thou didst decree that I be beheaded by the sword of the infidel.

input: و مرّةً ارفعتنی الی الصّلیب بما اظهرت فی الملک من جواهر اسرار عزّ فردانیّتک و بدایع آثار سلطان صمدانیّتک.
output: Again I was crucified for having unveiled to men's eyes the hidden gems of Thy glorious unity, for having revealed to them the wondrous signs of Thy sovereign and everlasting power.

input: و مرّةً ابتلیتنی فی ارض الطّفّ. بحیث کنت وحیداً بین عبادک.
output: How bitter the humiliations heaped upon me, in a subsequent age, on the plain of Karbilá. How lonely did I feel amidst Thy people.

input: و فریداً فی مملکتک.
output: To what a state of helplessness I was reduced in that land.

input: الی ان قطعوا رأسی ثمّ ارفعوه علی السّنان و داروه فی کلّ الدّیار و حضروه علی مقاعد المشرکین و مواضع المنکرین.
output: Unsatisfied with such indignities, my persecutors decapitated me, and, carrying aloft my head from land to land paraded it before the gaze of the unbelieving multitude, and deposited it on the seats of the perverse and faithless.

input: و مرّةً علّقونی فی الهوآء ثمّ ضربونی بما عندهم من رصاص الغلّ و البغضآء.
output: In a later age, I was suspended, and my breast was made a target to the darts of the malicious cruelty of my foes.

input: الی ان قطعوا ارکانی و فصلوا جوارحی.
output: My limbs were riddled with bullets, and my body was torn asunder.

input: الی ان بلغ الزّمان الی هذه الأیّام الّتی اجتمعوا المغلّون علی نفسی و یتدبّرون فی کلّ حین بأن یدخلوا فی قلوب العباد ضغنی و بغضی.
output: Finally, behold how, in this Day, my treacherous enemies have leagued themselves against me, and are continually plotting to instill the venom of hate and malice into the souls of Thy servants.

input: و یمکرون فی ذلک بکلّ ما هم علیه لمقتدرون....فوعزّتک یا محبوبی اشکرک حینئذ فی تلک الحالة و علی کلّ ما ورد علیّ فی سبیل رضائک.
output: With all their might they are scheming to accomplish their purpose.... Grievous as is my plight, O God, my Well-Beloved, I render thanks unto Thee, and my Spirit is grateful for whatsoever hath befallen me in the path of Thy good-pleasure.

input: و اکون راضیاً منک و من بدایع بلایاک.
output: I am well pleased with that which Thou didst ordain for me, and welcome, however calamitous, the pains and sorrows I am made to suffer.

input: ای محبوب.
output: O My Well-Beloved.

input: روحی در دل دمیدی و مرا از من اخذ نمودی.
output: Thou hast breathed Thy Breath into Me, and divorced Me from Mine own Self.

input: و بعد مابین مشرکین و مغلّین نمایشی از من گذاشته‌ئی.
output: Thou didst, subsequently, decree that no more than a faint reflection, a mere emblem of Thy Reality within Me be left among the perverse and envious.

input: و جمیع بآن ناظر شده بر اعراض قیام نموده‌اند.
output: Behold, how, deluded by this emblem, they have risen against Me, and heaped upon Me their denials.

input: ای محبوب حال خود را بنما و مرا فارغ کن.
output: Uncover Thy Self, therefore, O My Best-Beloved, and deliver Me from My plight.

input: جواب بشنو نمایشت محبوب جان منست.
output: Thereupon a Voice replied: I love, I dearly cherish this emblem.

input: چگونه راضی شوم جز چشمم بیند و جز قلبم عارف شود.
output: How can I consent that Mine eyes, alone, gaze upon this emblem, and that no heart except Mine heart recognize it.

input: قسم بجمالم یعنی جمالت.
output: By My Beauty, which is the same as Thy Beauty.

input: که از چشم و دل خود هم میخواهم مستور باشی تا چه رسد بعیون غیر طاهره.
output: My wish is to hide Thee from Mine own eyes: how much more from the eyes of men.

input: وای وای نوبت جواب باین عبد رسید لوح تمام شد و مطلب ناگفته و در ناسفته ماند.
output: I was preparing to make reply, when lo, the Tablet was suddenly ended, leaving My theme unfinished, and the pearl of Mine utterance unstrung.

input: فوالله یا قوم.
output: God is My witness, O people.

input: انّی قد کنت راقداً علی بساطی ولکن نسمة الله ایقظتنی.
output: I was asleep on My couch, when lo, the Breeze of God wafting over Me roused Me from My slumber.

input: و روح الله احیتنی و لسان الله تکلّم علی لسانی.
output: His quickening Spirit revived Me, and My tongue was unloosed to voice His Call.

input: لست انا بمذنب انتم.
output: Accuse Me not of having transgressed against God.

input: لا تنظرونی بعیونکم بل بعینی.
output: Behold Me, not with your eyes but with Mine.

input: و بذلک امرتم من لدن عزیز علیم.
output: Thus admonisheth you He Who is the Gracious, the All-Knowing.

input: و یا قوم هل تظنّون بأنّ الأمر بیدی.
output: Think ye, O people, that I hold within My grasp the control of God's ultimate Will and Purpose.

input: لا فونفس.
output: Far be it from Me to advance such claim.

input: الله المقتدر المتعالی العلیم الحکیم.
output: To this I testify before God, the Almighty, the Exalted, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

input: فوالله لو کان الأمر بیدی ما اظهرت نفسی علیکم فی اقلّ من آن و ما تکلّمت بکلمة.
output: Had the ultimate destiny of God's Faith been in Mine hands, I would have never consented, even though for one moment, to manifest Myself unto you, nor would I have allowed one word to fall from My lips.

input: و کان الله علی ذلک شهید و علیم.
output: Of this God Himself is, verily, a witness.

input: و بعد آهنگ رجوع نمودم.
output: Then summoned to return I beheld, and lo.

input: ملحوظ افتاد که حمامات قدسی چند در دست کلاب ارض مبتلا شده‌اند.
output: certain doves of holiness were sore tried within the claws of the dogs of earth.

input: و هزار لوح گواه شما.
output: Countless Tablets bear the testimony of the bounties vouchsafed unto thee.

input: بر نصرت امر قیام نمائید و بجنود بیان بتسخیر افئده و قلوب اهل عالم مشغول شوید.
output: Arise for the triumph of My Cause, and, through the power of thine utterance, subdue the hearts of men.

input: نفس اجتماع سبب تفریق نفوس موهومه است....
output: The mere act of your gathering together is enough to scatter the forces of these vain and worthless people....

input: این اصنام حائلند و خلق را از علوّ و صعود مانع.
output: These idols form the obstacle that impedeth man in his efforts to advance in the path of perfection.

input: امید آنکه ید اقتدار مدد فرماید و ناس را از ذلّت کبری برهاند.
output: We cherish the hope that the Hand of Divine power may lend its assistance to mankind, and deliver it from its state of grievous abasement.

input: بگو اهریمنان در کمین‌گاهان ایستاده‌اند.
output: Watch over yourselves, for the Evil One is lying in wait, ready to entrap you.

input: آگاه باشید و بروشنائی نام بینا از تیرگیها خود را آزاد نمائید.
output: Gird yourselves against his wicked devices, and, led by the light of the name of the All-Seeing God, make your escape from the darkness that surroundeth you.

input: حال اکثر اهل بلاد مستعدّند از برای اصغاء کلمهٴ علیا که بعث و حشر کلّ بآن منوط و معلّق است....
output: Behold how the generality of mankind hath been endued with the capacity to hearken unto God's most exalted Word—the Word upon which must depend the gathering together and spiritual resurrection of all men....

input: ای اهل عالم فضل این ظهور اعظم آنکه آنچه سبب اختلاف و فساد و نفاق است از کتاب محو نمودیم و آنچه علّت الفت و اتّحاد و اتّفاقست ثبت فرمودیم.
output: O ye that dwell on earth. The distinguishing feature that marketh the preeminent character of this Supreme Revelation consisteth in that We have, on the one hand, blotted out from the pages of God's holy Book whatsoever hath been the cause of strife, of malice and mischief amongst the children of men, and have, on the other, laid down the essential prerequisites of concord, of understanding, of complete and enduring unity.

input: یا معشر العلمآء اتّقوا الله ثمّ انصفوا فی امر هذا الأمّیّ الّذی شهدت له کتب الله المهیمن القیّوم....بترسید از خداوند یکتا این مظلوم با شما و امثال شما معاشر نبوده و کتب شما را ندیده و در مجلس تدریس وارد نشده.
output: Lay not aside the fear of God, O ye the learned of the world, and judge fairly the Cause of this unlettered One to Whom all the Books of God, the Protector, the Self-Subsisting, have testified.... Will not the dread of Divine displeasure, the fear of Him Who hath no peer or equal, arouse you. He Whom the world hath wronged hath, at no time, associated with you, hath never studied your writings, nor participated in any of your disputations.

input: شهادت میدهد بآنچه گفته شد کلاه او و زلف او و لباس او.
output: The garb He weareth, His flowing locks, His headdress, attest the truth of His words.

input: آخر انصاف کجا رفته.هیکل عدل در چه مکان آرمیده.
output: How long will ye persist in your injustice. Witness the habitation in which He, Who is the incarnation of justice, hath been forced to dwell.

input: چشم بگشائید و بدیدهٴ بصیرت نظر نمائید و تفکّر کنید شاید از انوار آفتاب بیان محروم نمانید و از امواج بحر عرفان ممنوع نشوید.
output: Open your eyes, and, beholding His plight, meditate diligently upon that which your hands have wrought, that haply ye may not be deprived of the light of His Divine utterance, nor remain bereft of your share of the ocean of His knowledge.

input: بعضی از امرا و آحاد ناس اعتراض نموده‌اند که این مظلوم از علما و سادات نبوده.
output: Certain ones among both commoners and nobles have objected that this wronged One is neither a member of the ecclesiastical order nor a descendant of the Prophet.

input: بگو ای اهل انصاف.
output: Say: O ye that claim to be just.

input: اگر فی‌الجمله تفکّر نمائید صدهزار بار این مقام را اعظم شمرید و اکبر دانید.
output: Reflect a little while, and ye shall recognize how infinitely exalted is His present state above the station ye claim He should possess.

input: قد اظهر الله امره من بیت ما کان فیه ما عند العلمآء و الفقهآء و العرفآء و الأدبآء.
output: The Will of the Almighty hath decreed that out of a house wholly devoid of all that the divines, the doctors, the sages, and scholars commonly possess His Cause should proceed and be made manifest.

input: نسمة الله او را بیدار نمود و بندا امر فرمود.
output: The Breathings of the Divine Spirit awoke Him, and bade Him arise and proclaim His Revelation.

input: فلمّا انتبه قام و نادی الکلّ الی الله ربّ العالمین.
output: No sooner was He roused from His slumber than He lifted up His voice and summoned the whole of mankind unto God, the Lord of all worlds.

input: این بیان نظر بضعف اهل امکان است والّا امرش مقدّس از اذکار و منزّه از افکار.
output: We have been moved to reveal these words in consideration of the weakness and frailty of men. otherwise, the Cause We have proclaimed is such as no pen can ever describe, nor any mind conceive its greatness.

input: یشهد بذلک من عنده امّ الکتاب.
output: To this beareth witness He with Whom is the Mother Book.

input: قد قیّد جمال القدم لاطلاق العالم و حبس فی الحصن الأعظم لعتق العالمین.
output: The Ancient Beauty hath consented to be bound with chains that mankind may be released from its bondage, and hath accepted to be made a prisoner within this most mighty Stronghold that the whole world may attain unto true liberty.

input: و اختار لنفسه الأحزان لسرور من فی الأکوان.
output: He hath drained to its dregs the cup of sorrow, that all the peoples of the earth may attain unto abiding joy, and be filled with gladness.

input: هذا من رحمة ربّک الرّحمن الرّحیم.
output: This is of the mercy of your Lord, the Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

input: قد قبلنا الذّلّة لعزّکم و الشّداید لرخائکم یا ملأ الموحّدین.
output: We have accepted to be abased, O believers in the Unity of God, that ye may be exalted, and have suffered manifold afflictions, that ye might prosper and flourish.

input: انّ الّذی جآء لتعمیر العالم قد اسکنه المشرکون فی اخرب البلاد.
output: He Who hath come to build anew the whole world, behold, how they that have joined partners with God have forced Him to dwell within the most desolate of cities.

input: لیس حزنی سجنی.
output: I sorrow not for the burden of My imprisonment.

input: و لا ذلّتی ابتلائی بین ایدی الأعدآء.
output: Neither do I grieve over My abasement, or the tribulation I suffer at the hands of Mine enemies.

input: انّها عزّ قد جعلها الله طراز نفسه.
output: They are My glory, a glory wherewith God hath adorned His own Self.

input: ان انتم من العارفین.
output: Would that ye know it.

input: بذلّتی ظهرت عزّة الکاینات و بابتلائی اشرقت شمس العدل علی العالمین.
output: The shame I was made to bear hath uncovered the glory with which the whole of creation had been invested, and through the cruelties I have endured, the Daystar of Justice hath manifested itself, and shed its splendor upon men.

input: بل حزنی من الّذین یرتکبون الفحشآء و ینسبون انفسهم الی الله العزیز الحمید.
output: My sorrows are for those who have involved themselves in their corrupt passions, and claim to be associated with the Faith of God, the Gracious, the All-Praised.

input: ینبغی لأهل البهآء ان ینقطعوا عمّن علی الأرض کلّها علی شأن یجدنّ اهل الفردوس نفحات التّقدیس من قمیصهم و یرون اهل الأکوان فی وجوههم نضرة الرّحمن الا انّهم من المقرّبین اولئک عباد بهم یظهر التّقدیس فی البلاد و تنتشر آثار الله العزیز الحکیم.
output: It behooveth the people of Bahá to die to the world and all that is therein, to be so detached from all earthly things that the inmates of Paradise may inhale from their garment the sweet smelling savor of sanctity, that all the peoples of the earth may recognize in their faces the brightness of the All-Merciful, and that through them may be spread abroad the signs and tokens of God, the Almighty, the All-Wise.

input: انّ الّذین ضیّعوا الأمر بما اتّبعوا اهوائهم انّهم فی ضلال مبین.
output: They that have tarnished the fair name of the Cause of God, by following the things of the flesh—these are in palpable error.

input: قل یا ملأ الیهود.
output: O Jews.

input: ان تریدوا ان تصلبوا الرّوح مرّة اخری تالله هذا لهو الرّوح قد ظهر بینکم.
output: If ye be intent on crucifying once again Jesus, the Spirit of God, put Me to death, for He hath once more, in My person, been made manifest unto you.

input: فافعلوا به ما تشاؤون لأنّه انفق روحه فی سبیل الله.
output: Deal with Me as ye wish, for I have vowed to lay down My life in the path of God.

input: و لا یخاف من احد ولو یجتمع علیه کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرض ان انتم توقنون.
output: I will fear no one, though the powers of earth and heaven be leagued against Me.

input: قل یا ملأ الانجیل.
output: Followers of the Gospel.

input: ان تریدوا ان تقتلوا محمّداً رسول الله تالله انّ هذا ذاته قد ظهر بالحقّ.
output: If ye cherish the desire to slay Muhammad, the Apostle of God, seize Me and put an end to My life, for I am He, and My Self is His Self.

input: فافعلوا به ما اردتم لأنّه یشتاق لقآء محبوبه فی ملکوت عزّه.
output: Do unto Me as ye like, for the deepest longing of Mine heart is to attain the presence of My Best-Beloved in His Kingdom of Glory.

input: و کذلک کان الأمر ان انتم تعلمون.
output: Such is the Divine decree, if ye know it.

input: قل یا ملأ الفرقان.
output: Followers of Muhammad.

input: ان تریدوا ان تعلّقوا هیکل علیّ الّذی نزل من عنده البیان تالله انّ هذا لمحبوبه الّذی قد ظهر باسم آخر.
output: If it be your wish to riddle with your shafts the breast of Him Who hath caused His Book the Bayán to be sent down unto you, lay hands on Me and persecute Me, for I am His Well-Beloved, the revelation of His own Self, though My name be not His name.

input: و قد اتی علی ظلل المعانی بسلطان من عنده.
output: I have come in the shadows of the clouds of glory, and am invested by God with invincible sovereignty.

input: و انّه لهو الحقّ علّام الغیوب.
output: He, verily, is the Truth, the Knower of things unseen.

input: و انتظر منکم ما فعلتم بظهور قبلی.
output: I, verily, anticipate from you the treatment ye have accorded unto Him that came before Me.

input: و یشهد بذلک کلّ شیء ان انتم تسمعون.
output: To this all things, verily, witness, if ye be of those who hearken.

input: ان یا ملأ البیان.
output: O people of the Bayán.

input: ان تریدوا ان تسفکوا دم الّذی به بشّرتم بلسان علیّ ثمّ من قبله بلسان محمّد ثمّ من قبله بلسان الرّوح فها هو هذا بینکم و ما عنده من ناصر لیمنعکم.
output: If ye have resolved to shed the blood of Him Whose coming the Báb hath proclaimed, Whose advent Muhammad hath prophesied, and Whose Revelation Jesus Christ Himself hath announced, behold Me standing, ready and defenseless, before you.

input: فیما تریدون ان تعملون.
output: Deal with Me after your own desires.

input: لو لم یکن مخالفاً بما نزل فی الألواح لقبّلت ید الّذی یسفک دمی فی سبیل محبوب العالمین.
output: Had it not been in conflict with that which the Tablets of God have decreed, I would have gladly kissed the hands of whosoever attempted to shed my blood in the path of the Well-Beloved.

input: و قدّرت عمّا ملّکنی الله له ارثاً ولو انّه یستحقّ بذلک نقمة الله و سخطه ثمّ قهره و غضبه بدوام الله الملک العادل الحکیم.
output: I would, moreover, have bestowed upon him a share of such worldly goods as God had allowed me to possess, even though he who perpetrated this act would have provoked the wrath of the Almighty, incurred His malediction, and deserved to be tormented throughout the eternity of God, the All-Possessing, the Equitable, the All-Wise.

input: ثمّ اعلم بأنّ هذا الغلام کلّما یکون ناظراً الی نفسه یجدها احقر الوجود.
output: Know verily that whenever this Youth turneth His eyes towards His own self, he findeth it the most insignificant of all creation.

input: و کلّما یرتدّ البصر الی تجلّیات الّتی ظهرت منها یجدها سلطان الغیب و الشّهود.
output: When He contemplates, however, the bright effulgences He hath been empowered to manifest, lo, that self is transfigured before Him into a sovereign Potency permeating the essence of all things visible and invisible.

input: فسبحان الّذی بعث مظهر نفسه بالحقّ و ارسله علی کلّ شاهد و مشهود.
output: Glory be to Him Who, through the power of truth, hath sent down the Manifestation of His own Self and entrusted Him with His message unto all mankind.

input: ای بی‌خبران سر از نوم غفلت بردارید و انوارش که عالم را احاطه نموده مشاهده کنید.
output: Shake off, O heedless ones, the slumber of negligence, that ye may behold the radiance which His glory hath spread through the world.

input: بعضی میگویند زود اشراق نموده.
output: How foolish are those who murmur against the premature birth of His light.

input: ای بی‌بصران.
output: O ye who are inly blind.

input: یا قریب و یا بعید حال اشراق فرموده.
output: Whether too soon or too late, the evidences of His effulgent glory are now actually manifest.

input: شما ملاحظه نمائید فی‌الحقیقه این اشراق محقّق است یا نه.
output: It behooveth you to ascertain whether or not such a light hath appeared.

input: دیگر قرب و بعد آن در دست شما و این غلام نبوده و نخواهد بود.
output: It is neither within your power nor mine to set the time at which it should be made manifest.

input: حکمت الهیّه که از انظر بریّه مستور است اقتضا نموده.
output: God's inscrutable Wisdom hath fixed its hour beforehand.

input: یا قوم فارضوا بما رضی الله لکم و قضی علیکم....ای صاحبان بغضا.
output: Be content, O people, with that which God hath desired for you and predestined unto you.... O my ill-wishers.

input: قسم بآفتاب فلک بقا که اگر امر بدست این عبد بود هرگز خود را معروف نمینمودم چه که اسم مذکورم ننگ دارد از ذکر این السن غیر طاهرهٴ کاذبه.
output: The Daystar of eternal Guidance beareth me witness: Had it been in my power, I would have, under no circumstances, consented to distinguish myself amongst men, for the Name I bear utterly disdaineth to associate itself with this generation whose tongues are sullied and whose hearts are false.

input: و در هر حین که ساکن شده و صمت اختیار نمودم روح القدس از یمینم ناطق شده و روح الأعظم قدّام وجهم و روح الأمین فوق رأسم و روح البهآء در صدرم ندا فرموده.
output: And whenever I chose to hold my peace and be still, lo, the voice of the Holy Ghost, standing on my right hand, aroused me, and the Supreme Spirit appeared before my face, and Gabriel overshadowed me, and the Spirit of Glory stirred within my bosom, bidding me arise and break my silence.

input: و حال اگر بسمع لطیف استماع شود از جمیع اعضا و احشا و عروق و اظفار ندآء الله را استماع نمائید حتّی از شعراتم میشنوید بأنّه لا اله الّا هو و انّ هذا الجمال لبهائه لمن فی السّموات و الأرضین.
output: If your hearing be purged and your ears be attentive, ye will assuredly perceive that every limb of my body, nay all the atoms of my being, proclaim and bear witness to this call: God, besides Whom is none other God, and He, Whose beauty is now manifest, is the reflection of His glory unto all that are in heaven and on earth.

input: انّ هذا لبحر الّذی منه ظهرت البحور و الیه یذهب کلّها.
output: This is the Ocean out of which all seas have proceeded, and with which every one of them will ultimately be united.

input: و منه اشرقت الشّموس و الیه یرجع کلّها.
output: From Him all the Suns have been generated, and unto Him they will all return.

input: و منه اثمرت سدرات الأمر بأثمار الّتی کلّ واحدة منها بعثت علی هیکل نبیّ و ارسل الی عالم من عوالم الّتی ما احصاها احد الّا نفس الله.
output: Through His potency the Trees of Divine Revelation have yielded their fruits, every one of which hath been sent down in the form of a Prophet, bearing a Message to God's creatures in each of the worlds whose number God, alone, in His all-encompassing Knowledge, can reckon.

input: الّتی احاطت الموجودات بحرف من کلمة الّتی خرج من قلمه الّذی کان محکوماً تحت اصبعه الّذی کان علی الحقّ قویّاً.
output: This He hath accomplished through the agency of but one Letter of His Word, revealed by His Pen—a Pen moved by His directing Finger—His Finger itself sustained by the power of God's Truth.

input: لا تمنعوا انفسکم عن فضل الله و رحمته.
output: Withhold not from yourselves the grace of God and His mercy.

input: و من یمنع و انّه علی خسران عظیم.
output: Whoso withholdeth himself therefrom is indeed in grievous loss.

input: أ تعبدون التّراب و تدعون ربّکم العزیز الوهّاب.
output: Do ye worship the dust, and turn away from your Lord, the Gracious, the All-Bountiful.

input: اتّقوا الله و لا تکوننّ من الخاسرین.
output: Fear ye God, and be not of those who perish.

input: قل قد ظهر کتاب الله علی هیکل الغلام.
output: Say: The Book of God hath been sent down in the form of this Youth.

input: فتبارک الله احسن المبدعین.
output: Hallowed, therefore, be God, the most excellent of makers.

input: انتم یا ملأ الأرض. لا تهربوا عنه.
output: Take ye good heed, O peoples of the world, lest ye flee from His face.

input: ان اسرعوا الیه و کونوا من الرّاجعین.
output: Nay, make haste to attain His presence, and be of them that have returned unto Him.

input: توبوا یا قوم عمّا قد فرّطتم فی جنب الله و ما اسرفتم فی امره و لا تکوننّ من الجاهلین.
output: Pray to be forgiven, O people, for having failed in your duty towards God, and for having trespassed against His Cause, and be not of the foolish.

input: هو الّذی خلقکم
output: He it is Who hath created you.

input: و رزقکم بأمره و عرّفکم نفسه العزیز العلیّ العلیم.
output: He it is Who hath nourished your souls through His Cause, and enabled you to recognize Him Who is the Almighty, the Most Exalted, the All-Knowing.

input: و اظهر لکم کنوز العرفان و عرّجکم الی سمآء الایقان فی امره المحکم العزیز الرّفیع.
output: He it is Who hath unveiled to your eyes the treasures of His knowledge, and caused you to ascend unto the heaven of certitude—the certitude of His resistless, His irrefutable, and most exalted Faith.

input: ایّاکم ان لا تمنعوا فضل الله علی انفسکم و لا تبطلوا اعمالکم و لا تنکروه فی هذا الظّهور الأظهر الأمنع المشرق المنیر.
output: Beware that ye do not deprive yourselves of the grace of God, that ye do not bring to naught your works, and do not repudiate the truth of this most manifest, this lofty, this shining, and glorious Revelation.

input: فأنصفوا فی امر الله بارئکم ثمّ انظروا الی ما نزل عن جهة العرش و تفکّروا فیه بقلوب طاهر سلیم.
output: Judge ye fairly the Cause of God, your Creator, and behold that which hath been sent down from the Throne on high, and meditate thereon with innocent and sanctified hearts.

input: اذاً یظهر لکم الأمر کظهور الشّمس فی وسط السّمآء.
output: Then will the truth of this Cause appear unto you as manifest as the sun in its noontide glory.

input: و تکوننّ من الموقنین.
output: Then will ye be of them that have believed in Him.

input: قل انّ دلیله نفسه.
output: Say: The first and foremost testimony establishing His truth is His own Self.

input: ثمّ ظهوره.
output: Next to this testimony is His Revelation.

input: و من یعجز عن عرفانهما جعل الدّلیل له آیاته.
output: For whoso faileth to recognize either the one or the other He hath established the words He hath revealed as proof of His reality and truth.

input: و هذا من فضله علی العالمین.
output: This is, verily, an evidence of His tender mercy unto men.

input: و اودع فی کلّ نفس ما یعرف به آثار الله.
output: He hath endowed every soul with the capacity to recognize the signs of God.

input: و من دون ذلک لن یتمّ حجّته علی عباده ان انتم فی امره لمن المتفکّرین.
output: How could He, otherwise, have fulfilled His testimony unto men, if ye be of them that ponder His Cause in their hearts.

input: انّه لا یظلم نفساً و لا یأمر العباد فوق طاقتهم.
output: He will never deal unjustly with anyone, neither will He task a soul beyond its power.

input: و انّه لهو الرّحمن الرّحیم.
output: He, verily, is the Compassionate, the All-Merciful.

input: قل قد ظهر امر الله علی شأن یعرفه اکمه الأرض و کیف ذی بصر طاهر منیر.
output: Say: So great is the glory of the Cause of God that even the blind can perceive it, how much more they whose sight is sharp, whose vision is pure.

input: و انّ الأکمه لن یدرک الشّمس ببصرها ولکن یدرک حرارة.
output: The blind, though unable to perceive the light of the sun, are, nevertheless, capable of experiencing its continual heat.

input: الّتی تظهر منها فی کلّ شهور و سنین ولکن اکمه البیان تالله لن یعرف الشّمس و لا اثرها و ضیائها ولو تطلع فی مقابلة عینه فی کلّ حین.
output: The blind in heart, however, among the people of the Bayán—and to this God is My witness—are impotent, no matter how long the Sun may shine upon them, either to perceive the radiance of its glory, or to appreciate the warmth of its rays.

input: قل یا ملأ البیان.
output: Say: O people of the Bayán.

input: انّا اختصصناکم لعرفان نفسنا بین العالمین.
output: We have chosen you out of the world to know and recognize Our Self.

input: و قرّبناکم الی شاطئ الأیمن عن یمین بقعة الفردوس مقام الّذی فیه تنطق النّار علی کلّ الألحان بأنّه لا اله الّا انا العلیّ العظیم.
output: We have caused you to draw nigh unto the right side of Paradise—the Spot out of which the undying Fire crieth in manifold accents: There is none other God besides Me, the All-Powerful, the Most High.

input: ایّاکم ان لا تحتجبوا انفسکم عن هذه الشّمس الّتی استضآءت عن افق مشیّة ربّکم الرّحمن بضیآء الّذی احاط کلّ صغیر و کبیر.
output: Take heed lest ye allow yourselves to be shut out as by a veil from this Daystar that shineth above the dayspring of the Will of your Lord, the All-Merciful, and whose light hath encompassed both the small and the great.

input: ان افتحوا ابصارکم لتشهدوها بعیونکم و لا تعلّقوا ابصارکم بذی بصر لأنّ الله ما کلّف نفساً الّا بعد وسعها.
output: Purge your sight, that ye may perceive its glory with your own eyes, and depend not on the sight of anyone except yourself, for God hath never burdened any soul beyond its power.

input: و کذلک نزل فی کلّ الألواح علی النّبیّین و المرسلین.
output: Thus hath it been sent down unto the Prophets and Messengers of old, and been recorded in all the Scriptures.

input: ان ادخلوا یا قوم فی هذا الفضآء الّذی ما قدّر له من اوّل و لا من آخر و فیه ارتفع ندآء الله و تهبّ روایح قدسه المنیع.
output: Strive, O people, to gain admittance into this vast Immensity for which God ordained neither beginning nor end, in which His voice hath been raised, and over which have been wafted the sweet savors of holiness and glory.

input: و لا تجعلوا اجسادکم عریّاً عن ردآء العزّ و لا قلوبکم عن ذکر ربّکم و لا سمعکم عن استماع نغماته الأبدع الأمنع العزیز الأفصح البلیغ.
output: Divest not yourselves of the Robe of grandeur, neither suffer your hearts to be deprived of remembering your Lord, nor your ears of hearkening unto the sweet melodies of His wondrous, His sublime, His all-compelling, His clear, and most eloquent voice.

input: ای نصیر ای عبد من.
output: O Nasír, O My servant.

input: غلام روحی با رحیق ابهی در فوق کلّ رؤس الیوم ناظر و واقف که که را نظر بر او افتد و من غیر اشاره از کفّ بیضایش اخذ نموده بیاشامد.
output: The Celestial Youth hath, in this Day, raised above the heads of men the glorious Chalice of Immortality, and is standing expectant upon His seat, wondering what eye will recognize His glory, and what arm will, unhesitatingly, be stretched forth to seize the Cup from His snow-white Hand and drain it.

input: ولکن هنوز احدی فایز باین سلسال بی‌مثال سلطان لایزال نشده.
output: Only a few have as yet quaffed from this peerless, this soft-flowing grace of the Ancient King.

input: الّا معدودی و هم فی جنّة الأعلی فوق الجنان علی سرر التّمکین هم مستقرّون.
output: These occupy the loftiest mansions of Paradise, and are firmly established upon the seats of authority.

input: لن یسبقهم المرایا و لا مظاهر الأسمآء و لا کلّ ما کان و ما یکون ان انتم من العارفین.
output: Neither the mirrors of His glory, nor the revealers of His names, nor any created thing, that hath been or will ever be, can ever excel them, if ye be of them that comprehend this truth.

input: ای نصیر.
output: O Nasír.

input: این نه ایّامی است که عرفان عارفین و ادراک مدرکین فضلش را درک نماید تا چه رسد بغافلین و محتجبین.
output: The excellence of this Day is immensely exalted above the comprehension of men, however extensive their knowledge, however profound their understanding.

input: تا چه رسد بغافلین و محتجبین.
output: How much more must it transcend the imaginations of them that have strayed from its light, and been shut out from its glory.

input: و اگر بصر را از حجبات اکبر مطهّر سازی فضلی مشاهده نمائی که از اوّل لا اوّل الی آخر لا آخر شبه و مثل و ندّ و نظیر و مثال از برایش نه‌بینی.
output: Shouldst thou rend asunder the grievous veil that blindeth thy vision, thou wouldst behold such a bounty as naught, from the beginning that hath no beginning till the end that hath no end, can either resemble or equal.

input: ولکن لسان الله بچه بیان ناطق شود که محتجبان درک او نمایند.
output: What language should He Who is the Mouthpiece of God choose to speak, so that they who are shut out as by a veil from Him can recognize His glory.

input: و الأبرار یشربون من رحیق القدس علی اسمی الأبهی من ملکوت الأعلی.
output: The righteous, inmates of the Kingdom on high, shall drink deep from the Wine of Holiness, in My name, the all-glorious.

input: و لم یکن لدونهم من نصیب.
output: None other besides them will share such benefits.

input: فونفسه المحبوب.
output: By the righteousness of God, my Well-Beloved.

input: ما اردت ان اکون رئیساً.
output: I have never aspired after worldly leadership.

input: لمن علی الأرض بل القی علیهم ما امرت به من لدن عزیز جمیل لینقطعهم عن شؤونات الأرض و یصعدهم الی مقرّ الّذی انقطعت عنه عرفان المشرکین ثمّ ادراک المعرضین.
output: My sole purpose hath been to hand down unto men that which I was bidden to deliver by God, the Gracious, the Incomparable, that it may detach them from all that pertaineth to this world, and cause them to attain such heights as neither the ungodly can conceive, nor the froward imagine.

input: یا ارض الطّآء یاد آر هنگامی را که مقرّ عرش بودی و انوارش از در و دیوارت ظاهر و هویدا.
output: Call thou to remembrance, O Land of Ta Tihrán, the former days in which thy Lord had made thee the seat of His throne, and had enveloped thee with the effulgence of His glory.

input: چه مقدار از نفوس مقدّسهٴ مطمئنّه که بحبّت جان دادند و روان ایثار نمودند.
output: How vast the number of those sanctified beings, those symbols of certitude, who, in their great love for thee, have laid down their lives and sacrificed their all for thy sake.

input: طوبی از برای تو و از برای نفوسی که در تو ساکنند.
output: Joy be to thee, and blissfulness to them that inhabit thee.

input: هر صاحب شمّی عرف مقصود را از تو مییابد.
output: I testify that out of thee, as every discerning heart knoweth, proceedeth the living breath of Him Who is the Desire of the world.

input: در تو پدید آمد آنچه مستور بود و از تو ظاهر شد آنچه پوشیده و پنهان.
output: In thee the Unseen hath been revealed, and out of thee hath gone forth that which lay hid from the eyes of men.

input: کدام عاشق صادق را ذکر نمائیم که در تو جان داد و در خاکت پنهان شد.
output: Which one of the multitude of thy sincere lovers shall We remember, whose blood hath been shed within thy gates, and whose dust is now concealed beneath thy soil.

input: نفحات قمیص الهی از تو قطع نشده و نخواهد شد.
output: The sweet savors of God have unceasingly been wafted, and shall everlastingly continue to be wafted upon thee.

input: ما ذکر مینمائیم تو را و مظلومان و مظلوماتی که در تو مستورند.
output: Our Pen is moved to commemorate thee, and to extol the victims of tyranny, those men and women that sleep beneath thy dust.

input: انّا نذکر اختی اظهاراً لعنایتی و ابرازاً لوفائی.
output: Among them is Our own sister, whom We now call to mind as a token of Our fidelity, and as proof of Our loving-kindness, unto her.

input: بمظلومیّت کبری بحقّ راجع شد.
output: How piteous was her plight. In what a state of resignation she returned to her God.

input: ما اطّلع بذلک الّا علمی المحیط.
output: We, alone, in Our all-encompassing knowledge, have known it.

input: ای ارض طاء.
output: O Land of Ta.

input: حال هم از فضل الهی محلّ و مقرّ دوستان حقّی.
output: Thou art still, through the grace of God, a center around which His beloved ones have gathered.

input: طوبی لهم و للّذین هاجروا الیک فی سبیل الله مالک هذا الیوم البدیع.
output: Happy are they. happy every refugee that seeketh thy shelter, in his sufferings in the path of God, the Lord of this wondrous Day.

input: طوبی از برای نفوسی که بذکر و ثنای حقّ ناطقند و بخدمت امر مشغول.
output: Blessed are they that remember the one true God, that magnify His Name, and seek diligently to serve His Cause.

input: ایشانند آن نفوسی که در کتب قبل مذکورند.
output: It is to these men that the sacred Books of old have referred.

input: امیرالمؤمنین علیه بهائی در وصفشان فرموده طوباهم افضل من طوبانا.
output: On them hath the Commander of the Faithful lavished his praise, saying: The blessedness awaiting them excelleth the blessedness we now enjoy.

input: قد نطق بالصّدق و انا من الشّاهدین.
output: He, verily, hath spoken the truth, and to this We now testify.

input: اگرچه حال این مقامات مستور است.
output: The glory of their station, however, is as yet undisclosed.

input: ولکن ید قدرت البتّه مانع را بردارد و ظاهر فرماید آنچه را که سبب و علّت روشنی چشم عالم است.
output: The Hand of Divine power will, assuredly, lift up the veil, and expose to the sight of men that which shall cheer and lighten the eye of the world.

input: شکر نمائید حقّ جلّ جلاله را که باین عنایت بدیعه فائز شدید و بطراز بیان رحمن مزیّن قدر وقت را بدانید و بآنچه سزاوار است تمسّک نمائید.
output: Render thanks unto God, the Eternal Truth, exalted be His glory, inasmuch as ye have attained so wondrous a favor, and been adorned with the ornament of His praise. Appreciate the value of these days, and cleave to whatsoever beseemeth this Revelation.

input: انّه لهو النّاصح المشفق العلیم.
output: He, verily, is the Counselor, the Compassionate, the All-Knowing.

input: یا ارض الطّاء لا تحزنی من شیء قد جعلک الله مطلع فرح العالمین.
output: Let nothing grieve thee, O Land of Ta Tihrán, for God hath chosen thee to be the source of the joy of all mankind.

input: لو یشآء یبارک سریرک بالّذی یحکم بالعدل و یجمع اغنام الله الّتی تفرّقت من الذّئاب.
output: He shall, if it be His Will, bless thy throne with one who will rule with justice, who will gather together the flock of God which the wolves have scattered.

input: علیه بهآءالله و بهآء من فی ملکوت الامر فی کلّ حین.
output: Upon him rest forever the glory of God, and the glory of all that dwell in the kingdom of His revelation.

input: افرحی بما جعلک الله افق النّور بما ولد فیک مطلع الظّهور.
output: Rejoice with great joy, for God hath made thee the Dayspring of His light, inasmuch as within thee was born the Manifestation of His Glory.

input: و سمّیت بهذا الاسم الّذی به لاح نیّر الفضل و اشرقت السّموات و الارضون.
output: Be thou glad for this name that hath been conferred upon thee—a name through which the Daystar of grace hath shed its splendor, through which both earth and heaven have been illumined.

input: سوف تنقلب فیک الامور و یحکم علیک جمهور النّاس.
output: Erelong will the state of affairs within thee be changed, and the reins of power fall into the hands of the people.

input: انّ ربّک لهو العلیم.
output: Verily, thy Lord is the All-Knowing.

input: انّه لا تنقطع عنک لحظات الالطاف.
output: The eye of His loving-kindness shall everlastingly be directed towards thee.

input: کذلک قضی الامر فی کتاب بدیع.
output: Thus hath it been decreed in the wondrous Book.

input: ان یا محمّد اذا خرجت عن ساحة العرش ان اقصد زیارة البیت من قبل ربّک.
output: When thou art departed out of the court of My presence, O Muhammad, direct thy steps towards My House Baghdád House, and visit it on behalf of thy Lord.

input: و اذا حضرت تلقآء الباب قف و قل یا بیت الله الأعظم این جمال القدم الّذی به جعلک الله قبلة الأمم و آیة ذکره لمن فی السّموات و الأرضین.
output: When thou reachest its door, stand thou before it and say: Whither is the Ancient Beauty gone, O most great House of God, He through Whom God hath made thee the cynosure of an adoring world, and proclaimed thee to be the sign of His remembrance unto all who are in the heavens and all who are on the earth.

input: یا بیت الله این الأیّام الّتی کنت فیها موطأ قدمیه و این الأیّام الّتی ارتفعت منک نغمات الرّحمن فی کلّ الأحیان.
output: Oh. for the former days when thou, O House of God, wert made His footstool, the days when in ceaseless strains the melody of the All-Merciful poured forth from thee.

input: و این طرازک الّذی منه استضآء من فی الأکوان.
output: What hath become of thy jewel whose glory hath irradiated all creation.

input: این الأیّام الّتی کنت عرشاً لاستقرار هیکل القدم و این الأیّام الّتی کنت مصباح الفلاح بین الأرض و السّمآء و تتضوّع منک نفحات السّبحان فی کلّ صباح و مسآء.
output: Whither are gone the days in which He, the Ancient King, had made thee the throne of His glory, the days in which He had chosen thee alone to be the lamp of salvation between earth and heaven, and caused thee to diffuse, at dawn and at eventide, the sweet fragrance of the All-Glorious.

input: یا بیت ‌الله این شمس العظمة و الاقتدار الّتی کانت مشرقة من افقک
output: Where, O House of God, is the Sun of majesty and power Who had enveloped thee with the brightness of His presence.

input: و این مطلع عنایة ربّک المختار الّذی کان مستویاً علیک.
output: Where is He, the Dayspring of the tender mercies of thy Lord, the Unconstrained, Who had established His seat within thy walls.

input: ما لی یا عرش الله اری تغیّر حالک و اضطربت ارکانک.
output: What is it, O throne of God, that hath altered thy countenance, and made thy pillars to tremble.

input: و غلق بابک علی وجه من ارادک.
output: What could have closed thy door to the face of them that eagerly seek thee.

input: و ما لی اراک الخراب.
output: What hath made thee so desolate.

input: أ سمعت محبوب العالمین تحت سیوف الأحزاب.
output: Couldst thou have been told that the Beloved of the world is pursued by the swords of His enemies.

input: طوبی لک و لوفائک بما اقتدیت مولاک فی احزانه و بلایاه.
output: The Lord bless thee, and bless thy fidelity unto Him, inasmuch as thou hast remained His companion through all His sorrows and His sufferings.

input: اشهد بأنّک المنظر الأکبر و المقرّ الأطهر.
output: I testify that thou art the scene of His transcendent glory, His most holy habitation.

input: و منک مرّت نسمة السّبحان علی من فی الأکوان و استفرحت قلوب المخلصین فی غرفات الجنان.
output: Out of thee hath gone forth the Breath of the All-Glorious, a Breath that hath breathed over all created things, and filled with joy the breasts of the devout that dwell in the mansions of Paradise.

input: و الیوم ینوح بما ورد علیک الملأ الأعلی و سکّان مداین الأسمآء.
output: The Concourse on high, and they that inhabit the Cities of the Names of God, weep over thee, and bewail the things that have befallen thee.

input: انّک لم تزل کنت مظهر الأسمآء و الصّفات و مسرح لحظات مالک الأرضین و السّموات.
output: Thou art still the symbol of the names and attributes of the Almighty, the Point towards which the eyes of the Lord of earth and heaven are directed.

input: قد ورد علیک ما ورد علی التّابوت الّذی کانت فیه السّکینة.
output: There hath befallen thee what hath befallen the Ark in which God's pledge of security had been made to dwell.

input: طوبی لمن یعرف لحن القول فیما اراد مالک البریّة.
output: Well is it with him that apprehendeth the intent of these words, and recognizeth the purpose of Him Who is the Lord of all creation.

input: و طوبی للّذین یستنشقون منک نفحات الرّحمن و یعرفون قدرک و یحفظون حرمتک و یراعون شأنک فی کلّ الأحیان.
output: Happy are those that inhale from thee the sweet savors of the Merciful, that acknowledge thine exaltation, that safeguard thy sanctity, that reverence, at all times, thy station.

input: نسأل الله بأن یفتح بصر الّذین غفلوا عنک و ما عرفوا قدرک لعرفانک و عرفان من رفعک بالحقّ.
output: We implore the Almighty to grant that the eyes of those who have turned away from thee, and failed to appreciate thy worth, may be opened, that they may truly recognize thee, and Him Who, through the power of truth, hath raised thee up on high.

input: انّهم قوم عمون و الیوم لا یعرفون.
output: Blind, indeed, are they about thee, and utterly unaware of thee in this day.

input: انّ ربّک لهو العزیز الغفور.
output: Thy Lord is, verily, the Gracious, the Forgiving.

input: اشهد بک امتحن الله عباده.
output: I bear witness that through thee God hath proved the hearts of His servants.

input: طوبی لمن اقبل الیک و یزورک.
output: Blessed be the man that directeth his steps toward thee, and visiteth thee.

input: و ویل للّذین انکروا حقّک و اعرضوا عنک و ضیّعوا قدرک و هتکوا حرمتک.
output: Woe to him that denieth thy right, that turneth away from thee, that dishonoreth thy name, and profaneth thy holiness.

input: یا بیت ‌الله ان هتک المشرکون ستر حرمتک لا تحزن.
output: Grieve not, O House of God, if the veil of thy sanctity be rent asunder by the infidels.

input: قد زیّنک الله بطراز ذکره بین الأرض و السّمآء.
output: God hath, in the world of creation, adorned thee with the jewel of His remembrance.

input: و انّه لا یهتک ابداً.
output: Such an ornament no man can, at any time, profane.

input: انّک تکون منظر ربّک فی کلّ الأحیان.
output: Towards thee the eyes of thy Lord shall, under all conditions, remain directed.

input: و یسمع ندآء من یزورک و یطوف حولک و یدعوه بک.
output: He, verily, will incline His ear to the prayer of every one that visiteth thee, who will circle around thee, and calleth upon Him in thy name.

input: یا الهی اسألک بهذا البیت الّذی تغیّر فی فراقک و ینوح لهجرک و ما ورد علیک فی ایّامک بأن تغفر لی و لأبویّ و ذوی قرابتی و المؤمنین من اخوانی.
output: I beseech Thee, O my God, by this House that hath suffered such change in its separation from Thee, that bewaileth its remoteness from Thy presence, and lamenteth Thy tribulation, to forgive me, and my parents, and my kindred, and such of my brethren as have believed in Thee.

input: ثمّ اقض لی حوائجی کلّها بجودک یا سلطان الأسمآء.
output: Grant that all my needs be satisfied, through Thy bounty, O Thou Who art the King of Names.

input: انّک انت أکرم الأکرمین و مولی العالمین.
output: Thou art the most Bountiful of the bountiful, the Lord of all worlds.

input: اذکر ما نزل فی ارض السّرّ فی السّنة الأولی لعبدنا المهدی.
output: Call thou to mind that which hath been revealed unto Mihdí, Our servant, in the first year of Our banishment to the Land of Mystery Adrianople.

input: و اخبرناه به فیما یرد علی البیت من بعد لئلّا یحزنه ما ورد من قبل من الّذی اعتدی و سرق
output: Unto him have We predicted that which must befall Our House Baghdád House, in the days to come, lest he grieve over the acts of robbery and violence already perpetrated against it.

input: عند ربّک علم السّموات و الأرضین.
output: Verily, the Lord, thy God, knoweth all that is in the heavens and all that is on the earth.

input: قلنا و قولنا الحقّ ثمّ اعلم بأنّ لیس هذا اوّل وهن نزل علی بیتی و قد نزل من قبل بما اکتسبت ایدی الظّالمین.
output: To him We have written: This is not the first humiliation inflicted upon My House. In days gone by the hand of the oppressor hath heaped indignities upon it. Verily, it shall be so abased in the days to come as to cause tears to flow from every discerning eye.

input: و سینزل علیه من الذّلّة ما تجری به الدّموع عن کلّ بصر بصیر.
output: Verily, it shall be so abased in the days to come as to cause tears to flow from every discerning eye.

input: کذلک القیناک بما هو المستور فی حجب الغیب و ما اطّلع به احد الّا الله العزیز الحمید.
output: Thus have We unfolded to thee things hidden beyond the veil, inscrutable to all save God, the Almighty, the All-Praised.

input: ثمّ تمضی ایّام یرفعه الله بالحقّ
output: In the fullness of time, the Lord shall, by the power of truth, exalt it in the eyes of all men.

input: ثمّ تمضی ایّام یرفعه الله بالحقّ و یجعله علماً فی الملک بحیث یطوف فی حوله ملأ عارفون.
output: He shall cause it to become the Standard of His Kingdom, the Shrine round which will circle the concourse of the faithful.

input: هذا قول ربّک من قبل ان یأتی یوم الفزع.
output: Thus hath spoken the Lord, thy God, ere the day of lamentation arriveth.

input: قد اخبرناک به فی هذا اللّوح لئلّا یحزنک ما ورد علی البیت بما اکتسبت ایدی المعتدین.
output: This revelation have We given thee in Our holy Tablet, lest thou sorrow for what hath befallen Our House through the assaults of the enemy.

input: و الحمد لله العلیم الحکیم.
output: All praise be to God, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

input: هر منصفی شهادت داده و میدهد که این مظلوم از اوّل ظهور کل را بافق اعلی دعوت نموده و از شقاوت و بغضا و بغی و فحشا منع فرموده.
output: Every unbiased observer will readily admit that, ever since the dawn of His Revelation, this wronged One hath invited all mankind to turn their faces towards the Dayspring of Glory, and hath forbidden corruption, hatred, oppression, and wickedness.

input: مع‌ذلک اهل اعتساف وارد آوردند.
output: And yet, behold what the hand of the oppressor hath wrought.

input: آنچه را که قلم از ذکرش عاجز و قاصر است.
output: No pen dare describe his tyranny.

input: حقّ حیات و راحت از برای کل خواسته ولکن عباد در قتل احبّا و سفک دم مطهّرش فتوی داده‌اند.
output: Though the purpose of Him Who is the Eternal Truth hath been to confer everlasting life upon all men, and ensure their security and peace, yet witness how they have arisen to shed the blood of His loved ones, and have pronounced on Him the sentence of death.

input: و مطالع این ظلم جهلائی هستند که باسم علم معروفند.
output: The instigators of this oppression are those very persons who, though so foolish, are reputed the wisest of the wise.

input: بشأنی بر اعراض قیام نموده‌اند که نفسی را که عالم از برای خدّام درگهش خلق شده او را بظلم مبین در سجن محکم متین حبس نموده‌اند.
output: Such is their blindness that, with unfeigned severity, they have cast into this fortified and afflictive Prison Him, for the servants of Whose Threshold the world hath been created.

input: ولکنّ الله بدّل السّجن بالجنّة العلیا و الفردوس الأعلی رغماً لهم و للّذین کفروا بهذا النّبإ العظیم.
output: The Almighty, however, in spite of them and those that have repudiated the truth of this Great Announcement, hath transformed this Prison House into the Most Exalted Paradise, the Heaven of Heavens.

input: و آنچه از اسباب ظاهره موجود شد منع ننمودیم.
output: We did not refuse such material benefits as could relieve Us from Our afflictions.

input: نفوسی که با این مظلوم معاشر بودند کل گواهی میدهند که ساحت اقدس مقدّس از اسباب ظاهره بوده.
output: Every one of Our companions, however, will bear Us witness that Our holy court is sanctified from, and far above, such material benefits.

input: ولکن در سجن قبول نمودیم آنچه را که مشرکین ارادهٴ منع آن نمودند.
output: We have nevertheless accepted, while confined in this Prison, those things of which the infidels have striven to deprive Us.

input: و اگر نفسی یافت شود و بیتی از ذهب و یا فضّه و یا فوق این دو از جواهر نفیسه بنا نماید اذن داده و میدهیم.
output: If a man be found willing to rear, in Our name, an edifice of pure gold or silver, or a house begemmed with stones of inestimable value, such a wish will no doubt be granted.

input: انّه یفعل ما یشآء و یحکم ما یرید.
output: He, verily, doeth what He willeth, and ordaineth that which He pleaseth.

input: و اذن داده شد که در این ارض بناهای عالیه ترتیب دهند و باسم حقّ جلّ جلاله اراضی طیّبهٔ طاهره که بنهر اردن متّصل است و یا حول او اخذ نمایند لیظهر ما کان مسطوراً من القلم الأعلی فی کتب القبل و ما اراده الله ربّ العالمین فی هذا الظّهور الأمنع الأقدس العزیز البدیع.
output: Leave hath, moreover, been given to whosoever may desire to raise, throughout the length and breadth of this land, noble and imposing structures, and dedicate the rich and sacred territories adjoining the Jordan and its vicinity to the worship and service of the one true God, magnified be His glory, that the prophecies recorded by the Pen of the Most High in the sacred Scriptures may be fulfilled, and that which God, the Lord of all worlds, hath purposed in this most exalted, this most holy, this mighty, and wondrous Revelation may be made manifest.

input: قلنا من قبل اوسعی ذیلک یا اورشلیم.
output: We have, of old, uttered these words: Spread thy skirt, O Jerusalem.

input: ان اعرفوا یا اهل البهآء ثمّ اشکروا ربّکم المبیّن المبین.
output: Ponder this in your hearts, O people of Bahá, and render thanks unto your Lord, the Expounder, the Most Manifest.

input: اگر حکمتهای بالغهٴ الهی ظاهر شود کل عدل محض را مشاهده مینمایند.
output: Were the mysteries, that are known to none except God, to be unraveled, the whole of mankind would witness the evidences of perfect and consummate justice.

input: و بیقین مبین باوامرش تمسّک میجویند و تشبّث مینمایند.
output: With a certitude that none can question, all men would cleave to His commandments, and would scrupulously observe them.

input: قد قدّرنا فی الکتاب خیراً کثیراً لمن اعرض عن الفحشآء متمسّکاً بالتّقوی.
output: We, verily, have decreed in Our Book a goodly and bountiful reward to whosoever will turn away from wickedness and lead a chaste and godly life.

input: انّه لهو المعطی الکریم.
output: He, in truth, is the Great Giver, the All-Bountiful.

input: لیس ذلّتی سجنی.
output: My captivity can bring on Me no shame.

input: لعمری انّه عزّ لی.
output: Nay, by My life, it conferreth on Me glory.

input: بل الذّلّة عمل احبّائی الّذین ینسبون انفسهم الینا و یتّبعون الشّیطان فی اعمالهم.
output: That which can make Me ashamed is the conduct of such of My followers as profess to love Me, yet in fact follow the Evil One.

input: الا انّهم من الخاسرین.
output: They, indeed, are of the lost.

input: لمّا قضی الأمر و اشرق نیّر الآفاق من شطر العراق امرناهم بما یقدّسهم عن العالمین.
output: When the time set for this Revelation was fulfilled, and He Who is the Daystar of the world appeared in 'Iráq, He bade His followers observe that which would sanctify them from all earthly defilements.

input: منهم من اخذ الهوی و اعرض عمّا امر و منهم من اتّبع الحقّ بالهدی و کان من المهتدین.
output: Some preferred to follow the desires of a corrupt inclination, while others walked in the way of righteousness and truth, and were rightly guided.

input: قل الّذین ارتکبوا الفحشآء و تمسّکوا بالدّنیا.
output: Say: He is not to be numbered with the people of Bahá who followeth his mundane desires, or fixeth his heart on things of the earth.

input: انّهم لیسوا من اهل البهآء هم عباد لو یردون وادیاً من الذّهب یمرّون عنه کمرّ السّحاب و لا یلتفتون الیه ابداً.
output: He is My true follower who, if he come to a valley of pure gold, will pass straight through it aloof as a cloud, and will neither turn back, nor pause.

input: الا انّهم منّی.
output: Such a man is, assuredly, of Me.

input: لیجدنّ من قمیصهم الملأ الأعلی عرف التّقدیس....و لو یردن علیهم ذوات الجمال بأحسن الطّراز لا ترتدّ الیهنّ ابصارهم بالهوی.
output: From his garment the Concourse on high can inhale the fragrance of sanctity.... And if he met the fairest and most comely of women, he would not feel his heart seduced by the least shadow of desire for her beauty.

input: اولئک خلقوا من التّقوی.
output: Such a one, indeed, is the creation of spotless chastity.

input: کذلک یعلّمکم قلم القدم من لدن ربّکم العزیز الوهّاب.
output: Thus instructeth you the Pen of the Ancient of Days, as bidden by your Lord, the Almighty, the All-Bountiful.

input: عالم منقلب است و انقلاب او یوماً فیوماً در تزاید.
output: The world is in travail, and its agitation waxeth day by day.

input: و وجه آن بر غفلت و لامذهبی متوجّه.
output: Its face is turned towards waywardness and unbelief.

input: و این فقره شدّت خواهد نمود و زیاد خواهد شد بشأنی که ذکر آن حال مقتضی نه.
output: Such shall be its plight, that to disclose it now would not be meet and seemly.

input: و مدّتی بر این نهج ایّام میرود.
output: Its perversity will long continue.

input: و اذا تمّ المیقات یظهر بغتةً ما یرتعد به فرائص العالم.
output: And when the appointed hour is come, there shall suddenly appear that which shall cause the limbs of mankind to quake.

input: اذاً ترتفع الأعلام و تغرّد العنادل علی الأفنان.
output: Then, and only then, will the Divine Standard be unfurled, and the Nightingale of Paradise warble its melody.

input: ذکّر حزنی و همّی و غمّی و بلائی و ابتلائی و غربتی و بکائی و حرقتی و سجنی فی هذه الأرض البعید.
output: Recall thou to mind My sorrows, My cares and anxieties, My woes and trials, the state of My captivity, the tears that I have shed, the bitterness of Mine anguish, and now My imprisonment in this far-off land.

input: ان یا مصطفی تالله.
output: God, O Mustafá, beareth Me witness.

input: لو تطّلع بما ورد علی جمال القدم لتنوح فی العرآء.
output: Couldst thou be told what hath befallen the Ancient Beauty, thou wouldst flee into the wilderness, and weep with a great weeping.

input: و تضرب علی رأسک و تصیح کصیحة السّلیم.
output: In thy grief, thou wouldst smite thyself on the head, and cry out as one stung by the sting of the adder.

input: فاشکر الله بما سترنا عنک اسرار القضایا الّتی نزّلت من سحاب مشیّة ربّک المقتدر القدیر.
output: Be thou grateful to God, that We have refused to divulge unto thee the secrets of those unsearchable decrees that have been sent down unto Us from the heaven of the Will of thy Lord, the Most Powerful, the Almighty.

input: ما قمت عن الفراش الّا و قد شهدت جنود البلآء واقفاً علی فنآء بابی
output: Every morning I arose from My bed, I discovered the hosts of countless afflictions massed behind My door.

input: و ما نمت علیها الّا و قد کان قلبی محزوناً عمّا ورد علیه من جنود الشّیاطین.
output: and every night when I lay down, lo. My heart was torn with agony at what it had suffered from the fiendish cruelty of its foes.

input: فاذاً لا یأکل جمال القدم من طعام الّا و قد یکون معه من البلایا و لا یشرب قطرة مآء الّا.
output: With every piece of bread the Ancient Beauty breaketh is coupled the assault of a fresh affliction, and with every drop He drinketh is mixed the bitterness of the most woeful of trials.

input: و قد یکون معه جواهر القضایا و اذا امشی یمشی جنود الهمّ قدّامی و عساکر الغمّ عن ورائی.
output: He is preceded in every step He taketh by an army of unforeseen calamities, while in His rear follow legions of agonizing sorrows.

input: و کذلک فاشهد حالی ان انت من الشّاهدین.
output: Such is My plight, wert thou to ponder it in thine heart.

input: و انّک انت لا تحزن بما قضی الله علینا.
output: Let not, however, thy soul grieve over that which God hath rained down upon Us.

input: ثمّ ارض برضائه لأنّا کنّا لم یزل راضیاً بما نزّل من عنده و بما قدّر من لدنه.
output: Merge thy will in His pleasure, for We have, at no time, desired anything whatsoever except His Will, and have welcomed each one of His irrevocable decrees.

input: لذا فاصبر انت فی نفسک و لا تجزع.
output: Let thine heart be patient, and be thou not dismayed.

input: و لا تکن من المضطربین.
output: Follow not in the way of them that are sorely agitated.

input: اذا رأیت سواد مدینتی قف و قل یا ارض الطّآء قد جئتک من شطر السّجن بنبإ الله المهیمن القیّوم.
output: As soon as thine eyes behold from afar My native city Tihrán, stand thou and say: I am come to thee out of the Prison, O Land of Ta, with tidings from God, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting.

input: قل یا امّ العالم و مطلع النّور بین الأمم ابشّرک بعنایة ربّک و اکبّر علیک من قبل الحقّ علّام الغیوب.
output: I announce unto thee, O mother of the world and fountain of light unto all its peoples, the tender mercies of thy Lord, and greet thee in the name of Him Who is the Eternal Truth, the Knower of things unseen.

input: اشهد فیک ظهر الاسم المکنون و الغیب المخزون.
output: I testify that within thee He Who is the Hidden Name was revealed, and the Unseen Treasure uncovered.

input: و بک لاح سرّ ما کان و ما یکون.
output: Through thee the secret of all things, be they of the past or of the future, hath been unfolded.

input: یا ارض الطّآء.
output: O Land of Ta.

input: یذکرک مولی الأسمآء فی مقامه المحمود.
output: He Who is the Lord of Names remembereth thee in His glorious station.

input: قد کنت مشرق امر الله و مطلع الوحی و مظهر الاسم الأعظم الّذی به اضطربت الأفئدة و القلوب.
output: Thou wert the Dayspring of the Cause of God, the fountain of His Revelation, the manifestation of His Most Great Name—a Name that hath caused the hearts and souls of men to tremble.

input: کم من مظلوم استشهد فیک فی سبیل الله و کم من مظلومة دفنت فیک بظلم ناح به عباد مکرمون.
output: How vast the number of those men and women, those victims of tyranny, that have, within thy walls, laid down their lives in the path of God, and been buried beneath thy dust with such cruelty as to cause every honored servant of God to bemoan their plight.

input: انّا اردنا ان نذکر الفردوس الأعلی و المدینة المبارکة النّورآء الّتی فیها تضوّع عرف المحبوب و انتشرت آیاته و ظهرت بیّناته و نصبت اعلامه و ارتفع خبائه و فصّل فیها کلّ امر حکیم.
output: It is Our wish to remember the Abode of supreme blissfulness Tihrán, the holy and shining city—the city wherein the fragrance of the Well-Beloved hath been shed, wherein His signs have been diffused, wherein the evidences of His glory have been revealed, wherein His standards have been raised, wherein His tabernacle hath been pitched, wherein each of His wise decrees hath been unfolded.

input: تلک مدینة فیها سطعت رائحة الوصال و انجذب بها المخلصون الی مقرّ القرب و القدس و الجمال.
output: It is the city in which the sweet savors of reunion have breathed, which have caused the sincere lovers of God to draw nigh unto Him, and to gain access to the Habitation of holiness and beauty.

input: طوبی لقاصد قصد و فاز و شرب رحیق اللّقآء من بحر عنایة ربّه العزیز الحمید.
output: Happy is the wayfarer that directeth his steps towards this city, that gaineth admittance into it, and quaffeth the wine of reunion, through the outpouring grace of his Lord, the Gracious, the All-Praised.

input: یا ارض المقصود قد جئتک من قبل الله و ابشّرک بفضله و رحمته و اکبّر علیک من لدنه.
output: I am come to thee, O land of the heart's desire, with tidings from God, and announce to thee His gracious favor and mercy, and greet and magnify thee in His name.

input: انّه لهو الفضّال الکریم.
output: He, in truth, is of immense bounteousness and goodness.

input: طوبی لنفس توجّهت الیک و وجدت منک عرف الله ربّ العالمین.
output: Blessed be the man that turneth his face towards thee, that perceiveth from thee the fragrance of God's Presence, the Lord of all worlds.

input: النّور علیک و البهآء علیک بما جعلک الله فردوساً لعباده و الأرض المقدّسة المبارکة الّتی انزل الله ذکرها فی کتب النّبیّین و المرسلین.
output: His glory be on thee, and the brightness of His light envelop thee, inasmuch as God hath made thee a paradise unto His servants, and proclaimed thee to be the blest and sacred land of which He, Himself, hath made mention in the Books which His Prophets and Messengers have revealed.

input: یا ارض النّورآء بک ارتفع علم انّه لا اله الّا هو و فیک نصبت رایة انّنی انا الحقّ علّام الغیوب.
output: Through thee, O land of resplendent glory, the ensign, There is none other God but Him, hath been unfurled, and the standard, Verily I am the Truth, the Knower of things unseen, been hoisted.

input: ینبغی لکلّ مقبل ان یفتخر بک و بما فیک من افنانی و اوراقی و آثاری و اولیائی و احبّائی الّذین اقبلوا بالاستقامة الکبری الی مقامی المحمود.
output: It behooveth every one that visiteth thee to glory in thee and in them that inhabit thee, that have branched from My Tree, who are the leaves thereof, who are the signs of My glory, who follow Me and are My lovers, and who, with the most mighty determination, have turned their faces in the direction of My glorious station.

input: ثمّ ذکّر حین الّذی وردت فی المدینة و ظنّوا وکلآء السّلطان بأنّک لن تعرف اصولهم و تکون من الجاهلین.
output: Call Thou to remembrance Thine arrival in the City Constantinople, how the Ministers of the Sultán thought Thee to be unacquainted with their laws and regulations, and believed Thee to be one of the ignorant.

input: لا اعلم حرفاً الّا ما علّمنی الله بجوده.
output: I am ignorant of all things except what God hath, through His bountiful favor, been pleased to teach Me.

input: و انّا نقرّ بذلک و نکون من المقرّین.
output: To this We assuredly testify, and unhesitatingly confess it.

input: قل ان کان اصولکم من عند انفسکم لن نتّبعها ابداً.
output: Say: If the laws and regulations to which ye cleave be of your own making, We will, in no wise, follow them.

input: و بذلک امرت من لدن حکیم خبیر.
output: Thus have I been instructed by Him Who is the All-Wise, the All-Informed.

input: و کذلک کنت من قبل و نکون من بعد بحول الله و قوّته.
output: Such hath been My way in the past, and such will it remain in the future, through the power of God and His might.

input: و انّ هذا لصراط حقّ مستقیم.
output: This, indeed, is the true and right way.

input: و ان کان من عند الله فأتوا برهانکم ان کنتم لمن الصّادقین.
output: If they be ordained by God, bring forth, then, your proofs, if ye be of them that speak the truth.

input: قل انّا اثبتنا کلّ ما ظنّوا فیک و عملوا بک فی کتاب الّذی لن یغادر فیه حرف من عمل العاملین.
output: Say: We have written down in a Book which leaveth not unrecorded the work of any man, however insignificant, all that they have imputed to Thee, and all that they have done unto Thee.

input: قل یا ایّها الوکلآء ینبغی لکم بأن تتّبعوا اصول الله فی انفسکم و تَدَعوا اصولکم و تکوننّ من المهتدین.
output: Say: It behooveth you, O Ministers of State, to keep the precepts of God, and to forsake your own laws and regulations, and to be of them who are guided aright.

input: و هذا خیر لکم عمّا عندکم ان انتم من العارفین.
output: Better is this for you than all ye possess, did ye but know it.

input: و ان لن تتّبعوا الله فی امره لن یقبل اعمالکم علی قدر نقیر و قطمیر.
output: If ye transgress the commandment of God, not one jot or one tittle of all your works shall be acceptable in His sight.

input: فسوف تجدون ما اکتسبتم فی الحیوة الباطلة و تجزون بما عملتم فیها.
output: Ye shall, erelong, discover the consequences of that which ye shall have done in this vain life, and shall be repaid for them.

input: و انّ هذا لصدق یقین.
output: This, verily, is the truth, the undoubted truth.

input: فکم من عباد عملوا کما عملتم و کانوا اعظم منکم و رجعوا کلّهم الی التّراب و قضی علیهم ما قضی.
output: How great the number of those who, in bygone ages, have committed the things ye have committed, and who, though superior to you in rank, have, in the end, returned unto dust, and been consigned to their inevitable doom.

input: ان انتم فی امر الله لمن المتفکّرین.
output: Would that ye might ponder the Cause of God in your hearts.

input: و ستلحقون بهم و تدخلون بیت الّتی لن تجدوا فیها لأنفسکم لا من نصیر و لا من حمیم.
output: Ye shall follow in their wake, and shall be made to enter a habitation wherein none shall be found to befriend or help you.

input: و تسألون عمّا فعلتم فی ایّامکم و فرّطتم فی امر الله و استکبرتم علی اولیائه بعد الّذی وردوا علیکم بصدق مبین.
output: Ye shall, of a truth, be asked of your doings, shall be called to account for your failure in duty with regard to the Cause of God, and for having disdainfully rejected His loved ones who, with manifest sincerity, have come unto you.

input: و انتم شاورتم فی امرهم و اخذتم حکم انفسکم و ترکتم حکم الله المهیمن القدیر.
output: It is ye who have taken counsel together regarding them, ye that have preferred to follow the promptings of your own desires, and forsaken the commandment of God, the Help in Peril, the Almighty.

input: قل أ.
output: Say: What.

input: تأخذون اصولکم و تضعون اصول الله.
output: Cleave ye to your own devices, and cast behind your backs the precepts of God.

input: ورآء ظهورکم و انّ هذا لظلم علی انفسکم و انفس العباد.
output: Ye, indeed, have wronged your own selves and others.

input: لو تکوننّ من العارفین.
output: Would that ye could perceive it.

input: قل ان کان اصولکم علی العدل فکیف تأخذون منها ما تهوی به هواکم.
output: Say: If your rules and principles be founded on justice, why is it, then, that ye follow those which accord with your corrupt inclinations and reject such as conflict with your desires.

input: و تَدَعون ما کان مخالفاً لأنفسکم.
output: By what right claim ye, then, to judge fairly between men.

input: ما لکم کیف تکوننّ من الحاکمین أ کان من اصولکم بأن تعذّبوا الّذی جآءکم بأمرکم و تخذلوه و تؤذوه فی کلّ یوم.
output: Are your rules and principles such as to justify your persecution of Him Who, at your bidding, hath presented Himself before you, your rejection of Him, and your infliction on Him every day of grievous injury.

input: بعد الّذی ما عصاکم فی اقلّ من آن.
output: Hath He ever, though it be for one short moment, disobeyed you.

input: و یشهد بذلک کلّ من سکن فی العراق و من ورائه کلّ ذی علم علیم.
output: All the inhabitants of 'Iráq, and beyond them every discerning observer, will bear witness to the truth of My words.

input: فأنصفوا فی انفسکم یا ایّها الوکلآء.
output: Be fair in your judgment, O ye Ministers of State.

input: بأیّ ذنب اطردتمونا.
output: What is it that We have committed that could justify Our banishment.

input: و بأیّ جرم اخرجتمونا.
output: What is the offense that hath warranted Our expulsion.

input: بعد الّذی استأجرناکم و ما آجرتمونا.
output: It is We Who have sought you, and yet, behold how ye refused to receive Us.

input: هذا لظلم عظیم الّذی لن یقاس بظلم فی الأرض.
output: This is a sore injustice that ye have perpetrated—an injustice with which no earthly injustice can measure.

input: و کان الله علی ما اقول شهید....
output: To this the Almighty is Himself a witness....

input: فاعلموا بأنّ الدّنیا و زینتها و زخرفها سیفنی
output: Know ye that the world and its vanities and its embellishments shall pass away.

input: و یبقی الملک لله الملک المهیمن العزیز القدیر.
output: Nothing will endure except God's Kingdom which pertaineth to none but Him, the Sovereign Lord of all, the Help in Peril, the All-Glorious, the Almighty.

input: ستمضی ایّامکم و کلّ ما انتم تشتغلون به و به تفتخرون علی النّاس و یحضرکم ملائکة الأمر علی مقرّ الّذی ترجف فیه ارکان الخلایق و تقشعرّ فیه جلود الظّالمین.
output: The days of your life shall roll away, and all the things with which ye are occupied and of which ye boast yourselves shall perish, and ye shall, most certainly, be summoned by a company of His angels to appear at the spot where the limbs of the entire creation shall be made to tremble, and the flesh of every oppressor to creep.

input: و تسألون عمّا اکتسبتم فی الحیوة الباطلة و تجزون بما فعلتم.
output: Ye shall be asked of the things your hands have wrought in this, your vain life, and shall be repaid for your doings.

input: و هذا من یوم الّذی یأتیکم و السّاعة الّتی لا مردّ لها.
output: This is the day that shall inevitably come upon you, the hour that none can put back.

input: و شهد بذلک لسان صدق علیم.
output: To this the Tongue of Him that speaketh the truth and is the Knower of all things hath testified.

input: ان یا ملأ المدینة اتّقوا الله و لا تفسدوا فی الأرض.
output: Fear God, ye inhabitants of the City Constantinople, and sow not the seeds of dissension amongst men.

input: و لا تتّبعوا الشّیطان.
output: Walk not in the paths of the Evil One.

input: ثمّ اتّبعوا الحقّ فی هذه الأیّام القلیل.
output: Walk ye, during the few remaining days of your life, in the ways of the one true God.

input: ستمضی ایّامکم کما مضت علی الّذینهم کانوا قبلکم.
output: Your days shall pass away as have the days of them who were before you.

input: و ترجعون علی التّراب کما رجعوا الیه آبائکم و کانوا من الرّاجعین.
output: To dust shall ye return, even as your fathers of old did return.

input: ثمّ اعلموا بأنّا ما نخاف من احد الّا الله.
output: Know ye that I am afraid of none except God.

input: وحده و ما توکّلی الّا علیه و ما اعتصامی الّا به و ما نرید الّا ما اراد لنا.
output: In none but Him have I placed My trust. to none will I cleave but Him, and wish for naught except the thing He hath wished for Me.

input: و انّ هذا لهو المراد لو انتم من العارفین.
output: This, indeed, is My heart's desire, did ye but know it.

input: انّی انفقت روحی و جسدی لله ربّ العالمین.
output: I have offered up My soul and My body as a sacrifice for God, the Lord of all worlds.

input: من عرف الله لن یعرف دونه و من خاف الله لن یخاف سواه ولو یجتمع علیه کلّ من فی الأرض اجمعین.
output: Whoso hath known God shall know none but Him, and he that feareth God shall be afraid of no one except Him, though the powers of the whole earth rise up and be arrayed against him.

input: و ما نقول الّا بما امرت و ما نتّبع الّا الحقّ بحول الله و قوّته.
output: I speak naught except at His bidding, and follow naught, through the power of God and His might, except His truth.

input: و انّه یجزی الصّادقین.
output: He, verily, shall recompense the truthful.

input: ثمّ اذکر یا عبد ما رأیت فی المدینة حین ورودک لیبقی ذکرها فی الأرض و یکون ذکری للمؤمنین.
output: Narrate, O Servant, the things Thou didst behold at the time of Thine arrival in the City, that Thy testimony may endure amongst men, and serve as a warning unto them that believe.

input: فلمّا وردنا المدینة وجدنا رؤسائها کالأطفال الّذین یجتمعون علی الطّین لیلعبوا به.
output: We found, upon Our arrival in the City, its governors and elders as children gathered about and disporting themselves with clay.

input: و ما وجدنا منهم من بالغ لنعلّمه ما علّمنی الله و نلقی علیه من کلمات حکمة منیع.
output: We perceived no one sufficiently mature to acquire from Us the truths which God hath taught Us, nor ripe for Our wondrous words of wisdom.

input: و لذا بکینا علیهم بعیون السّرّ لارتکابهم بما نهوا عنه و اغفالهم عمّا خلقوا له.
output: Our inner eye wept sore over them, and over their transgressions and their total disregard of the thing for which they were created.

input: و هذا ما اشهدناه فی المدینة و اثبتناه فی الکتاب لیکون تذکرة لهم و ذکری للآخرین.
output: This is what We observed in that City, and which We have chosen to note down in Our Book, that it may serve as a warning unto them, and unto the rest of mankind.
