input: قل ان کنتم تریدون الدّنیا و زخرفها ینبغی لکم بأن تطلبوها فی الأیّام الّتی کنتم فی بطون امّهاتکم لأنّ فی تلک الأیّام فی کلّ آن تقرّبتم الی الدّنیا و تبعّدتم عنها ان کنتم من العاقلین.
output: Say: If ye be seekers after this life and the vanities thereof, ye should have sought them while ye were still enclosed in your mothers' wombs, for at that time ye were continually approaching them, could ye but perceive it.

input: فلمّا ولدتم و بلغ اشدّکم اذاً تبعّدتم عن الدّنیا و تقرّبتم الی التّراب.
output: Ye have, on the other hand, ever since ye were born and attained maturity, been all the while receding from the world and drawing closer to dust.

input: فکیف تحرصون فی جمع الزّخارف علی انفسکم بعد الّذی فات الوقت عنکم و مضت الفرصة.
output: Why, then, exhibit such greed in amassing the treasures of the earth, when your days are numbered and your chance is well-nigh lost.

input: فتنبّهوا یا ملأ الغافلین.
output: Will ye not, then, O heedless ones, shake off your slumber.

input: اسمعوا ما ینصحکم به هذا العبد لوجه الله.
output: Incline your ears to the counsels which this Servant giveth you for the sake of God.

input: و ما یرید منکم من شیء و رضی بما قضی الله له و یکون من الرّاضین.
output: He, verily, asketh no recompense from you and is resigned to what God hath ordained for Him, and is entirely submissive to God's Will.

input: یا قوم قد مضت من ایّامکم اکثرها و ما بقت الّا ایّام معدودة.
output: The days of your life are far spent, O people, and your end is fast approaching.

input: اذاً دعوا ما اخذتم من عند انفسکم ثمّ خذوا احکام الله بقوّة لعلّ تصلون الی ما اراد الله لکم و تکوننّ من الرّاشدین.
output: Put away, therefore, the things ye have devised and to which ye cleave, and take firm hold on the precepts of God, that haply ye may attain that which He hath purposed for you, and be of them that pursue a right course.

input: و لا تفرحوا بما اوتیتم من زینة الأرض و لا تعتمدوا علیها.
output: Delight not yourselves in the things of the world and its vain ornaments, neither set your hopes on them.

input: فاعتمدوا بذکر الله العلیّ العظیم.
output: Let your reliance be on the remembrance of God, the Most Exalted, the Most Great.

input: فسوف یفنی الله ما عندکم.
output: He will, erelong, bring to naught all the things ye possess.

input: اتّقوا الله و لا تنسوا عهد الله فی انفسکم و لا تکوننّ من المحتجبین.
output: Let Him be your fear, and forget not His covenant with you, and be not of them that are shut out as by a veil from Him.

input: ایّاکم ان لا تستکبروا علی الله و احبّائه.
output: Beware that ye swell not with pride before God, and disdainfully reject His loved ones.

input: ثمّ اخفضوا جناحکم للمؤمنین الّذین آمنوا بالله و آیاته و تشهد قلوبهم بوحدانیّته و السنتهم بفردانیّته و لا یتکلّمون الّا بعد اذنه.
output: Defer ye humbly to the faithful, they that have believed in God and in His signs, whose hearts witness to His unity, whose tongues proclaim His oneness, and who speak not except by His leave.

input: کذلک ننصحکم بالعدل و نذکّرکم بالحقّ لعلّ تکوننّ من المتذکّرین.
output: Thus do We exhort you with justice, and warn you with truth, that perchance ye may be awakened.

input: و لا تحملوا علی النّاس ما لا تحملوه علی انفسکم و لن ترضوا لأحد ما لا ترضونه لکم.
output: Lay not on any soul a load which ye would not wish to be laid upon you, and desire not for anyone the things ye would not desire for yourselves.

input: و هذا خیر النّصح لو انتم من السّامعین.
output: This is My best counsel unto you, did ye but observe it.

input: ثمّ احترموا العلمآء بینکم الّذین یفعلون ما علموا و یتّبعون حدود الله و یحکمون بما حکم الله فی الکتاب.
output: Respect ye the divines and learned amongst you, they whose conduct accords with their professions, who transgress not the bounds which God hath fixed, whose judgments are in conformity with His behests as revealed in His Book.

input: فاعلموا بأنّهم سرج الهدایة بین السّموات و الأرضین.
output: Know ye that they are the lamps of guidance unto them that are in the heavens and on the earth.

input: انّ الّذین لن تجدوا للعلمآء بینهم من شأن و لا من قدر اولئک غیّروا نعمة الله علی انفسهم.
output: They who disregard and neglect the divines and learned that live amongst them—these have truly changed the favor with which God hath favored them.

input: قل فارتقبوا حتّی یغیّر الله علیکم.
output: Say: Await ye till God will have changed His favor unto you.

input: انّه لا یعزب عن علمه من شیء.
output: Nothing whatsoever escapeth Him.

input: یعلم غیب السّموات و الأرض.
output: He knoweth the secrets both of the heavens and of the earth.

input: و انّه بکلّ شیء علیم.
output: His knowledge embraceth all things.

input: و لا تفرحوا بما فعلتم او تفعلون و لا بما وردتم علینا لأنّ بذلک لن یزداد شأنکم لو انتم تنظرون فی اعمالکم بعین الیقین
output: Rejoice not in what ye have done, or will do in the future, nor delight in the tribulation with which ye have afflicted Us, for ye are unable by such means as these to exalt your stations, were ye to examine your works with acute discernment.

input: و کذلک لن ینقص عنّا من شیء.
output: Neither will ye be capable of detracting from the loftiness of Our state.

input: بل یزید الله اجرنا بما صبرنا فی البلایا.
output: Nay, God will add unto the recompense with which He shall reward Us, for having sustained with persevering patience the tribulations We have suffered.

input: و انّه یزید اجر الصّابرین.
output: He, verily, shall increase the reward of them that endure with patience.

input: فاعلموا بأنّ البلایا و المحن لم یزل کانت موکّلة لأصفیآء الله و احبّائه ثمّ لعباده المنقطعین الّذین لا تلهیهم التّجارة و لا بیع عن ذکر الله و لا یسبقونه بالقول و هم بأمره لمن العاملین.
output: Know ye that trials and tribulations have, from time immemorial, been the lot of the chosen Ones of God and His beloved, and such of His servants as are detached from all else but Him, they whom neither merchandise nor traffic beguile from the remembrance of the Almighty, they that speak not till He hath spoken, and act according to His commandment.

input: کذلک جرت سنّة الله من قبل و یجری من بعد.
output: Such is God's method carried into effect of old, and such will it remain in the future.

input: فطوبی للصّابرین الّذین یصبرون فی البأسآء و الضّرّآء و لن یجزعوا من شیء و کانوا علی مناهج الصّبر لمن السّالکین....
output: Blessed are the steadfastly enduring, they that are patient under ills and hardships, who lament not over anything that befalleth them, and who tread the path of resignation....

input: فسوف یظهر الله قوماً یذکرون ایّامنا و کلّ ما ورد علینا و یطلبون حقّنا عن الّذین‌هم ظلمونا بغیر جرم و لا ذنب مبین.
output: The day is approaching when God will have raised up a people who will call to remembrance Our days, who will tell the tale of Our trials, who will demand the restitution of Our rights from them that, without a tittle of evidence, have treated Us with manifest injustice.

input: و من ورائهم کان الله قائماً علیهم و یشهد ما فعلوا.
output: God, assuredly, dominateth the lives of them that wronged Us, and is well aware of their doings.

input: و یأخذهم بذنبهم.
output: He will, most certainly, lay hold on them for their sins.

input: و انّه اشدّ المنتقمین.
output: He, verily, is the fiercest of avengers.

input: و کذلک قصصنا لکم من قصص الحقّ و القیناکم ما قضی الله من قبل لعلّ تتوبون الیه فی انفسکم و ترجعون الیه و تکوننّ من الرّاجعین و تتنبّهون فی افعالکم و تستیقظون عن نومکم و غفلتکم و تدارکوا ما فات عنکم و تکوننّ من المحسنین.
output: Thus have We recounted unto you the tales of the one true God, and sent down unto you the things He had preordained, that haply ye may ask forgiveness of Him, may return unto Him, may truly repent, may realize your misdeeds, may shake off your slumber, may be roused from your heedlessness, may atone for the things that have escaped you, and be of them that do good.

input: فمن شآء فلیقبل قولی
output: Let him who will, acknowledge the truth of My words.

input: و من شآء فلیعرض.
output: and as to him that willeth not, let him turn aside.

input: و ما علیّ الّا بأن اذکّرکم فیما فرّطتم فی امر الله لعلّ تکوننّ من المتذکّرین.
output: My sole duty is to remind you of your failure in duty towards the Cause of God, if perchance ye may be of them that heed My warning.

input: اذاً فاسمعوا قولی ثمّ ارجعوا الی الله و توبوا الیه لیرحمکم الله بفضله و یغفر خطایاکم و یعفو جریراتکم.
output: Wherefore, hearken ye unto My speech, and return ye to God and repent, that He, through His grace, may have mercy upon you, may wash away your sins, and forgive your trespasses.

input: و انّه سبقت رحمته غضبه و احاط فضله کلّ من دخل فی قمص الوجود من الأوّلین و الآخرین.
output: The greatness of His mercy surpasseth the fury of His wrath, and His grace encompasseth all who have been called into being and been clothed with the robe of life, be they of the past or of the future.

input: قد ظهر فی هذا الظّهور ما لا ظهر فی ازل الآزال.
output: There hath appeared in this Revelation what hath never appeared before.

input: و من المشرکین من رأی و قال هذا ساحر افتری علی الله.
output: As to the infidels that have witnessed what hath been manifested, they murmur and say: Verily, this is a sorcerer who hath devised a lie against God.

input: الا انّهم قوم مدحضون.
output: They are indeed an outcast people.

input: ان یا قلم القدم و اذکر للأمم ما ظهر فی العراق.
output: Tell out to the nations, O Pen of the Ancient of Days, the things that have happened in 'Iráq.

input: اذ جآء رسول من معشر العلمآء و حضر تلقآء الوجه و سأل من العلوم اجبناه بعلم من لدنّا
output: Tell them of the messenger whom the congregation of the divines of that land had delegated to meet Us, who, when attaining Our presence, questioned Us concerning certain sciences, and whom We answered by virtue of the knowledge We inherently possess.

input: انّ ربّک لعلّام الغیوب.
output: Thy Lord is, verily, the Knower of things unseen.

input: قال نشهد عندک من العلوم ما لا احاطه احد.
output: We testify, said he, that the knowledge Thou dost possess is such as none can rival.

input: انّه لا یکفی المقام الّذی ینسبونه النّاس الیک.
output: Such a knowledge, however, is insufficient to vindicate the exalted station which the people ascribe to Thee.

input: فأتنا بما یعجز عن الاتیان بمثله من علی الأرض کلّها.
output: Produce, if Thou speakest the truth, what the combined forces of the peoples of the earth are powerless to produce.

input: کذلک قضی الأمر فی محضر ربّک العزیز الودود.
output: Thus was it irrevocably decreed in the court of the presence of thy Lord, the All-Glorious, the Loving.

input: فانظر.
output: Witness.

input: ماذا تری.
output: What is it thou seest.

input: اذاً انصعق.
output: He was dumbfounded.

input: فلمّا افاق قال آمنت بالله العزیز المحمود.
output: And when he came to himself, he said: I truly believe in God, the All-Glorious, the All-Praised.

input: اذهب الی القوم قل فاسألوا ما شئتم.
output: Go thou to the people, and tell them: 'Ask whatsoever ye please.

input: انّه لهو المقتدر علی ما یشآء.
output: Powerful is He to do what He willeth.

input: لا یعجزه ما کان و ما یکون.
output: Nothing whatsoever, be it of the past or of the future, can frustrate His Will.' Say: 'O ye congregation of the divines.

input: قل یا معشر العلمآء ان اجتمعوا علی امر ثمّ اسألوا ربّکم الرّحمن.
output: Say: 'O ye congregation of the divines! Choose any matter ye desire, and ask your Lord, the God of Mercy, to reveal it unto you.

input: ان اظهر لکم بسلطان من عنده آمنوا و لا تکوننّ من الّذین‌هم یکفرون.
output: If He fulfill your wish, by virtue of His sovereignty, believe ye then in Him, and be not of those that reject His truth.'

input: قال الآن طلع فجر العرفان و تمّت حجّة الرّحمن.
output: The dawn of understanding hath now broken, said he, and the testimony of the All-Merciful is fulfilled.

input: قام و رجع الی القوم بأمر من لدی الله العزیز المحبوب.
output: He arose and returned unto them that sent him, at the bidding of God, the All-Glorious, the Well-Beloved.

input: قضت ایّام معدودات و ما رجع الینا.
output: Days passed and he failed to come back to Us.

input: الی ان ارسل رسولاً آخر اخبرنا بأنّ القوم اعرضوا عمّا ارادوا.
output: Eventually, there came another messenger who informed Us that the people had given up what they originally had purposed.

input: و هم قوم صاغرون.
output: They are indeed a contemptible people.

input: کذلک قضی الأمر فی العراق انّی شهید.
output: This is what happened in 'Iráq, and to what I reveal I Myself am witness.

input: علی ما اقول و انتشر هذا الأمر فی الأقطار و ما استشعر احد.
output: This happening was noised abroad, yet none was found to comprehend its meaning.

input: کذلک قضینا.
output: Thus did We ordain it.

input: ان انتم تعلمون.
output: Would that ye knew this.

input: من سأل الآیات فی القرون الخالیة اذا اظهرنا له کفر بالله.
output: Whoso hath in bygone ages asked Us to produce the signs of God, hath, no sooner had We revealed them to him, repudiated God's truth.

input: ولکنّ النّاس اکثرهم غافلون.
output: The people, however, have, for the most part, remained heedless.

input: انّ الّذین فتحت ابصارهم بنور العرفان یجدون نفحات الرّحمن و یقبلون الیه.
output: They whose eyes are illumined with the light of understanding will perceive the sweet savors of the All-Merciful, and will embrace His truth.

input: الا انّهم هم المخلصون.
output: These are they who are truly sincere.

input: یا ثمرتی و یا ورقتی.
output: O thou who art the fruit of My Tree and the leaf thereof.

input: علیک بهائی و رحمتی.
output: On thee be My glory and My mercy.

input: محزون مباش از آنچه وارد شده.
output: Let not thine heart grieve over what hath befallen thee.

input: اگر در دفتر عالم نظر نمائی مشاهده کنی آنچه را که همّ و غم را رفع نماید.
output: Wert thou to scan the pages of the Book of Life, thou wouldst, most certainly, discover that which would dissipate thy sorrows and dissolve thine anguish.

input: یا ثمرتی دو امر از آمر حقیقی ظاهر. و این در مقامات قضا و قدر است.
output: Know thou, O fruit of My Tree, that the decrees of the Sovereign Ordainer, as related to fate and predestination, are of two kinds.

input: اطاعتش لازم و تسلیم واجب.
output: Both are to be obeyed and accepted.

input: اجلیست محتوم و همچنین اجلیست بقول خلق معلّق.
output: The one is irrevocable, the other is, as termed by men, impending.

input: امّا اوّل باید بآن تسلیم نمود چه که حتم است
output: To the former all must unreservedly submit, inasmuch as it is fixed and settled.

input: ولکن حقّ قادر بر تغییر و تبدیل آن بوده و هست
output: God, however, is able to alter or repeal it.

input: ولکن ضرّش اعظم است از قبل لذا تفویض و توکّل محبوب.
output: As the harm that must result from such a change will be greater than if the decree had remained unaltered, all, therefore, should willingly acquiesce in what God hath willed and confidently abide by the same.

input: و امّا اجل معلّق بمسئلت و دعا رفع شده و میشود.
output: The decree that is impending, however, is such that prayer and entreaty can succeed in averting it.

input: انشآءالله آن ثمره و من معها از آن محفوظند.
output: God grant that thou who art the fruit of My Tree, and they that are associated with thee, may be shielded from its evil consequences.

input: قولی الهی الهی.
output: Say: O God, my God.

input: اودعت عندی امانة من عندک و اخذتها بارادتک.
output: Thou hast committed into mine hands a trust from Thee, and hast now according to the good-pleasure of Thy Will called it back to Thyself.

input: لیس لأمتک هذه ان تقول لم و بم لأنّک محمود فی فعلک و مطاع فی امرک.
output: It is not for me, who am a handmaid of Thine, to say, whence is this to me or wherefore hath it happened, inasmuch as Thou art glorified in all Thine acts, and art to be obeyed in Thy decree.

input: ای ربّ انّ امتک هذه متوجّهة الی فضلک و عطائک.
output: Thine handmaid, O my Lord, hath set her hopes on Thy grace and bounty.

input: قدّر لها ما یقرّبها الیک و ینفعها فی کلّ عالم من عوالمک.
output: Grant that she may obtain that which will draw her nigh unto Thee, and will profit her in every world of Thine.

input: لا اله الّا انت الآمر القدیم.
output: There is none other God but Thee, the Ordainer, the Ancient of Days.

input: صلّ اللّهمّ یا الهی علی الّذین شربوا رحیق حبّک امام الوجوه رغماً لأعدائک و اقرّوا و اعترفوا بوحدانیّتک و فردانیّتک و بما ارتعدت به فرائص جبابرة خلقک و فراعنة بلادک.
output: Vouchsafe Thy blessings, O Lord, my God, unto them that have quaffed the wine of Thy love before the face of men, and, in spite of Thine enemies, have acknowledged Thy unity, testified to Thy oneness, and confessed their belief in that which hath made the limbs of the oppressors among Thy creatures to quake, and the flesh of the proud ones of the earth to tremble.

input: اشهد انّ سلطانک لا یفنی و ارادتک لا تتغیّر.
output: I bear witness that Thy Sovereignty can never perish, nor Thy Will be altered.

input: قدّر للّذین اقبلوا الیک و لامائک اللّآئی تمسّکن بحبلک ما ینبغی لبحر کرمک و سمآء فضلک.
output: Ordain for them that have set their faces towards Thee, and for Thine handmaids that have held fast by Thy Cord, that which beseemeth the Ocean of Thy bounty and the Heaven of Thy grace.

input: انت الّذی یا الهی وصفت نفسک بالغنآء و عبادک بالفقر.
output: Thou art He, O God, Who hath proclaimed Himself as the Lord of Wealth, and characterized all that serve Him as poor and needy.

input: بقولک یا ایّها الّذین آمنوا.
output: Even as Thou hast written: O ye that believe.

input: انتم الفقرآء الی الله و الله هو الغنیّ الحمید.
output: Ye are but paupers in need of God. but God is the All-Possessing, the All-Praised.

input: فلمّا اعترفت بفقری و غنائک ینبغی ان لا تجعلنی محروماً عنه.
output: Having acknowledged my poverty, and recognized Thy wealth, suffer me not to be deprived of the glory of Thy riches.

input: انّک انت المهیمن العلیم الحکیم.
output: Thou art, verily, the Supreme Protector, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

input: ان اذکری ما ظهر من امّ الأشرف الّذی فدی نفسه فی ارض الزّآء.
output: Call thou to mind the behavior of Ashraf's mother, whose son laid down his life in the Land of Zá Zanján.

input: الا انّه فی مقعد صدق عند مقتدر قدیر.
output: He, most certainly, is in the seat of truth, in the presence of One Who is the Most Powerful, the Almighty.

input: اذا اراد المشرکون ان یقتلوه بالظّلم ارسلوا الیه امّه لتنصحه لعلّ یتوب و یتّبع الّذین کفروا بالله ربّ العالمین.
output: When the infidels, so unjustly, decided to put him to death, they sent and fetched his mother, that perchance she might admonish him, and induce him to recant his faith, and follow in the footsteps of them that have repudiated the truth of God, the Lord of all worlds.

input: اذا حضرت تلقآء وجه ابنها تکلّمت بما ناحت به قلوب العشّاق ثمّ الملأ الأعلی.
output: No sooner did she behold the face of her son, than she spoke to him such words as caused the hearts of the lovers of God, and beyond them those of the Concourse on high, to cry out and be sore pained with grief.

input: و ربّک علی ما اقول شهید و علیم.
output: Truly, thy Lord knoweth what My tongue speaketh. He Himself beareth witness to My words.

input: قالت ابنی ابنی.
output: And when addressing him she said: My son, mine own son.

input: ان افد نفسک فی سبیل ربّک ایّاک.
output: Fail not to offer up thyself in the path of thy Lord.

input: ان تکفر بالّذی سجد لوجهه من فی السّموات و الأرضین.
output: Beware that thou betray not thy faith in Him before Whose face have bowed down in adoration all who are in the heavens and all who are on the earth.

input: یا بنیّ ان استقم علی امر ربّک.
output: Go thou straight on, O my son, and persevere in the path of the Lord, thy God.

input: ثمّ اقبل الی محبوب العالمین.
output: Haste thee to attain the presence of Him Who is the Well-Beloved of all worlds.

input: علیها صلواتی و رحمتی و تکبیری و بهائی.
output: On her be My blessings, and My mercy, and My praise, and My glory.

input: و انّی بنفسی لأکون دیة ابنها و اذاً فی سرادق عظمتی و کبریائی بوجه تستضیء منه الحوریّات فی الغرفات ثمّ اهل الفردوس و اهل مداین القدس.
output: I Myself shall atone for the loss of her son—a son who now dwelleth within the tabernacle of My majesty and glory, and whose face beameth with a light that envelopeth with its radiance the Maids of Heaven in their celestial chambers, and beyond them the inmates of My Paradise, and the denizens of the Cities of Holiness.

input: لو یراه احد یقول ان هذا الّا ملک کریم.
output: Were any eye to gaze on his face, he would exclaim: Lo, this is no other than a noble angel.

input: قد اضطرب النّظم من هذا النّظم الاعظم و اختلف التّرتیب بهذا البدیع.
output: The world's equilibrium hath been upset through the vibrating influence of this most great, this new World Order.

input: الّذی ما شهدت عین الابداع شبهه.
output: Mankind's ordered life hath been revolutionized through the agency of this unique, this wondrous System—the like of which mortal eyes have never witnessed.

input: اغتمسوا فی بحر بیانی لعلّ تطّلعون بما فیه من لئالئ الحکمة و الاسرار.
output: Immerse yourselves in the ocean of My words, that ye may unravel its secrets, and discover all the pearls of wisdom that lie hid in its depths.

input: ایّاکم ان توقّفوا فی هذا الامر الّذی به ظهرت سلطنة الله و اقتداره.
output: Take heed that ye do not vacillate in your determination to embrace the truth of this Cause—a Cause through which the potentialities of the might of God have been revealed, and His sovereignty established.

input: اسرعوا الیه بوجوه بیضآء.
output: With faces beaming with joy, hasten ye unto Him.

input: هذا دین الله من قبل و من بعد.
output: This is the changeless Faith of God, eternal in the past, eternal in the future.

input: من اراد فلیقبل و من لم یرد فانّ الله لغنیّ عن العالمین.
output: Let him that seeketh, attain it. and as to him that hath refused to seek it—verily, God is Self-Sufficient, above any need of His creatures.

input: قل هذا لقسطاس الهدی لمن فی السّموات و الارض و البرهان الاعظم لو انتم تعرفون.
output: Say: This is the infallible Balance which the Hand of God is holding, in which all who are in the heavens and all who are on the earth are weighed, and their fate determined, if ye be of them that believe and recognize this truth.

input: قل به ثبت کلّ حجّة فی الاعصار لو انتم توقنون قل به استغنی کلّ فقیر و تعلّم کلّ عالم و عرج.
output: Say: Through it the poor have been enriched, the learned enlightened, and the seekers enabled to ascend unto the presence of God.

input: من اراد الصّعود الی الله ایّاکم ان تختلفوا فیه.
output: Beware, lest ye make it a cause of dissension amongst you.

input: کونوا کالجبال الرّواسخ فی امر ربّکم العزیز الودود.
output: Be ye as firmly settled as the immovable mountain in the Cause of your Lord, the Mighty, the Loving.

input: یا اهل الارض اذا غربت شمس جمالی و سترت سمآء هیکلی لا تضطربوا.
output: Be not dismayed, O peoples of the world, when the daystar of My beauty is set, and the heaven of My tabernacle is concealed from your eyes.

input: قوموا علی نصرة امری و ارتفاع کلمتی بین العالمین.
output: Arise to further My Cause, and to exalt My Word amongst men.

input: انّا معکم فی کلّ الاحوال و ننصرکم بالحقّ.
output: We are with you at all times, and shall strengthen you through the power of truth.

input: انّا کنّا قادرین.
output: We are truly almighty.

input: من عرفنی یقوم علی خدمتی بقیام لا تقعده جنود السّموات و الارضین.
output: Whoso hath recognized Me, will arise and serve Me with such determination that the powers of earth and heaven shall be unable to defeat his purpose.

input: انّ النّاس نیام.
output: The peoples of the world are fast asleep.

input: لو انتبهوا سرعوا بالقلوب الی الله العلیم الحکیم.
output: Were they to wake from their slumber, they would hasten with eagerness unto God, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

input: و نبذوا ما عندهم و لو کان کنوز الدّنیا کلّها لیذکرهم مولاهم بکلمة من عنده.
output: They would cast away everything they possess, be it all the treasures of the earth, that their Lord may remember them to the extent of addressing to them but one word.

input: کذلک ینبّئکم من عنده علم الغیب فی لوح ما ظهر فی الامکان و ما اطّلع به الّا نفسه المهیمنة علی العالمین.
output: Such is the instruction given you by Him Who holdeth the knowledge of things hidden, in a Tablet which the eye of creation hath not seen, and which is revealed to none except His own Self, the omnipotent protector of all worlds.

input: قد اخذهم سکر الهوی علی شأن لا یرون مولی الوری الّذی ارتفع ندآئه من کلّ الجهات لا اله الّا انا العزیز الحکیم.
output: So bewildered are they in the drunkenness of their evil desires, that they are powerless to recognize the Lord of all being, Whose voice calleth aloud from every direction: There is none other God but Me, the Mighty, the All-Wise.

input: قل لا تفرحوا بما ملکتموه فی العشیّ
output: Say: Rejoice not in the things ye possess. tonight they are yours,

input: و فی الاشراق یملکه غیرکم.
output: tomorrow others will possess them.

input: کذلک یخبرکم العلیم الخبیر.
output: Thus warneth you He Who is the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.

input: قل هل رأیتم لما عندکم من قرار او وفآء.
output: Say: Can ye claim that what ye own is lasting or secure.

input: لا.
output: Nay.

input: و نفسی الرّحمن.
output: By Myself, the All-Merciful.

input: لو انتم من المنصفین تمرّ ایّام حیوتکم کما تمرّ الاریاح و یطوی بساط عزّکم کما طوی بساط الاوّلین.
output: The days of your life flee away as a breath of wind, and all your pomp and glory shall be folded up as were the pomp and glory of those gone before you.

input: تفکّروا یا قوم.
output: Reflect, O people.

input: این ایّامکم الماضیة و این اعصارکم الخالیة.
output: What hath become of your bygone days, your lost centuries.

input: طوبی لایّام مضت بذکر الله و لاوقات صرفت فی ذکره الحکیم.
output: Happy the days that have been consecrated to the remembrance of God, and blessed the hours which have been spent in praise of Him Who is the All-Wise.

input: لا تبقی عزّة الاعزّآء و لا زخارف الاغنیآء و لا شوکة الاشقیآء.
output: By My life. Neither the pomp of the mighty, nor the wealth of the rich, nor even the ascendancy of the ungodly will endure.

input: سیفنی الکلّ بکلمة من عنده.
output: All will perish, at a word from Him.

input: انّه لهو المقتدر العزیز القدیر.
output: He, verily, is the All-Powerful, the All-Compelling, the Almighty.

input: لا ینفع النّاس ما عندهم من الاثاث.
output: What advantage is there in the earthly things which men possess.

input: و ما ینفعهم غفلوا عنه.
output: That which shall profit them, they have utterly neglected.

input: سوف ینتبهون و لا یجدون ما فات عنهم فی ایّام ربّهم العزیز الحمید.
output: Erelong, they will awake from their slumber, and find themselves unable to obtain that which hath escaped them in the days of their Lord, the Almighty, the All-Praised.

input: لو یعرفون ینفقون ما عندهم لتذکر اسمآئهم لدی العرش.
output: Did they but know it, they would renounce their all, that their names may be mentioned before His throne.

input: الا انّهم من المیّتین.
output: They, verily, are accounted among the dead.

input: قل یا قوم لا یأخذکم الاضطراب اذا غاب ملکوت ظهوری و سکنت امواج بحر بیانی.
output: Let not your hearts be perturbed, O people, when the glory of My Presence is withdrawn, and the ocean of My utterance is stilled.

input: انّ فی ظهوری لحکمة و فی غیبتی حکمة اخری ما اطّلع بها الّا الله الفرد الخبیر.
output: In My presence amongst you there is a wisdom, and in My absence there is yet another, inscrutable to all but God, the Incomparable, the All-Knowing.

input: و نراکم من افقی الابهی و ننصر من قام علی نصرة امری بجنود من الملأ الاعلی و قبیل من الملئکة المقرّبین.
output: Verily, We behold you from Our realm of glory, and shall aid whosoever will arise for the triumph of Our Cause with the hosts of the Concourse on high and a company of Our favored angels.

input: یا ملأ الارض.
output: O peoples of the earth.

input: تالله الحقّ قد انفجرت من الاحجار الانهار العذبة السّآئغة بما اخذتها حلاوة بیان ربّکم المختار و انتم من الغافلین.
output: God, the Eternal Truth, is My witness that streams of fresh and soft-flowing waters have gushed from the rocks, through the sweetness of the words uttered by your Lord, the Unconstrained. and still ye slumber.

input: دعوا ما عندکم ثمّ طیروا بقوادم الانقطاع فوق الابداع.
output: Cast away that which ye possess, and, on the wings of detachment, soar beyond all created things.

input: کذلک یأمرکم مالک الاختراع الّذی بحرکة قلمه قلّب العالمین.
output: Thus biddeth you the Lord of creation, the movement of Whose Pen hath revolutionized the soul of mankind.

input: هل تعرفون من ایّ افق ینادیکم ربّکم الابهی.
output: Know ye from what heights your Lord, the All-Glorious is calling.

input: و هل علمتم من ایّ قلم یأمرکم ربّکم مالک الاسمآء.
output: Think ye that ye have recognized the Pen wherewith your Lord, the Lord of all names, commandeth you.

input: لا و عمری.
output: Nay, by My life.

input: لو عرفتم لترکتم الدّنیا مقبلین بالقلوب الی شطر المحبوب.
output: Did ye but know it, ye would renounce the world, and would hasten with your whole hearts to the presence of the Well-Beloved.

input: و اخذکم اهتزاز الکلمة علی شأن یهتزّ منه العالم الاکبر و کیف هذا العالم الصّغیر.
output: Your spirits would be so transported by His Word as to throw into commotion the Greater World—how much more this small and petty one.

input: کذلک هطلت من سمآء عنایتی امطار مکرمتی فضلاً من عندی لتکونوا من الشّاکرین....
output: Thus have the showers of My bounty been poured down from the heaven of My loving-kindness, as a token of My grace. that ye may be of the thankful....

input: ایّاکم ان تفرّقکم شئونات النّفس و الهوی.
output: Beware lest the desires of the flesh and of a corrupt inclination provoke divisions among you.

input: کونوا کالاصابع فی الید و الارکان للبدن.
output: Be ye as the fingers of one hand, the members of one body.

input: کذلک یعظکم قلم الوحی ان انتم من الموقنین.
output: Thus counseleth you the Pen of Revelation, if ye be of them that believe.

input: فانظروا فی رحمة الله و الطافه.
output: Consider the mercy of God and His gifts.

input: انّه یأمرکم بما ینفعکم بعد اذ کان غنیّاً عن العالمین.
output: He enjoineth upon you that which shall profit you, though He Himself can well dispense with all creatures.

input: لن تضرّنا سیّئاتکمٍ کما لا تنفعنا حسناتکم.
output: Your evil doings can never harm Us, neither can your good works profit Us.

input: انّما ندعوکم لوجه الله.
output: We summon you wholly for the sake of God.

input: یشهد بذلک کلّ عالم بصیر.
output: To this every man of understanding and insight will testify.

input: معلوم آن جناب بوده که کلّ اسماء و صفات و جمیع اشیاء از آنچه ظاهر و مشهود است و از آنچه باطن و غیر مشهود بعد از کشف حجبات عن وجهها لن یبقی منها الّا آیة الله الّتی اودعها الله فیها.
output: It is clear and evident that when the veils that conceal the realities of the manifestations of the Names and Attributes of God, nay of all created things visible or invisible, have been rent asunder, nothing except the Sign of God will remain—a sign which He, Himself, hath placed within these realities.

input: و هی باقیة الی ما شآء الله ربّک و ربّ السّموات و الأرضین.
output: This sign will endure as long as is the wish of the Lord thy God, the Lord of the heavens and of the earth.

input: تا چه رسد بمؤمن که مقصود از آفرینش وجود و حیات او بوده.
output: If such be the blessings conferred on all created things, how superior must be the destiny of the true believer, whose existence and life are to be regarded as the originating purpose of all creation.

input: و چنانچه اسم ایمان از اوّل لا اوّل بوده و الی آخر لا آخر خواهد بود و هم‌چنین مؤمن باقی و حیّ بوده و خواهد بود.
output: Just as the conception of faith hath existed from the beginning that hath no beginning, and will endure till the end that hath no end, in like manner will the true believer eternally live and endure.

input: و لم‌یزل و لایزال طائف حول مشیّة الله بوده.
output: His spirit will everlastingly circle round the Will of God.

input: و او است باقی ببقآء الله و دائم بدوام او.
output: He will last as long as God, Himself, will last.

input: و ظاهر بظهور او و باطن بامر او.
output: He is revealed through the Revelation of God, and is hidden at His bidding.

input: و این مشهود است که اعلی افق بقا مقرّ مؤمنین بالله و آیات او بوده.
output: It is evident that the loftiest mansions in the Realm of Immortality have been ordained as the habitation of them that have truly believed in God and in His signs.

input: ابداً فنا بآن مقعد قدس راه نجوید.
output: Death can never invade that holy seat.

input: کذلک نلقی علیک من آیات ربّک لتستقیم علی حبّک و تکون من العارفین.
output: Thus have We entrusted thee with the signs of thy Lord, that thou mayest persevere in thy love for Him, and be of them that comprehend this truth.

input: قل کلّ ما یخرج من فمه انّه لمحیی الأبدان لو انتم من العارفین.
output: Every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God is endowed with such potency as can instill new life into every human frame, if ye be of them that comprehend this truth.

input: کلّ ما انتم تشهدون فی الأرض انّه قد ظهر بأمره العالی المتعالی المحکم البدیع.
output: All the wondrous works ye behold in this world have been manifested through the operation of His supreme and most exalted Will, His wondrous and inflexible Purpose.

input: اذا استشرق عن افق فمه شمس اسمه الصّانع بها تظهر الصّنایع فی کلّ الأعصار
output: Through the mere revelation of the word Fashioner, issuing forth from His lips and proclaiming His attribute to mankind, such power is released as can generate, through successive ages, all the manifold arts which the hands of man can produce.

input: و انّ هذا لحقّ یقین.
output: This, verily, is a certain truth.

input: و یستشرق هذا الاسم علی کلّ ما یکون و تظهر منه الصّنایع بأسباب الملک. لو انتم من الموقنین.
output: No sooner is this resplendent word uttered, than its animating energies, stirring within all created things, give birth to the means and instruments whereby such arts can be produced and perfected.

input: کلّ ما تشهدون ظهورات الصّنعیّة البدیعة کلّها ظهر من هذا الاسم.
output: All the wondrous achievements ye now witness are the direct consequences of the Revelation of this Name.

input: و سیظهر من بعد ما لا سمعتموه من قبل.
output: In the days to come, ye will, verily, behold things of which ye have never heard before.

input: کذلک قدّر فی الألواح و لا یعرفها الّا کلّ ذی بصر حدید.
output: Thus hath it been decreed in the Tablets of God, and none can comprehend it except them whose sight is sharp.

input: و کذلک حین الّذی تستشرق عن افق البیان شمس اسمی العلّام یحمل کلّ شیء من هذا الاسم بدایع العلوم علی حدّه و مقداره و یظهر منه فی مذ الأیّام بأمر من لدن مقتدر علیم.
output: In like manner, the moment the word expressing My attribute The Omniscient issueth forth from My mouth, every created thing will, according to its capacity and limitations, be invested with the power to unfold the knowledge of the most marvelous sciences, and will be empowered to manifest them in the course of time at the bidding of Him Who is the Almighty, the All-Knowing.

input: و کذلک فانظر فی کلّ الأسمآء و کن علی یقین منیع.
output: Know thou of a certainty that the Revelation of every other Name is accompanied by a similar manifestation of Divine power.

input: قل انّ کلّ حرف تخرج من فم الله انّها لأمّ الحروفات و کذلک کلّ کلمة تظهر من معدن الأمر انّها لأمّ الکلمات و انّ لوحه لأمّ الألواح.
output: Every single letter proceeding out of the mouth of God is indeed a mother letter, and every word uttered by Him Who is the Wellspring of Divine Revelation is a mother word, and His Tablet a Mother Tablet.

input: فطوبی للعارفین.
output: Well is it with them that apprehend this truth.

input: باسمم حجبات غلیظ را بردرید و اصنام تقلید را بقوّت توحید بشکنید.
output: Tear asunder, in My Name, the veils that have grievously blinded your vision, and, through the power born of your belief in the unity of God, scatter the idols of vain imitation.

input: و بفضای رضوان قدس رحمن وارد شوید.
output: Enter, then, the holy paradise of the good-pleasure of the All-Merciful.

input: نفس را از آلایش ما سوی الله مطهّر نمائید و در موطن امن کبری و مقرّ عصمت عظمی آسایش کنید.
output: Sanctify your souls from whatsoever is not of God, and taste ye the sweetness of rest within the pale of His vast and mighty Revelation, and beneath the shadow of His supreme and infallible authority.

input: بحجاب نفس خود را محتجب مسازید چه که هر نفسی را کامل خلق نمودم تا کمال صنعم مشهود آید.
output: Suffer not yourselves to be wrapt in the dense veils of your selfish desires, inasmuch as I have perfected in every one of you My creation, so that the excellence of My handiwork may be fully revealed unto men.

input: پس در اینصورت هر نفسی بنفسه قابل ادراک جمال سبحان بوده و خواهد بود.
output: It follows, therefore, that every man hath been, and will continue to be, able of himself to appreciate the Beauty of God, the Glorified.

input: چه که اگر قابل اینمقام نباشد تکلیف از او ساقط.
output: Had he not been endowed with such a capacity, how could he be called to account for his failure.

input: و در محضر حشر اکبر بین یدی الله اگر از نفسی سؤال شود که چرا بجمالم مؤمن نشده و از نفسم اعراض نموده‌ و او متمسّک شود بجمیع اهل عالم و معروض دارد که چون احدی اقبال ننمود و کلّ را معرض مشاهده نمودم لذا اقتدا بایشان نموده از جمال ابدیّه دور مانده‌ام هرگز این عذر مسموع نیاید و مقبول نگردد.
output: If, in the Day when all the peoples of the earth will be gathered together, any man should, whilst standing in the presence of God, be asked: Wherefore hast thou disbelieved in My Beauty and turned away from My Self, and if such a man should reply and say: Inasmuch as all men have erred, and none hath been found willing to turn his face to the Truth, I, too, following their example, have grievously failed to recognize the Beauty of the Eternal, such a plea will, assuredly, be rejected.

input: چه که ایمان هیچ نفسی بدون او معلّق نبوده و نخواهد بود.
output: For the faith of no man can be conditioned by anyone except himself.

input: اینست از اسرار تنزیل که در کلّ کتب سماوی بلسان جلیل قدرت نازل فرمودم و بقلم اقتدار ثبت نمودم.
output: This is one of the verities that lie enshrined in My Revelation—a verity which I have revealed in all the heavenly Books, which I have caused the Tongue of Grandeur to utter, and the Pen of Power to inscribe.

input: پس حال قدری تفکّر نمائید تا ببصر ظاهر و باطن بلطافت حکمتیّه و جواهر آثار ملکوتیّه که در این لوح منیعهٴ ابدیّه بخطاب محکمهٴ مبرمه نازل فرمودم مشاهده نموده ادراک نمائید و خود را از مقرّ قصوی و سدرهٴ منتهی و مکمن عزّ ابهی دور مگردانید.
output: Ponder awhile thereon, that with both your inner and outer eye, ye may perceive the subtleties of Divine wisdom and discover the gems of heavenly knowledge which, in clear and weighty language, I have revealed in this exalted and incorruptible Tablet, and that ye may not stray far from the All-Highest Throne, from the Tree beyond which there is no passing, from the Habitation of everlasting might and glory.

input: آثار حقّ چون شمس بین آثار عباد او مشرق و لایح است.
output: The signs of God shine as manifest and resplendent as the sun amidst the works of His creatures.

input: و هیچ شأنی از شئون او بدون او مشتبه نگردد.
output: Whatsoever proceedeth from Him is apart, and will always remain distinguished, from the inventions of men.

input: از مشرق علمش شموس علم و معانی مشرق و از رضوان مدادش نفحات رحمن مرسل.
output: From the Source of His knowledge countless Luminaries of learning and wisdom have risen, and out of the Paradise of His Pen the breath of the All-Merciful hath continually been wafted to the hearts and souls of men.

input: فهنیئاً للعارفین.
output: Happy are they that have recognized this truth.

input: ان یا عبد ان استمع ما یوحی الیک عن جهة عرش ربّک العلیّ العظیم.
output: Give ear, O My servant, unto that which is being sent down unto thee from the Throne of thy Lord, the Inaccessible, the Most Great.

input: بأنّه لا اله الّا هو.
output: There is none other God but Him.

input: قد خلق الخلق لعرفان نفسه الرّحمن الرّحیم.
output: He hath called into being His creatures, that they may know Him, Who is the Compassionate, the All-Merciful.

input: و ارسل الی کلّ مدینة رسولاً من عنده لیبشّرهم برضوان الله و یقرّبهم الی مقعد الأمن مقرّ قدس رفیع.
output: Unto the cities of all nations He hath sent His Messengers, Whom He hath commissioned to announce unto men tidings of the Paradise of His good pleasure, and to draw them nigh unto the Haven of abiding security, the Seat of eternal holiness and transcendent glory.

input: و من النّاس من اهتدی بهدی الله و فاز بلقائه و شرب من ایادی التّسلیم سلسبیل الحیوان و کان من الموقنین.
output: Some were guided by the Light of God, gained admittance into the court of His presence, and quaffed, from the hand of resignation, the waters of everlasting life, and were accounted of them that have truly recognized and believed in Him.

input: و منهم من قام علی الاعراض و کفر بآیات الله المقتدر العزیز العلیم.
output: Others rebelled against Him, and rejected the signs of God, the Most Powerful, the Almighty, the All-Wise.

input: و قضت القرون و انتهت الی سیّد الأیّام یوم الّذی فیه اشرقت شمس البیان عن افق الرّحمن و طلع جمال السّبحان باسم علیّ عظیم.
output: Ages rolled away, until they attained their consummation in this, the Lord of days, the Day whereon the Daystar of the Bayán manifested itself above the horizon of mercy, the Day in which the Beauty of the All-Glorious shone forth in the exalted person of 'Alí-Muhammad, the Báb.

input: اذاً قام الکلّ علی الاعراض و منهم.
output: No sooner did He reveal Himself, than all the people rose up against Him.

input: من قال ان هذا الّا رجل افتری علی الله العزیز القدیم.
output: By some He was denounced as one that hath uttered slanders against God, the Almighty, the Ancient of Days.

input: و منهم من قال به جنّة کما تکلّم بذلک احد من العلمآء فی محضری و کنّا من الشّاهدین.
output: Others regarded Him as a man smitten with madness, an allegation which I, Myself, have heard from the lips of one of the divines.

input: و منهم من قال ما نطق علی الفطرة بل سرق کلمات الله و رکّبها بکلمات نفسه و بما خرج من افواههم.
output: Still others disputed His claim to be the Mouthpiece of God, and stigmatized Him as one who had stolen and used as his the words of the Almighty, who had perverted their meaning, and mingled them with his own.

input: قد بکت عیون العظمة و هم کانوا علی مقاعدهم لمن الفرحین.
output: The Eye of Grandeur weepeth sore for the things which their mouths have uttered, while they continue to rejoice upon their seats.

input: و قال یا قوم تالله.
output: God, said He, is My witness, O people.

input: قد جئتکم بأمر الله ربّکم و ربّ آبائکم الأوّلین.
output: I am come to you with a Revelation from the Lord, your God, the Lord of your fathers of old.

input: و یا قوم لا تنظروا الی ما عندکم.
output: Look not, O people, at the things ye possess.

input: فانظروا بما نزّل من عند الله.
output: Look rather at the things God hath sent down unto you.

input: و انّه خیر لکم عن کلّ شیء ان انتم من العارفین.
output: This, surely, will be better for you than the whole of creation, could ye but perceive it. Repeat the gaze, O people, and consider the testimony of God and His proof which are in your possession, and compare them unto the Revelation sent down unto you in this Day, that the truth, the infallible truth, may be indubitably manifested unto you.

input: و یا قوم فارجعوا البصر الی ما عندکم من حجّة الله و برهانه و ما نزّل یومئذ لیظهر لکم الحقّ بآیات واضح مبین.
output: Repeat the gaze, O people, and consider the testimony of God and His proof which are in your possession, and compare them unto the Revelation sent down unto you in this Day, that the truth, the infallible truth, may be indubitably manifested unto you.

input: و یا قوم لا تتّبعوا خطوات الشّیطان ان اتّبعوا ملّة الرّحمن و کونوا من المؤمنین.
output: Follow not, O people, the steps of the Evil One. follow ye the Faith of the All-Merciful, and be ye of them that truly believe.

input: هل بعد ظهور الله ینفع احداً
output: What would it profit man, if he were to fail to recognize the Revelation of God.

input: شیء لا
output: Nothing whatever.

input: فونفسی المقتدر العلیم الحکیم.
output: To this Mine own Self, the Omnipotent, the Omniscient, the All-Wise, will testify.

input: کلّما زاد فی النّصح زادوا فی البغضآء الی ان قتلوه بالظّلم.
output: The more He exhorted them, the fiercer grew their enmity, till, at the last, they put Him to death with shameful cruelty.

input: الا لعنة الله علی الظّالمین.
output: The curse of God be upon the oppressors.

input: و آمن به قلیل من النّاس و قلیل من عبادنا الشّاکرین.
output: A few believed in Him. few of Our servants are the thankful.

input: و وصّی هؤلآء فی کلّ الألواح بل فی کلّ سطر جمیل بأن لا یعتکفوا حین الظّهور بشیء عمّا خلق بین السّموات و الأرضین.
output: These He admonished, in all His Tablets—nay, in every passage of His wondrous writings—not to give themselves up in the Day of the promised Revelation to anything whatever, be it in the heaven or in the earth.

input: و قال یا قوم.
output: O people. said He,

input: انّی قد اظهرت نفسی لنفسه و ما نزّلت البیان الّا لاثبات امره.
output: I have revealed Myself for His Manifestation, and have caused My Book, the Bayán, to descend upon you for no other purpose except to establish the truth of His Cause.

input: اتّقوا الله و لا تتعرّضوا به کما اعترضوا علیّ ملأ الفرقان.
output: Fear ye God, and contend not with Him as the people of the Qur'án have contended with Me. At whatever time ye hear of Him, hasten ye towards Him, and cleave ye to whatsoever He may reveal unto you.

input: و اذا سمعتم ذکره فاسعوا الیه و خذوا ما عنده.
output: At whatever time ye hear of Him, hasten ye towards Him, and cleave ye to whatsoever He may reveal unto you.

input: لأنّ دونه لن یغنیکم لو تتمسّکوا بحجج الأوّلین و الآخرین.
output: Naught else besides Him can ever profit you, no, not though ye produce from first to last the testimonies of all those who were before you.

input: فلمّا قضت اشهر معلومات و سنین معدودات قد شقّت سمآء القضآء و اتی جمال علیّ بالحقّ علی غمام الأسمآء بقمیص اخری اذاً قاموا علی النّفاق بهذا النّور المشرق عن شطر الآفاق.
output: And when after the lapse of a few years the heaven of Divine decree was cleft asunder, and the Beauty of the Báb appeared in the clouds of the names of God, arrayed in a new raiment, these same people maliciously rose up against Him, Whose light embraceth all created things.

input: و نقضوا المیثاق و کفروا به و حاربوا بنفسه و جادلوا بآیاته و کذّبوا ببرهانه و کانوا من المشرکین.
output: They broke His Covenant, rejected His truth, contended with Him, caviled at His signs, treated His testimony as falsehood, and joined the company of the infidels.

input: الی ان قاموا علی قتله.
output: Eventually, they determined to take away His life.

input: کذلک کان شأن هؤلآء الغافلین.
output: Such is the state of them who are in a far-gone error.

input: فلمّا شهدوا انفسهم عجزآء عن ذلک قاموا علی المکر.
output: And when they realized their powerlessness to achieve their purpose, they arose to plot against Him.

input: و یأتون فی کلّ حین بمکر جدید لیضیع به امر الله.
output: Witness how every moment they devise a fresh device to harm Him, that they may injure and dishonor the cause of God.

input: قل فویل لکم.
output: Say: Woe be to you.

input: بذلک یضیع انفسکم.
output: Your schemings cover you with shame.

input: و انّ ربّکم الرّحمن لغنیّ عن العالمین.
output: Your Lord, the God of mercy, can well dispense with all creatures.

input: و لن یزیده شیء و لن ینقصه امر.
output: Nothing whatever can either increase or diminish the things He doth possess.

input: ان آمنتم فلأنفسکم و ان کفرتم یرجع الیکم.
output: If ye believe, to your own behoof will ye believe.

input: و کان ذیله مقدّساً عن دنس المشرکین.
output: and if ye believe not, ye yourselves will suffer.

input: ان یا عبد المؤمن.
output: O My servant that believest in God.

input: بالله تالله.
output: By the righteousness of the Almighty.

input: لو ارید ان اذکر لک ما ورد علیّ لن تحمله النّفوس و لا العقول
output: Were I to recount to thee the tale of the things that have befallen Me, the souls and minds of men would be incapable of sustaining its weight.

input: و لا العقول و کان الله علی ذلک شهید.
output: God Himself beareth Me witness.

input: و انّک انت فاحفظ نفسک و لا تعقّب هؤلآء.
output: Watch over thyself, and follow not the footsteps of these people.

input: و کن فی امر ربّک لمن المتفکّرین.
output: Meditate diligently upon the Cause of thy Lord.

input: ان اعرف ربّک بنفسه لا بدونه.
output: Strive to know Him through His own Self and not through others.

input: لأنّ دونه لن یکفیک بشیء.
output: For no one else besides Him can ever profit thee.

input: و یشهد بذلک کلّ الأشیآء ان انت من السّامعین.
output: To this all created things will testify, couldst thou but perceive it.

input: ان اخرج عن خلف الحجاب باذن ربّک العزیز الوهّاب ثمّ خذ کأس البقآء باسم ربّک العلیّ الأعلی بین الأرض و السّمآء ثمّ اشرب منها و لا تکن من الصّابرین.
output: Emerge from behind the veil, by the leave of thy Lord, the All-Glorious, the Most Powerful, and seize, before the eyes of those who are in the heavens and those who are on the earth, the Chalice of Immortality, in the name of thy Lord, the Inaccessible, the Most High, and quaff thy fill, and be not of them that tarry.

input: حین الّذی یصل الکأس الی شفتاک لیقولنّ اهل ملإ الأعلی بأنّ هنیئاً لک یا ایّها العبد الموقن بالله.
output: The moment thou touchest the Cup with thy lips, the Concourse on high will acclaim thee saying, Drink with healthy relish, O man that hast truly believed in God.

input: و اهل مداین البقآء بأنّ مریئاً لک یا ایّها الشّارب من کأس حبّه.
output: and the inhabitants of the Cities of Immortality will cry out, Joy be to thee, O thou that hast drained the Cup of His love.

input: و ینادی لسان الکبریآء بأنّ بشری لک یا ایّها العبد بما فزت بما لا فاز به الّا الّذینهم انقطعوا عن کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرض و کانوا من المنقطعین.
output: and the Tongue of Grandeur will hail thee, Great is the blessedness that awaiteth thee, O My servant, for thou hast attained unto that which none hath attained, except such as have detached themselves from all that is in the heavens and all that is on the earth, and who are the emblems of true detachment.

input: و امّا ما سألت عن الفطرة.
output: And now, concerning thy question regarding the creation of man.

input: فاعلم بأنّ کلّ النّاس قد خلقوا علی فطرة الله المهیمن القیّوم.
output: Know thou that all men have been created in the nature made by God, the Guardian, the Self-Subsisting.

input: و قدّر لکلّ نفس مقادیر الأمر علی ما رقم فی الواح عزّ محفوظ.
output: Unto each one hath been prescribed a preordained measure, as decreed in God's mighty and guarded Tablets.

input: ولکن یظهر کلّ ذلک بارادات انفسکم.
output: All that which ye potentially possess can, however, be manifested only as a result of your own volition.

input: کما انتم فی اعمالکم تشهدون.
output: Your own acts testify to this truth. Consider, for instance, that which hath been forbidden, in the Bayán, unto men. God hath in that Book, and by His behest, decreed as lawful whatsoever He hath pleased to decree, and hath, through the power of His sovereign might, forbidden whatsoever He elected to forbid. To this testifieth the text of that Book. Will ye not bear witness.

input: مثلاً فانظر فیما حرّم علی العباد فی الکتاب من شیء کما انتم فی البیان.
output: Consider, for instance, that which hath been forbidden, in the Bayán, unto men.

input: تنظرون بحیث احلّ الله ما اراد بأمره و حرّم ما شآء بسلطانه.
output: God hath in that Book, and by His behest, decreed as lawful whatsoever He hath pleased to decree, and hath, through the power of His sovereign might, forbidden whatsoever He elected to forbid.

input: قل کلّ ذلک فی الکتاب.
output: To this testifieth the text of that Book.

input: أ فلا تشهدون.
output: Will ye not bear witness.

input: ولکنّ النّاس بعد علمهم عمّا نهوا عنه هم یرتکبون.
output: Men, however, have wittingly broken His law.

input: هل ینسب هذا الی الله او الی انفسهم.
output: Is such a behavior to be attributed to God, or to their proper selves.

input: ان انتم تنصفون.
output: Be fair in your judgment.

input: قل ما من حسنة الّا من عند الله و ما من سیّئة الّا من انفسکم.
output: Every good thing is of God, and every evil thing is from yourselves.

input: أ فلا تعرفون.
output: Will ye not comprehend.

input: و هذا ما نزل فی کلّ الألواح ان انتم تعلمون.
output: This same truth hath been revealed in all the Scriptures, if ye be of them that understand.

input: بلی انّه عالم بأعمالکم قبل ظهورها کما هو عالم بعد ظهورها.
output: Every act ye meditate is as clear to Him as is that act when already accomplished.

input: و انّه ما من اله الّا هو.
output: There is none other God besides Him. His is all creation and its empire. All stands revealed before Him.

input: و کلّ عنده فی الواح قدس مکنون.
output: all is recorded in His holy and hidden Tablets.

input: و هذا العلم لم یکن علّة الفعل فی خلقه کما انّ علمکم بشیء لم یکن علّة لظهوره فیما اردتم او تریدون و علمتم او تعلمون.
output: This foreknowledge of God, however, should not be regarded as having caused the actions of men, just as your own previous knowledge that a certain event is to occur, or your desire that it should happen, is not and can never be the reason for its occurrence.

input: و اینکه سؤال از خلق شده بود.
output: As to thy question concerning the origin of creation.

input: بدان که لم‌یزل خلق بوده و لایزال خواهد بود.
output: Know assuredly that God's creation hath existed from eternity, and will continue to exist forever.

input: لا لأوّله بدایة و لا لآخره نهایة.
output: Its beginning hath had no beginning, and its end knoweth no end.

input: اسم الخالق بنفسه یطلب المخلوق و کذلک اسم الرّبّ یقتضی المربوب.
output: His name, the Creator, presupposeth a creation, even as His title, the Lord of Men, must involve the existence of a servant.

input: و اینکه در کلمات قبل ذکر شده کان الهاً و لا مألوه و ربّاً و لا مربوب و امثال ذلک معنی آن در جمیع احیان محقّق.
output: As to those sayings, attributed to the Prophets of old, such as, In the beginning was God. there was no creature to know Him, and The Lord was alone. with no one to adore Him, the meaning of these and similar sayings is clear and evident, and should at no time be misapprehended.

input: و این همان کلمه‌ایست که میفرماید کان الله و لم یکن معه من شیء.
output: To this same truth bear witness these words which He hath revealed: God was alone. there was none else besides Him.

input: و یکون بمثل ما قد کان.
output: He will always remain what He hath ever been.

input: و هر ذی بصری شهادت میدهد که الآن ربّ موجود و مربوب مفقود.
output: Every discerning eye will readily perceive that the Lord is now manifest, yet there is none to recognize His glory.

input: یعنی آن ساحت مقدّس است از ماسوی و آنچه در رتبهٴ ممکن ذکر می‌شود.
output: By this is meant that the habitation wherein the Divine Being dwelleth is far above the reach and ken of anyone besides Him.

input: محدود است بحدودات امکانیّه.
output: Whatsoever in the contingent world can either be expressed or apprehended, can never transgress the limits which, by its inherent nature, have been imposed upon it.

input: و حقّ مقدّس از آن.
output: God, alone, transcendeth such limitations.

input: لم‌یزل بوده.
output: He, verily, is from everlasting.

input: و نبوده با او احدی.
output: No peer or partner has been, or can ever be, joined with Him.

input: نه اسم.
output: No name can be compared with His Name.

input: و نه رسم و نه وصف.
output: No pen can portray His nature, neither can any tongue depict His glory.

input: و لایزال خواهد بود مقدّس از کلّ ما سواه.
output: He will, forever, remain immeasurably exalted above anyone except Himself.

input: مثلاً ملاحظه کن در حین ظهور مظهر کلّیّه.
output: Consider the hour at which the supreme Manifestation of God revealeth Himself unto men.

input: قبل از آنکه آن ذات قدم خود را بشناساند و بکلمهٴ امریّه تنطّق فرماید عالم بوده و معلومی با او نبوده.
output: Ere that hour cometh, the Ancient Being, Who is still unknown of men and hath not as yet given utterance to the Word of God, is Himself the All-Knower in a world devoid of any man that hath known Him.

input: و هم‌چنین خالق بوده و مخلوقی با او نه.
output: He is indeed the Creator without a creation.

input: چه که در آن حین قبض روح از کلّ ما یصدق علیه اسم شیء میشود.
output: For at the very moment preceding His Revelation, each and every created thing shall be made to yield up its soul to God.

input: و اینست آن یومی که میفرماید لمن الملک الیوم.
output: This is indeed the Day of which it hath been written: Whose shall be the Kingdom this Day.

input: و نیست احدی مجیب.
output: And none can be found ready to answer.

input: مع انّک تری امراً لم یکن موجوداً فی العالم و یظهر من بعد اذاً حقّق بأنّ عالم الّذی انت رأیت فیه ما رأیت یکون.
output: This being not the case, however, it must necessarily follow that the world in which thou livest is different and apart from that which thou hast experienced in thy dream.

input: عالماً آخر الّذی لا له اوّل و لا آخر.
output: This latter world hath neither beginning nor end.

input: و انّک ان تقول هذا العالم فی نفسک و مطویّ فیها بأمر من لدن عزیز قدیر.
output: It would be true if thou wert to contend that this same world is, as decreed by the All-Glorious and Almighty God, within thy proper self and is wrapped up within thee.

input: لحقّ و لو تقول بأن الرّوح لا تجرّد عن العلایق فی النّوم سیّره الله فی عالم الّذی یکون مستوراً فی سرّ هذا العالم لحقّ.
output: It would equally be true to maintain that thy spirit, having transcended the limitations of sleep and having stripped itself of all earthly attachment, hath, by the act of God, been made to traverse a realm which lieth hidden in the innermost reality of this world.

input: و امّا ما سألت بنی نوع انسانی بعد از موت ظاهری غیر از انبیا و اولیا آیا همین تعیّن و تشخّص و ادراک و شعوری که قبل از موت در او موجود است بعد از موت هم باقی است یا زائل میشود.
output: Thou hast asked Me whether man, as apart from the Prophets of God and His chosen ones, will retain, after his physical death, the self-same individuality, personality, consciousness, and understanding that characterize his life in this world.

input: و بر فرض بقا چگونه است که در حال حیات فی‌الجمله صدمه که بمشاعر انسانی وارد میشود از قبیل بیهوشی و مرض شدید شعور و ادراک از او زایل میشود و موت که انعدام ترکیب و عناصر است.
output: If this should be the case, how is it, thou hast observed, that whereas such slight injuries to his mental faculties as fainting and severe illness deprive him of his understanding and consciousness, his death, which must involve the decomposition of his body and the dissolution of its elements, is powerless to destroy that understanding and extinguish that consciousness.

input: چگونه میشود که بعد او تشخّص و شعوری متصوّر شود با آنکه آلات بتمامها از هم پاشیده.انتهی
output: How can anyone imagine that man's consciousness and personality will be maintained, when the very instruments necessary to their existence and function will have completely disintegrated.

input: معلوم آن جناب بوده که روح در رتبهٴ خود قائم و مستقرّ است.
output: Know thou that the soul of man is exalted above, and is independent of all infirmities of body or mind.

input: و اینکه در مریض ضعف مشاهده میشود بواسطهٴ اسباب مانعه بوده والّا در اصل ضعف بروح راجع نه.
output: That a sick person showeth signs of weakness is due to the hindrances that interpose themselves between his soul and his body, for the soul itself remaineth unaffected by any bodily ailments.

input: مثلاً در سراج ملاحظه نمائید.
output: Consider the light of the lamp.

input: مضیء و روشن است ولکن اگر حائلی مانع شود در این صورت نور او ممنوع. مع آنکه در رتبهٴ خود مضیء بوده ولکن باسباب مانعه اشراق نور منع شده.
output: Though an external object may interfere with its radiance, the light itself continueth to shine with undiminished power.

input: و هم‌چنین مریض در حالت مرض ظهور قدرت و قوّت روح بسبب اسباب حائله ممنوع و مستور.
output: In like manner, every malady afflicting the body of man is an impediment that preventeth the soul from manifesting its inherent might and power.

input: ولکن بعد از خروج از بدن بقدرت و قوّت و غلبه‌ئی ظاهر که شبه آن ممکن نه.
output: When it leaveth the body, however, it will evince such ascendancy, and reveal such influence as no force on earth can equal.

input: و ارواح لطیفهٴ طیّبهٴ مقدّسه بکمال قدرت و انبساط بوده و خواهند بود.
output: Every pure, every refined and sanctified soul will be endowed with tremendous power, and shall rejoice with exceeding gladness.

input: مثلاً اگر سراج در تحت فانوس حدید واقع شود.
output: Consider the lamp which is hidden under a bushel.

input: ابداً نور او در خارج ظاهر نه مع آنکه در مقام خود روشن بوده.
output: Though its light be shining, yet its radiance is concealed from men.

input: در آفتاب خلف سحاب ملاحظه فرمائید.
output: Likewise, consider the sun which hath been obscured by the clouds.

input: که در رتبهٴ خود روشن و مضیء است ولکن نظر بسحاب حائله نور او ضعیف مشاهده میشود.
output: Observe how its splendor appeareth to have diminished, when in reality the source of that light hath remained unchanged.

input: و همین آفتاب را روح انسانی ملاحظه فرمائید و جمیع اشیاء را بدن او.
output: The soul of man should be likened unto this sun, and all things on earth should be regarded as his body.

input: که جمیع بدن بافاضه و اشراق آن نور روشن و مضیء ولکن این مادامی است که اسباب مانعهٴ حائله منع ننماید و حجاب نشود.
output: So long as no external impediment interveneth between them, the body will, in its entirety, continue to reflect the light of the soul, and to be sustained by its power.

input: و بعد از حجاب ظهور نور شمس ضعیف مشاهده میشود.
output: As soon as, however, a veil interposeth itself between them, the brightness of that light seemeth to lessen.

input: چنانچه ایّامی که غمام حایل است.
output: Consider again the sun when it is completely hidden behind the clouds.

input: اگرچه ارض بنور شمس روشن است ولکن آن روشنی ضعیف بوده و خواهد بود.
output: Though the earth is still illumined with its light, yet the measure of light which it receiveth is considerably reduced.

input: و بعد از رفع سحاب انوار شمس بکمال ظهور مشهود.
output: Not until the clouds have dispersed, can the sun shine again in the plenitude of its glory.

input: و در دو حالت شمس در رتبهٴ خود علی حدّ واحد بوده.
output: Neither the presence of the cloud nor its absence can, in any way, affect the inherent splendor of the sun.

input: هم‌چنین است آفتاب نفوس که باسم روح مذکور شده و میشود.
output: The soul of man is the sun by which his body is illumined, and from which it draweth its sustenance, and should be so regarded.

input: و هم‌چنین ملاحظه در ضعف وجود ثمره نمائید در اصل شجره که قبل از خروج از شجر مع آنکه در شجر است بشأنی ضعیف که ابداً مشاهده نمیشود.
output: Consider, moreover, how the fruit, ere it is formed, lieth potentially within the tree.

input: و اگر نفسی آن شجر را قطعه قطعه نماید ذرّه‌ئی از ثمر و صورت آن نخواهد یافت.
output: Were the tree to be cut into pieces, no sign nor any part of the fruit, however small, could be detected.

input: ولکن بعد از خروج از شجر بطراز بدیع و قوّت منیع ظاهر.
output: When it appeareth, however, it manifesteth itself, as thou hast observed, in its wondrous beauty and glorious perfection.

input: چنانچه در اثمار ملاحظه میشود و بعضی از فواکه است که بعد از قطع از سدره لطیف میشود.
output: Certain fruits, indeed, attain their fullest development only after being severed from the tree.

input: و امّا ما سألت عن الرّوح و بقائه بعد صعوده.
output: And now concerning thy question regarding the soul of man and its survival after death.

input: اعلم انّه یصعد حین ارتقائه الی ان یحضر بین یدی الله فی هیکل لا تغیّره القرون و الأعصار و لا حوادث العالم و ما یظهر فیه.
output: Know thou of a truth that the soul, after its separation from the body, will continue to progress until it attaineth the presence of God, in a state and condition which neither the revolution of ages and centuries, nor the changes and chances of this world, can alter.

input: و یکون باقیاً بدوام ملکوت الله و سلطانه و جبروته و اقتداره.
output: It will endure as long as the Kingdom of God, His sovereignty, His dominion and power will endure.

input: و منه تظهر آثار الله و صفاته و عنایة الله و الطافه.
output: It will manifest the signs of God and His attributes, and will reveal His loving kindness and bounty.

input: انّ القلم لا یقدر ان یتحرّک علی ذکر هذا المقام و علوّه و سموّه علی ما هو علیه.
output: The movement of My Pen is stilled when it attempteth to befittingly describe the loftiness and glory of so exalted a station.

input: و تدخله ید الفضل الی مقام لا یعرف بالبیان و لا یذکر بما فی الامکان.
output: The honor with which the Hand of Mercy will invest the soul is such as no tongue can adequately reveal, nor any other earthly agency describe.

input: طوبی لروح خرج من البدن مقدّساً عن شبهات الأمم.
output: Blessed is the soul which, at the hour of its separation from the body, is sanctified from the vain imaginings of the peoples of the world.

input: انّه یتحرّک فی هوآء ارادة ربّه و یدخل فی الجنّة العلیا.
output: Such a soul liveth and moveth in accordance with the Will of its Creator, and entereth the all-highest Paradise.

input: و تطوفه طلعات الفردوس الأعلی و یعاشر مع انبیآء الله و اولیائه.
output: The Maids of Heaven, inmates of the loftiest mansions, will circle around it, and the Prophets of God and His chosen ones will seek its companionship.

input: و یتکلّم معهم و یقصّ لهم ما ورد علیه فی سبیل الله ربّ العالمین.
output: With them that soul will freely converse, and will recount unto them that which it hath been made to endure in the path of God, the Lord of all worlds.

input: لو یطّلع احد علی ما قدّر له فی عوالم الله ربّ العرش و الثّری لیشتعل فی الحین شوقاً لذاک المقام الأمنع الأرفع الأقدس الأبهی....
output: If any man be told that which hath been ordained for such a soul in the worlds of God, the Lord of the throne on high and of earth below, his whole being will instantly blaze out in his great longing to attain that most exalted, that sanctified and resplendent station....

input: انّه لا یوصف و لا ینبغی ان یذکر الّا علی قدر معلوم.
output: The nature of the soul after death can never be described, nor is it meet and permissible to reveal its whole character to the eyes of men.

input: انبیا و مرسلین محض هدایت خلق بصراط مستقیم حقّ آمده‌اند.
output: The Prophets and Messengers of God have been sent down for the sole purpose of guiding mankind to the straight Path of Truth.

input: و مقصود آنکه عباد تربیت شوند تا در حین صعود با کمال تقدیس و تنزیه و انقطاع قصد رفیق اعلی نمایند.
output: The purpose underlying Their revelation hath been to educate all men, that they may, at the hour of death, ascend, in the utmost purity and sanctity and with absolute detachment, to the throne of the Most High.

input: لعمر الله اشراقات آن ارواح سبب ترقّیات عالم و مقامات امم است.
output: The light which these souls radiate is responsible for the progress of the world and the advancement of its peoples.

input: ایشانند مایهٴ وجود و علّت عظمی از برای ظهورات و صنایع عالم.
output: They are like unto leaven which leaveneth the world of being, and constitute the animating force through which the arts and wonders of the world are made manifest.

input: بهم تمطر السّحاب و تنبت الأرض.
output: Through them the clouds rain their bounty upon men, and the earth bringeth forth its fruits.

input: هیچ شیء از اشیاء بی ‌سبب و علّت و مبدء موجود نه.
output: All things must needs have a cause, a motive power, an animating principle.

input: و سبب اعظم ارواح مجرّده بوده و خواهد بود.
output: These souls and symbols of detachment have provided, and will continue to provide, the supreme moving impulse in the world of being.

input: و فرق این عالم با آن عالم مثل فرق عالم جنین و این عالم است.
output: The world beyond is as different from this world as this world is different from that of the child while still in the womb of its mother.

input: باری بعد از صعود بین یدی الله حاضر میشود بهیکلی که لایق بقا و قابل آن عالم است.
output: When the soul attaineth the Presence of God, it will assume the form that best befitteth its immortality and is worthy of its celestial habitation.

input: این بقا بقاء زمانیست نه بقاء ذاتی چه که مسبوقست بعلّت و بقاء ذاتی غیر مسبوق.
output: Such an existence is a contingent and not an absolute existence, inasmuch as the former is preceded by a cause, whilst the latter is independent thereof.

input: و آن مخصوص است بحقّ جلّ جلاله.
output: Absolute existence is strictly confined to God, exalted be His glory.

input: طوبی للعارفین اگر در اعمال انبیا تفکّر نمائی بیقین مبین شهادت میدهی که غیر این عالم عالمهاست
output: Well is it with them that apprehend this truth. Wert thou to ponder in thine heart the behavior of the Prophets of God thou wouldst assuredly and readily testify that there must needs be other worlds besides this world.

input: حکمای ارض چنانچه در لوح حکمت از قلم اعلی نازل اکثری بآنچه در کتب الهی نازل قائل و معترفند
output: The majority of the truly wise and learned have, throughout the ages, as it hath been recorded by the Pen of Glory in the Tablet of Wisdom, borne witness to the truth of that which the holy Writ of God hath revealed.

input: ولکن طبیعیّین که بطبیعت قائلند در بارهٴ انبیا نوشته‌اند که ایشان حکیم بوده‌اند و نظر بتربیت عباد ذکر مراتب جنّت و نار و ثواب و عذاب نموده‌اند
output: Even the materialists have testified in their writings to the wisdom of these divinely appointed Messengers, and have regarded the references made by the Prophets to Paradise, to hell fire, to future reward and punishment, to have been actuated by a desire to educate and uplift the souls of men.

input: حال ملاحظه نمائید جمیع در هر عالمی که بوده و هستند انبیا را مقدّم بر کل میدانند
output: Consider, therefore, how the generality of mankind, whatever their beliefs or theories, have recognized the excellence, and admitted the superiority, of these Prophets of God.

input: بعضی آن جواهر مجرّده را حکیم میگویند و برخی من قبل الله میدانند
output: These Gems of Detachment are acclaimed by some as the embodiments of wisdom, while others believe them to be the mouthpiece of God Himself.

input: حال امثال این نفوس اگر عوالم الهی را منحصر باین عالم میدانستند هرگز خود را بدست اعدا نمیدادند
output: How could such Souls have consented to surrender themselves unto their enemies if they believed all the worlds of God to have been reduced to this earthly life?

input: و عذاب و مشقّاتی که شبه و مثل نداشته تحمّل نمیفرمودند
output: Would they have willingly suffered such afflictions and torments as no man hath ever experienced or witnessed.

input: اینکه از حقیقت نفس سؤال نمودید.
output: Thou hast asked Me concerning the nature of the soul.

input: انّها آیة الهیّة و جوهرة ملکوتیّة الّتی عجز کلّ ذی علم عن عرفان حقیقتها و کلّ ذی عرفان عن معرفتها.
output: Know, verily, that the soul is a sign of God, a heavenly gem whose reality the most learned of men hath failed to grasp, and whose mystery no mind, however acute, can ever hope to unravel.

input: انّها اوّل شیء حکی عن الله موجده و اقبل الیه و تمسّک به و سجد له.
output: Know, verily, that the soul is a sign of God, a heavenly gem whose reality the most learned of men hath failed to grasp, and whose mystery no mind, however acute, can ever hope to unravel. It is the first among all created things to declare the excellence of its Creator, the first to recognize His glory, to cleave to His truth, and to bow down in adoration before Him.

input: در اینصورت بحقّ منسوب و باو راجع
output: If it be faithful to God, it will reflect His light, and will, eventually, return unto Him.

input: و من غیر آن بهوی منسوب و باو راجع.
output: If it fail, however, in its allegiance to its Creator, it will become a victim to self and passion, and will, in the end, sink in their depths.

input: الیوم هر نفسی شبهات خلق او را از حقّ منع ننمود و ضوضاء علما و سطوة امرا او را محجوب نساخت او از آیات کبری لدی الله مالک الوری محسوب و در کتاب الهی از قلم اعلی مسطور.
output: Whoso hath, in this Day, refused to allow the doubts and fancies of men to turn him away from Him Who is the Eternal Truth, and hath not suffered the tumult provoked by the ecclesiastical and secular authorities to deter him from recognizing His Message, such a man will be regarded by God, the Lord of all men, as one of His mighty signs, and will be numbered among them whose names have been inscribed by the Pen of the Most High in His Book.

input: طوبی لمن فاز بها و عرف شأنها و مقامها.
output: Blessed is he that hath recognized the true stature of such a soul, that hath acknowledged its station, and discovered its virtues.

input: در مراتب نفس از امّاره و لوّامه و ملهمه و مطمئنّه و راضیه و مرضیّه و امثال آن از قبل ذکر شده و کتب قوم مشحون است از این اذکار
output: Much hath been written in the books of old concerning the various stages in the development of the soul, such as concupiscence, irascibility, inspiration, benevolence, contentment, Divine good-pleasure, and the like.

input: قلم اعلی اقبال بذکر این مراتب نداشته و ندارد.
output: the Pen of the Most High, however, is disinclined to dwell upon them.

input: نفسی که الیوم لله خاضع است و باو متمسّک کلّ الأسمآء اسمائها و کلّ المقامات مقاماتها.
output: Every soul that walketh humbly with its God, in this Day, and cleaveth unto Him, shall find itself invested with the honor and glory of all goodly names and stations.

input: و در حین نوم تعلّق بشیء خارج نداشته و ندارد.
output: When man is asleep, his soul can, in no wise, be said to have been inherently affected by any external object.

input: در مقام خود ساکن و مستریح.
output: It is not susceptible of any change in its original state or character.

input: جمیع امور باسباب ظاهر و باهر.
output: Any variation in its functions is to be ascribed to external causes.

input: و باسباب مقامات سیر و ادراک و مشاهده مختلف میشود.
output: It is to these external influences that any variations in its environment, its understanding, and perception should be attributed.

input: در بصر ملاحظه نمائید.
output: Consider the human eye.

input: جمیع اشیاء موجوده از ارض و سماء و اشجار و انهار و جبال کل را مشاهده مینماید.
output: Though it hath the faculty of perceiving all created things, yet the slightest impediment may so obstruct its vision as to deprive it of the power of discerning any object whatsoever.

input: و بیک سبب جزئی از جمیع محروم تعالی من خلق الأسباب و تعالی من علّق الأمور بها.
output: Magnified be the name of Him Who hath created, and is the Cause of, these causes, Who hath ordained that every change and variation in the world of being be made dependent upon them.

input: کلّ شیء من الأشیآء باب لمعرفته و آیة لسلطانه و ظهور من اسمائه و دلیل لعظمته و اقتداره و سبیل الی صراطه المستقیم....
output: Every created thing in the whole universe is but a door leading into His knowledge, a sign of His sovereignty, a revelation of His names, a symbol of His majesty, a token of His power, a means of admittance into His straight Path....

input: انّ النّفس علی ما هی علیه آیة من آیات الله و سرّ من اسرار الله.
output: Verily I say, the human soul is, in its essence, one of the signs of God, a mystery among His mysteries.

input: او است آیة کبری و مخبری که خبر میدهد از عوالم الهی.
output: It is one of the mighty signs of the Almighty, the harbinger that proclaimeth the reality of all the worlds of God.

input: در او مستور است آنچه که عالم حال استعداد ذکر آن را نداشته و ندارد.
output: Within it lieth concealed that which the world is now utterly incapable of apprehending.

input: ان انظر الی نفس الله القائمة علی السّنن و النّفس الأمّارة الّتی قامت علی الاعراض و تنهی النّاس عن مالک الأسمآء و تأمرهم بالبغی و الفحشآء.
output: Ponder in thine heart the revelation of the Soul of God that pervadeth all His Laws, and contrast it with that base and appetitive nature that hath rebelled against Him, that forbiddeth men to turn unto the Lord of Names, and impelleth them to walk after their lusts and wickedness.

input: الا انّها فی خسران مبین....
output: Such a soul hath, in truth, wandered far in the path of error....

input: و اینکه سؤال نمودید روح بعد از خراب بدن بکجا راجع میشود.
output: Thou hast, moreover, asked Me concerning the state of the soul after its separation from the body.

input: اگر بحقّ منسوب است برفیق اعلی راجع.
output: Know thou, of a truth, that if the soul of man hath walked in the ways of God, it will, assuredly, return and be gathered to the glory of the Beloved.

input: بمقامی راجع میشود که جمیع السن و اقلام از ذکرش عاجز است.
output: It shall attain a station such as no pen can depict, or tongue describe.

input: هر نفسی که در امر الله ثابت و راسخ است او بعد از صعود جمیع عوالم از او کسب فیض مینماید.
output: The soul that hath remained faithful to the Cause of God, and stood unwaveringly firm in His Path shall, after his ascension, be possessed of such power that all the worlds which the Almighty hath created can benefit through him.

input: او است مایهٔ ظهور عالم و صنایع او و اشیاء ظاهرهٴ در او بامر سلطان حقیقی و مربّی حقیقی.
output: Such a soul provideth, at the bidding of the Ideal King and Divine Educator, the pure leaven that leaveneth the world of being, and furnisheth the power through which the arts and wonders of the world are made manifest.

input: در خمیر ملاحظه نمائید که محتاج است بمایه.
output: Consider how meal needeth leaven to be leavened with.

input: و ارواح مجرّده مایهٴ عالمند.
output: Those souls that are the symbols of detachment are the leaven of the world.

input: تفکّر و کن من الشّاکرین.
output: Meditate on this, and be of the thankful.

input: این مقامات و هم‌چنین مقامات نفس در الواح شتّی ذکر شده او است.
output: In several of Our Tablets We have referred to this theme, and have set forth the various stages in the development of the soul.

input: آیتی که از دخول و خروج مقدّس است.
output: Verily I say, the human soul is exalted above all egress and regress.

input: و او است ساکن طائر و سائر قاعد.
output: It is still, and yet it soareth. it moveth, and yet it is still.

input: شهادت میدهد بر عالمی که از برای او اوّل و آخر است و هم‌چنین بر عالمی که مقدّس از اوّل و آخر است.
output: It is, in itself, a testimony that beareth witness to the existence of a world that is contingent, as well as to the reality of a world that hath neither beginning nor end.

input: در این لیل امری مشاهده مینمائی و بعد از بیست سنه او ازید او اقلّ بعینه آن را مشاهده مینمائی.
output: Behold how the dream thou hast dreamed is, after the lapse of many years, reenacted before thine eyes.

input: حال ملاحظه کن این چه عالمی است.
output: Consider how strange is the mystery of the world that appeareth to thee in thy dream.

input: تفکّر فی حکمة الله و ظهوراته....
output: Ponder in thine heart upon the unsearchable wisdom of God, and meditate on its manifold revelations....

input: در آثار صنع ملاحظه نما و تفکّر کن.
output: Witness the wondrous evidences of God's handiwork, and reflect upon its range and character.

input: خاتم انبیا میفرماید زدنی فیک تحیّراً.
output: He Who is the Seal of the Prophets hath said: Increase my wonder and amazement at Thee, O God.

input: و ما ذکرت فی انتهآء عالم الأجسام عرفان این مقام معلّق است بابصار ناظرین.
output: As to thy question whether the physical world is subject to any limitations, know thou that the comprehension of this matter dependeth upon the observer himself.

input: در مقامی متناهی و در مقامی مقدّس از آن.
output: In one sense, it is limited. in another, it is exalted beyond all limitations.

input: حقّ لم‌یزل بوده و خواهد بود.
output: The one true God hath everlastingly existed, and will everlastingly continue to exist.

input: و هم‌چنین خلق.
output: His creation, likewise, hath had no beginning, and will have no end.

input: الّا انّ الثّانی مسبوق بالعلّة.
output: All that is created, however, is preceded by a cause.

input: در اینصورت حکم توحید ثابت و محقّق.
output: This fact, in itself, establisheth, beyond the shadow of a doubt, the unity of the Creator.

input: و اینکه از افلاک سؤال نمودید.
output: Thou hast, moreover, asked Me concerning the nature of the celestial spheres.

input: اوّلاً باید معلوم شود که مقصود از ذکر افلاک و سماء که در کتب قبل و بعد مذکور چیست و هم‌چنین ربط و اثر آن بعالم ظاهر بچه نحو.
