input: یتّبعون اهوائهم معرضین عن الله المهیمن القیّوم.
output: They follow their own idle fancies while turning aside from God, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting.

input: قل تالله.
output: Say, by the righteousness of God.

input: قد اتی الرّحمن بقدرة و سلطان.
output: The All-Merciful is come invested with power and sovereignty.

input: و به ارتعدت فرائص الأدیان و غنّ عندلیب البیان علی اعلی غصن العرفان.
output: Through His power the foundations of religions have quaked and the Nightingale of Utterance hath warbled its melody upon the highest branch of true understanding.

input: قد ظهر من کان مکنوناً فی العلم و مسطوراً فی الکتاب.
output: Verily, He Who was hidden in the knowledge of God and is mentioned in the Holy Scriptures hath appeared.

input: قل هذا یوم فیه استوی مکلّم الطّور علی عرش الظّهور و قام النّاس لله ربّ العالمین.
output: Say, this is the Day when the Speaker on Sinai hath mounted the throne of Revelation and the people have stood before the Lord of the worlds.

input: و السّمآء انجمها و السّاعة اشراطها و القیامة سطوتها و الأقلام آثارها و الأرواح اسرارها.
output: and the Heavens have revealed their stars, and the Hour its signs, and the Resurrection its dreadful majesty. when the pens have unloosed their outpourings and the spirits have laid bare their mysteries.

input: طوبی لمن عرفه و فاز به و ویل لمن انکره و اعرض عنه.
output: Blessed is the man who recognizeth Him and attaineth His presence, and woe betide such as deny Him and turn aside from Him.

input: فأسأل الله ان یؤیّد عباده علی الرّجوع.
output: I beseech God to aid His servants to return unto Him.

input: یا ایّها المقبل الی الأفق الأعلی و الشّارب رحیقی المختوم من ایادی العطآء.
output: O thou who hast set thy face towards the Realm on High and hast quaffed My sealed wine from the hand of bounteousness.

input: فاعلم للعصمة معان شتّی و مقامات شتّی.
output: Know thou that the term Infallibility hath numerous meanings and diverse stations.

input: انّ الّذی عصمه الله من الزّلل یصدق علیه هذا الاسم فی مقام
output: In one sense it is applicable to the One Whom God hath made immune from error.

input: و کذلک من عصمه الله من الخطأ و العصیان و من الاعراض و الکفر و من الشّرک و امثالها یطلق علی کلّ واحد من هؤلآء اسم العصمة.
output: Similarly it is applied to every soul whom God hath guarded against sin, transgression, rebellion, impiety, disbelief and the like.

input: انّه نور لا تعقّبه الظّلمة و صواب لا یعتریه الخطآء.
output: Indeed He is a Light which is not followed by darkness and a Truth not overtaken by error.

input: لو یحکم علی المآء حکم الخمر و علی السّمآء حکم الأرض و علی النّور حکم النّار حقّ لا ریب فیه
output: Were He to pronounce water to be wine or heaven to be earth or light to be fire, He speaketh the truth and no doubt would there be about it.

input: و لیس لأحد ان یعترض علیه او یقول لم و بم.
output: and unto no one is given the right to question His authority or to say why or wherefore.

input: و الّذی اعترض انّه من المعرضین فی کتاب الله ربّ العالمین.
output: Whosoever raiseth objections will be numbered with the froward in the Book of God, the Lord of the worlds.

input: انّه لا یسأل عمّا یفعل و کلّ عن کلّ یسألون.
output: Verily He shall not be asked of His doings but all others shall be asked of their doings.

input: لو یتجاوز عنها علی قدر شعرة واحدة لیحبط عمله.
output: and should anyone deviate therefrom, even to the extent of a hair's breadth, his work would be brought to naught.

input: انظر ثمّ اذکر اذ اتی محمّد رسول الله.
output: Consider thou and call to mind the time when Muhammad appeared.

input: قال و قوله الحقّ
output: He said, and His word is the truth:

input: و لله علی النّاس حجّ البیت.
output: Pilgrimage to the House is a service due to God.

input: و کذلک الصّلوة و الصّوم و الأحکام الّتی اشرقت من افق کتاب الله مولی العالم و مربّی الأمم.
output: And likewise are the daily prayer, fasting, and the laws which shone forth above the horizon of the Book of God, the Lord of the World and the true Educator of the peoples and kindreds of the earth.

input: للکلّ ان یتّبعوه فیما حکم به الله
output: It is incumbent upon everyone to obey Him in whatsoever God hath ordained.

input: و الّذی انکره کفر بالله و آیاته و رسله و کتبه.
output: and whosoever denieth Him hath disbelieved in God, in His verses, in His Messengers and in His Books.

input: انّه لو یحکم علی الصّواب حکم الخطأ و علی الکفر حکم الایمان حقّ من عنده.
output: Were He to pronounce right to be wrong or denial to be belief, He speaketh the truth as bidden by God.

input: هذا مقام لا یذکر و لا یوجد فیه الخطأ و العصیان.
output: This is a station wherein sins or trespasses neither exist nor are mentioned.

input: انظر فی الآیة المبارکة المنزلة الّتی وجب بها حجّ البیت علی الکلّ.
output: Consider thou the blessed, the divinely revealed verse in which pilgrimage to the House is enjoined upon everyone.

input: انّ الّذین قاموا بعده علی الأمر وجب علیهم ان یعملوا ما امروا به فی الکتاب.
output: It devolved upon those invested with authority after Him to observe whatever had been prescribed unto them in the Book.

input: لیس لأحد ان یتجاوز عن حدود الله و سننه.
output: Unto no one is given the right to deviate from the laws and ordinances of God.

input: و الّذی تجاوز انّه من الخاطئین فی کتاب الله ربّ العرش العظیم.
output: Whoso deviateth therefrom is reckoned with the trespassers in the Book of God, the Lord of the Mighty Throne.

input: یا ایّها النّاظر الی افق الأمر.
output: O thou who hast fixed thy gaze upon the Dawning-Place of the Cause of God.

input: اعلم ارادة الله لم تکن محدودة بحدود العباد انّه لا یمشی علی طرقهم.
output: Know thou for a certainty that the Will of God is not limited by the standards of the people, and God doth not tread in their ways.

input: للکلّ ان یتمسّکوا بصراطه المستقیم.
output: Rather is it incumbent upon everyone to firmly adhere to God's straight Path.

input: انّه محمود فی فعله و مطاع فی امره
output: Verily He is to be praised in His acts and to be obeyed in His behests.

input: یفعل ما یشآء و یحکم ما یرید.
output: He doeth whatsoever He willeth and ordaineth whatsoever He pleaseth.

input: ثمّ اعلم ما سواه مخلوق بکلمة من عنده لیس لهم حرکة و لا سکون الّا بأمره و اذنه.
output: Know thou moreover that all else besides Him have been created through the potency of a word from His presence, while of themselves they have no motion nor stillness, except at His bidding and by His leave.

input: یا ایّها الطّائر فی هوآء المحبّة و الوداد و النّاظر الی انوار وجه ربّک مالک الایجاد.
output: O thou who soarest in the atmosphere of love and fellowship and hast fixed thy gaze upon the light of the countenance of thy Lord, the King of creation.

input: لیعلم الکلّ انّه ما اتّخذ لنفسه فی العصمة الکبری شریکاً و لا وزیراً.
output: so that everyone may become aware that within His realm of supreme infallibility He hath not taken a partner nor a counselor unto Himself.

input: و ما سواه مأمور محکوم و هو الحاکم الآمر العلیم الخبیر.
output: while all else besides Him are but His subjects and under His rule, and He is the supreme Ruler, the Ordainer, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.

input: انّک اذا اجتذبتک نفحات آیات الظّهور و اخذک الکوثر الطّهور من ایادی عطآء ربّک مالک یوم النّشور قل
output: As to thyself, whenever thou art enraptured by the vitalizing breaths of the revealed verses and art carried away by the pure, life-giving water proffered by the hand of the bounty of thy Lord, the sovereign Ruler of the Day of Resurrection, lift up thy voice and say:

input: الهی.
output: O my God.

input: اذ اعرض عنک اکثر عبادک من العلمآء و الفقهآء ثمّ الّذین اتّبعوهم من دون بیّنة من عندک و برهان من لدنک.
output: while most of the doctors and divines among Thy servants together with such as follow them have, without the least proof or evidence from Thee, turned away from Thee.

input: و مطلع آیاتک و مصدر اوامرک و احکامک و منبع حکمتک و الطافک.
output: the Manifestation of Thy signs, the Fountainhead of Thy laws and commandments and the Source of Thy wisdom and bestowals.

input: طوبی لأرض فازت بقدومک و استقرّ علیها عرش عظمتک و تضوّع فیها عرف قمیصک.
output: Blessed is the land that hath been ennobled by Thy footsteps, wherein the throne of Thy sovereignty is established and the fragrance of Thy raiment is diffused.

input: وعزّتک و سلطانک و قدرتک و اقتدارک لا احبّ البصر الّا لمشاهدة جمالک و لا ارید السّمع الّا لاصغآء ندائک و آیاتک.
output: By Thy glory and majesty, by Thy might and power, I desire not my sight save to behold Thy beauty, nor my hearing save to hearken to Thy call and Thy verses.

input: لا تحرم العیون عمّا خلقتها له و لا الوجوه عن التّوجّه الی افقک و القیام لدی باب عظمتک و الحضور امام عرشک و الخضوع لدی اشراقات انوار شمس فضلک.
output: Debar not the eyes from that for which Thou hast created them, nor the faces from turning to Thy horizon, or from paying homage at the portals of Thy majesty, or from appearing in the presence of Thy throne, or from bowing down before the splendors of the Daystar of Thy bounty.

input: ایربّ انا الّذی شهد قلبی و کبدی و جوارحی و لسان ظاهری و باطنی بوحدانیّتک و فردانیّتک و بأنّک انت الله لا اله الّا انت.
output: I am the one, O Lord, whose heart and soul, whose limbs, whose inner and outer tongue testify to Thy unity and Thy oneness, and bear witness that Thou art God and that there is no God but Thee.

input: قد خلقت الخلق لعرفانک و خدمة امرک لترتفع به مقاماتهم فی ارضک و ترتقی انفسهم بما انزلته فی زبرک و کتبک و الواحک.
output: Thou didst bring mankind into being to know Thee and to serve Thy Cause, that their station might thereby be elevated upon Thine earth and their souls be uplifted by virtue of the things Thou hast revealed in Thy Scriptures, Thy Books and Thy Tablets.

input: فلمّا اظهرت نفسک و انزلت آیاتک اعرضوا عنک و کفروا بک و بما اظهرته بقدرتک و قوّتک.
output: Yet no sooner didst Thou manifest Thyself and reveal Thy signs than they turned away from Thee and repudiated Thee and rejected that which Thou didst unveil before their eyes through the potency of Thy might and Thy power.

input: و قاموا علی ضرّک و اطفآء نورک و اخماد نار سدرتک.
output: They rose up to inflict harm upon Thee, to extinguish Thy light and to put out the flame that blazeth in Thy Burning Bush.

input: و بلغوا فی الظّلم مقاماً ارادوا سفک دمک و هتک حرمتک.
output: Their iniquity waxed so grievous that they conspired to shed Thy blood and to violate Thy honor.

input: و کذلک من ربّیته بأیادی عنایتک و حفظته من شرّ طغاة خلقک و بغاة عبادک و کان ان یحرّر آیاتک امام عرشک.
output: And likewise acted he whom Thou hadst nurtured with the hand of Thy loving-kindness, hadst protected from the mischief of the rebellious among Thy creatures and the froward amidst Thy servants, and whom Thou hadst set the task of writing Thy holy verses before Thy throne.

input: فآه.
output: Alas.

input: آه.
output: Alas.

input: عمّا ارتکب فی ایّامک بحیث نقض عهدک و میثاقک و انکر آیاتک و قام علی الاعراض و ارتکب ما ناح به سکّان ملکوتک.
output: for the things he perpetrated in Thy days to such an extent that he violated Thy Covenant and Thy Testament, rejected Thy holy Writ, rose up in rebellion and committed that which caused the denizens of Thy Kingdom to lament.

input: فلمّا خاب فی نفسه و وجد رائحة الخسران صاح و قال ما تحیّر به المقرّبون من اصفیائک و اهل خبآء مجدک.
output: Then no sooner had he found his hopes shattered and had perceived the odor of utter failure than he raised his voice and gave tongue to that which caused Thy chosen ones, who are nigh unto Thee, and the inmates of the pavilion of glory, to be lost in bewilderment.

input: ترانی یا الهی کالحوت المتبلبل علی التّراب.
output: Thou seest me, O my God, writhing in anguish upon the dust, like unto a fish.

input: اغثنی ثمّ ارحمنی یا مستغاث و یا من فی قبضتک زمام النّاس من الذّکور و الاناث.
output: Deliver me, have mercy upon me, O Thou Whose aid is invoked by all men, O Thou within Whose grasp lie the reins of power over all men and women.

input: کأنّ الأشیآء کلّها تبشّرنی بأمطار سحاب سمآء رحمتک.
output: as if every created thing imparteth unto me the joyous tidings that the clouds of the heaven of Thy mercy will pour down their rain upon me.

input: وعزّتک یا سند المخلصین و مقصود المقرّبین
output: By Thy might, O Thou Who art the Mainstay of the sincere ones and the Desire of them that enjoy near access unto Thee.

input: و ما للمعدوم ان یصف من ثبت بالبرهان انّه لا یوصف بالأوصاف و لا یذکر بالأذکار.
output: and how can an evanescent creature extol Him Who hath demonstrated that no description can ever express Him and no word of praise magnify His glory.

input: لم یزل کان مقدّساً عن ادراک خلقه و منزّهاً عن عرفان عباده.
output: He hath from everlasting been immeasurably exalted above the understanding of His creatures and sanctified from the conceptions of His servants.

input: ایربّ.
output: O Lord.

input: تری المیّت امام وجهک.
output: Thou beholdest this lifeless one before Thy face.

input: و العلیل تلقآء عرشک لا تمنعه عن بحر شفائک.
output: And Thou seest this afflicted one standing before Thy throne. turn him not away from the ocean of Thy healing.

input: بعد علمی بأنّ ما یظهر من العبد محدود بحدود نفسه و لا یلیق لحضرتک و لا ینبغی لبساط عزّک و عظمتک.
output: though I am well aware that whatever proceedeth from a servant cannot transcend the limitations of his soul, nor beseem Thy Lordship, nor be worthy of the court of Thy glory and Thy Majesty.

input: لو لا ثنائک لا ینفعنی لسانی و لو لا خدمتک لا ینفعنی وجودی.
output: Were it not to celebrate Thy praise, my tongue would be of no use to me, and were it not for the sake of rendering service to Thee, my existence would avail me not.

input: و لا احبّ البصر الّا لمشاهدة انوار افقک الأعلی.
output: But for the pleasure of beholding the splendors of Thy realm of glory, why should I cherish sight.

input: و لا ارید السّمع الّا لاصغآء ندائک الأحلی.
output: And but for the joy of giving ear to Thy most sweet voice, of what use is hearing.

input: لم ادر یا الهی و سندی و رجائی
output: I know not, O my God, my Mainstay, my heart's Desire,

input: هل قدّرت لی ما تقرّ به عینی و ینشرح به صدری و یفرح به قلبی
output: whether Thou hast ordained for me that which shall bring solace to mine eyes, gladden my bosom and rejoice my heart,

input: او قضائک المبرم منعنی عن الحضور امام عرشک یا مالک القدم و سلطان الأمم.
output: or whether Thine irrevocable decree, O King of eternity and the sovereign Lord of all nations, will debar me from presenting myself before Thy throne.

input: وعزّتک و سلطانک و عظمتک و اقتدارک قد اماتتنی ظلمة البعد.
output: I swear by Thy glory and majesty and by Thy dominion and power, the darkness of my remoteness from Thee hath destroyed me.

input: این نور قربک یا مقصود العارفین.
output: What hath become of the light of Thy nearness, O Desire of every understanding heart.

input: و اهلکتنی سطوة الهجر
output: The tormenting agony of separation from Thee hath consumed me.

input: این ضیآء وصالک یا محبوب المخلصین.
output: Where is the effulgent light of Thy reunion, O Well-Beloved of such as are wholly devoted to Thee?

input: تری یا الهی
output: Thou seest, O my God,

input: ما ورد علیّ فی سبیلک من الّذین انکروا حقّک و نقضوا میثاقک و جادلوا بآیاتک و کفروا بنعمتک بعد ظهورها و کلمتک بعد انزالها و بحجّتک بعد اکمالها.
output: what hath befallen me in Thy Path at the hand of those who have denied Thy Truth, have violated Thy Covenant, caviled at Thy signs, rejected the blessings Thou didst vouchsafe, disbelieved the verses Thou didst send down and have refused to acknowledge the testimony Thou didst fulfill.

input: یشهد لسان لسانی و قلب قلبی و روح روحی و ظاهری و باطنی بوحدانیّتک و فردانیّتک و بقدرتک و اقتدارک و عظمتک و سلطانک و بعزّتک و رفعتک و اختیارک.
output: The tongue of my tongue and the heart of my heart and the spirit of my spirit and my outward and inmost beings bear witness to Thy unity and Thy oneness, Thy power and Thine omnipotence, Thy grandeur and Thy sovereignty, and attest Thy glory, loftiness and authority.

input: و بأنّک انت الله لا اله الّا انت.
output: I testify that Thou art God and that there is none other God besides Thee.

input: لم تزل کنت کنزاً مخفیّاً عن الأبصار و الادراک و لا تزال تکون بمثل ما کنت فی ازل الآزال.
output: From everlasting Thou hast been a treasure hidden from the sight and minds of men and shalt continue to remain the same for ever and ever.

input: لا تضعفک قوّة العالم و لا یخوّفک اقتدار الأمم.
output: The powers of earth can never frustrate Thee, nor can the might of the nations alarm Thee.

input: انت الّذی فتحت باب العلم علی وجه عبادک لعرفان مشرق وحیک و مطلع آیاتک و سمآء ظهورک و شمس جمالک.
output: Thou art the One Who hath unlocked the door of knowledge before the faces of Thy servants that they may recognize Him Who is the Daystar of Thy Revelation, the Dawning-Place of Thy signs, the Heaven of Thy manifestation and the Sun of Thy divine beauty.

input: و وعدت من علی الأرض فی کتبک و زبرک و صحفک بظهور نفسک و کشف سبحات الجلال عن وجهک کما اخبرت به حبیبک الّذی به اشرق نیّر الأمر من افق الحجاز و سطع نور الحقیقة بین العباد بقولک یوم یقوم النّاس لربّ العالمین.
output: In Thy holy Books, in Thy Scriptures and Thy Scrolls Thou hast promised all the peoples of the world that Thou Thyself shalt appear and shalt remove the veils of glory from Thy face, even as Thou didst announce in Thy words unto Thy Friend through Whom the Daystar of Revelation shone brightly above the horizon of Hijáz, and the dawning light of divine Truth shed its radiance among all men, proclaiming: The Day when mankind shall stand before the Lord of the worlds.

input: و من قبله بشّرت الکلیم ان اخرج القوم من الظّلمات الی النّور و ذکّرهم بأیّام الله.
output: And before Muhammad Thou didst impart this glad-tiding unto Him Who conversed with Thee, saying: Bring forth thy people from the darkness into the light and remind them of the days of God.

input: و اخبرت به الرّوح و انبیائک و رسلک من قبل و من بعد.
output: Moreover Thou didst proclaim this truth unto the Spirit and unto Thy Prophets and Thy Messengers, whether of the remote or more recent past.

input: لو یظهر من خزائن قلمک الأعلی ما انزلته فی ذکر هذا الذّکر الأعظم و نبأک العظیم لینصعق اهل مدائن العلم و العرفان الّا من انقذته باقتدارک و حفظته بجودک و فضلک.
output: If all that which Thou hast sent down in glorification of this Most Great Remembrance, this Great Announcement, were to stream forth from the wellspring of Thy most august Pen, the inmates of the cities of knowledge and understanding would be dumbfounded, except such as Thou wouldst deliver through the potency of Thy might and wouldst protect as a token of Thy bountiful favor and Thy grace.

input: اشهد انّک وفیت بعهدک و اظهرت الّذی بشّرت بظهوره انبیائک و اصفیائک و عبادک.
output: I bear witness that Thou hast in truth fulfilled Thy pledge and hast made manifest the One Whose advent was foretold by Thy Prophets, Thy chosen ones and by them that serve Thee.

input: انّه اتی من افق العزّة و الاقتدار برایات آیاتک و اعلام بیّناتک.
output: He hath come from the heaven of glory and power, bearing the banners of Thy signs and the standards of Thy testimonies.

input: و قام امام الوجوه بقوّتک و قدرتک و دعا الکلّ الی الذّروة العلیا و الأفق الأعلی بحیث ما منعه ظلم العلمآء و سطوة الأمرآء.
output: Through the potency of Thine indomitable power and strength, He stood up before the faces of all men and summoned all mankind to the summit of transcendent glory and unto the all-highest Horizon, in such wise that neither the oppression of the ecclesiastics nor the onslaught of the rulers was able to deter Him.

input: قام بالاستقامة الکبری و نطق بأعلی النّدآء قد اتی الوهّاب راکباً علی السّحاب.
output: He arose with inflexible resolve and, unloosing His tongue, proclaimed in ringing tones: He Who is the All-Bountiful is come, riding aloft on the clouds.

input: اقبلوا یا اهل الأرض بوجوه بیضآء و قلوب نورآء.
output: Advance, O people of the earth, with shining faces and radiant hearts.

input: طوبی لمن فاز بلقائک و شرب رحیق الوصال من ایادی عطائک و وجد عرف آیاتک و نطق بثنائک و طار فی هوائک و اخذه جذب بیانک و ادخله فی الفردوس الأعلی مقام المکاشفة و المشاهدة امام عرش عظمتک.
output: Great indeed is the blessedness of him who attaineth Thy presence, drinketh the wine of reunion proffered by the hand of Thy bounteousness, inhaleth the fragrance of Thy signs, unlooseth his tongue in celebrating Thy praise, soareth high in Thy heavens, is carried away by the sweetness of Thy Voice, gaineth admittance into the most exalted Paradise and attaineth the station of revelation and vision before the throne of Thy majesty.

input: ایربّ اسألک بالعصمة الکبری الّتی جعلتها افقاً لظهورک و بکلمتک العلیا الّتی بها خلقت الخلق و اظهرت الأمر و بهذا الاسم الّذی به ناحت الأسمآء و ارتعدت فرائص العرفآء ان تجعلنی منقطعاً عن دونک بحیث لا اتحرّک الّا بارادتک و لا اتکلّم الّا بمشیّتک و لا اسمع الّا ذکرک و ثنائک.
output: I beg of Thee by the Most Great Infallibility which Thou hast chosen to be the dayspring of Thy Revelation, and by Thy most sublime Word through whose potency Thou didst call the creation into being and didst reveal Thy Cause, and by this Name which hath caused all other names to groan aloud and the limbs of the sages to quake, I beg of Thee to make me detached from all else save Thee, in such wise that I may move not but in conformity with the good-pleasure of Thy Will, and speak not except at the bidding of Thy Purpose, and hear naught save the words of Thy praise and Thy glorification.

input: لک الحمد یا الهی و لک الشّکر یا رجائی بما اوضحت لی صراطک المستقیم و اظهرت لی نبأک العظیم و ایّدتنی علی الاقبال الی مشرق وحیک و مصدر امرک بعد اعراض عبادک و خلقک.
output: I magnify Thy Name, O my God, and offer thanksgiving unto Thee, O my Desire, inasmuch as Thou hast enabled me to clearly perceive Thy straight Path, hast unveiled Thy Great Announcement before mine eyes and hast aided me to set my face towards the Dayspring of Thy Revelation and the Fountainhead of Thy Cause, whilst Thy servants and Thy people turned away from Thee.

input: اسألک یا مالک ملکوت البقآء بصریر قلمک الأعلی و بالنّار المشتعلة النّاطقة فی الشّجرة الخضرآء و بالسّفینة الّتی جعلتها مخصوصة لأهل البهآء ان تجعلنی مستقیماً علی حبّک و راضیاً بما قدّرت لی فی کتابک و قائماً علی خدمتک و خدمة اولیائک.
output: I entreat Thee, O Lord of the Kingdom of eternity, by the shrill voice of the Pen of Glory, and by the Burning Fire which calleth aloud from the verdant Tree, and by the Ark which Thou hast specially chosen for the people of Bahá, to grant that I may remain steadfast in my love for Thee, be well pleased with whatsoever Thou hast prescribed for me in Thy Book and may stand firm in Thy service and in the service of Thy loved ones.

input: ثمّ ایّد عبادک یا الهی علی ما یرتفع به امرک و علی عمل ما انزلته فی کتابک.
output: Graciously assist then Thy servants, O my God, to do that which will serve to exalt Thy Cause and will enable them to observe whatsoever Thou hast revealed in Thy Book.

input: انّک انت المقتدر المهیمن علی ما تشآء و فی قبضتک زمام الأشیآء.
output: Verily Thou art the Lord of Strength, Thou art potent to ordain whatsoever Thou willest and within Thy grasp Thou holdest the reins of all created things.

input: لا اله الّا انت المقتدر العلیم الحکیم.
output: No God is there but Thee, the All-Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

input: یا ایّها الجلیل.
output: O Jalíl.

input: قد اریناک البحر و امواجه و الشّمس و اشراقها و السّمآء و انجمها و الأصداف و لآلئها.
output: We have unveiled to thine eyes the sea and the waves thereof, the sun and the radiance thereof, the heavens and the stars thereof, the shells and the pearls thereof.

input: اشکر الله بهذا الفضل الأعظم و الکرم الّذی احاط علی العالم.
output: Render thou thanks unto God for so great a bounty, so gracious a favor that hath pervaded the whole world.

input: یا ایّها المتوجّه الی انوار الوجه. قد احاطت الأوهام سکّان الأرض و منعتهم عن التّوجّه الی افق الیقین و اشراقه و ظهوراته و انواره. بالظّنون منعوا عن القیّوم. یتکلّمون بأهوائهم و لا یشعرون.
output: O thou who hast set thy face towards the splendors of My Countenance. Vague fancies have encompassed the dwellers of the earth and debarred them from turning towards the Horizon of Certitude, and its brightness, and its manifestations and its lights. Vain imaginings have withheld them from Him Who is the Self-Subsisting. They speak as prompted by their own caprices, and understand not.

input: منهم من قال هل الآیات نزّلت؟ قل ای وربّ السّموات! و هل اتت السّاعة؟
output: Among them are those who have said: Have the verses been sent down? Say Yea, by Him Who is the Lord of the heavens! Hath the Hour come?

input: بل قضت ومظهر البیّنات قد جآءت الحاقّة و اتی الحقّ بالحجّة و البرهان. قد برزت السّاهرة و البریّة فی وجل و اضطراب. قد اتت الزّلازل و ناحت القبائل من خشیة الله المقتدر الجبّار. قل الصّاخّة صاحت و الیوم لله الواحد المختار.
output: Nay, more. it hath passed, by Him Who is the Revealer of clear tokens. Verily, the Inevitable is come, and He, the True One, hath appeared with proof and testimony. The Plain is disclosed, and mankind is sore vexed and fearful. Earthquakes have broken loose, and the tribes have lamented, for fear of God, the Lord of Strength, the All-Compelling. Say: The stunning trumpet-blast hath been loudly raised, and the Day is God's, the One, the Unconstrained.

input: و قال هل الطّامّة تمّت؟ قل ای وربّ الأرباب!
output: And they say: Hath the Catastrophe come to pass? Say: Yea, by the Lord of Lords!

input: و هل القیامة قامت؟ بل القیّوم بملکوت الآیات
output: Is the Resurrection come? Nay, more; He Who is the Self-Subsisting hath appeared with the Kingdom of His signs.

input: و هل تری النّاس صرعی.
output: Seest thou men laid low?

input: بلی وربّی الأعلی الأبهی.
output: Yea, by my Lord, the Most High, the Most Glorious!

input: و هل انقعرت الأعجاز؟ بل نسفت الجبال ومالک الصّفات! قال این الجنّة و النّار؟ قل الأولی لقائی و الأخری نفسک یا ایّها المشرک المرتاب. قال انّا ما نری المیزان. قل ای وربّی الرّحمن! لا یراه الّا اولو الأبصار.
output: Have the tree-stumps been uprooted? Yea, more; the mountains have been scattered in dust; by Him the Lord of attributes! They say: Where is Paradise, and where is Hell? Say: The one is reunion with Me; the other thine own self, O thou who dost associate a partner with God and doubtest. They say: We see not the Balance. Say: Surely, by my Lord, the God of Mercy! None can see it except such as are endued with insight.

input: قال هل سقطت النّجوم؟ قل ای اذ کان القیّوم فی ارض السّرّ. فاعتبروا یا اولی الأنظار! قد ظهرت العلامات کلّها اذ اخرجنا ید القدرة من جیب العظمة و الاقتدار. قد نادی المناد اذ اتی المیعاد و انصعق الطّوریّون فی تیه الوقوف من سطوة ربّک مالک الایجاد.
output: They say: Have the stars fallen? Say: Yea, when He Who is the Self-Subsisting dwelt in the Land of Mystery.18 Take heed, ye who are endued with discernment! All the signs appeared when We drew forth the Hand of Power from the bosom of majesty and might. Verily, the Crier hath cried out, when the promised time came, and they that have recognized the splendors of Sinai have swooned away in the wilderness of hesitation, before the awful majesty of thy Lord, the Lord of creation.

input: یقول النّاقور هل نفخ فی الصّور؟ قل بلی وسلطان الظّهور! اذ استقرّ علی عرش اسمه الرّحمن. قد اضآء الدّیجور من فجر رحمة ربّک مطلع الأنوار. قد مرّت نسمة الرّحمن و اهتزّت الأرواح فی قبور الأبدان. کذلک قضی الأمر من لدی الله العزیز المنّان.
output: The trumpet asketh: Hath the Bugle been sounded? Say: Yea, by the King of Revelation! when He mounted the throne of His Name, the All-Merciful. Darkness hath been chased away by the dawning light of the mercy of thy Lord, the Source of all light. The breeze of the All-Merciful hath wafted, and the souls have been quickened in the tombs of their bodies. Thus hath the decree been fulfilled by God, the Mighty, the Beneficent.

input: قال الّذین کفروا متی انفطرت السّمآء؟ قل اذ کنتم فی اجداث الغفلة و الضّلال.
output: They who reject the truth have said: When were the heavens cleft asunder? Say: While ye lay in the graves of waywardness and error.

input: من المشرکین من یمسح عینیه و ینظر الیمین و الشّمال. قل قد عمیت. لیس لک الیوم من ملاذ. منهم من قال هل حشرت النّفوس؟ قل ای وربّی! اذ کنت فی مهاد الأوهام.
output: Among the faithless is he who rubbeth his eyes, and looketh to the right and to the left.Say: Blinded art thou. No refuge hast thou to flee to. And among them is he who saith: Have men been gathered together? Say: Yea, by My Lord! whilst thou didst lie in the cradle of idle fancies.

input: منهم من قال هل نزّل الکتاب بالفطرة. قل انّها فی الحیرة. اتّقوا یا اولی الألباب!
output: And among them is he who saith: Hath the Book been sent down through the power of the true Faith? Say: The true Faith itself is astounded. Fear ye, O ye men of understanding heart!

input: و منهم من قال أ حُشِرْتُ اعمی؟ قل بلی وراکب السّحاب. قد تزیّنت الجنّة بأوراد المعانی و سعّر السّعیر من نار الفجّار. قل قد اشرق النّور من افق الظّهور و اضآءت الآفاق اذ اتی مالک یوم المیثاق! قد خسر الّذین ارتابوا و ربح من اقبل بنور الیقین الی مطلع الایقان. طوبی لک یا ایّها النّاظر بما نزّل لک هذا اللّوح الّذی منه تطیر الأرواح. احفظه ثمّ اقرأه. لعمری! انّه باب رحمة ربّک. طوبی لمن یقرأه فی العشیّ و الاشراق.
output: And among them is he who saith: Have I been assembled with others, blind? Say: Yea, by Him that rideth upon the clouds! Paradise is decked with mystic roses, and hell hath been made to blaze with the fire of the impious. Say: The light hath shone forth from the horizon of Revelation, and the whole earth hath been illumined at the coming of Him Who is the Lord of the Day of the Covenant! The doubters have perished, whilst he that turned, guided by the light of assurance, unto the Dayspring of Certitude hath prospered. Blessed art thou, who hast fixed thy gaze upon Me, for this Tablet which hath been sent down for thee—a Tablet which causeth the souls of men to soar. Commit it to memory, and recite it. By My life! It is a door to the mercy of thy Lord. Well is it with him that reciteth it at eventide and at dawn.

input: انّا سمعنا ذکرک فی هذا الأمر الّذی منه اندکّ جبل العلم و زلّت الأقدام.
output: We, verily, heard thy praise of this Cause, through which the mountain of knowledge was crushed, and men's feet have slipped.

input: البهآء علی اهل البهآء الّذین اقبلوا الی العزیز الوهّاب.
output: My glory be upon thee and upon whomsoever hath turned unto the Almighty, the All-Bounteous.

input: قد انتهی اللّوح و ما انتهی البیان. اصبر انّ ربّک هو الصّبّار.
output: The Tablet is ended, but the theme is unexhausted. Be patient, for thy Lord is patient.

input: هذه آیات انزلناها من قبل ای فی اوّل ورودنا فی السّجن الأعظم و ارسلناها الیک لتعرف ما نطقت به الألسنة الکذبة اذ اتی الله بقدرة و سلطان. قد تزعزع بنیان الظّنون و انفطرت سمآء الأوهام و القوم فی مریة و شقاق. قد انکروا حجّة الله و برهانه بعد اذ اتی من افق الاقتدار بملکوت الآیات. ترکوا ما امروا به و ارتکبوا ما منعوا عنه فی الکتاب. وضعوا الههم اخذوا اهوائهم. الا انّهم فی غفلة و ضلال. یقرؤون الآیات و ینکرونها. یرون البیّنات و یعرضون عنها. الا انّهم فی ریب عجاب.
output: These are verses We sent down previously, and We have sent them unto thee, that thou mayest be acquainted with what their lying tongues have spoken, when God came unto them with might and sovereignty. The foundations of idle fancies have trembled, and the heaven of vain imaginings hath been cleft asunder, and yet the people are in doubt and in contention with Him. They have denied the testimony of God and His proof, after He came from the heaven of power with the kingdom of His signs. They have cast away what had been prescribed, and perpetrated what had been forbidden them in the Book. They have abandoned their God, and clung unto their desires. They truly have strayed and are in error. They read the verses and deny them. They behold the clear tokens and turn aside. They truly are lost in strange doubt.

input: انّا وصّینا اولیائنا بتقوی الله، الّذی کان مطلع الأعمال و الأخلاق. انّه قائد جنود العدل فی مدینة البهآء. طوبی لمن دخل فی ظلّ رایته النّورآء و تمسّک به.
output: We have admonished Our loved ones to fear God, a fear which is the fountainhead of all goodly deeds and virtues. It is the commander of the hosts of justice in the city of Bahá. Happy the man that hath entered the shadow of its luminous standard, and laid fast hold thereon

input: انّه من اصحاب السّفینة الحمرآء الّتی نزّل ذکرها فی قیّوم‌الأسمآء
output: He, verily, is of the Companions of the Crimson Ark, which hath been mentioned in the Qayyúm-i-Asmá.

input: قل یا حزب الله! زیّنوا هیاکلکم بطراز الأمانة و الدّیانة. ثمّ انصروا ربّکم بجنود الأعمال و الأخلاق. انّا منعناکم عن الفساد و الجدال فی کتبی و صحفی و زبری و الواحی و ما اردنا بذلک الّا علوّکم و سموّکم. تشهد بذلک السّمآء و انجمها و الشّمس و اشراقها و الأشجار و اوراقها و البحار و امواجها و الأرض و کنوزها. نسأل الله ان یمدّ اولیائه و یؤیّدهم علی ما ینبغی لهم فی هذا المقام المبارک العزیز البدیع.
output: Say: O people of God! Adorn your temples with the adornment of trustworthiness and piety. Help, then, your Lord with the hosts of goodly deeds and a praiseworthy character. We have forbidden you dissension and conflict in My Books, and My Scriptures, and My Scrolls, and My Tablets, and have wished thereby naught else save your exaltation and advancement. Unto this testify the heavens and the stars thereof, and the sun and the radiance thereof, and the trees and the leaves thereof, and the seas and the waves thereof, and the earth and the treasures thereof. We pray God to assist His loved ones, and aid them in that which beseemeth them in this blest, this mighty, and wondrous station.

input: و نسأله ان یوفّق من حولی علی عمل ما امروا به من قلمی الأعلی.
output: Moreover We beseech Him to graciously enable those who surround Me to observe that which My Pen of Glory hath enjoined upon them.

input: یا جلیل.
output: O Jalíl.

input: علیک بهائی و عنایتی انّا امرنا العباد بالمعروف و هم عملوا ما ناح به قلبی و قلمی.
output: Upon thee be My glory and My loving providence. Verily We have enjoined the people to do what is meet and seemly and yet they have committed such things as have caused My heart and My Pen to lament.

input: اسمع ما نزّل من سمآء مشیّتی و ملکوت ارادتی.
output: Incline thine ear to that which is sent down from the heaven of My Will and the realm of My good-pleasure.

input: لیس حزنی سجنی و ما ورد علیّ من اعدائی.
output: I sorrow not for My captivity, nor for the things that have befallen Me at the hand of Mine enemies.

input: بل من الّذین ینسبون انفسهم الی نفسی و یرتکبون ما تصعد به زفراتی و تنزل عبراتی.
output: Nay, My sorrows are occasioned by those who claim to be related to Me and yet commit that which causeth the voice of My lamentations to be lifted up and My tears to flow.

input: قد نصحناهم بعبارات شتّی فی الواح شتّی نسأل الله ان یوفّقهم و یقرّبهم و یؤیّدهم علی ما تطمئنّ به القلوب و تستریح به النّفوس و یمنعهم عمّا لا ینبغی لأیّامه.
output: We have exhorted them at length in various Tablets and beseech God to graciously assist them, to enable them to draw nigh unto Him and to confirm them in that which would bring peace to the hearts and tranquility to the souls and would stay their hands from whatsoever ill-beseemeth His days.

input: قل یا اولیائی فی بلادی.
output: Say, O My loved ones in My lands.

input: اسمعوا نصح من ینصحکم لوجه الله.
output: Give ye ear unto the counsels of Him Who admonisheth you for the sake of God.

input: انّه خلقکم و اظهر لکم ما یرفعکم و ینفعکم .و علّمکم صراطه المستقیم و نبأه العظیم.
output: He hath in truth created you, hath revealed before your eyes that which exalteth you and promoteth your interests. He hath made known unto you His straight Path and hath acquainted you with His Great Announcement.

input: توجّهنا الی الیمین رأینا ما لا یتحرّک القلم علی ذکره و ذکر ما شهدت عین مولی الوری فی ذاک المقام الألطف الأشرف المبارک الأعلی.
output: Turning Our face to the right, We beheld what the pen is powerless to describe. nor can it set forth that which the eye of the Lord of Mankind witnessed in that most sanctified, that most sublime, that blest, and most exalted Spot.

input: ثمّ، اقبلنا الی الیسار شاهدنا طلعة من طلعات الفردوس الأعلی قائمة علی عمود من النّور و نادت بأعلی النّدآء یا ملأ الأرض و السّمآء. انظروا جمالی و نوری و ظهوری و اشراقی. تالله الحقّ! انا الأمانة و ظهورها و حسنها. و اجر لمن تمسّک بها و عرف شأنها و مقامها و تشبّث بذیلها.
output: Turning, then, to the left We gazed on one of the Beauties of the Most Sublime Paradise, standing on a pillar of light, and calling aloud saying: O inmates of earth and heaven. Behold ye My beauty, and My radiance, and My revelation, and My effulgence. By God, the True One! I am Trustworthiness and the revelation thereof, and the beauty thereof. I will recompense whosoever will cleave unto Me, and recognize My rank and station, and hold fast unto My hem.

input: انا الزّینة الکبری لأهل البهآء و طراز العزّ لمن فی الملکوت الانشآء. و انا السّبب الأعظم لثروة العالم و افق الاطمینان لأهل الامکان. کذلک انزلنا لک ما یقرّب العباد الی مالک الایجاد.
output: I am the most great ornament of the people of Bahá, and the vesture of glory unto all who are in the kingdom of creation. I am the supreme instrument for the prosperity of the world, and the horizon of assurance unto all beings. Thus have We sent down for thee that which will draw men nigh unto the Lord of creation.

input: قلم اعلی از لغت فصحی بلغت نورا توجّه نمود لیعرف الجلیل عنایة ربّه الجمیل و یکون من الشّاکرین.
output: The Pen of the Most High turneth from the eloquent language to the luminous one that thou, O Jalíl, mayest appreciate the tender mercy of thy Lord, the Incomparable One and mayest be of them that are truly grateful.

input: یا ایّها النّاظر الی الأفق الأعلی.
output: O thou who hast fixed thy gaze upon the all-glorious Horizon.

input: ندا بلند است و قوّهٴ سامعه قلیل بل مفقود.
output: The Call is raised but hearing ears are numbered, nay nonexistent.

input: اینمظلوم در فم ثعبان اولیای الهی را ذکر مینماید.
output: This Wronged One findeth himself in the maw of the serpent, yet He faileth not to make mention of the loved ones of God.

input: این ایّام وارد شد آنچه که سبب جزع و فزع ملأ اعلی گشت.
output: So grievous have been Our sufferings in these days that the Concourse on High are moved to tears and to lamentation.

input: ظلم عالم و ضرّ امم مالک قدم را از ذکر منع ننمود و از اراده اش بازنداشت
output: Neither the adversities of the world nor the harm inflicted by its nations could deter Him Who is the King of Eternity from voicing His summons or frustrate His purpose.

input: نفوسیکه سالها خلف حجاب مستور چون افق امر را منیر و کلمة الله را نافذ مشاهده نمودند بیرون دویدند با سیوف بغضا و وارد آوردند آنچه را که قلم از ذکرش عاجز و لسان از بیانش قاصر.
output: When those who had for years been hiding behind the veils perceived that the horizon of the Cause was resplendent and that the Word of God was all-pervasive, they rushed forth and with swords of malice inflicted such harm as no pen can portray nor any tongue describe.

input: منصفین شاهد و گواه که از اوّل امر اینمظلوم امام وجوه ملوک و مملوک و علما و امرا من غیر ستر و حجاب قیام نمود و بأعلی النّدآء کلّ را بصراط مستقیم دعوت فرمود.
output: They that judge with fairness testify that since the early days of the Cause this Wronged One hath arisen, unveiled and resplendent, before the faces of kings and commoners, before the rulers and the divines, and hath, in ringing tones, summoned all men unto the straight Path.

input: ناصری جز قلمش نبود و معینی جز نفسش نه.
output: He hath had no helper save His Pen, nor any succorer other than Himself.

input: نفوسیکه از اصل امر بیخبر و غافلند بر اعراض قیام کردند.
output: Those who are ignorant or heedless of the motivating purpose of the Cause of God have rebelled against Him.

input: ایشانند ناعقین الّذین ذکرهم الله فی الزّبر و الألواح و اخبر عباده بانتشارهم و ضوضائهم و اغوائهم.
output: Such men are the foreboders of evil, whom God hath mentioned in His Book and Tablets and against whose influence, clamor and deception He hath warned His people.

input: طوبی از برای نفوسیکه من فی العالم را تلقاء ذکر مالک قدم معدوم و مفقود مشاهده نمایند و بعروهٴ محکم الهی تمسّک جویند تمسّکی که شبهات و اشارات و اسیاف و مدافع ایشانرا منع ننماید و محروم نسازد.
output: Well is it with those who, in the face of the remembrance of the Lord of Eternity, regard the peoples of the world as utter nothingness, as a thing forgotten, and hold fast to the firm handle of God in such wise that neither doubts nor insinuations, nor swords, nor cannon could hold them back or deprive them of His presence.

input: طوبی للرّاسخین و طوبی للثّابتین.
output: Blessed are the steadfast; blessed are they that stand firm in His Faith.

input: قلم اعلی نظر باستدعای آنجناب مراتب و مقامات عصمت کبری را ذکر نمود.
output: In response to thy request the Pen of Glory hath graciously described the stations and grades of the Most Great Infallibility.

input: و مقصود آنکه کلّ بیقین مبین بدانند که خاتم انبیا روح ما سواه فداه در مقام خود شبه و مثل و شریک نداشته.
output: The purpose is that all should know of a certainty that the Seal of the Prophets—may the souls of all else but Him be offered up for His sake—is without likeness, peer or partner in His Own station.

input: اولیا صلوات الله علیهم بکلمهٴ او خلق شده اند ایشان بعد از او اعلم و افضل عباد بوده‌اند و در منتهی رتبهٴ عبودیّت قائم.
output: The Holy Ones—may the blessings of God be upon them—were created through the potency of His Word, and after Him they were the most learned and the most distinguished among the people and abide in the utmost station of servitude.

input: تقدیس ذات الهی از شبه و مثل و تنزیه کینونتش از شریک و شبیه بآنحضرت ثابت و ظاهر.
output: The divine Essence, sanctified from every comparison and likeness, is established in the Prophet, and God's inmost Reality, exalted above any peer or partner, is manifest in Him.

input: اینست مقام توحید حقیقی و تفرید معنوی.
output: This is the station of true unity and of veritable singleness.

input: و حزب قبل از این مقام کما هو حقّه محروم و ممنوع.
output: The followers of the previous Dispensation grievously failed to acquire an adequate understanding of this station.

input: حضرت نقطه روح ما سواه فداه میفرماید اگر حضرت خاتم بکلمهٴ ولایت نطق نمیفرمود ولایت خلق نمیشد.
output: The Primal Point—may the life of all else but Him be offered up for His sake—saith: If the Seal of the Prophets had not uttered the word 'Successorship,' such a station would not have been created.

input: حزب قبل مشرک بوده اند و خود را موحّد میشمردند اجهل عباد بودند و خود را افضل میدانستند.
output: The people aforetime joined partners with God, though they professed belief in His unity. and although they were the most ignorant amongst men, they considered themselves the most accomplished.

input: از جزای آن نفوس غافله در یوم جزا عقاید و مراتب و مقامات ایشان نزد هر بصیر و هر خبیری واضح و معلوم گشت.
output: But, as a token of divine retribution upon those heedless ones, their erroneous beliefs and pursuits have, in this Day of Judgment, been made clear and evident to every man of discernment and understanding.

input: از حقّ بطلب عباد این ظهور را از ظنون و اوهام حزب قبل حفظ فرماید و از اشراقات انوار آفتاب توحید حقیقی محروم نسازد.
output: Beseech thou God, the True One, that He may graciously shield the followers of this Revelation from the idle fancies and corrupt imaginings of such as belong to the former Faith, and may not deprive them of the effulgent splendors of the daystar of true unity.

input: مظلوم عالم میفرماید نیّر عدل مستور آفتاب انصاف خلف سحاب.
output: He Whom the world hath wronged now proclaimeth: The light of Justice is dimmed, and the sun of Equity veiled from sight.

input: مقام حارس و حافظ سارق قائم مکان امین خائن جالس.
output: The robber occupieth the seat of the protector and guard, and the position of the faithful is seized by the traitor.

input: در سنهٴ قبل ظالمی بر دست حکومت این مدینه جالس در هر حین از او ضرّی وارد.
output: A year ago an oppressor ruled over this city, and at every instant caused fresh harm.

input: عمل نمود آنچه را که سبب فزع اکبر بود.
output: He wrought that which cast terror into the hearts of men.

input: ولکن قلم اعلی را ظلم عالم منع ننموده و نمینماید.
output: But to the Pen of Glory the tyranny of the world hath never been nor will it ever be a hindrance.

input: محض فضل و رحمت مخصوص امرا و وزرای ارض مرقوم داشتیم آنچه را که سبب حفظ و حراست و امن و امانست که شاید عباد از شرّ ظالمین محفوظ مانند.
output: In the abundance of Our grace and loving-kindness We have revealed specially for the rulers and ministers of the world that which is conducive to safety and protection, tranquility and peace. haply the children of men may rest secure from the evils of oppression.

input: انّه هو الحافظ النّاصر المعین.
output: He, verily, is the Protector, the Helper, the Giver of victory.

input: رجال بیت عدل الهی باید در لیالی و ایّام بآنچه از افق سماء قلم اعلی در تربیت عباد و تعمیر بلاد و حفظ نفوس و صیانت ناموس اشراق نموده ناظر باشند.
output: It is incumbent upon the men of God's House of Justice to fix their gaze by day and by night upon that which hath shone forth from the Pen of Glory for the training of peoples, the upbuilding of nations, the protection of man and the safeguarding of his honor.

input: اشراق اوّل
output: The first Ishráq

input: چون آفتاب حکمت از افق سماء سیاست طلوع نمود باین کلمهٴ علیا نطق فرمود اهل ثروت و اصحاب عزّت و قدرت باید حرمت دین را به احسن ما یمکن فی الابداع ملاحظه نمایند.
output: When the Daystar of Wisdom rose above the horizon of God's Holy Dispensation it voiced this all-glorious utterance: They that are possessed of wealth and invested with authority and power must show the profoundest regard for religion.

input: دین نوریست مبین و حصنی است متین از برای حفظ و آسایش اهل عالم چه که خشیة الله ناس را بمعروف امر و از منکر نهی نماید.
output: In truth, religion is a radiant light and an impregnable stronghold for the protection and welfare of the peoples of the world, for the fear of God impelleth man to hold fast to that which is good, and shun all evil.

input: اگر سراج دین مستور ماند هرج و مرج راه یابد نیّر عدل و انصاف و آفتاب امن و اطمینان از نور بازمانند.
output: Should the lamp of religion be obscured, chaos and confusion will ensue, and the lights of fairness and justice, of tranquility and peace cease to shine.

input: هر آگاهی بر آنچه ذکر شد گواهی داده و میدهد.
output: Unto this will bear witness every man of true understanding.

input: اشراق دوم
output: The second Ishráq

input: جمیع را بصلح اکبر که سبب اعظم است از برای حفظ بشر امر نمودیم.
output: We have enjoined upon all mankind to establish the Most Great Peace—the surest of all means for the protection of humanity.

input: سلاطین آفاق باید باتّفاق باین امر که سبب بزرگست از برای راحت و حفظ عالم تمسّک فرمایند.
output: The sovereigns of the world should, with one accord, hold fast thereunto, for this is the supreme instrument that can ensure the security and welfare of all peoples and nations.

input: ایشانند مشارق قدرت و مطالع اقتدار الهی.
output: They, verily, are the manifestations of the power of God and the daysprings of His authority.

input: از حقّ میطلبیم تأیید فرماید بر آنچه که سبب آسایش عباد است.
output: We beseech the Almighty that He may graciously assist them in that which is conducive to the well-being of their subjects.

input: شرحی در این باب از قبل از قلم اعلی جاری و نازل طوبی للعاملین.
output: A full explanation regarding this matter hath been previously set forth by the Pen of Glory. well is it with them that act accordingly.

input: اشراق سوّم
output: The third Ishráq

input: اجرای حدود است چه که سبب اوّل است از برای حیات عالم.
output: It is incumbent upon everyone to observe God's holy commandments, inasmuch as they are the wellspring of life unto the world.

input: آسمان حکمت الهی بدو نیّر روشن و منیر مشورت و شفقت و خیمهٴ نظم عالم بدو ستون قائم و برپا مجازات و مکافات.
output: The heaven of divine wisdom is illumined with the two luminaries of consultation and compassion and the canopy of world order is upraised upon the two pillars of reward and punishment.

input: اشراق چهارم
output: The fourth Ishráq

input: جنود منصوره در اینظهور اعمال و اخلاق پسندیده است.
output: In this Revelation the hosts that can render it victorious are the hosts of praiseworthy deeds and upright character.

input: و قائد و سردار این جنود تقوی الله بوده اوست دارای کلّ و حاکم بر کلّ.
output: The leader and commander of these hosts hath ever been the fear of God, a fear that encompasseth all things and reigneth over all things.

input: اشراق پنجم
output: The fifth Ishráq

input: معرفت دول بر احوال مأمورین و اعطاء مناصب باندازه و مقدار.
output: Governments should fully acquaint themselves with the conditions of those they govern, and confer upon them positions according to desert and merit.

input: التفات باینفقره بر هر رئیس و سلطانی لازم و واجب شاید خائن مقام امین را غصب ننماید و ناهب مقرّ حارس را.
output: It is enjoined upon every ruler and sovereign to consider this matter with the utmost care that the traitor may not usurp the position of the faithful, nor the despoiler rule in the place of the trustworthy.

input: در سجن اعظم بعضی از مأمورین که از قبل و بعد آمده اند لله الحمد بطراز عدل مزیّن و بعضی نعوذ بالله.
output: Among the officials who in the past have governed in this Most Great Prison some, praise be to God, were adorned with justice, but as to others, We take refuge with God.

input: از حقّ میطلبیم کلّ را هدایت فرماید شاید از اثمار سدرهٴ امانت و دیانت محروم نمانند و از انوار آفتاب عدل و انصاف ممنوع نشوند.
output: We beseech the One true God to guide them one and all, that haply they may not be deprived of the fruit of faith and trustworthiness, nor be withheld from the light of equity and justice.

input: اشراق ششم
output: The sixth Ishráq

input: اتّحاد و اتّفاق عباد است.
output: is union and concord amongst the children of men.

input: لازال باتّفاق آفاق عالم بنور امر منوّر و سبب اعظم دانستن خطّ و گفتار یکدیگر است.
output: From the beginning of time the light of unity hath shed its divine radiance upon the world, and the greatest means for the promotion of that unity is for the peoples of the world to understand one another's writing and speech.

input: از قبل در الواح امر نمودیم امنای بیت عدل یک لسان از السن موجوده و یا لسانی بدیع و یک خطّ از خطوط اختیار نمایند و در مدارس عالم اطفال را بآن تعلیم دهند.
output: In former Epistles We have enjoined upon the Trustees of the House of Justice either to choose one language from among those now existing or to adopt a new one, and in like manner to select a common script, both of which should be taught in all the schools of the world.

input: تا عالم یکوطن و یکقطعه مشاهده شود.
output: Thus will the earth be regarded as one country and one home.

input: ابهی ثمرهٴ شجرهٴ دانش اینکلمهٴ علیا است همه بار یکدارید و برگ یکشاخسار.
output: The most glorious fruit of the tree of knowledge is this exalted word: Of one tree are all ye the fruit, and of one bough the leaves.

input: لیس الفخر لمن یحبّ الوطن بل لمن یحبّ العالم.
output: Let not man glory in this that he loveth his country, let him rather glory in this that he loveth his kind.

input: از قبل در اینمقام نازلشد آنچه که سبب عمار عالم و اتّحاد امم است.
output: Concerning this We have previously revealed that which is the means of the reconstruction of the world and the unity of nations.

input: طوبی للفائزین و طوبی للعاملین.
output: Blessed are they that attain thereunto. Blessed are they that act accordingly.

input: اشراق هفتم
output: The seventh Ishráq

input: قلم اعلی کلّ را وصیّت میفرماید بتعلیم و تربیت اطفال.
output: The Pen of Glory counseleth everyone regarding the instruction and education of children.

input: و این آیات در این مقام در کتاب اقدس در اوّل ورود سجن از سماء مشیّت الهی نازل.
output: Behold that which the Will of God hath revealed upon Our arrival in the Prison City and recorded in the Most Holy Book.

input: کتب علی کلّ اب تربیة ابنه و بنته بالعلم و الخطّ و دونهما عمّا حدّد فی اللّوح.
output: Unto every father hath been enjoined the instruction of his son and daughter in the art of reading and writing and in all that hath been laid down in the Holy Tablet.

input: و الّذی ترک ما امر به فللأمنآء ان یأخذوا منه ما یکون لازماً لتربیتهما ان کان غنیّاً والّا یرجع الی بیت العدل.
output: He that putteth away that which is commanded unto him, the Trustees are then to take from him that which is required for their instruction, if he be wealthy, and if not the matter devolveth upon the House of Justice.

input: انّا جعلناه مأوی للفقرآء و المساکین.
output: Verily, have We made it a shelter for the poor and needy.

input: انّ الّذی ربّی ابنه او ابناً من الأبنآء کأنّه ربّی احد ابنائی علیه بهائی و عنایتی و رحمتی الّتی سبقت العالمین.
output: He that bringeth up his son or the son of another, it is as though he hath brought up a son of Mine. upon him rest My Glory, My Loving-Kindness, My Mercy, that have compassed the world.

input: اشراق هشتم
output: The eighth Ishráq

input: اینفقره از قلم اعلی در این حین مسطور و از کتاب اقدس محسوب.
output: This passage, now written by the Pen of Glory, is accounted as part of the Most Holy Book:

input: ایشانند امنآء الله بین عباده و مطالع الأمر فی بلاده.
output: They, in truth, are the Trustees of God among His servants and the daysprings of authority in His countries.

input: یا حزب الله.
output: O people of God.

input: مربّی عالم عدلست چه که دارای دو رکن است مجازات و مکافات.
output: That which traineth the world is Justice, for it is upheld by two pillars, reward and punishment.

input: و ایندو رکن دو چشمه اند از برای حیات اهل عالم
output: These two pillars are the sources of life to the world.

input: چون که هر روز را امری و هر حین را حکمتی مقتضی لذا امور به بیت عدل راجع تا آنچه را مصلحت وقت دانند معمول دارند.
output: Inasmuch as for each day there is a new problem and for every problem an expedient solution, such affairs should be referred to the House of Justice that the members thereof may act according to the needs and requirements of the time.

input: نفوسیکه لوجه الله بر خدمت امر قیام نمایند ایشان ملهمند بالهامات غیبی الهی.
output: They that, for the sake of God, arise to serve His Cause, are the recipients of divine inspiration from the unseen Kingdom.

input: بر کلّ اطاعت لازم.
output: It is incumbent upon all to be obedient unto them.

input: امور سیاسیّه کلّ راجع است به بیت عدل و عبادات به ما انزله الله فی الکتاب.
output: All matters of State should be referred to the House of Justice, but acts of worship must be observed according to that which God hath revealed in His Book.

input: یا اهل بها.
output: O people of Bahá.

input: شما مشارق محبّت و مطالع عنایت الهی بوده و هستید.
output: Ye are the dawning-places of the love of God and the daysprings of His loving-kindness.

input: لسان را بسبّ و لعن احدی میالائید و چشم را از آنچه لایق نیست حفظ نمائید.
output: Defile not your tongues with the cursing and reviling of any soul, and guard your eyes against that which is not seemly.

input: همه اوراق یک شجرید و قطره های یک بحر
output: Ye are all the leaves of one tree and the drops of one ocean.

input: اشراق نهم
output: The ninth Ishráq

input: دین الله و مذهب الله محض اتّحاد و اتّفاق اهل عالم از سماء مشیّت مالک قدم نازل گشته و ظاهر شده آنرا علّت اختلاف و نفاق مکنید.
output: The purpose of religion as revealed from the heaven of God's holy Will is to establish unity and concord amongst the peoples of the world. make it not the cause of dissension and strife.

input: سبب اعظم و علّت کبری از برای ظهور و اشراق نیّر اتّحاد دین الهی و شریعهٴ ربّانی بوده.
output: The religion of God and His divine law are the most potent instruments and the surest of all means for the dawning of the light of unity amongst men.

input: و نموّ عالم و تربیت امم و اطمینان عباد و راحت من فی البلاد از اصول و احکام الهی اوست.
output: The progress of the world, the development of nations, the tranquility of peoples, and the peace of all who dwell on earth are among the principles and ordinances of God.

input: سبب اعظم از برای این عطیّهٴ کبری کأس زندگانی بخشد و حیات باقیه عطا فرماید و نعمت سرمدیّه مبذول دارد.
output: Religion bestoweth upon man the most precious of all gifts, offereth the cup of prosperity, imparteth eternal life, and showereth imperishable benefits upon mankind.

input: رؤسای ارض مخصوص امنای بیت عدل الهی در صیانت این مقام و علوّ و حفظ آن جهد بلیغ مبذول دارند.
output: It behooveth the chiefs and rulers of the world, and in particular the Trustees of God's House of Justice, to endeavor to the utmost of their power to safeguard its position, promote its interests and exalt its station in the eyes of the world.

input: و همچنین آنچه لازمست تفحّص در احوال رعیّت و اطّلاع بر اعمال و امور هر حزبی از احزاب.
output: In like manner it is incumbent upon them to inquire into the conditions of their subjects and to acquaint themselves with the affairs and activities of the diverse communities in their dominions.

input: از مظاهر قدرت الهی یعنی ملوک و رؤسا میطلبم که همّت نمایند شاید اختلاف از میان برخیزد و آفاق بنور اتّفاق منوّر شود.
output: We call upon the manifestations of the power of God—the sovereigns and rulers on earth—to bestir themselves and do all in their power that haply they may banish discord from this world and illumine it with the light of concord.

input: باید کلّ بآنچه از قلم اعلی جاریشده تمسّک نمایند و عمل کنند.
output: It is incumbent upon everyone to firmly adhere to and observe that which hath streamed forth from Our Most Exalted Pen.

input: حقّ شاهد و ذرّات کائنات گواه که آنچه سبب علوّ و سموّ و تربیت و حفظ و تهذیب اهل ارض است ذکر نمودیم و از قلم اعلی در زبر و الواح نازل.
output: God, the True One, beareth Me witness, and every atom in existence is moved to testify that such means as lead to the elevation, the advancement, the education, the protection and the regeneration of the peoples of the earth have been clearly set forth by Us and are revealed in the Holy Books and Tablets by the Pen of Glory.

input: از حقّ میطلبیم عباد را تأیید فرماید.
output: We entreat God to graciously aid His servants.

input: آنچه این مظلوم از کلّ طلب مینماید عدل و انصافست.
output: What this Wronged One doth expect from everyone is justice and fairness.

input: باصغا اکتفا ننمایند در آنچه از اینمظلوم ظاهر شده تفکّر کنند.
output: Let no one be content with mere hearing.rather doth it behoove everyone to ponder that which this Wronged One hath revealed.

input: قسم بآفتاب بیان که از افق سماء ملکوت رحمن اشراق نموده اگر مبیّنی مشاهده میشد و یا ناطقی خود را محلّ شماتت و استهزا و مفتریات عباد نمی‌ نمودیم
output: I swear by the Daystar of utterance, shining above the horizon of the Kingdom of the All-Merciful, had there been any expounder or speaker discernible, We would not have made Ourself the object of the censure, ridicule and slander of the people.

input: حین ورود عراق امر الله مخمود و نفحات وحی مقطوع.
output: Upon Our arrival in 'Iráq We found the Cause of God sunk in deep apathy and the breeze of divine revelation stilled.

input: اکثری پژمرده بل مرده مشاهده گشتند.
output: Most of the believers were faint and dispirited, nay utterly lost and dead.

input: لذا در صور مرّةً اخری دمیده شد. و اینکلمهٴ مبارکه از لسان عظمت جاری
output: Hence there was a second blast on the Trumpet, whereupon the Tongue of Grandeur uttered these blessed words:

input: نفخنا فی الصّور مرّة اخری.
output: We have sounded the Trumpet for the second time.

input: آفاقرا از نفحات وحی و الهام زنده نمودیم.
output: Thus the whole world was quickened through the vitalizing breaths of divine revelation and inspiration.

input: حال از خلف هر حجابی نفوسی بقصد مظلوم بیرون دویده
output: Certain souls have now sallied forth from behind the veils, intent on inflicting harm upon this Wronged One.

input: این نعمت کبری را منع کردند و انکار نمودند.
output: They have hindered and denied the outpouring of this priceless bounty.

input: ای اهل انصاف.
output: O ye that judge with fairness.

input: اگر این امر انکار شود کدام امر در ارض قابل اثبات است و یا لایق اقرار.
output: If this Cause is to be denied then what other cause in this world can be vindicated or deemed worthy of acceptance.

input: معرضین در صدد جمع آیات اینظهور برآمده اند و نزد هر که یافته‌اند باظهار محبّت اخذ کرده‌ اند.
output: Such as have turned away from the Cause of God are diligently seeking to collect the Holy Writings of this Revelation. and they have already, through gestures of friendship, managed to secure certain of these Writings from those who held them in their possession.

input: و نزد هر مذهبی از مذاهب خود را از آن مذهب میشمرند.
output: Moreover, when they meet the followers of any religion, they hold themselves out as believers therein.

input: قل موتوا بغیظکم.
output: Say, die ye in your wrath.

input: انّه اتی بأمر لا ینکره ذو بصر و ذو سمع و ذو درایة و ذو عدل و ذو انصاف.
output: Verily He hath appeared with so great an authority that no man of vision, of hearing, of insight, of justice or of equity can ever deny Him.

input: یشهد بذلک قلم القدم فی هذا الحین المبین.
output: Unto this beareth witness in this resplendent Hour the Pen of Him Who is the Ancient of Days.

input: علیک بهائی.
output: Upon thee be My glory.

input: اولیای حقّ را باعمال امر مینمائیم شاید موفّق شوند و بآنچه از سماء امر نازلشده عمل نمایند.
output: We exhort the loved ones of God to perform good deeds that perchance they may be graciously assisted and may hold fast to that which hath been sent down from the heaven of His Revelation.

input: نفع بیان رحمن بنفوس عامله راجع.
output: The benefits arising from this divine utterance shall fall upon such as observe His precepts.

input: نسأل الله ان یؤیّدهم علی ما یحبّ و یرضی و یوفّقهم علی العدل و الانصاف فی هذا الأمر المبرم و یعرّفهم آیاته و یهدیهم الی صراطه المستقیم.
output: We beseech God to enable them to do that which is pleasing and acceptable unto Him, to grant that they may deal equitably and may observe justice in this all-compelling Cause, to acquaint them with His Holy Writings and to direct their steps towards His straight Path.

input: حضرت مبشّر روح ما سواه فداه احکامی نازل فرموده اند
output: Our Exalted Herald—may the life of all else besides Him be offered up for His sake—hath revealed certain laws.

input: ولکن عالم امر معلّق بود بقبول لذا این مظلوم بعضی را اجرا نمود و در کتاب اقدس بعبارات اخری نازل.
output: However, in the realm of His Revelation these laws were made subject to Our sanction, hence this Wronged One hath put some of them into effect by embodying them in the Kitáb-i-Aqdas in different words.

input: و در بعضی توقّف نمودیم.
output: Others We set aside.

input: الأمر بیده.
output: He holdeth in His hand the authority.

input: و هو العزیز الحمید.
output: He is the Almighty, the All-Praised.

input: و بعضی از احکام هم بدعاً نازل.
output: There are also ordinances newly revealed.

input: باید حزب الله جهد بلیغ مبذول دارند که شاید نار ضغینه و بغضا که در صدور احزاب مکنونست بکوثر بیان و نصایح مقصود عالمیان ساکن شود و اشجار وجود باثمار بدیعهٴ منیعه مزیّن گردد.
output: The people of God should make the utmost endeavor that perchance the fire of hatred and malice which smoldereth in the breasts of kindreds and peoples may, through the living waters of utterance and the exhortations of Him Who is the Desire of the world, be quenched and the trees of human existence may be adorned with wondrous and excellent fruit.

input: انّه هو النّاصح المشفق الکریم.
output: He is, in truth, the Admonisher, the Compassionate, the All-Bountiful.

input: البهآء اللّائح المشرق من افق سمآء العطآء علیکم یا اهل البهآء و علی کلّ ثابت مستقیم و کلّ راسخ علیم.
output: May the brightness of His glory shining above the horizon of bounty rest upon you, O people of Bahá, upon every one who standeth firm and steadfast and upon those that are well grounded in the Faith and are endued with true understanding.

input: اینکه سؤال از منافع و ربح ذهب و فضّه شده بود چند سنهٴ قبل مخصوص اسم الله زین المقرّبین علیه بهآء الله الأبهی این بیان از ملکوت رحمن ظاهر
output: As to thy question concerning interest and profit on gold and silver: Some years ago the following passage was revealed from the heaven of the All-Merciful in honor of the one who beareth the name of God, entitled Zaynu'l-Muqarrabín—upon him be the glory of the Most Glorious.

input: قوله تعالی اکثری از ناس محتاج باینفقره مشاهده میشوند.
output: He—exalted be His Word—saith: Many people stand in need of this.

input: چه اگر ربحی در میان نباشد امور معطّل و معوّق خواهد ماند.
output: Because if there were no prospect for gaining interest, the affairs of men would suffer collapse or dislocation.

input: نفسیکه موفّق شود با هم جنس خود و یا هم‌ وطن خود و یا برادر خود مدارا نماید و یا مراعات کند یعنی بدادن قرض الحسن کمیابست.
output: One can seldom find a person who would manifest such consideration towards his fellow-man, his countryman or towards his own brother and would show such tender solicitude for him as to be well-disposed to grant him a loan on benevolent terms.

input: لذا فضلاً علی العباد ربا را مثل معاملات دیگر که مابین ناس متداولست قرار فرمودیم.
output: Therefore as a token of favor towards men We have prescribed that interest on money should be treated like other business transactions that are current amongst men.

input: یعنی ربح نقود از این حین که اینحکم مبین از سماء مشیّت نازلشد حلال و طیّب و طاهر است تا اهل ارض بکمال روح و ریحان و فرح و انبساط بذکر محبوب عالمیان مشغول باشند.
output: Thus, now that this lucid commandment hath descended from the heaven of the Will of God, it is lawful and proper to charge interest on money, that the people of the world may, in a spirit of amity and fellowship and with joy and gladness, devotedly engage themselves in magnifying the Name of Him Who is the Well-Beloved of all mankind.

input: انّه یحکم کیف یشآء.
output: Verily He ordaineth according to His Own choosing.

input: و احلّ الرّبا کما حرّمه من قبل.
output: He hath now made interest on money lawful, even as He had made it unlawful in the past.

input: فی قبضته ملکوت الأمر.
output: Within His grasp He holdeth the kingdom of authority.

input: یفعل و یأمر.
output: He doeth and ordaineth.

input: و هو الآمر العلیم.
output: He is in truth the Ordainer, the All-Knowing.

input: یا زین المقرّبین اشکر ربّک بهذا الفضل المبین.
output: Render thou thanks unto thy Lord, O Zaynu'l-Muqarrabín, for this manifest bounty.

input: علمای ایران اکثری بصدهزار حیله و خدعه باکل ربا مشغول بودند.
output: Many ecclesiastics in Persia have, through innumerable designs and devices, been feeding on illicit gains obtained by usury.

input: ولکن ظاهر آنرا بگمان خود بطراز حلّیّت آراسته مینمودند.
output: They have contrived ways to give its outward form a fair semblance of lawfulness.

input: یلعبون بأوامر الله و احکامه و لا یشعرون.
output: They make a plaything of the laws and ordinances of God, but they understand not.

input: ولکن باید این امر باعتدال و انصاف واقع شود.
output: However, this is a matter that should be practiced with moderation and fairness.

input: قلم اعلی در تحدید آن توقّف نموده حکمة من عنده و وسعة لعباده.
output: Our Pen of Glory hath, as a token of wisdom and for the convenience of the people, desisted from laying down its limit.

input: و نوصی اولیآء الله بالعدل و الانصاف و ما یظهر به رحمة احبّائه و شفقتهم بینهم.
output: Nevertheless We exhort the loved ones of God to observe justice and fairness, and to do that which would prompt the friends of God to evince tender mercy and compassion towards each other.

input: انشآءالله کلّ مؤیّد شوند بر آنچه از لسان حقّ جاریشده.
output: God grant that all men may be graciously aided to observe that which the Tongue of the One true God hath uttered.

input: و اگر آنچه ذکر شد عمل نمایند البتّه حقّ جلّ جلاله از سماء فضل ضعف آنرا عطا میفرماید.
output: And if they put into practice what We have set forth, God—exalted be His glory—will assuredly double their portion through the heaven of His bounty.

input: انّه هو الفضّال الغفور الرّحیم.
output: Verily He is the Generous, the Forgiving, the Compassionate.

input: الحمد لله العلیّ العظیم.
output: Praise be unto God, the Most Exalted, the Most Great.

input: ولکن اجرای این امور برجال بیت عدل محوّل شده تا بمقتضیات وقت و حکمت عمل نمایند.
output: Nevertheless the conduct of these affairs hath been entrusted to the men of the House of Justice that they may enforce them according to the exigencies of the time and the dictates of wisdom.

input: مجدّد کلّ را وصیّت مینمائیم بعدل و انصاف و محبّت و رضا.
output: Once again We exhort all believers to observe justice and fairness and to show forth love and contentment.

input: انّهم اهل البهآء و اصحاب السّفینة الحمرآء.
output: They are indeed the people of Bahá, the companions of the Crimson Ark.

input: علیهم سلام الله مولی الأسمآء و فاطر السّمآء.
output: Upon them be the peace of God, the Lord of all Names, the Creator of the heavens.

input: هو النّاطق بالحقّ فی ملکوت البیان
output: He is the One Who speaketh through the power of Truth in the Kingdom of Utterance

input: یا مشارق العدل و الانصاف و مطالع الصّدق و الألطاف!
output: O ye the embodiments of justice and equity and the manifestations of uprightness and of heavenly bounties!

input: انّ المظلوم یبکی و یقول ینوح و ینادی الهی الهی زیّن رؤوس اولیائک باکلیل الانقطاع و هیاکلهم بطراز التّقوی.
output: In tears and lamenting, this Wronged One calleth aloud and saith: O God, my God! Adorn the heads of Thy loved ones with the crown of detachment and attire their temples with the raiment of righteousness.

input: ینبغی لأهل البهآء ان ینصروا الرّبّ ببیانهم و یعظوا النّاس بأعمالهم و اخلاقهم اثر الأعمال انفذ من اثر الأقوال.
output: It behooveth the people of Bahá to render the Lord victorious through the power of their utterance and to admonish the people by their goodly deeds and character, inasmuch as deeds exert greater influence than words.

input: یا حیدر قبل علی!
output: O Haydar-'Alí!

input: علیک ثنآء الله و بهائه.
output: Upon thee be the praise of God and His glory.

input: قل انّ الانسان یرتفع بأمانته و عفّته و عقله و اخلاقه و یهبط بخیانته و کذبه و جهله و نفاقه.
output: Say: Honesty, virtue, wisdom and a saintly character redound to the exaltation of man, while dishonesty, imposture, ignorance and hypocrisy lead to his abasement. By My life!

input: لعمری لا یسمو الانسان بالزّینة و الثّروة بل بالآداب و المعرفة.
output: By My life! Man's distinction lieth not in ornaments or wealth, but rather in virtuous behavior and true understanding.

input: اهل ایران اکثری بکذب و ظنون تربیت شده‌اند.
output: Most of the people in Persia are steeped in deception and idle fancy.

input: کجاست مقام آن نفوس و مقام رجالی که از خلیج اسماء گذشته‌اند و بر شاطی بحر تقدیس خرگاه افراشته‌اند.
output: How great the difference between the condition of these people and the station of such valiant souls as have passed beyond the sea of names and pitched their tents upon the shores of the ocean of detachment.

input: باری نفوس موجوده لایق اصغاء تغرّدات حمامات فردوس اعلی نبوده و نیستند مگر قلیلی.
output: Indeed none but a few of the existing generation hath yet earned the merit of hearkening unto the warblings of the doves of the all-highest Paradise.

input: و قلیل من عبادی الشّکور.
output: Few of My servants are truly thankful.

input: اکثری از عباد باوهام انس دارند.
output: People for the most part delight in superstitions.

input: یک قطره از دریای وهم را بر بحر ایقان ترجیح میدهند.
output: They regard a single drop of the sea of delusion as preferable to an ocean of certitude.

input: از معنی محروم باسم متمسّکند و از مشرق آیات الهی ممنوع و بظنون متشبّث.
output: By holding fast unto names they deprive themselves of the inner reality and by clinging to vain imaginings they are kept back from the Dayspring of heavenly signs.

input: انشآءالله آن جناب در جمیع احوال مؤیّد باشند بر کسر اصنام اوهام و خرق سبحات انام.
output: God grant you may be graciously aided under all conditions to shatter the idols of superstition and to tear away the veils of the imaginations of men.

input: الأمر بید الله مظهر الوحی و الالهام و مالک یوم القیام.
output: Authority lieth in the grasp of God, the Fountainhead of revelation and inspiration and the Lord of the Day of Resurrection.

input: آنچه جناب مذکور در بارهٴ بعضی از مبلّغین ذکر نموده اصغا شد.
output: We heard that which the person in question hath mentioned regarding certain teachers of the Faith.

input: قد نطق بالحقّ.
output: Indeed he hath spoken truly.

input: بعضی از نفوس غافله در بلاد باسم حقّ سائرند و بتضییع امرش مشغول و اسم آن را نصرت و تبلیغ گذاشته‌اند مع آنکه انجم شرائط مبلّغین از آفاق سموات الواح الهی مشرق و لائح.
output: Some heedless souls roam the lands in the name of God, actively engaged in ruining His Cause, and call it promoting and teaching the Word of God; and this notwithstanding that the qualifications of the teachers of the Faith, like unto stars, shine resplendent throughout the heavens of the divine Tablets.

input: هر منصفی گواه و هر بصیری آگاه که حقّ جلّ جلاله در لیالی و ایّام بآنچه سبب ارتفاع مقامات و مراتب انسان است تکلّم فرموده و تعلیم نموده.
output: Every fair-minded person testifieth and every man of insight is well aware that the One true God—exalted be His glory—hath unceasingly set forth and expounded that which will elevate the station and will exalt the rank of the children of men.

input: اهل بها چون شمع مابین جمع مشرق و لائحند و بارادة الله متمسّک.
output: The people of Bahá burn brightly amidst the gatherings even as a candle and hold fast unto that which God hath purposed.

input: این مقام مالک مقامهاست.
output: This station standeth supreme above all stations.

input: طوبی لمن نبذ ما عند العالم رجآء ما عند الله مالک القدم.
output: Well is it with him who hath cast away the things that the people of the world possess, yearning for that which pertaineth unto God, the Sovereign Lord of eternity.

input: قل الهی الهی ترانی طائفاً حول ارادتک و ناظراً الی افق جودک و منتظراً تجلّیات انوار نیّر عطائک.
output: Say: O God, my God! Thou beholdest me circling round Thy Will with mine eyes turned towards the horizon of Thy bounty, eagerly awaiting the revelation of the effulgent splendors of the sun of Thy favors.

input: اسألک یا محبوب افئدة العارفین و مقصود المقرّبین ان تجعل اولیائک منقطعین عن اراداتهم متمسّکین بارادتک.
output: I beg of Thee, O Beloved of every understanding heart and the Desire of such as have near access unto Thee, to grant that Thy loved ones may become wholly detached from their own inclinations, holding fast unto that which pleaseth Thee.

input: ای ربّ زیّنهم بطراز التّقوی و نوّرهم بنور الانقطاع ثمّ ایّدهم بجنود الحکمة و البیان لاعلآء کلمتک بین خلقک و اظهار امرک بین عبادک.
output: Attire them, O Lord, with the robe of righteousness and illumine them with the splendors of the light of detachment. Summon then to their assistance the hosts of wisdom and utterance that they may exalt Thy Word amongst Thy creatures and proclaim Thy Cause amidst Thy servants.

input: انّک انت المقتدر علی ما تشآء و فی قبضتک زمام الأمور.
output: Verily, potent art Thou to do what Thou willest, and within Thy grasp lie the reins of all affairs.

input: لا اله الّا انت العزیز الغفور.
output: No God is there but Thee, the Mighty, the Ever-Forgiving.

input: یا ایّها النّاظر الی الوجه!
output: O thou who hast turned thy gaze towards My face!

input: این ایّام وارد شد آنچه که سبب حزن اکبر گشت.
output: In these days there occurred that which hath plunged Me into dire sadness.

input: از بعضی از ظالمین که خود را بحقّ نسبت میدهند ظاهر شد آنچه که فرائص صدق و امانت و عدل و انصاف مرتعد.
output: Certain wrong-doers who profess allegiance to the Cause of God committed such deeds as have caused the limbs of sincerity, of honesty, of justice, of equity to quake.

input: مع آنکه کمال عنایت و عطا در بارهٴ شخص معلوم ظاهر و مجری گشت عمل نمود آنچه را که عین الله گریست.
output: One known individual to whom the utmost kindness and favor had been extended perpetrated such acts as have brought tears to the eye of God.

input: و از قبل ذکر شد آنچه که سبب آگاهی و انتباه است چند سنه ستر نمودیم که شاید متنبّه شود و راجع گردد.
output: Formerly We uttered words of warning and premonition, then for a number of years We kept the matter secret that haply he might take heed and repent.

input: اثری ظاهر نه.
output: But all to no purpose.

input: بالأخره امام وجوه خلق بر تضییع امر الله قیام نمود.
output: In the end he bent his energies upon vilifying the Cause of God before the eyes of all men.

input: ستر انصاف را درید نه رحم بر خود و نه بر امر الله نمود.
output: He tore the veil of fairness asunder and felt sympathy neither for himself nor for the Cause of God.

input: حال حزن اعمال بعض دیگر بر حزن اعمال او غلبه نموده.
output: Now, however, the deeds of certain individuals have brought sorrows far more grievous than those which the deeds of the former had caused.

input: از حقّ بطلب نفوس غافله را تأیید فرماید بر رجوع و انابه.
output: Beseech thou God, the True One, that He may graciously enable the heedless to retract and repent.

input: انّه هو الغفّار و هو الفضّال الکریم.
output: Verily He is the Forgiving, the Bountiful, the Most Generous.

input: این ایّام باید کل باتّحاد و اتّفاق تمسّک نمایند و بنصرت امر الله مشغول گردند که شاید نفوس غافله فائز شوند بآنچه که سبب رستگاری ابدیست.
output: In these days it is incumbent upon everyone to adhere tenaciously unto unity and concord and to labor diligently in promoting the Cause of God, that perchance the wayward souls may attain that which will lead unto abiding prosperity.

input: باری اختلاف احزاب سبب و علّت ضعف شده.
output: In brief, dissensions among various sects have opened the way to weakness.

input: هر حزبی راهی اخذ نموده و بحبلی تمسّک جسته.
output: Each sect hath picked out a way for itself and is clinging to a certain cord.

input: مع کوری و نادانی خود را صاحب بصر و علم میدانند.
output: Despite manifest blindness and ignorance they pride themselves on their insight and knowledge.

input: از جمله عرفای ملّت اسلام بعضی از آن نفوس متشبّثند بآنچه که سبب کسالت و انزواست.
output: Among them are mystics who bear allegiance to the Faith of Islám, some of whom indulge in that which leadeth to idleness and seclusion.

input: لعمر الله از مقام بکاهد و بر غرور بیفزاید.
output: I swear by God! It lowereth man's station and maketh him swell with pride.

input: از انسان باید ثمری پدید آید.
output: Man must bring forth fruit.

input: انسان بی‌ثمر بفرمودهٴ حضرت روح بمثابهٴ شجر بی‌ثمر است و شجر بی‌ثمر لائق نار.
output: One who yieldeth no fruit is, in the words of the Spirit, like unto a fruitless tree, and a fruitless tree is fit but for the fire.

input: آن نفوس در مقامات توحید ذکر نموده‌اند آنچه را که سبب اعظم است از برای ظهور کسالت و اوهام عباد.
output: That which the aforesaid persons have mentioned concerning the stations of Divine Unity will conduce in no small measure to idleness and vain imaginings.

input: فی‌الحقیقه فرق را برداشته‌اند و خود را حقّ پنداشته‌اند حقّ مقدّس است از کل.
output: These mortal men have evidently set aside the differences of station and have come to regard themselves as God, while God is immeasurably exalted above all things.

input: در کل آیات او ظاهر آیات از اوست نه او در.
output: Every created being however revealeth His signs which are but emanations from Him and not His Own Self.

input: دفتر دنیا کل مذکور و مشهود نقش عالم کتابیست اعظم.
output: All these signs are reflected and can be seen in the book of existence, and the scrolls that depict the shape and pattern of the universe are indeed a most great book.

input: هر صاحب بصری ادراک مینماید آنچه را که سبب وصول بصراط مستقیم و نبأ عظیم است.
output: Therein every man of insight can perceive that which would lead to the Straight Path and would enable him to attain the Great Announcement.

input: در تجلّیات آفتاب مشاهده نمائید انوارش عالم را احاطه نموده ولکن تجلّیات از او و ظهور اوست بنفس او نه نفس او.
output: Consider the rays of the sun whose light hath encompassed the world. The rays emanate from the sun and reveal its nature, but are not the sun itself.

input: آنچه در ارض مشاهده میشود حاکی از قدرت و علم و فضل اوست و او مقدّس از کل.
output: Whatsoever can be discerned on earth amply demonstrateth the power of God, His knowledge and the outpourings of His bounty, while He Himself is immeasurably exalted above all creatures.
